Partner Strategy & Analytics team strives to impact partners by supporting internal stakeholders with data-driven strategic insights and recommendations Trust thought partnership with internal leaders is another key success indicator as a Manager of Strategy & Analytics Experience That Matters Most 5+ years’ experience in an analytical or strategy leadership role (strategy, business analytics, business operations, corporate finance, business transformation) and/or in a professional services organization (consulting, private equity, investment banking) Strong proficiency in Databricks and advanced SQL, including CTE structuring, query performance optimization, and fundamental window functions, with foundational knowledge of data governance and data engineering principles. title: Senior Organic Analytics Manager
jd_text: Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com. The Impact You Will Make This role helps Risepoint understand how organic discovery, AI search, and the digital experience contribute to student demand and enrollment. The Senior Manager, Organic Analytics will lead day-to-day analytical work across SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), website/DXP performance, and the organic funnel. By connecting visibility and website behavior to leads, applications, and enrollments, this person will help the organization understand what happened, why it happened, where it is concentrated, and what actions should follow. How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life The Senior Manager, Organic Analytics is the primary day-to-day analytics partner for SEO, AEO, organic content, and DXP/CRO measurement within Channel Analytics. Working under the direction of the Sr. Director, Channel Analytics, this person leads analytical execution, develops measurement approaches, defines business and reporting requirements, conducts deep-dive analyses, and translates findings into clear recommendations. They partner closely with Analytics Solutions, which develops production dashboards, as well as SEO/AEO, Digital Experience, CRO, CRM, Data Engineering, and other analytics stakeholders. The role measures and evaluates organic strategy; it does not own SEO/content execution. What You Will Do • Lead monthly Organic MBR analysis and recurring performance diagnosis across SEO, AEO, website/DXP, and the organic funnel, including traffic, leads, applications/enrollments where available, conversion, YoY/MoM drivers, where performance is concentrated, opportunities, and risks. • Analyze SEO performance using GA4, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms, including impressions, clicks, CTR, rankings/visibility, branded vs. non-branded demand where useful, landing-page/content performance, and where performance gains or declines are concentrated. • Lead AEO measurement across AI visibility, citations, Citation Share/Share of Voice, prompts/topics, engine-level performance, AI referral traffic, competitive/source analysis, and downstream outcomes; partner with Profound or similar platform data as available. • Design measurement for AEO, SEO, DXP, and CRO initiatives by establishing baselines, intervention dates, comparison groups or matched controls where appropriate, and post-launch reads; evaluate uncertainty, confounding, and whether observed changes are reasonably attributable to the intervention. • Measure website and funnel performance from organic/AI discovery through landing-page behavior, forms, leads, applications, and enrollments; distinguish traffic-driven changes from conversion-driven changes and evaluate DXP migrations, site releases, and CRO changes. • Reconcile GA4/GSC/SEO/AEO/CRM data, investigate material Organic performance changes, identify tracking or taxonomy issues before results reach leadership, and translate findings into 2–4 decision-ready insights rather than metric dumps. • Define KPI logic, reporting requirements, analytical views, intervention/change logs, and data-quality needs; partner with Antonio/Analytics Solutions and Data Engineering to bring GA4, GSC, AEO platform, Salesforce, and intervention data into scalable reporting and Databricks-based workflows rather than relying on manual Excel processes. What Success Looks Like • Organic MBR analysis is delivered with clear drivers, concentrations, business implications, and recommended actions, allowing the Sr. Director to review and sharpen the story rather than perform the first-pass analysis. • SEO, AEO, and DXP performance can be connected from visibility and search demand through website behavior, leads, applications, and enrollments, with known data limitations clearly documented. • AEO reporting moves from manual snapshots toward a scalable history and measurement process with clear hero metrics, engine-level views, prompt/topic and URL-level analysis, intervention tracking, and credible post-launch reads. • Material Organic, content, and website changes can be diagnosed quickly, including whether movement reflects demand, visibility, traffic quality, conversion, tracking, taxonomy, or maturation effects. • The Senior Manager becomes the primary day-to-day analytics partner for Organic, AEO, and Digital Experience stakeholders, increasing Channel Analytics capacity while the Sr. Director retains overall strategy, prioritization, and cross-channel accountability. How Impact Will be Measured • Reliability, adoption, and usefulness of Organic MBR analysis and recurring SEO, AEO, DXP/CRO, and funnel reporting. • Quality of business requirements, KPI definitions, analytical specifications, and data QA provided to Analytics Solutions and Data Engineering. • Improved visibility into organic traffic quality, search/content effectiveness, AI-search performance, website conversion, and progression through application and enrollment. • Quality and credibility of pilot, test, migration, and rollout measurement, including appropriate treatment of baselines, comparison groups, intervention timing, uncertainty, and confounding. • Clarity and actionability of recommendations and evidence that insights influence SEO/AEO, content, DXP/CRO, partner, and prioritization decisions. • Reduction in repetitive manual analysis and stakeholder confidence in the Organic analytics story presented to leadership. What You’ll Bring to the Team Experience & Skills That Matter Most (Required) • 6+ years of hands-on experience in digital/web analytics, organic/SEO analytics, marketing analytics, or a closely related data-driven environment, with demonstrated strength diagnosing performance rather than only producing reports. • Advanced SQL skills and the ability to independently pull, join, QA, and investigate complex web, marketing, and CRM datasets in cloud data environments. • Strong analytical proficiency with GA4 and Google Search Console plus working knowledge of SEO data/tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, or equivalent; understand traffic sources, landing pages, events, funnels, rankings/visibility, queries, content performance, and technical SEO concepts. • Strong funnel analytics skills, including the ability to connect sessions and website behavior to leads, applications, enrollments, conversion rates, cohort/maturation considerations, and known attribution or identity-resolution limitations. • Strong analytical diagnosis, data QA, and executive storytelling skills: identify whether unusual results are real or caused by tracking/taxonomy issues and translate findings into what happened, why, where it is concentrated, and what should happen next. • Experience defining KPI logic, business requirements, and reporting specifications for BI/Analytics Solutions teams; strong Excel skills and enough data-visualization fluency to design useful reporting without being the production dashboard developer. • Working knowledge of experimentation and causal measurement concepts, including pre/post design, control or matched-comparison groups, confounding, uncertainty/statistical significance, and the limits of correlation; deep experimental-design expertise is not required. Experience That’s Great to Have (Preferred) • AEO/generative-search literacy, including citations vs. mentions, prompts and prompt themes, AI visibility/Share of Voice, source attribution, branded vs. non-branded prompts, engine differences, AI referrals, zero-click/offsite discovery, and experience with Profound, Ahrefs Brand Radar, Semrush AI visibility tools, or similar platforms. • Deeper experimentation/causal-inference experience, including matched controls, difference-in-differences, natural experiments, incrementality, or rollout measurement; Python or R experience for large-scale prompt/citation analysis, URL classification, topic clustering, or competitor analysis is also valuable. • Experience with Databricks, BigQuery, Snowflake, Salesforce data, Power BI, GSC/API data, web scraping/log-file analysis, DXP/CRO teams, or higher-education/high-consideration lead-generation environments. Risepoint is an equal-opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce.

Position Summary The Sr. Manager, CE Financial Business Planning & Operations will lead financial forecasting, business planning, supply chain financial alignment, and analytics for the full CE eCommerce portfolio — including VD (TV, Audio, Monitor) and DA (Refrigerator, Laundry, Cooking, Dishwasher) — and will model the financial impact of CE's Expansion Commerce channel launches. title: PMO Senior Project Manager
jd_text: Our associates celebrate lives. We celebrate our associates. The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing a portfolio of complex, large-scale projects spanning one or more areas of the business. This position manages resources, schedules, financials, risks, issues, dependencies, and project change requests while adhering to PMO governance and stage-gate quality control guidelines throughout the full project life cycle. The Senior Project Manager leads projects using traditional, Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery approaches based on the needs of the initiative. The role partners with business and technical teams to improve processes, strengthen data quality and governance, support organizational readiness, and ensure projects deliver measurable business outcomes. The Senior Project Manager has the authority to manage assigned projects on a day-to-day basis and verify that each project produces the required deliverables at the expected level of quality, within approved time and cost constraints, and achieves the potential benefits defined in the business case. Job Responsibilities Project & Portfolio Leadership Manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional projects and programs from initiation through implementation and closure. Partner with business stakeholders to develop project business cases, charters, benefit assumptions, success measures, and project approval documentation. Develop and maintain project plans, budgets, schedules, risk mitigation strategies, and governance processes. Manage project scope, change control, prioritization, and governance processes to ensure alignment with business objectives and approved business cases. Provide leadership and direction to project teams while ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives. Deliver executive-level reporting on milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, financial performance, and project outcomes. Ensure expected business outcomes and benefits are achieved through effective planning, execution, adoption, measurement, and transition to operational ownership. Agile & Scrum Delivery Lead or support projects utilizing Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies. Facilitate Agile planning, prioritization, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and continuous improvement activities. Partner with business and technical teams to manage delivery roadmaps, backlogs, and project priorities. Promote collaboration, accountability, and efficient delivery of business value. Select and apply the most appropriate delivery methodology based on project complexity, stakeholder needs, and organizational objectives. Data Management & Reporting Support data governance, data quality, reporting, and portfolio management initiatives. Develop dashboards, metrics, and reporting tools that provide actionable insights to leadership. Ensure project and portfolio information is maintained accurately within enterprise systems. Identify opportunities to improve data integrity, reporting effectiveness, and decision-making. Analyze trends, performance metrics, and project data to support informed business decisions. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence Lead process improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes. Partner with stakeholders to assess current-state processes and implement sustainable improvements. Apply continuous improvement principles to optimize project delivery and operational effectiveness. Support adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working across the organization. Facilitate process assessments, root cause analysis, and workflow optimization activities. Stakeholder & Vendor Management Build strong relationships with executives, business leaders, technical teams, vendors, and project sponsors. Lead and facilitate project governance, steering committee, executive leadership, and stakeholder meetings to drive decision-making and alignment. Lead vendor evaluation, RFP, demonstration, selection, contracting, implementation, and delivery management activities as required. Collaborate with Change Management resources to support organizational readiness, training, communications, and adoption. Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment between project objectives and business priorities. PMO Leadership Contribute to PMO standards, governance, reporting, methodologies, and best practices. Mentor team members and promote effective project management and Agile delivery techniques. Stay current on emerging project management, Agile, reporting, data management, and process improvement practices. Positively represent and market PMO services across the organization. Support continuous improvement of PMO processes, tools, and service offerings. Minimum Requirements Education Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Information Systems, Data Management, Marketing, or a related field. Certification or License PMP certification required. Agile, Scrum, Lean, Six Sigma, or Process Improvement certification preferred. Experience Eight (8) years of experience managing complex projects, programs, or portfolios. Experience leading cross-functional, multi-workstream initiatives from initiation through implementation and closure. Demonstrated experience using traditional, Agile, Scrum, or hybrid project delivery methodologies. Experience supporting data management, reporting, data governance, or data quality improvement initiatives. Experience leading business process improvement, workflow optimization, or operational excellence efforts. Experience managing project governance, executive steering committees, business case development, scope management, change control, and benefits realization. Experience partnering with senior leaders, business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and Change Management professionals. Experience working with Marketing teams or supporting Marketing initiatives is a plus. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Proven ability to partner and collaborate across multiple business and technical areas to achieve common objectives. Strong working knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management principles. Working knowledge of Agile and Scrum principles, roles, ceremonies, artifacts, and delivery practices. Ability to facilitate Agile ceremonies and support backlog, user story, sprint, release, and roadmap management. Ability to select and apply Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery approaches based on project needs. Knowledge of data management, data governance, data quality, reporting, and data integrity principles. Ability to analyze data, identify trends or inconsistencies, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Experience developing dashboards, reports, metrics, and executive-level presentations. Knowledge of process assessment, process mapping, root cause analysis, workflow design, and continuous improvement techniques. Ability to document current-state and future-state processes and develop sustainable implementation plans. Demonstrated ability to develop business cases, perform cost-benefit analyses, and measure realization of projected business outcomes. Ability to train and mentor others on effective project management and delivery techniques. Awareness of emerging project management, Agile, data management, and process improvement trends. Thorough working knowledge of vendor management processes, with proven ability to lead projects through vendor evaluation, selection, contracting, and implementation. Sound judgment and decisiveness in resolving business problems, making decisions, and identifying priorities. Strong financial management and analytical skills. Effective time management and ability to manage multiple complex priorities simultaneously. Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and presentation skills. Excellent critical thinking, problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict management skills. Strong diplomacy and influence skills, with the ability to gain alignment without direct authority. Excellent team leadership and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to influence and lead organizational change with a continuous improvement mindset. Proficiency with project planning and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint. Knowledge of enterprise-level project and portfolio management tools, including portfolio management, dashboard and report creation, resource optimization, integrations, and data management. Knowledge of Sales, Marketing, and Operations processes, business technology platforms, customer engagement strategies, performance metrics, and process improvement practices is a plus. Knowledge of Organizational Change Management principles and practices is a plus. Ability to travel to delivery centers or field locations as required. Work Conditions Work indoors during all seasons and weather conditions. Some local and/or multiple-location travel may be required. Professional dress is required. Physical Requirements Sitting continuously for extended periods of time. Climbing stairs to access buildings as needed. Physical effort requiring manual dexterity, including use of computers, phones, and other office equipment. Working beyond standard business hours as business needs require. Postal Code: 77019 Category (Portal Searching): Administration and Clerical Job Location: US-TX - Houston

title: Principal Product Manager
jd_text: <p><strong>About us:</strong></p> <p class="gmail_quote"><a href="http://kiva.org/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://kiva.org&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1689704734241000&amp;usg=AOvVaw2mDNVP5uDuhsIuI8U0b5Qf">Kiva</a> is a global nonprofit, founded in 2005, with a mission to expand financial access and help underserved communities thrive. Kiva unlocks capital for borrowers through crowdfunded loans supported by individuals around the world. Lenders on Kiva can start with as little as $25 to support causes that matter most to them, whether that’s gender equity and support for women, refugees, climate change, small businesses, agriculture, and more. Since our founding, over two million people have invested&nbsp;<strong data-stringify-type="bold">over $2 billion</strong>&nbsp;in real dreams and real opportunity, spanning more than&nbsp;<strong data-stringify-type="bold">100 countries</strong>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<strong data-stringify-type="bold">over 5 million</strong>&nbsp;borrowers</p> <p class="gmail_quote">As we work toward our mission, Kiva invests in building and retaining a global team of talent to add to our values-driven and digital-first culture. Our organization is supported by over 700 volunteers and 130+ full time employees dispersed around the world, as well as within team hubs located in San Francisco, Nairobi, Bogota, and Bangkok. Kiva’s team is growing as we pursue exciting new opportunities to scale our impact and create a financially inclusive world.</p> <h4><strong>Kiva's values:</strong></h4> <p>Impact first - This is why we exist. This is the drumbeat we march to. Every day.</p> <p>Extreme ownership - Own it; you, your relationships, your impact. Insist that others support you and hold you accountable.</p> <p>Be curious and bold - Never stop learning. Question assumptions. Take Risks and dream big.</p> <p>Inclusion. Equity. Diversity. - Without reservation and without caveat. In our hiring, in our workplace and in our impact in the world.</p> <p>Honor and integrity - Do the most right thing in the most right way. Cherish diversity and respect each other.</p> <p>Love and kindness always - Say what you mean. Mean what you say. And don't say it mean. Clarity. Courage. Kindness.</p> <p><strong>Role overview:</strong></p> <p>Kiva has been around for 20 years, and we are in an exciting period of building for growth, combining technology solutions with tried and true nonprofit tactics to reach the populations we serve.&nbsp;</p> <p>Kiva is looking for a strategic and collaborative Principal Product Manager to help us reach our growth goals. Product managers at Kiva take extreme ownership and roll up their sleeves to step in where help is needed. We understand our users and prioritize impact first. In this role, you will report to the Head of Product. You will identify and evaluate new product opportunities across our B2C and B2B audiences, starting with the high-net-worth individual audience. You will decide what gets built and why, define what success looks like, and stay accountable for results. We are product builders and stay involved from crafting the strategic vision to speaking with users, creating prototypes, defining requirements, evaluating tradeoffs, and measuring results. You’ll work with engineers, designers, marketing, and strategic partnerships, ensuring the team is aligned to execute a shared vision.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At this time, we can only consider applicants with authorization to work in the United States on a permanent, full-time basis; unfortunately, we cannot provide visa sponsorship.</span></p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities include:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and drive the vision for your product area, breaking it into a productive action plan that prioritizes impact, results, and speed of learnings&nbsp;</li> <li>Emphasize problem discovery and prioritization- know what the most important thing to solve is before diving into solutions&nbsp;</li> <li>Leverage internal and market signals to identify which longer-term bets or new product ideas are likely to succeed. Use frameworks and structured thinking to make decisions, even with incomplete information or ambiguity, where the problem or solution is not clear.</li> <li>Lead outcome definition for your product and projects. Define KPIs and success metrics.&nbsp;</li> <li>Know your customer, be able to run your own qualitative and quantitative research.&nbsp;</li> <li>Build relationships inside and outside the product team to anticipate stakeholder needs, and align leadership and cross-functional partners around your product vision</li> <li>Partner with engineering to build and execute solutions at quality commensurate to the risk, help shape GTM for significant releases&nbsp;</li> <li>Communicate roadmap, vision, results, and tradeoffs across the organization&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Learn and fail fast - know when to iterate, scale, or stop. Help others do the same&nbsp;</li> <li>Be able to communicate ideas and prototype with AI to validate ideas or experiment&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8-10 years of experience in product management roles, ideally B2C or marketplace, where you have managed a significant product area&nbsp;</li> <li>Track record of shipping successful products</li> <li>User-centered mindset; empathy for users and instinct for good UX.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong business acumen and a habit of using data to support decisions&nbsp;</li> <li>Self-starter and leader. You anticipate second- and third-order effects and decision tradeoffs, and reframe ambiguous or cross-functional problems in ways that reveal better opportunities and align stakeholders around the right problem.</li> <li>Nice to have: nonprofit, impact-focused, or philanthropy experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"> <div><span id="m_-5993597306425104663gmail-docs-internal-guid-5a7ebfb3-7fff-14ed-a2cb-ef0b74a4cdd0">A work-from-home position; final candidate must be authorized to work in the U.S.</span></div> </li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">An opportunity to improve real lives, solve hard problems, and change the world</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Friendly, supportive, and adventurous environment with a team of engaged colleagues</span></li> <li>A comprehensive, industry-leading benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance, parental leave, professional development, 401k matching, and unlimited PTO. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by Kiva.</li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunities to connect with and learn from colleagues and partners around the world</span></li> <li>Salary range: $162K - $185K; a final offer will be dependent upon a candidate’s location, skills, and experience.&nbsp;</li> <li>Currently, we are <em><strong>only</strong> able to hire </em>home employees residing in the following states: <strong>AZ, CA, CO, DE, FL, GA, IL, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, NY, OH, OR, SC, TX, UT, VA, and WA.</strong></li> </ul> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">A diverse and inclusive workplace where we learn from each other is an integral part of Kiva's culture. We actively welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer and a great place to work. Join us and help us achieve our mission!</span></em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We will only accept applications directly from candidates. Kiva will not be responsible for any recruiting agency fees, absent a formal agreement.</span></p>

jd_text: About Us We’re not like other insurance companies. From our specialty products to our business model, our culture to our results — we’re different. For decades, our financial track record has been stellar — a testament to our culture and validation of our reputation as an excellent underwriting company. Position Purpose Under general oversight, underwrite and manage a profitable Inland Marine book of business, with a primary focus on construction-related mobile property and specialized inland marine risks. Evaluate complex new and renewal business, apply sound underwriting judgment, and build lasting relationships with agency partners to drive profitable growth. This individual contributor role offers significant underwriting autonomy and market visibility while partnering closely with agents and brokers to develop business within RLI's Inland Marine appetite. Success in this role requires strong technical underwriting expertise, relationship management skills, and the ability to identify profitable opportunities in a competitive marketplace. Principal Duties & Responsibilities Analyze, evaluate, accept, decline, rate, quote, and bind complex new and renewal Inland Marine submissions within assigned underwriting authority. Underwrite a broad portfolio of Inland Marine risks, including Builder's Risk, Installation Floaters, Contractor's Equipment, Property in Transit, Mobile Property, and other specialized inland marine exposures. Evaluate account exposures, loss history, construction operations, pricing models, catastrophe exposure, and profitability to make sound underwriting decisions. Develop and execute a territory marketing strategy that strengthens agency relationships and grows a profitable book of Inland Marine business. Serve as a trusted underwriting partner for agents and brokers by providing responsive service, technical expertise, and creative underwriting solutions within company guidelines. Monitor portfolio performance and identify trends impacting profitability, rate adequacy, and risk selection. Maintain complete underwriting documentation and ensure compliance with underwriting guidelines and authority levels. Collaborate with underwriting leadership on product initiatives, agency development, and underwriting strategies. Assist with special projects and perform other duties as assigned. Education & Experience Typically requires a bachelor's degree in insurance, finance, risk management, business, or a related field. Minimum of 7 years of commercial property and casualty underwriting experience, including 3+ years of Inland Marine underwriting experience. Experience underwriting construction-related Inland Marine products such as Builder's Risk, Installation Floaters, Contractor's Equipment, or related specialized property risks preferred. Experience developing agency relationships and managing a profitable book of business. Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. Knowledge, Skills, & Competencies Demonstrates advanced underwriting judgment and decision-making for complex Inland Marine risks. Thorough understanding of Inland Marine products, construction-related property exposures, coverage analysis, pricing methodologies, and risk selection. Ability to independently manage a profitable book of business while balancing growth and underwriting discipline. Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate loss trends, catastrophe exposure, and account profitability. Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with independent agents and brokers through consistent communication and market presence. Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills. Demonstrates initiative, accountability, and sound business judgment while working independently. Maintains organized underwriting files and clear documentation supporting underwriting decisions. Ability to prioritize multiple opportunities while effectively managing a territory and agency relationships. Commitment to continuous learning and staying informed on Inland Marine market trends and emerging risks. Compensation Overview The base salary range for the position is listed below. Please note that the base salary is only one component of our robust total rewards package at RLI. The salary offered will take into account a number of factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, experience, scope & responsibilities of the role, qualifications/credentials, talent availability & specialization, as well as business needs. We hire the best and the brightest employees and allow them to share in the company's success through our Total Rewards. With the Employee Stock Ownership plan at its core, the Total Rewards program includes all compensation, benefits and perks that come with being an RLI employee. RLI fosters a true learning culture and encourages professional growth through insurance courses, in-house training and other educational programs. title: Presales Solutions Architect - Enterprise Networking
jd_text: About Us Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services. Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy: Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S. Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities. Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family. World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours. Job Summary The Presales Solutions Architect – Enterprise Networking at SHI International is responsible for being SHI's Subject Matter Expert across the enterprise networking domain. The foundation of this role is core networking – routing and switching, campus LAN architecture, and WAN and SD-WAN design – with working breadth across enterprise wireless, network access control and segmentation, network management and observability, and network automation. We are looking for depth in core networking first. Candidates who bring strong routing, switching, and WAN architecture experience and can speak credibly to the adjacent domains are encouraged to apply, even if their hands-on depth is uneven across every area listed below. In this role, you will split your time between presales client engagements and internal practice development. On the presales side, you'll take a consultative approach, leading technical discovery sessions with clients to assess their network infrastructure maturity, designing target-state enterprise network architectures, and delivering compelling demos, POCs, and technical presentations. On the internal side, you'll build reusable collateral such as reference architectures, battle cards, and enablement content; evaluate and qualify new vendor partnerships; and conduct training sessions that keep our engineering and sales teams current on emerging network technologies, platform capabilities, and best practices. Your credibility and technical depth will make you a trusted advisor to both SHI's most strategic customers and our internal stakeholders, driving meaningful network outcomes and revenue growth across the Networking practice. This position is a remote position with Home Office setup as determined by SHI management. Role Description Design and deliver product demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical presentations focused on enterprise networking solutions including campus routing and switching, enterprise wireless, SD-WAN and WAN edge, and network management and automation platforms Lead technical discovery sessions to assess clients' network infrastructure maturity across campus, branch, wireless, WAN, and network operations capabilities Translate complex networking concepts – such as dynamic routing design, Layer 2/Layer 3 segmentation, RF design and spectrum planning, application-aware routing, and QoS policy – into business-relevant value propositions for both technical and executive audiences Design and present target-state enterprise network architectures covering campus LAN, wireless, branch and WAN/SD-WAN, high availability, network access control and segmentation, and integration with broader infrastructure stacks (security, cloud, data center, collaboration) Support wireless engagements by leading discovery, interpreting predictive and validation survey output, framing high-density and IoT design considerations, and engaging specialist resources where deep RF design is required Develop and maintain internal practice collateral including reference architectures, battle cards, competitive analyses, technical briefs, and vendor evaluation frameworks Evaluate and qualify new vendor technologies and product capabilities; make recommendations on partner adoption, platform consolidation, and legacy solution retirement Conduct internal enablement sessions for engineering and sales teams on emerging network technologies, product updates, use cases, and enterprise networking best practices Drive revenue growth within the presales team by identifying new networking opportunities and optimizing service offerings Collaborate with SHI stakeholder partner teams to create synergistic networking service solutions that integrate across SHI's broader portfolio Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients and partners, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention through product briefings, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer Stay current with new networking technologies, protocols, and industry developments; track evolving architectures such as intent-based networking, cloud-managed networking, network-as-a-service, and private cellular to inform architectural recommendations Contribute to practice development by identifying areas for growth, leading innovation initiatives, and creating and maintaining practice standards to ensure high-quality service delivery Behaviors and Competencies Adaptability: Can proactively adapt to challenging situations, anticipate changes, and make modifications to meet the demands of changing circumstances. Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences and can facilitate effective communication between others. Documentation: Independently produces and maintains documentation for routine processes; ensures accuracy and consistency. Leadership: Can proactively seek out leadership roles, initiate team projects, and contribute to team development and success. Problem Solving: Can proactively identify potential problems, initiate preventive measures, and propose and contribute to innovative solutions. Teamwork: Can lead a team effectively, facilitate cooperation, sharing information, and ensuring that all team members are able to contribute to their full potential. Self – Motivation: Can proactively seek out challenges, initiate self-development projects, and contribute to personal or professional innovative ideas. Skill Level Requirements Strong proficiency in cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud). Solid understanding of microservices, APIs, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Expertise in solution design across enterprise systems, integration platforms, and data layers. Strong background in system security, data privacy, and compliance. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business-oriented language. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation tools, and infrastructure-as-code frameworks. Proficient in software development methodologies (Agile, DevOps). Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills. Other Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience Minimum 6 years of experience in network engineering, enterprise network architecture, or infrastructure engineering roles, including hands-on routing, switching, and campus or WAN design and implementation Demonstrated experience in presales, solutions architecture, or technical consulting within the networking or infrastructure domain Experience presenting to customers, internal teams, or industry professional groups on networking topics Exposure to at least two of the following adjacent areas: enterprise wireless, SD-WAN, network access control and segmentation, or network automation The estimated annual pay range for this position is $180,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending. Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

jd_text: As passionate about our people as we are about our mission. Why Join Q2? Summary We run a large SQL Server estate at serious scale, mostly on EC2, alongside a fast-growing set of PostgreSQL, Aurora, Snowflake, MongoDB, and Pinecone workloads supporting analytical and AI use cases. We are primarily an AWS shop with a small Azure footprint, and this team keeps that estate fast, available, recoverable, and cost-efficient for the financial institutions that depend on it. We are looking for a manager who owns production and drives our engineers to be the best versions of themselves. Not someone who reacts to what breaks, but someone who anticipates risk, guides a highly skilled team to the best solution, and drives programs end to end without being told to. Patching and maintenance are an afterthought for us; the successful candidate is already thinking about the problems the team hasn't realized it has yet. A defining trait of this team is that we build our own solutions rather than outsource: we build custom tooling so we can scale with technology instead of people, while knowing the line where a vendor solves it more economically. We serve two sets of customers who both matter deeply. Externally, a bad day for us can mean a bank that anchors a local community is unavailable to the people who depend on it. Internally, our stakeholders are other Q2'ers, and the goal is to multiply their impact through self-service tooling to the point where they don't need a DBA at all. Responsibilities Own production: accountable for availability, performance, and recoverability across the multi-engine estate. Own the coverage model and act as the incident-command backstop so the team, not any one person, carries a bad day Set technical direction and own the outcome. Guide highly skilled engineers to the best solution, mentoring rather than driving where that serves better, and tell senior stakeholders where we are going and why Champion build-our-own tooling and self-service, with the judgment to know where a vendor is the more economical answer Push AI hands-on to build observability into the stack and extend the tooling we have already built Grow the team and hold it accountable to the value it delivers: coach, set clear expectations, and run honest performance conversations Own the economics: enterprise licensing and annual true-up, storage right-sizing, and cost-to-serve. Track spend and defend the numbers to finance and leadership Set the standards for availability-group and DR design, build and automation practices, and data security and access control aligned with governance policy Lead modernization end to end: version migrations, cross-engine consolidation, and DR maturation, driven to measurable milestones Establish engineering rhythms, KPIs, and accountability, and partner across data platform, architecture, and product to deliver curated data products Experience and Knowledge Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field and a minimum of 6 years of related experience; or an advanced degree with 4+ years of experience Typically requires 1-2 years managing and developing employees Deep SQL Server expertise at scale: Always On availability groups, multi-region high availability and DR, performance troubleshooting, and enterprise licensing economics Ability to lead engineers across multiple database technologies: relational (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Aurora), analytical (Snowflake), and non-relational or specialized stores (MongoDB, vector databases such as Pinecone). Expertise in all is not required, but you must guide direction, judge quality, and grow specialists across the estate Strong AWS depth running a database estate primarily on EC2, treating cloud cost as a first-class engineering concern; working Azure knowledge is useful A track record of defining and driving programs end to end, including migration or modernization work you initiated and owned, not just projects you were assigned Robust, hands-on AI ability to build observability and tooling quickly; this is critical, not optional Strong judgment under pressure and a bias to own the ambiguous, unowned problem rather than route it away Familiarity with security, compliance, and operational best practices; financial services or other regulated, high-availability experience preferred This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English. title: Manager, Facilities Operations Commissioning
jd_text: The Manager, Facilities Operations Engineering Commissioning will be responsible for the oversight of commissioning, continuous improvement, and developmental support for sites in a geographic region. This role will provide assistance with commissioning-related engineering, including the coordination, installation, and integration of connectivity, network infrastructure, security, life safety, other building subsystems and finishes, transformers, electrical switchgear, UPS (Uninterrupted Power Supply), STS (Static Transfer Switch), PDU (Power Distribution Unit), electrical distribution equipment, Chillers, water loops/components, Cooling distribution equipment, Electrical Power Monitoring Systems, and Building Management and automation systems. The position requires project planning abilities coupled with leadership through influence and a proactive partnership approach. The ideal candidate will bring experience in electrical and mechanical systems, along with an understanding of large-scale data centers (or comparable environments), which may encompass electrical distribution systems, static UPS, emergency standby generation, fire alarm/suppression, monitoring systems, and cooling systems. This role will be a regional role that reports to the Director, Facility Operations, Commissioning that will require an estimated 30-50% travel to other sites around the U.S. RESPONSIBILITIES, other duties may be assigned. Manage the commissioning team(s) in assigned region, develop capabilities, engage employees. Follow operating and commissioning standards required for quality, safety, and ongoing operation. Oversee travel budgets to ensure compliance with organizational expenditure requirements. Assist in site construction activity and installations as needed, in coordination with QTS project departments, external construction resources, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards. Direct Cx Engineers to witness testing of all equipment during commissioning in your region and validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation. Assist Director as necessary in revising comprehensive commissioning plans for Level 1, Level 2, Level 3, Level 4, and Level 5 systems, including connectivity, network infrastructure, security, life safety, other building subsystems and finishes, Electrical, Mechanical, and Building Automation components. Identify, track, and resolve any issues during the commissioning process, working closely with the project team to resolve technical challenges. Utilize findings and provide feedback to program management team to drive continuous improvement. Assist and work with all QTS site teams on standard operating procedures (SOP), method of procedures (MOP), and emergency response procedures (ERP) established for critical environments, as well as the formal change management process. Develop metrics for your team to provide feedback to QTS. Lead your teams in quality improvement, standard compliance, vendor oversight, completions and turnover. Drive innovation into facilities programs/systems with an environmentally conscious attitude. Interfaces with vendors, QTS Engineering, QTS Development and peer operations organizations. Maintain positive relationships and communication with staff and executive level management. Assist site engineering/management with compliance with local health & safety (i.e. OSHA) standards and national electrical and building codes. Ensure proper training and growth of staff. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or similar HVAC or critical power certifications OR equivalent professional experience in lieu of degree. Five or more years of direct experience with engineering related activities in a technical or critical environment (data center, nuclear/electric power, hospital, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, industrial/commercial field engineering). PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Ten or more years of direct experience with engineering related activities in a technical or critical environment (data center, nuclear/electric power, hospital, pharmaceutical, semiconductor, industrial/commercial field engineering). Five or more years of data center engineering, commissioning, project management, or equivalent. Three or more years of management/supervisory experience overseeing engineering or critical operations managers. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES Must be fluent with and possess an excellent working knowledge of Data Center critical and construction environments. Ability to develop solutions and create technical strategic and tactical plans on complex projects. Ability and willingness to think outside of the box to find creative and innovative solutions to improve quality / reliability and continuously drive down operating costs. Advanced understanding of both mechanical and electrical equipment, systems and design related to data centers. (Including but not limited to uninterruptable power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers (air-cooled and water-cooled), pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers.) Experience with emergency backup systems (generators, UPS, battery backup). Knowledge and experience with building monitoring/controls, electricity and medium / low voltage electrical distribution systems, mechanical systems, telecommunications, access controls, CCTV, life safety systems, and/or building subsystems. Knowledge and experience with project management and commissioning management software systems. Ability to lead multiple Commissioning Teams in various stages of commissioning. You will define high-performance schemas, orchestrate complex hybrid-database environments (Snowflake/Kinetica/NoSQL), and serve as the primary technical liaison for our customers. This is a high-visibility role blending deep technical governance with strategic relationship development. Key Responsibilities: System Architecture: Design the end-to-end blueprint for a modern data layer that seamlessly integrates structured, unstructured, and relational (Graph) data for AI agents. Schema & Ontology Design: Define multi-tenant schemas and Knowledge Graph ontologies that allow LLM agents to perform complex reasoning and cross-domain data retrieval. Database Administration & Governance: Oversee the health, security, and performance optimization of our data clusters (Snowflake/Kinetica), ensuring 99.9% availability for mission-critical AI workflows. Strategic Client Fronting: Act as the "Face of Engineering" for the customer. Performance Engineering: Define performance and observability standards to ensure low-latency, accurate, reliable data retrieval for real-time agentic AI workloads. Basic Qualifications: System Architecture: Design the end-to-end blueprint for a modern data layer that seamlessly integrates structured, unstructured, and relational (Graph) data for AI agents. Schema & Ontology Design: Define multi-tenant schemas and Knowledge Graph ontologies that allow LLM agents to perform complex reasoning and cross-domain data retrieval. Database Administration & Governance: Oversee the health, security, and performance optimization of our data clusters (Snowflake/Kinetica), ensuring 99.9% availability for mission-critical AI workflows. Strategic Client Fronting: Act as the "Face of Engineering" for the customer. Lead discovery workshops, manage technical expectations, and align the architectural roadmap with their business objectives. Performance Engineering: Establish benchmarks for data latency and retrieval accuracy, ensuring the data layer can keep pace with the real-time demands of agentic execution. The Hybrid Stack: Proven expertise in architecting for Snowflake (Data Cloud) and Kinetica (Real-time/Vector/OLAP). Knowledge Graph Mastery: Ability to design Property Graphs or RDF schemas that map enterprise entities into a machine-readable "World Model." title: Maintenance Shop Lead Tech
jd_text: POSITION SUMMARY: Reporting to a Maintenance Supervisor or Maintenance Manager, the Maintenance Lead Technician provides direction to a group of technicians to ensure that all repairs and maintenance of equipment are performed in compliance with the Company’s safety standards and applicable federal and state regulations. The Maintenance Lead Technician is responsible for all chassis (diesel and non-diesel equipment and trucks) and refuse bodywork, including, but not limited to, hydraulic, electrical, heating and air conditioning system maintenance and repair. In addition, the Lead Technician diagnoses more complicated repair work; provides coaching on diagnostic techniques to subordinate technicians; performs external repair inspections to ensure all repair work is done in a safe manner; and schedules the repair work for his or her work group to ensure that all repair and maintenance work is done in a safe and timely manner, reducing lost productivity within the shop. PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES: Maintains expert knowledge of, and advanced working proficiency in, the following vehicle components and systems, with the ability to perform complex repair maintenance functions, both on-site and on the road:o Chassis component repair and maintenance; Refuse bodies, including control, hydraulic and electrical systems o Air and hydraulic braking systems; o Engine repair and maintenance;o Suspension, drivetrain and steering systems; and o Heating and air conditioning systems. o Performs line maintenance welding and fabrication. o Provides direction to technicians assigned to his or her work group to ensure that all repair and maintenance work is performed in a safe, efficient and timely manner. May plan and schedule repair work to minimize lost productivity. o Inspects repairs done by a third party vendor to ensure all work has been properly completed in accordance with the Company’s safety procedures and federal and state regulations; follows up when necessary. o Performs repair diagnostics on more complex matters. o Identifies the source of malfunctions using a variety of electronic tools. o Completes applicable Company training programs. o Handles Maintenance Supervisor responsibilities, as needed. o Acts as a mentor to technicians. Performs other job-related duties as assigned or apparent. QUALIFICATIONS: Ability to perform inspections and repairs without supervision in some (not all required) of the following heavy truck, or automotive systems:o Suspensions, Steering, General Engine, Transmissions, Brakes, Electrical, Hydraulics, Drive Train, Diesel Emissions. At least 3 years of experience in a role requiring compliance with OSHA Haz Com, OSHA Lock Out Tag Out, and all OSHA fire protection regulations is a plus but not required. At least 1 year of supervisory or lead technician experience is a plus but not required. ASE Heavy Truck Certifications (T1-T8) is a plus but not required. Class B or higher Commercial Driver’s License is a plus but not required Valid Driver’s License. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: At least 3 years of experience as a technician working on heavy-duty trucks. jd_text: You desire impactful work. You’re RGA ready RGA is a purpose-driven organization working to solve today’s challenges through innovation and collaboration. Define and enforce the reference architecture at every tier: canonical investment domain model, IBOR/ABOR/PBOR data flows, API-first service standards, event-driven and batch integration patterns (CDC, streaming, file), and application technology standards. Engage with investment engineering teams for implementations from UI to pipeline, production code quality, review designs and pull requests, and set the engineering bar for testing, CI/CD, observability, and infrastructure-as-code. Strong Pluses Insurance or reinsurance general-account experience, including investment accounting and statutory reporting exposure. title: Lifecycle Operations Manager
jd_text: COMPANY 🌱 RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement 🏠, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee ☕🍄 delivering clean energy ⚡, mental clarity 🧠, and immune support 🛡️. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth 📈 and a community of over 1 million active subscribers. 🎉 DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail 🛒, quickly becoming the #2 item in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027 🚀. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness. ✨ We're a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we're just getting started! 🌱🔥 WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯 We're looking for a Lifecycle Operations Manager to sit at the intersection of marketing strategy and technical execution — the person who takes lifecycle briefs and journey maps and turns them into live, tested, working flows in Klaviyo and Postscript. This is not a campaign coordinator role. This is the technical half of the lifecycle partnership: the person who interrogates the brief, surfaces the gaps, builds the logic layer, and keeps the stack healthy. You build things that work — and you know what it takes to keep them working. Responsibilities will include: Translate Strategy into Built Experiences Take lifecycle briefs, journey maps, and campaign strategy and turn them into robust, tested, live flows in Klaviyo and Postscript — built and scheduled, not near-final drafts. Interrogate the brief before you build it: surface gaps a strategist wouldn't think to specify — customers already in the flow, active subscribers, recent sends, no order history. Tell Marketing when something isn't buildable as written — and come back with the version that is, or the work required to make it possible. Configure the full logic layer: triggers, filters, conditional splits, profile property conditions, wait timing, smart sending, and suppression. Coordinate email and SMS so channels complement rather than collide, and build the guardrails and governance that keep sending rules consistent as the program grows. Build the Foundation That Makes It Possible Own the technical health of our lifecycle stack — Klaviyo, Postscript, Shopify, and Recharge — including integration stability, data governance, and documentation that outlives any one person's memory. Own the tracking layer end to end: verify that Shopify, Recharge, and on-site events land in Klaviyo with the right properties, on the right profile, at the right time. If Marketing wants to trigger on something we don't currently capture, you make it capturable. Configure and troubleshoot webhooks, API-driven events, custom metrics, and profile properties. Maintain source-of-truth definitions for the events, attributes, and segments the retention program runs on. Drive operational efficiency by building reusable systems — modular templates, universal content blocks, dynamic content logic — so the tenth version of a journey takes a fraction of the time the first one did. Lead the evaluation and onboarding of new capabilities with a clear view of impact vs. complexity. Test It and Launch It Own the pre-send QA standard for every email and SMS build: dynamic content and personalization across edge cases, link and UTM accuracy, alt text, dark mode, mobile, and rendering across major inbox clients. QA the technical side of landing pages: form and popup behavior, consent capture, list assignment, redirects, mobile rendering, and whether tracking actually fires. QA product and subscription configuration: variants, selling plans, discount and bundle logic, Recharge subscription rules, one-time vs. recurring behavior, and swap or upsell flows. Operationalize A/B tests end to end: audience configuration, randomization, holdouts, and instrumentation that's actually measurable. Help define clear experiment frameworks — success metrics, sample sizes, timelines — and make sure the implementation is technically sound so results mean something. Keep It Running Monitor flow health, delivery, and errors proactively. Broken things should surface on your dashboard, not in a post-mortem. Find and fix silent failures before they become reporting problems: events that stopped firing, properties that drifted, duplicate or mis-identified profiles, integrations that quietly desynced. Monitor sending health — bounce and complaint rates, list growth quality, suppression hygiene, sunset logic — and keep authentication and sending domain configuration in good standing. Own reporting requirements for lifecycle ops: flow health, delivery and error monitoring, and experiment status. Proactively consolidate or retire journeys that add operational complexity without adding return. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🔍 2–4 years of hands-on experience in lifecycle / CRM operations at a DTC or ecommerce brand, working directly from marketing briefs. Deep working knowledge of Klaviyo as your primary tool — flows, segments, templates, and integrations, not just campaign sends. Hands-on experience with Shopify and Recharge, including how subscription data behaves and where it tends to break. Experience with an SMS platform — Postscript preferred; Attentive, Klaviyo SMS, or similar considered. Technical proficiency with HTML, CSS for email, and templating logic (Liquid or similar); comfortable reading, writing, and debugging dynamic content and personalization rules. Demonstrated experience partnering with developers or data teams on integrations, event tracking, and troubleshooting. You can read an API doc, test an endpoint, and reason about a webhook payload without hand-holding. Solid understanding of experiment design — control vs. test, holdouts, key metrics, avoiding bias — and its practical constraints in a live sending program. Proven ability to manage multiple builds in parallel with clear prioritization and communication — and to tell a stakeholder what's realistic before committing to it. PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS 💫 Low-ego, team-first: The best idea wins, no matter whose it is Self-starter: You see what needs doing and get after it, no waiting for direction Comfortable in ambiguity: Fast pace and shifting priorities energize you rather than rattle you Builder at heart: You're energized by a fast-moving environment where you help create the processes and playbooks, not just follow them Mission-driven: You genuinely care about wellness and are excited to help build RYZE's next chapter WHAT WE OFFER 🌟 Benefits Competitive hourly or monthly contract compensation 💰 Fully remote, flexible work environment 🌍 Opportunity to work on high-impact performance creative for a fast-growing brand 🚀 Access to RYZE creative assets, tools, templates, and performance insights 🎨

title: Lead HIM Technician
jd_text: Here at Savista, we enable our clients to navigate the biggest challenges in healthcare: quality clinical care with positive patient experiences and optimal financial results. We partner with healthcare organizations to problem solve and deliver revenue cycle improvement services that enable their success, support their patients, and nurture their communities, all while living our values of Commitment, Authenticity, Respect and Excellence (CARE). About the Role As a Lead HIM Technician , you will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day operations of the Health Information Management (HIM) department. What You’ll Do Lead Daily HIM Operations Monitor daily workflow and coordinate the processing of incoming chart requests, chart retrieval, chart re-filing, loose document filing, purging, driving processes, and shipment preparation. Prioritize and adjust work assignments as needed to ensure daily processes are completed accurately and within established timeframes. Monitor workloads and proactively communicate potential backlogs or operational concerns to management. Serve as a first point of contact for team members with questions regarding day-to-day HIM processes and procedures. Assist with departmental coverage during periods of illness, vacation, position vacancies, or other staffing needs. Assist with locating missing charts and resolving issues that may impact workflow or timely record retrieval. Support special projects and other initiatives requested by HIM leadership or administration. Support Training & Team Development Assist with the orientation and training of new HIM employees. Provide ongoing training and cross-training to HIM staff to promote consistent, accurate, and efficient processes. Serve as a resource and subject matter expert for team members regarding daily workflows and procedures. Help foster a collaborative team environment focused on quality, productivity, and excellent service. Monitor Quality & Productivity Conduct weekly quality and productivity audits of key HIM processes, including chart retrieval, chart re-filing, loose document filing, purging, and driving activities. Document audit results, identify trends or opportunities for improvement, and communicate findings to management. Maintain accurate daily productivity and audit statistics. Help ensure department processes consistently meet established quality and productivity expectations. Identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, procedures, and overall departmental efficiency. Protect Patient Information & Support Compliance Maintain strict security and confidentiality of health information and comply with all applicable record-access and review requirements. Follow local, state, and federal HIPAA regulations and organizational policies governing the privacy and security of patient information. Consult with management regarding unusual, sensitive, or non-routine requests involving health information. Assist customers, co-workers, care providers, and other internal stakeholders with HIM-related questions and requests. Answer department telephone calls and provide professional, courteous service as needed. What You’ll Bring Experience working in Health Information Management, medical records, or a related healthcare environment. Interest in building a long-term career in Health Information Management. Currently enrolled in an RHIT program or interested in enrolling in an RHIT program. Strong understanding of HIM workflows, including chart retrieval, filing, record maintenance, and related processes. Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and adjust workflows based on departmental needs. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and quality. Ability to monitor productivity and quality metrics and identify opportunities for improvement. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with team members, leadership, care providers, and customers. Ability to train, coach, and support team members in day-to-day processes. Sound judgment when handling confidential or unusual requests. Working knowledge of HIPAA requirements and the importance of protecting confidential health information. Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Why You’ll Enjoy This Role Grow your HIM career: Build hands-on experience that can prepare you for future opportunities in Health Information Management. Work toward your RHIT: Eligible employees may receive educational assistance to pursue their RHIT credential. Balance work and school: Weekend hours are available to help accommodate school schedules and educational commitments. Develop leadership skills: Gain experience supporting training, quality, productivity, and workflow management. Make an impact: Help keep critical HIM processes accurate, timely, and efficient. Be a team resource: Serve as a trusted go-to person for your colleagues and help others succeed. Improve the way work gets done: Have a voice in identifying process improvements and making daily operations more effective. Build a career, not just a job: Develop skills and experience that can open the door to future growth within HIM. Additional Responsibilities Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned or requested by HIM leadership or administration. Position Summary The Infrastructure Electrical Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Manager is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and maintenance of all electrical power distribution systems. This position is critical for maintaining the continuous, safe, and efficient operation of the electrical infrastructure necessary to support round-the-clock manufacturing operations. The role requires extensive experience in managing complex electrical O&M (Operations & Maintenance) programs, including preventative maintenance (PM), predictive maintenance (PdM), and emergency corrective actions in a high-stakes industrial environment. The individual in this position is expected to lead the development and optimization of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and maintenance workflows to maximize system uptime and eliminate single points of failure. Operational excellence must be achieved with an absolute emphasis on safety, incident reduction, and rigorous adherence to electrical codes. Samsung Austin Semiconductor is a 24/7/365 factory where utility interruptions are catastrophic; therefore, a "zero-outage" mindset is mandatory. Role and Responsibilities Here’s What You’ll Be Responsible For: Lead the development, ownership, and auditing of the operational processes and maintenance schedules required to ensure the safe and error-free operation of the electrical grid. Mentor junior operations engineers and technicians in reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) and best practices. Interface with Manufacturing and Equipment teams to manage power load requirements and coordinate planned maintenance windows. Exercise **Extreme Ownership** over the electrical infrastructure, accepting full responsibility for system stability, equipment health, and the rapid restoration of power in the event of a failure. Develop and oversee detailed Method Statements and Risk Assessments for all operational switching, maintenance activities, and emergency repairs to ensure zero safety incidents. Manage third-party maintenance vendors, service contracts, and specialized technicians to ensure all facility electrical assets are maintained to OEM specifications. Lead the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process for any electrical anomalies or outages, implementing permanent corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Proactively identify aging infrastructure and develop lifecycle replacement plans (CapEx) to mitigate the risk of equipment failure. Perform regular site audits and thermographic/power quality inspections to verify the health of electrical equipment and ensure compliance with safety and NEC standards. Demonstrate strong leadership skills to coordinate between Facilities, Manufacturing, and EHS organizations to balance the need for critical maintenance with the demands of aggressive production schedules. Skills and Qualifications Here's what you'll need: Education, Training, Certification(s) and Minimum years of experience required 4-year degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering from an ABET accredited institution. Minimum 11 years of experience in electrical operations and maintenance within a heavy industrial setting. Semiconductor fab or Data Center experience is highly preferred. Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) or PMP certification is a plus. OSHA 30-Hour Construction/General Industry certification is a plus. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Software, and Tools Expert knowledge of industrial power distribution systems (Hight/Medium/Low Voltage), switchgear, UPS systems, generators, and ATS, as well as deep familiarity with NEC, NFPA 70E (Electrical Safety in the Workplace). Strong crisis management skills and the ability to lead technical teams under pressure during emergency outage scenarios. Advanced data analysis skills using Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, Power Query) to track Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and Mean Time to Repair (MTTR). Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems for tracking work orders, asset history, and PM scheduling. Proficiency with electrical monitoring tools (Power Quality Analyzers, Infrared Thermography, and Arc Flash Analysis software like ETAP or SKM). Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical failures into executive-level briefings. jd_text: Ready to be a Titan? ServiceTitan is looking for a Data Quality Analyst to join our Data Engineering department. jd_text: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing! We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business. Public Partnerships LLC supports individuals with disabilities or chronic illnesses and aging adults, to remain in their homes and communities and “self” direct their own long-term home care. Our role as the nation’s largest and most experienced Financial Management Service provider is to assist those eligible Medicaid recipients to choose and pay for their own support workers and services within their state-approved personalized budget. We are appointed by states and managed healthcare organizations to better serve more of their residents and members requiring long-term care and ensure the efficient use of taxpayer funded services. Our culture attracts and rewards people who are results-oriented and strive to exceed customer expectations. We desire motivated candidates who are excited to join our fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment, and who want to make a difference in helping transform the lives of the consumers we serve. (learn more at www.pplfirst.com ). Job Summary: The thesis of the engagement consultant career track is that you’re not just building an analytics ecosystem, your expertise is also in being a key part of solution ideation and business impact enablement. As the Principal Analytics Engagement Consultant you write and publish PPL’s analytics standards for data modeling, the semantic layer, metric definitions, statistical method, documentation, and reproducibility, and those standards bind every team producing analytics. You co-author the enterprise analytics strategy with the VP of Analytics and hold the technical roadmap for the semantic and governance layer. You also hold the entire team to a high standard of execution on systems level thinking and solutioning. When a deliverable, a figure, or a claim is not supported by the evidence, you can stop it, and you are expected to. You are the deciding technical voice on leveling and hiring for the Analytics Engagement Consultant team. You lead PPL’s most consequential engagements: the ones with cross-functional executive sponsorship, regulatory exposure, or material P&L impact. You choose which of these you take on and you own the outcome. You work with PPL Data Architects to ensure the semantic layer, the canonical data models, and the metric definitions meet the minimum quality and rigor expected of the regulatory environment in which PPL operates. You sit with the executive team as a peer. You shape which questions get asked, you reframe the ones that are wrong, and when the evidence disagrees with the room, you use your influence to help change the decision. You defend methodology under regulatory and audit scrutiny, and over time you make PPL known in the Medicaid market as a partner with deep integrity and analytical rigor. You are the quality gate for every analytics team member below you. You review and approve their work, and you develop promising talent toward Principal-level judgment: which method, how much rigor, when to push back, when to stop. You own the evolution of the function’s methodology, tooling standards, and operating model with the VP. You set the culture of the craft, which at PPL means intellectual honesty, partnership with the business, and the willingness to raise your hand when the data does not support an assertion. You stay in the code. When the hardest model needs building, you build it, and your production dbt, SQL, and Python work is the reference implementation others learn from. Key Competencies Enterprise Analytics & Methodology Leadership 12+ years of progressive analytics, data science, analytics engineering, or consulting experience, including 5+ years at the Staff, Principal, or equivalent level. Production ownership of a dbt projects other teams depend on, at enterprise scale. Proven authority in defining analytical methodologies, establishing organizational standards, and serving as the final reviewer for high-impact analysis. Demonstrated ability to deliver rigorous analytical work that withstands executive, regulatory, and audit-level scrutiny. Advanced Data Engineering & Contact Center Analytics Deep hands-on expertise with contact-center platforms and data, including contact-level modeling, workforce management, routing, multi-channel structures, and Erlang calculations. Enterprise-scale ownership of production dbt environments and data models relied upon by multiple teams. Advanced SQL expertise with working knowledge of Databricks, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and orchestration tools; Python experience is beneficial. Executive Influence & Analytics Craft Leadership Proven ability to translate complex analysis into compelling, evidence-based narratives that influence executive and enterprise-level decisions. Demonstrated confidence challenging assumptions and presenting findings that may be unexpected or contrary to prevailing perspectives. Strong track record of developing analytics professionals through mentorship, code review, technical guidance, and cross-functional leadership. Requirements Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in analytics, data science, analytics engineering, or management consulting, including 5+ years at a Staff, Principal, or equivalent level. Analytical work that shaped enterprise decisions and stood up to regulatory, audit, or executive scrutiny, with specific examples you can walk through. Authority over methodology at an organizational level: you have defined standards, enforced them across teams you did not manage, and served as final reviewer on high-stakes analysis. Production ownership of a dbt projects other teams depend on, at enterprise scale.
