title: Digital Production Associate
jd_text: ABOUT THE POSITION : The Digital Production Associate (“DPA”) contributes to digital production workflows in an active library environment within the Distinctive Collections & Digital Scholarship Division. Reporting to the Head of Digital Initiatives and Open Publishing, the DPA is responsible for the digitization of textual, photographic, and audiovisual materials associated with The Claremont Colleges Digital Library and other special projects. The DPA contributes to the success of digitization projects through effective collaboration, communication, and by skillful project management and oversight of assigned digital library operations and the special collections scan-on-demand program. Key responsibilities include contributing to the creation, use, migration, and management of digital objects and metadata; contributing to the establishment and improvement of best practices for digitization and publishing workflows, creating documentation, keeping and reporting accurate statistics, training digital production student assistants and temporary project staff; and maintaining effective communication with stakeholders. Priority Deadline: The deadline for first consideration is November 13, 2026. Applications received by this date will receive priority consideration; the position will remain open until filled. Please note that a cover letter and CV/resume are required along with the application. Union: This position is represented by The Claremont Colleges Services Library Staff Federation AFT Local 6735. The employee in this position will be bound by the collective bargaining agreement. COMPENSATION Pay : The pay range for this position is $27.00 - $28.85/hour. Benefits : This position is eligible for our employment benefits package including: 10% retirement contributions after one year (no matching required) Tuition Remission and Professional Development funds Access to fitness facilities Generous time off including 11 paid holidays, up to 22 vacation days and 12 sick days per year, and a paid Winter Closure. Medical, Dental, Vision Work Schedule : The regular hours for this full-time position are 40 hours scheduled from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday for 12 months annually. May be required to work holiday, weekend, and/or evening hours. Regular hours may vary due to the needs of the organization or business unit. This position is not eligible for a hybrid work schedule. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Digital Production Responsibilities Participates in digital production and publishing workflows for the Claremont Colleges Digital Library (CCDL) and Scholarship@Claremont, with a keen attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality, consistency, accessibility, and long-term digital preservation. Performs quality control of digitized and born-digital content, including imaging, post-processing, audiovisual content, optical character recognition (OCR), metadata, file management, and other digital production activities in accordance with established workflows and standards, including applicable FADGI standards. Participates in the digital collections lifecycle, from digitization and metadata creation through content ingest, publishing, and digital asset management. Supports the Open Publishing Applications Specialist (OPAS) in open publishing production work, including managing the submission of content, creating metadata, designing and documenting workflows, monitoring and ensuring the quality of data, and tracking projects through the publication process. Maintain close and effective communication and reporting on digitization and asset ingest, production issues, and project activities with the Head of Digital Initiatives and Open Publishing. Supports the production and management of video and audio recordings, including AV reformatting and transcription workflows, such as generating, reviewing, correcting and preparing machine-generated transcripts to enhance accessibility and support their use in digital collections and publishing workflows. Responds to email inquiries submitted to the Digital Initiatives LibAnswers queue. Oversee scan-on-demand processes including coordination with related units. Student Assistant Training and Coordination Provides training and guidance to student assistants supporting digitization, scan-on-demand, and audiovisual projects and communicate any issues to the Head of Digital Initiatives and Open Publishing in a timely manner. Assigns and monitors student work and provides training in digitization equipment, imaging, post-processing, quality control, metadata, content ingest, AV reformatting, and file management. Project-related Responsibilities Document procedures and workflows. Track and report on project progress, milestones, and production outputs and communicate issues requiring supervisory attention. Work collaboratively to make recommendations regarding digitization, metadata, quality control, and production workflows. Other Related Duties Perform other related duties as assigned QUALIFICATIONS Education/Training : A bachelor's degree from an accredited institution. Experience : At least two (2) years of relevant experience in digital production, digitization, digital collections, digital publishing, photography, or a related field, including experience managing digital assets and workflows, creating and maintaining documentation, and applying established standards and procedures to the production of digital content. Other: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities : Knowledge of digital asset and content management practices,, including metadata, file formats, reformatting and digitization workflows, image capture, post-processing, OCR, quality control, and preservation. Demonstrated ability to manage projects and workflows, prioritize competing tasks, meet deadlines, and ensure the quality and consistency of work General knowledge of audio-visual terminology and equipment. Ability to learn and work effectively with evolving technologies, systems, and digital production tools Ability to analyze and troubleshoot digitization and digital production processes and remediate them. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, project partners, and other stakeholders.. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with a focus on accuracy, quality, accessibility, and long-term digital preservation. Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a production-oriented, team environment. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with technology developed or adopted by the archival community for digitizing manuscript material and managing digital content, including familiarity with FADGI guidelines and related digital preservation practices. Experience with or demonstrated interest in applying WCAG standards and best practices for digital content. Experience with capture/conversion and editing software for video and audio files, including ability to troubleshoot audio visual equipment. Experience with digital repository, digital asset management, or publishing platforms such as CONTENTdm and/or bepress. Knowledge of digital preservation principles, standards, and practices. Experience with applications used in digital production such as MS Excel, Adobe Photoshop, etc. Experience using project management tools or methods to coordinate complex, multi-step projects. Physical Requirements: This position primarily performs work in an office environment and requires the ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working at a computer. The role involves frequent use of a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment, as well as repetitive hand and wrist movements. The position requires the ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, video conference, and electronic communication; read and interpret printed and electronic documents; and exchange accurate information with employees, supervisors, and external partners. Occasional standing, walking, bending, reaching, and lifting, carrying, pushing, or pulling materials weighing up to 15 pounds may be required, such as files, office supplies, or computer equipment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. In this role, engineers spend approximately 60–75% of their time coding, working hands-on with code, data, and modern tools (including AI-assisted development, cloud services, and automation frameworks) to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality technology solutions that drive business outcomes in the fintech sector. They collaborate with cross-functional teams – product managers, designers, data scientists, QA, operations, and compliance – to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, all while adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. This role sits within an AI-first engineering team building production-grade agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs). Engineers design and implement multi-agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, tool-calling integrations, and LLM inference services — all at enterprise scale on on-premise infrastructure. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with stakeholders to interpret requirements for project components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solution fixes. Translate business requirements by verifying assumptions and escalating potential design issues to appropriate stakeholders. Participate in system design and architecture, refining code plans and contributing to design documentation. Contribute to project estimation and escalate issues that may cause delays. Develop, implement, and maintain code for products, services, or components, applying coding patterns, guidelines, and best practices. Apply debugging tools to verify assumptions and proactively flag issues before they occur. Participate in code reviews to ensure coding standards are followed and address routine pull requests. Create test plans and configure testing procedures to identify and resolve defects for multiple features. Respond to support requests during on-call rotations, troubleshooting issues and deploying fixes under guidance. AI & Agentic Systems Design, implement, and tune multi-agent LLM workflows using agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangGraph4j, LangChain4j), including declarative graph compilation, conditional routing between agent nodes, state persistence, and dynamic agent spawning at runtime. Build and maintain ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) agent loops — iterative Reason→Act→Observe cycles in which an LLM selects tools, interprets tool results, and continues until a terminal answer is produced. Implement Supervisor/Orchestrator agent patterns where a Lead Agent dynamically plans, spawns, and coordinates Specialist Sub-Agents using conditional graph edges and tool frameworks. Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool servers that expose enterprise data sources as callable tools for AI agents, enabling natural-language-driven access to structured backend systems. Implement and refine RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines: document ingestion and chunking (PDF/Word), embedding generation, vector storage (e.g., PostgreSQL + pgvector), and semantic similarity retrieval to ground LLM responses in authoritative source documents. Integrate with enterprise LLM inference gateways via REST APIs, including request shaping, prompt template management, token budget control, and graceful degradation under service unavailability. Design and implement agent memory architectures — both short-term per-agent isolated context stores and long-term shared knowledge repositories used across agent workflows. Build confidence scoring and uncertainty quantification mechanisms for AI-generated outputs, including threshold-based routing of low-confidence results to human review. Implement agent feedback loops — capturing human reviewer decisions and feeding structured corrections back into prompt templates and knowledge repositories to continuously improve model behavior. Write LangChain4j / LangChain tool definitions (e.g., Java @Tool-annotated methods) and wire them into ReAct agents for data transformation, external API calls, and domain-specific processing. Build and maintain agentic audit trails — structured logs capturing every tool call, agent decision, LLM prompt/response, and state transition for traceability and explainability. Develop and test Spring Boot microservices (Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5.x) that host AI orchestration engines, expose REST APIs for downstream consumers, and integrate with upstream data source systems. Author and maintain Helm charts and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for containerized deployment of AI services to Kubernetes/OpenShift clusters across multi-region on-premise data centers. Build end-to-end and integration tests for non-deterministic AI components — including prompt regression suites, tool call mock frameworks, agent output schema validators, and determinism gates to catch silent prompt drift before production. Business Optimization & Vendor Management Department The Business Optimization & Vendor Management team supports effective planning, financial visibility, operational discipline, and informed decision-making. The team partners with budget owners, business leaders, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders to maintain reliable planning information, monitor financial commitments, improve reporting, and strengthen processes that help the organization use its resources effectively. Position Overview The Business Analyst, Budget Planning & Financial Operations supports budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities that help business leaders effectively manage approved budgets and financial commitments throughout the year. This role partners with budget owners and business leaders to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor spending, identify risks and opportunities, and keep assumptions aligned with current business needs. The analyst helps stakeholders avoid unexpected overspend while also identifying available funding and planned activities that may need action so approved resources are used effectively. The ideal candidate is analytical, highly organized, and comfortable working directly with stakeholders. As the individual develops knowledge of the business and its planning processes, they will take an increasingly active role in recurring forecast discussions, budget reviews, and follow-up with assigned budget owners. Essential Job Functions Budget Planning & Forecast Management Support annual budget planning and recurring forecast cycles, including non-labor operating expense and capital expenditure planning. Maintain and update forecast workbooks, planning files, assumptions, and supporting documentation throughout the year. Work with budget owners to understand spending plans, project timing, contract obligations, purchase commitments, and changing business priorities. Help budget owners maintain realistic forecasts that reduce the risk of overspending and highlight opportunities to use approved funding before year-end. Track forecast changes, open actions, and decisions to ensure planning information remains current and explainable. Identify potential overages, unused funding, timing shifts, and other risks or opportunities, and raise them for timely discussion and action. Support capital planning, project cost tracking, and workforce or position planning activities as assigned. Budget Owner & Business Leader Partnership Build productive working relationships with budget owners and business leaders. Prepare for and participate in recurring budget and forecast review meetings. Ask thoughtful questions, clarify assumptions, document decisions, and follow up on required updates. Explain budget, forecast, actual, and committed-spend information in clear business terms. Provide budget owners with timely information that supports prioritization and spending decisions. jd_text: Imagine yourself… Leading one of the most strategic digital transformation initiatives across a global organization. title: Project Manager, Construction Management
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Neuralink:</strong></p> <p>We are creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.</p></div><p><strong>Team Description:</strong></p> <p>Designing &amp; building physical infrastructure is a critical step to scaling Neuralink. The EPC Team at Neuralink is looking for a driven Associate Project Manager to join our team in Austin, TX. As part of the team, you will play an instrumental role in designing, planning, and constructing our campus and facilities. This position requires an outgoing and highly organized mindset, an ability to perform at a high level on a consistent basis, a desire to work on multi-disciplinary projects, and an excitement about Neuralink’s mission!</p> <p><strong>Job Description and Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p>Capital process planning for construction projects from initial budgetary inception to approved, and executed on time and within budgetary constraints. <strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Resolve construction conflicts in the field and in real time</li> <li>Contractor scheduling to ensure projects meet deadlines</li> <li>Sourcing materials and equipment required for delivering construction projects&nbsp;</li> <li>Reviewing and approving payment applications from contractors</li> <li>Responding to, or sourcing responses for RFIs related to constructability or deviations from construction drawings or manufacturer specifications</li> <li>Construction review meetings and reports with internal stakeholders at major milestones during construction</li> <li>Quality control reviews and reports to document the quality of constructed items</li> <li>RFIs and Submittals for the design team to review and approve during construction projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications: </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in civil, mechanical, architectural or similar engineering discipline</li> <li>&nbsp;Minimum 3 years of experience managing commercial construction or in tenant improvement projects, specifically for industrial buildings such as laboratories, clean rooms, or manufacturing facilities.</li> <li>&nbsp;Evidence of exceptional ability.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong><strong> </strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in site greenfield site design and build out including grading, roadway, pavements, utilities, and stormwater management plans</li> <li>Experience managing construction projects in hyper-scaling and start-up tech companies</li> <li>Experience with structural engineering, deep and shallow foundation designs, steel, concrete, and other building materials</li> <li>Experience in geotechnical engineering</li> <li>Experience in Mechanical, electrical and process piping construction&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience managing external consultants and contractors from design to substantial completion</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Expected Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the following range. Your actual base pay will be determined by your job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. We also believe in aligning our employees’ success with the company's long-term growth. As such, in addition to base salary, Neuralink offers equity compensation (in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSU)) for all full-time employees.</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$71,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$119,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><strong>What We Offer:</strong></p> <p>Full-time employees are eligible for the following benefits listed below.</p> <ul> <li>An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields</li> <li>Growth potential; we rapidly advance team members who have an outsized impact</li> <li>Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan</li> <li>Paid holidays</li> <li>Commuter benefits</li> <li>Meals provided</li> <li>Equity (RSUs) <em>*Temporary Employees &amp; Interns excluded</em></li> <li>401(k) plan <em>*Interns initially excluded until they work 1,000 hours</em></li> <li>Parental leave <em>*Temporary Employees &amp; Interns excluded</em></li> <li>Flexible time off <em>*Temporary Employees &amp; Interns excluded</em></li> </ul> </div></div>

title: AI Project Manager, CX
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p>We are seeking a motivated Project Manager to support customer-facing software and AI-enabled delivery projects. In this role, you will assist in day-to-day project coordination, documentation, and communication while learning best practices in AI and SaaS delivery. This position is ideal for someone looking to grow their project management career in a modern, AI-driven environment.</p> <p><strong>Role Description:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage delivery of software and AI-enabled projects under guidance of senior project managers.</li> <li>Maintaining project plans, schedules, RAID logs, and delivery documentation.</li> <li>Track project progress, risks, and dependencies and escalate as needed.</li> <li>Prepare and contribute to customer and internal status communications.</li> <li>Coordinate meetings, action items, and follow-ups across cross-functional teams.</li> <li>Support adherence to delivery processes, PMO standards, and best practices.</li> <li>Adapt to changing project priorities while maintaining attention to detail.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Delivery Experience (Preferred)&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to software delivery involving conversational AI or AI-enabled platforms.</li> <li>Basic understanding of AI, LLM, or NLU concepts and terminology.</li> <li>Ability to follow and document AI-related requirements and risks.</li> <li>Support customer expectation-setting with guidance from senior team members.</li> <li>Awareness of common AI risks such as data quality or model limitations.</li> <li>Familiar in learning prompt engineering concepts and AI performance metrics.</li> <li>Comfort using AI-powered tools for productivity, documentation, or analysis.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Project Management Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Up to 4 years of experience supporting customer-facing software or SaaS projects.</li> <li>Foundational understanding of AI, Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.</li> <li>Experience working in AI, technical, or SaaS environments preferred.</li> <li>Developing problem-solving and risk-awareness skills.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.</li> <li>Familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, MS Project, or Salesforce.</li> <li>PMP, AI, or similar certification a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and employees will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required.<br><br>This organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.​</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

title: Product Manager, Strategy & Growth
jd_text: <p><strong>Product Manager, Strategy &amp; Growth</strong></p> <p><strong>About OpenSesame</strong></p> <p>OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.<br>Learn more: <a href="http://www.opensesame.com/about">www.opensesame.com/about</a></p> <p><strong>About the Job</strong></p> <p>AI, new workforce models, and changing approaches to talent development are reshaping how organizations develop their people. These shifts create opportunities for OpenSesame that extend beyond individual product features to new products, markets, partnerships, business models, and roles we can play in the learning and workforce ecosystem.</p> <p>As Product Manager, Strategy &amp; Growth, you will identify and validate where OpenSesame can create new customer and business value. You will combine customer insight, market intelligence, emerging technology, and commercial thinking to shape product strategy and drive new growth.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, AI-forward role. You will use AI extensively to accelerate research, analysis, prototyping, and experimentation—but your focus will be broader than AI products. Your job is to anticipate where the future of work and learning is heading, test where OpenSesame has the right to win, and turn the strongest opportunities into products and businesses.</p> <p><strong>Performance-Based Objectives</strong></p> <p><strong>30 Days — Build the Opportunity Map</strong></p> <ul> <li>Complete 15+ customer and stakeholder interviews focused on unmet needs, changing buying behaviors, and the future of enterprise learning.</li> <li>Deliver a market and competitive assessment covering major shifts in AI, workforce development, skills, learning technology, and adjacent markets.</li> <li>Present a prioritized opportunity map identifying 3–5 areas for further validation, supported by customer, market, and business evidence.</li> <li>Build at least one prototype or concept to begin testing a high-potential opportunity with customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>60 Days — Validate the Best Opportunities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run customer experiments against the 3 highest-priority opportunities using prototypes, interviews, data, or other appropriate tests.</li> <li>Produce an evidence-based assessment of each opportunity covering customer value, differentiation, market potential, feasibility, and business model.</li> <li>Test pricing, packaging, partnership, or distribution hypotheses for opportunities with commercial potential.</li> <li>Recommend which opportunities to advance, modify, or stop based on evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>90 Days — Turn Opportunities into a Roadmap</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver a roadmap with specific experiments and investments across 3 developing areas where OpenSesame could create significant new customer and business value.</li> <li>Define the customer problem, strategic rationale, business hypothesis, success measures, and next experiment for each area.</li> <li>Launch at least one cross-functional initiative based on a validated opportunity.</li> <li>Deliver positioning, pricing, packaging, partnership, and GTM recommendations for initiatives approaching market validation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>6 Months — Prove Market Potential</strong></p> <ul> <li>Move at least 2 strategic opportunities from hypothesis through customer validation and market testing.</li> <li>Launch or pilot at least one new product, offering, partnership, or business model with customers.</li> <li>Deliver measurable evidence of adoption, willingness to pay, revenue potential, retention impact, or strategic differentiation.</li> <li>Present investment recommendations for scaling, iterating, or stopping each initiative based on results.</li> </ul> <p>You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.</p> <p>We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job — that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.</p> <p>Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer, and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This position can be located anywhere in the U.S or Canada. All positions will require up to 15 days of travel per year for company-wide events (typically January, May, September).&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Performance Driven</strong>: We’re looking for self-starters with a track record of follow-through, curiosity, and results. We don’t hire based on a checklist, we hire for potential, drive, and evidence of performance. If you’re motivated to learn, comfortable with experimentation, and excited about how technology can make sales more human, you’ll fit right in.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>: The base salary for this role ranges between $160,000 and $180,000 per year, depending on experience. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong>: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pay Transparency</strong>: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.</p> <p><strong>CPRA</strong> (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our<a href="https://www.opensesame.com/privacy"> privacy policy</a> or the California Attorney General's website.</p>

title: External Relations Project Manager
jd_text: Are you someone who strives for excellence, values accountability, provides the best service, all while reflecting unwavering integrity? Our talented team members across the state follow the behaviors, beliefs and outcomes of these core values to ensure that our vision is met. If you're ready to join the TSTC family and make great memories please complete our application process. Job Description The External Relations Project Manager serves as the division’s lead for project execution, operational improvement, and modernization initiatives across External Relations. This role provides senior-level leadership for divisional project intake, planning, tracking, and execution while driving continuous improvement efforts that strengthen operational performance, organizational effectiveness, and strategic alignment across the division. Working closely with divisional leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, the External Relations Project Manager translates strategic priorities into actionable plans, project roadmaps, and operational solutions. The role leads divisional efforts related to workflow redesign, service delivery improvement, operational streamlining, modernization, and execution discipline, ensuring projects and initiatives are aligned with TSTC priorities and positioned for sustainable success. The External Relations Project Manager serves as a senior technical professional who independently manages a complex portfolio of divisional projects, modernization efforts, and operational improvement initiatives. Through disciplined project leadership, stakeholder coordination, process improvement, and data-informed execution, this role strengthens divisional capacity, improves operational consistency, and supports the long-term operational maturity of External Relations. Essential Functions The employee will demonstrate TSTC’s Core Values of Excellence, Accountability, Service, and Integrity with internal and external stakeholders, customers, students, and members of the community. Project Intake, Planning & Prioritization Leads divisional project intake and planning processes by vetting new initiatives, proposals, and taskforce concepts and translating business priorities into project scopes, timelines, roadmaps, and recommended next steps. Partners with divisional leadership to assess feasibility, align priorities, and support informed decision-making regarding project activation, sequencing, ownership, and resource needs. Project Execution & Oversight Serves as project lead for select divisional initiatives and manages planning, execution, implementation, and transition to operational ownership as appropriate. Monitors major initiatives, projects, and operational efforts across the division to ensure alignment with goals, timelines, deliverables, and intended outcomes. Tracks progress through dashboards, trackers, data visualizations, and regular check-ins with project owners to support accountability and sustained execution. Operational Improvement & Modernization Leads divisional initiatives focused on improving operational efficiency, service delivery, execution consistency, and organizational performance across External Relations. Evaluates workflows, identifies operational challenges, and implements practical improvements that strengthen coordination, efficiency, and service outcomes. Leads modernization and transformation initiatives that improve divisional capabilities, operational agility, and service delivery through redesigned workflows, more effective operating models, and implementation of improved processes and tools. Project Accountability & Organizational Effectiveness Supports divisional accountability for project execution by monitoring milestone completion, surfacing roadblocks, and identifying at-risk efforts that require intervention or escalation. Facilitates post-project reviews, operational retrospectives, and follow-up planning to identify lessons learned, reinforce accountability, and sustain continuous improvement across divisional initiatives. Supports organizational effectiveness efforts that improve divisional coordination, execution discipline, and operational maturity. Reporting, Documentation & Decision Support Prepares operational plans, project summaries, executive briefs, status reports, dashboards, and related documentation to support divisional leadership reporting and decision-making. Organizes project-related information, documents progress, and produces materials that improve visibility into divisional priorities, project health, execution risks, and operational outcomes. Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement Builds strong working relationships across External Relations and with internal stakeholders across TSTC to support project alignment, communication, and execution. Facilitates collaboration across departments and project teams, creates forums for dialogue and issue resolution, and promotes shared understanding of priorities, timelines, roles, and responsibilities. Partners with divisional leadership and stakeholders to identify operational pain points, improve coordination, and strengthen divisional capacity. Strategic Planning & Divisional Support Partners with divisional leadership to support strategic planning, divisional goal setting, organizational evolution, and implementation of high-priority initiatives. Supports development of operational roadmaps, planning materials, and execution strategies that advance divisional priorities and strengthen alignment between day-to-day operations and long-range goals. Education & Experience Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in business, public administration, project management, organizational leadership, higher education administration, or a related field. Four years of experience in project management, operational improvement, organizational effectiveness, or related work involving complex cross-functional initiatives. Two years of experience leading continuous improvement, modernization, service delivery improvement, operational transformation, or organizational effectiveness initiatives. Experience developing project plans, roadmaps, reports, dashboards, or other tools used to support executive visibility, project monitoring, and operational decision-making. Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to plan, coordinate, and execute complex initiatives. Preferred Qualifications Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, Agile, Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM), Prosci, or other related certification. Five years of experience in project management, operational improvement, organizational effectiveness, or related work involving complex cross-functional initiatives. Three years of experience leading continuous improvement, modernization, service delivery improvement, operational transformation, or organizational effectiveness initiatives. Experience in higher education, workforce development, public sector operations, or another complex multi-stakeholder environment. Experience supporting executive-level planning, organizational change, or divisional strategy implementation. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree, except in cases where a specific degree is required to meet accreditation standards, licensure requirements, or other legislative or regulatory obligations. This includes, but is not limited to, certain faculty positions and staff roles governed by state or federal educational mandates. Skills & Abilities Ability to manage multiple projects, competing deadlines, and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment. Ability to analyze operational workflows, identify performance gaps, and develop and implement process improvement strategies. Ability to think strategically and develop innovative, practical, and sustainable solutions to operational challenges. Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Ability to collect, analyze, and present data and metrics to measure project impact and prepare reports and recommendations for leadership. Ability to develop project plans, implementation roadmaps, dashboards, and status reporting tools that support project execution and leadership visibility. Ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration, planning, and problem-solving across multiple stakeholder groups. Ability to convey complex information clearly through written, verbal, and presentation formats to diverse audiences. Core Competencies Strategic Project Leadership Independently manages complex divisional initiatives from intake and planning through execution and operational transition. Applies sound judgment to scope work, prioritize efforts, anticipate risks, and align project execution with divisional goals, timelines, and operational realities. Operational Improvement & Innovation Evaluates processes, identifies inefficiencies, and implements operational improvements that strengthen divisional performance, scalability, and service delivery. Applies continuous improvement principles, modern practices, and practical innovation to improve execution and organizational effectiveness. Cross-Functional Collaboration Builds effective partnerships across functions, teams, and leadership levels to support coordinated planning and execution. Facilitates communication, alignment, and shared problem-solving in support of divisional priorities and complex cross-functional work. Analytical Thinking & Decision Support Uses data, reporting, and operational analysis to evaluate progress, identify trends, and support informed decision-making. Develops dashboards, summaries, and executive-ready reporting that improve visibility and help leaders assess priorities, risks, and outcomes. Organization & Execution Discipline Maintains strong organization across multiple projects, workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholder needs. Ensures projects are monitored effectively, deliverables are tracked, commitments are followed through, and work is completed with accuracy and discipline. Adaptability & Change Agility Works effectively in evolving environments and supports change through structured planning, clear communication, and practical problem-solving. title: Senior Benefits Program Manager
jd_text: Who We Are Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise. Description The Senior Benefits Program Manager supports the design, and owns the administration and compliance of the organization's health and welfare plans and 401(k) plan. This individual is the subject-matter expert on benefits program execution, leading the annual enrollment process from start to finish and ensuring the company's retirement and welfare plans remain compliant with all applicable regulations. This is an individual contributor role requiring deep technical expertise and the ability to manage vendors and projects independently. Responsibilities Oversee day-to-day administration for all health, welfare, and 401(k) plans, serving as the primary escalation point for complex claims, eligibility, and plan interpretation issues. Lead the end-to-end annual open enrollment process, from plan changes and carrier negotiations through system configuration, communications, and reconciliation. Ensure regulatory compliance across all benefit offerings, managing ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, Section 125, nondiscrimination testing, Form 5500 filings, and plan disclosures. Manage relationships and service-level agreements with insurance carriers, third-party administrators, and the 401(k) recordkeeper, leading vendor evaluations and renewals. Reconcile monthly benefit invoices, analyze plan performance and utilization reporting, and deliver educational communications to support employees and budgeting decisions. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree required. 8+ years of progressive experience administering employee benefits programs. Proven experience leading the annual benefits open enrollment process from strategy through post-enrollment execution. Hands-on compliance experience managing ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, Section 125, and 401(k) plan requirements (e.g., Form 5500 filings and nondiscrimination testing). Experience utilizing HRIS and benefits administration software platforms. Preferred Qualifications Strong project management capabilities with a track record of leading plan implementations, carrier transitions, and process improvement initiatives independently. Excellent analytical and organizational skills, with demonstrated experience conducting invoice reconciliations and financial reporting. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on translating complex benefits concepts into clear employee education. A high degree of discretion and sound judgment when handling confidential employee data. title: Turbine/Generator Project Manager - Comanche Peak
jd_text: If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online. Job Summary The Turbine/Generator Project Manager provides project management of turbine generator and auxiliary systems maintenance, including modifications, upgrades, installations, maintenance during the preparation for and execution of plant outages. The project manager ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, meeting high standards of quality and customer satisfaction. Responsibilities include: Developing and maintaining the Turbine/Generator Long Range Plan. Leading and managing turbine generator projects, coordinating internal and external resources, while ensuring project deliverables are achieved safely within the approved scope, cost, and schedule. Leading the project from requirements definition through implementation, identifying schedules, scopes, budget estimations, and implementation plans, including risk mitigation. Reviewing complex project and contract budgets for adequacy, completeness, and other requirements. Identifying and developing solutions to items that may impact project schedule or cost and addressing with responsible parties and analyzing project status, revising the scope, schedule, or budget when necessary to ensure that project requirements can be met. Job Description Key Accountabilities Management and oversight of vendor contracts; acting as the Owner’s Representative. Delivery of projects within cost and schedule constraints involving multiple vendors and coordination of a variety of internal work. Providing a high level of customer service, continuous day-to-day support of peers/groups and proactive involvement with the leadership team, fellow peers and customers. Providing oversight of consultants and contractors to ensure policies/procedures are followed and standards are met, ensuring compliance with specifications and standards. Focusing on continuous improvement and providing leadership on initiatives and projects. Drive project team adherence to pre-outage and outage work management milestones. Demonstrated troubleshooting ability to identify issues, assess alternatives and risks, and implement solutions while keeping overall project on track. Establish and maintain processes for managing scope during the project lifecycle, setting quality and performance standards and assessing risks. Develop and maintain partnerships with third-party resources, including vendors and researchers Assign and monitor resources to ensure project efficiency and maximize deliverables. Report project outcomes and/or risks to the appropriate management channels and escalate issues, as necessary, according to project work plan. Performing Emergency Response Organization (ERO) duties as assigned. Education, Experience, & Skill Requirements High school or secondary school diploma with 8 years’ experience OR a bachelor’s degree or higher with five years’ experience 5-8 years of project management experience, preferably with steam turbine projects, and experience in construction management or the power generation industry are beneficial. Four years’ experience at a commercial nuclear power plant (preferred). PMP or IPMA certification is desired; will be required within 2 years of becoming the Project Manager. A strong understanding of steam turbine design, assembly, repair, and auxiliary systems is necessary. Knowledge of turbine thermodynamics and relevant industry standards is also helpful. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc..) , ERP systems (like SAP or Maximo), and other relevant software is needed. Essential skills include leadership, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, organization, and interpersonal abilities. The ability to multitask and work effectively in a matrix structure is also important. Strong written and oral/verbal communication skills, including the ability to make formal presentations to management. The ability to access all areas of a customer site, including confined spaces and heights, is required. The work environment involves both office and field settings, including power plants. There may be exposure to extreme temperatures, noise, and vibrations. Travel is required to support fleet outages, meetings and project execution/evaluation. title: Platform Architect (Remote)
jd_text: <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <p>You are a seasoned virtualization architect who thrives in complex, multi-domain environments and enjoys guiding clients towards outcomes that align technology with business strategy. You bring a consultative mindset to every engagement, asking the right questions and influencing decisions rather than leading with products. You are comfortable owning solution strategy end to end, partnering closely with Account Executives and technical leaders to drive successful deal outcomes. You also take pride in mentoring others, helping elevate technical rigor and consultative skills across the organization.</p> <p><strong>About The Role</strong></p> <p>The Senior Virtualization Pre-Sales Architect plays a critical role in shaping technical strategy for high-value, multi-practice opportunities at Myriad360. This role carries full ownership of solution architecture from discovery through design validation and deal progression. You will collaborate closely with Account Executives, Practice Directors, Client Solution Architects, and Principal Architects to deliver cohesive, scalable solutions that align with client goals and business priorities. As a senior technical leader, you will serve as a trusted advisor to clients and a mentor to CSAs and engineers across the organization.</p> <p><strong>Must be based and reside in the United States. Travel up to 25% may be required.</strong></p> <p><strong>Other responsibilities include:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Lead sophisticated, technical workshops centered on educating clients, creating conceptual designs, functional consumption plans, and other various workshop topics needed for pre-sales consulting</li> <li>Assume full ownership of solution architecture and technical strategy for medium to large-scale opportunities</li> <li>Proactively identify cross-practice opportunities spanning networking, data center, cloud, security, and platform engineering</li> <li>Collaborate with Client Solution Architects (CSAs) to ensure alignment across practices by supporting cohesive architectural solutions and well-defined execution pathways</li> <li>Collaborate with Practice Directors and Principal Architects to draft and validate solution designs, bills of materials (BOMs), and statements of work (SOWs)</li> <li>Serve as a key technical escalation point during advanced stages of the sales cycle</li> <li>Oversee and provide support for professional services engagements</li> <li>Build, maintain, and perform demos in the Myriad 360 lab and/or in partner lab environments</li> <li>Mentor CSAs and engineers in best practices for solution design, discovery methods, and consultative selling</li> <li>Contribute to the development of reusable solution patterns, reference architectures, and enablement resources</li> <li>Represent Myriad360 in senior-level client discussions, workshops, and technical briefings</li> <li>Complete ongoing security awareness training and comply with company policies to the requirements section</li> <li>Identify and escalate security risks to the appropriate Executive Leadership Team member and actively contribute to remediation efforts</li> <li>Other duties as assigned&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired skills and experience:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>7–10 years of experience in virtualization solution architecture, pre-sales engineering, technical consulting, and/or customer engineering roles</li> <li>Relevant OEM certifications (current VCF 9 certifications) are highly preferred</li> <li>Deep knowledge and hands-on experience with Broadcom VMware Cloud Foundation 9.x or its components preferred</li> <li>Demonstrated success in designing and selling non-VMware solutions such as Nutanix preferred</li> <li>Demonstrated knowledge in designing and selling vSphere Kubernetes Service and/or other Kubernetes platforms preferred</li> <li>Demonstrated success in designing and selling datacenter compute, storage, and/or data protection (DR, backup, replication) solutions desired</li> <li>Advanced consultative discovery skills with a proven ability to guide client decision-making processes</li> <li>Capability to independently manage complex technical sales cycles</li> <li>A strong desire to learn new technologies outside of your comfort zone to keep up with bleeding edge approaches</li> </ul> <p><strong>A Little About Us</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>Our mission is to challenge and enable our employees to achieve great things.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>We live and breathe our core values:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>We Before Me:</strong>&nbsp;We demonstrate empathy through our actions and solicit diverse voices and opinions. We put ourselves in each other’s shoes, readily admit our mistakes, and generously share our time and knowledge.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Dare To Be Great:</strong>&nbsp;We are big-picture thinkers who focus on solutions to problems. We solicit and offer actionable feedback to others without hesitation. We embrace opportunities to improve ourselves, our teams, and our work. We aim to be the best of the best.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Own It:</strong>&nbsp;We set clear expectations, communicate proactively, and follow through on our commitments. We take pride in the experiences we create and the outcomes we deliver. We are personally invested in the success of our team and our clients. We iterate to deliver ever better results.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>We are consistently listed among Inc &amp; Crain's "Best Places to Work" and we're proud of our accessible &amp; engaged executive team. We believe in cultivating an atmosphere of inclusion and providing an environment that enables every employee to work to the best of their ability.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Some of Our Benefits</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)</li> <li>Incentive compensation plans for all employees</li> <li>Company-funded 401k contributions</li> <li>Zero-cost employer-covered health insurance&nbsp;</li> <li>Annual BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) reimbursement up to $500</li> <li>Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Transparent, candid culture with 1:1 coaching, performance reviews, and a consistent feedback loop</li> <li>Quirky, diverse, respectful, high-performing coworkers you’ll want to achieve greatness with!&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pursuant to the NYC Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range in New York City for this position is&nbsp;$250,000- $275,000 OTE, (base salary plus opportunities for bonus and/or commission). Compensation in other geographies may vary.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Myriad360 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

title: Lead Technical Account Manager
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>After key customers have purchased and are implementing our products, the Technical Account Management (TAM) team takes ownership of the customer relationship and becomes their advocate within NiCE. The Technical Account Manager (TAM) begins to engage with the customer before they go live on the contact center platform, and works closely with the customer from that point forward to ensure their success.</p> <p>Our TAMs are seasoned account management and technical resolution professionals who are at the top of their field and are unified in exceeding customer expectations, improving our processes and technology, and meeting company growth objectives. The Lead TAM is a deeply experienced and expert account management professional, responsible for resolving the most complex problems and providing excellent technical and customer service to specific key accounts. TAM will help customers overcome issues that arise, succeed in their business using our technology and services, expand their usage of our products, be a reference to prospective customers, and be a long-term and loyal customer. The accounts assigned are generally our largest, most complex, and challenging customers.</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact? </strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Take ownership of the customer relationship for key CX customers and become their advocate within CX, engaging before go-live and working closely with customers to ensure their success.</li> <li>Resolve the most complex problems and provide excellent technical and customer service to specific key accounts, including resolving technically and emotionally challenging and high-stakes issues.</li> <li>Exemplify an effective and productive relationship with assigned accounts, holding regular discussions to review open issues, understand their contact center and business, ensure CX solutions meet their needs, and become a trusted partner and advisor.</li> <li>Ensure all technical challenges, issues, cases, and requests are handled properly and within SLA targets by partnering with Technical Support, Professional Services, Product Management, and Engineering.</li> <li>Be accountable for customer satisfaction, retention, and referenceability for all assigned accounts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes? </strong></p> <ul> <li>10 years in a Technical/Service role in software, telecommunications or in customer service, call/contact center and/or service delivery</li> <li>Demonstrated technical problem solving proficiency</li> <li>Excellent analytical and advanced troubleshooting skills with end-users/customers</li> <li>Working technical knowledge of contact center software/design/functionality</li> <li>Implementation: broad skills in both technology &amp; analysis; experience in communicating at a technical and functional level while managing business rapport</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>TCP/IP networking knowledge and VoIP technology exposure</li> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of TCP/IP, telecom circuits from DS0 through OC-48</li> <li>Understanding of network topology and telecommunications architecture (PBX, Carriers and VoIP)</li> <li>Understanding of basic scripting fundamentals</li> <li>Solid understanding of TCP/IP and internet fundamentals</li> <li>Extensive software, telecommunications and IP Telephony</li> <li>Experience using SIP signaling</li> <li>Competent in database and SQL concepts and scripting</li> <li>Desired personal profile: analytical, inquisitive, service &amp; team-oriented, friendly demeanor, early adopter</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></p> <p>Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!</p> <p><em>This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and employees will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by immediate supervisor and other management as required.</em><br><em>This organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.​</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

You’ll work closely with partner engineers, sales engineers, and internal teams to turn product knowledge into real-world solutions.</p> <p>You’ll be a go-to technical resource for partners, helping them move from basic understanding to confident execution across sales cycles and customer implementations.</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact? Information Systems team, you’ll contribute to system administration, user support, process automation, and data management—helping ensure our systems run efficiently and our users are set up for success.</p> <p><strong>Performance Objectives:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Within 30 Days:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Gain a general understanding of OpenSesame’s Salesforce environment and business systems.</li> <li>Complete onboarding, familiarize yourself with existing automation, and support user management requests, such as role and profile adjustments.</li> <li>Complete routine administration tasks within 2 business days and process at least 5 minor system modifications.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Within 60 Days:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with other Salesforce administrators to identify process inefficiencies and recommend solutions.</li> <li>Assist in resolving user-reported Salesforce issues, ensuring at least 95% of business requests are implemented within agreed-upon timelines.</li> <li>Document and update system changes within 48 hours to ensure alignment with business processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Within 90 Days:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop a standardized set of training materials and best practice guidelines for end users.</li> <li>Conduct at least one training session to improve adoption and efficiency.</li> <li>Take ownership of data imports, exports, and clean-up efforts, ensuring completion of data-related tasks within 2 business days.</li> <li>Participate in at least one significant process improvement that enhances system efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Within 120 Days:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Attend at least two training sessions or webinars per quarter to stay updated with the latest Salesforce releases and best practices.</li> <li>Work toward Salesforce Administrator certification, demonstrating a commitment to professional development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tech Stack</strong></p> <ul> <li>Salesforce</li> <li>CPQ</li> <li>Jira/Confluence</li> <li>Ringlead</li> <li>Make</li> <li>Gong</li> <li>Celigo</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This is a remote-first role, but candidates must be located in regions that allow for significant overlap with U.S. time zones.</p> <p><strong>Performance Driven</strong>: We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, and we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences.<br><br><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity: </strong>OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process. For more information on our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion initiatives, click<a href="https://www.opensesame.com/site/about/diversity-equity-inclusion"> <strong>here</strong></a>.</p> <p><strong>Pay Transparency: </strong>At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation.</p> <p><strong>We Care About Your Security:</strong> We’ve been made aware of a phishing scam involving individuals impersonating OpenSesame recruiters. All legitimate communication from our team will come from @opensesame.com email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message, please contact us directly at <a href="mailto:careers@opensesame.com">careers@opensesame.com</a>. Your security matters to us, thank you for staying vigilant.</p>

title: Lead HRIS Technology Consultant, Workday  (Remote)
jd_text: At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone. We put people first, and work hand in hand with employees and customers to create a diverse and inclusive environment. Passionate about building insurance and financial services solutions, we push the boundaries of what’s possible. We need you to help us shape what’s next. You’ll be encouraged to share your experiences, ideas and skills to help others take control of their financial future. Join a team that has received numerous awards for being a top place to work: TruStage awards and recognition Job Summary: This position is responsible for the ongoing development, improvement, support, maintenance and configuration of our cloud-based Human Resource Information System (HRIS). This person works with business units across the enterprise, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and HR areas to ensure the HRIS meets the needs of the enterprise as efficiently as possible. The role is balanced between high level operational execution and development, and execution of strategic direction of business function activities. Key Responsibilities: Provide end-user support for HRIS-specific issue resolution. Provide analysis, requirements gathering, configuration, testing, and migration of changes from demo to production for multiple functional areas of the HRIS. Work with SMEs, senior leaders, business unit experts and other HR areas to develop, improve and configure business processes, security settings, basic and advanced report setups and final configurations to meet the HRIS need of the business and to improve employee experience. Review and test vendor software updates. Review new features of software to support corporate strategy and align software to our needs. Act as HRIS SME and implementer for enterprise-wide or cross-functional projects, including mergers/acquisitions or other confidential projects. Implement new features of the HRIS software to meet changing business requirements. Provide expert guidance to the business related to changing features resulting from software updates. Partner with IT staff on effects of configuration/data changes on IT databases and other IT-owned systems. Create and maintain job aids specific to assist end users with self-service items in the system. Stay current on new functionality/offerings from vendor(s), and HRIS technology trends. Drive system optimization and enhancement initiatives by collaborating with HR department leads to identify automation opportunities, improve user experience, and develop strategic roadmaps that align HRIS capabilities with business objectives. Provide governance and oversight of HRIS, including data and data security. Ensure alignment between process and technology to ensure all changes support goals. Train/mentor team members with less experience. The above statement of duties is not intended to be all inclusive and other duties will be assigned from time to time. Job Requirements: Degree in Information Systems, Human Resources, business or related field or work experience. 7+ years’ experience as HRIS consultant required. Workday experience preferred. Proficient in seven or more of these HRIS functional areas: HCM (e.g., Staffing/Jobs/Organizations, Time off and Leave, Worker data, Onboarding), Benefits, Compensation, Talent, Performance, Recruiting, Payroll, Security, Integrations, Reporting. Strong consulting, analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate complex ideas/information related to systems. Demonstrated experience in providing positive, proactive communications. Strong familiarity with Cloud-based software concepts and business process modeling. Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly, concisely, logically, tactfully, and effectively, both verbally and in writing. Demonstrated strong interpersonal and customer care skills. Experience with agile methodology in project management. Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. Advanced Excel preferred. #LI-LT #LI-Remote If you’re ready to help make a difference, apply today. A resume is required to apply. TruStage may process applicant information using an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool. This tool automatically generates a screening score based on how well applicant information matches the requirements and qualifications for the position. TruStage recruiters use the screening score as a guide to further evaluate candidates; the score is one component of an application review and does not automatically determine whether a candidate moves forward. Candidates may choose to opt out of this process. Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan and exemption status. Base Salary Range: $104,200.00 - $156,300.00 At TruStage, we believe a sound, inclusive benefits program is of vital importance, along with a flexible workplace that allows for work-life balance, career growth and retirement assistance. In addition to your base pay, your position may be eligible for an annual incentive (bonus) plan. Additional benefits available to eligible employees include medical, dental, vision, employee assistance program, life insurance, disability plans, parental leave, paid time off, 401k, and tuition reimbursement, just to name a few. Beyond pay and benefits, we also recognize that flexibility, including working in a place you prefer, is essential to caring for our employees. We will continue to strive to offer flexibility and invest in technology and other tools that will make hybrid working normal rather than an exception, so that when “life happens,” you can focus on what’s most important. Accommodation request TruStage is a place where everyone can bring their best self and thrive. If you need application or interview process accommodations, please contact the accessibility department.
