title: Senior Financial Analyst - Varsity Spirit Products
jd_text: VARSITY SPIRIT, A VARSITY BRANDS COMPANY - THE DRIVING FORCE IN SPIRIT ACROSS CHEER, DANCE, BAND AND YEARBOOK For over 50 years, Varsity Spirit has been the leading global source for all things spirit, including cheerleading, dance team, performing arts and yearbook. Focused on safety, entertainment and traditional school leadership, Varsity Spirit’s 5,000+ employees are dedicated to celebrating school spirit. A leader in apparel innovation, educational camps, clinics, competitions, and yearbook, Varsity Spirit impacts more than a million athletes each year. OUR COMMITMENT TO SAFETY At Varsity Spirit, the safety and wellbeing of the young people we serve is of the utmost importance. Since our inception 50 years ago, we have been – and remain – steadfastly committed to doing our part to create a safe and positive environment for our participants’ physical, emotional, and social development, and promoting an environment free from abuse and misconduct. Varsity has a zero tolerance for abuse in its programs, events, and associated business activities. Varsity is committed to reporting all suspicions, allegations, and incidents of abuse in full accordance with local laws and reporting requirements. Learn more at Our Commitment to Safety - Varsity.com . WORK TYPE: Hybrid (Monday-Thursday / WFH Friday) LOCATION: Farmers Branch, TX Brands Headquarters - 14460 Varsity Brands Way WORK HOURS: 8am - 5pm CT TRAVEL: Travel is minimal; occasional out-of-area or overnight travel may be expected based on business needs. HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT: The Senior Financial Analyst, Varsity Spirit Products supports both accounting accuracy and forward-looking financial analysis for the business. The role provides month-end close support, reconciliations and accrual analysis while leading budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, variance analysis, and business performance insights. This position partners closely with Finance leadership, Accounting, Sales, Operations, and functional leaders to ensure reported results are accurate, forecasts are well supported, and management reporting provides clear visibility into profitability, accountability, and operational execution. A key expectation is to connect accounting detail with forward-looking financial insight and translate financial data into practical actions that improve financial accuracy and business performance. WHAT YOU WILL DO: Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Support month-end close activities, including preparation or review of journal entries, accrual analysis, account reconciliations, expense review, and investigation of unusual or unexpected activity. Ensure financial results and supporting schedules are accurate, complete, timely, and appropriately documented for management review, audit requests, and control requirements. Prepare monthly management reporting and executive-ready commentary that clearly explains performance versus budget, forecast, prior year, and key business metrics. Provide back up support for sales commission accruals and payments, including reviewing calculations, documentation, plan alignment, and appropriate treatment in financial reporting and forecasts Analyze revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, working capital, accruals, balance sheet activity, and other financial results to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights. Partner with business and functional leaders to review financial performance, validate forecast assumptions, explain variances, resolve accounting or reporting questions, and develop corrective actions as appropriate. Lead and support annual budget, rolling forecast, and long-range planning activities, including development of financial models, assumptions, templates, and business partner inputs. Build scenario models and sensitivity analyses to evaluate pricing actions, cost initiatives, investments, and changes in operating assumptions and communicate implications to decision makers. Support internal and external audit requests by providing accurate schedules, reconciliations, explanations, and supporting documentation. Continuously improve close, reporting, forecasting, data quality, documentation, internal controls, and analytical tools to increase accuracy, efficiency, and insight. Other duties as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS: Knowledge, Skills, Abilities Strong understanding of financial statements, month-end close, journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, management reporting, and key business drivers. Ability to connect accounting results to budget performance, forecast expectations, profitability, operational performance, and business decision-making. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to reconcile financial activity, identify trends and root causes, and recommend practical solutions. Effective business-partnering and communication skills with the ability to translate detailed accounting and financial information into clear insights for financial and non-financial audiences. Demonstrated ownership, attention to detail, organization, and ability to manage multiple close, reporting, and planning deadlines with limited supervision. Ability to constructively challenge assumptions, anticipate business needs, and proactively identify accounting, reporting, or financial risks and opportunities. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with ERP, financial planning, reporting, and business intelligence tools. Success Indicators Accurate and timely month-end close support, reconciliations, accrual analysis, budget, forecast, variance analysis, and management reporting deliverables. Clear identification and explanation of key accounting activity, financial drivers, risks, opportunities, and performance trends. Improved forecast accuracy through disciplined assumptions, accurate accounting inputs, business partner engagement, and proactive risk and opportunity tracking. Effective partnership with Finance, Accounting, Sales, Operations, and functional leadership. Executive-ready reporting and commentary that connects accounting results to management decisions and future financial performance. Continued improvement in close processes, reporting tools, forecasting processes, documentation, internal controls, data quality, and analytical capabilities. Education, Certification and Experience Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field required. Five or more years of experience in accounting, financial analysis, FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or a related accounting or finance role. Strong understanding of financial statements, month-end close, account reconciliations, accruals, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with SAP or other ERP, financial planning, reporting, or business intelligence systems. Experience supporting accounting and finance activities in business unit finance, manufacturing, distribution, apparel, consumer products, or a similar environment preferred. Experience developing budget and forecast models, executive reporting packages, dashboards, KPI reporting, reconciliations, or automated financial analysis tools preferred. CPA, CMA, MBA, or progress toward a professional certification preferred. Experience supporting SOX, audit, internal controls, financial statement review, or balance sheet reconciliation requirements preferred. Supervisory Responsibility This position has no direct reports. Physical Demands and/or Work Environment This job operates in a professional office environment. Largely a sedentary role with some filing requiring the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bending or standing on a stool as necessary. title: Commercial Operations Analyst
jd_text: WaterBridge is hiring a Commercial Operations Analyst for our Midland, TX office location. The Commercial Operations Analyst will support WaterBridge's Commercial Operations team across pricing, contract analysis, financial modeling, and business development. This is a high-visibility role that works directly with commercial leadership and interfaces regularly with finance, engineering, and operations. The right candidate is comfortable moving between detailed financial models and clear recommendations, with some exposure to customer-facing work as needed. Primary Duties & Responsibilities: Coordinate with operations and corporate engineering on produced water takeaway and supply project scopes Track and analyze customer volumes, revenue, and performance of the supply business Problem solve and help with strategy to maximize supply opportunities across company Assist operations with optimizing produced water takeaway commercial opportunities Support customer relationship management in coordination with senior commercial staff through tracking and maintaining project timelines and regular updates on projects Assist in the development and execution of business development initiatives, including preparation of term sheets, proposals, and presentations for prospective customers Assist in the aggregation of market activity and commercial opportunities to drive further growth Build and maintain financial and operational models to evaluate commercial opportunities, including new company projects, customer contracts, volume commitments, and rate structures Support contract negotiations by preparing economic analyses, scenario runs, and pricing proposals Work cross-functionally with operations, land, finance, accounting and legal to ensure contract terms are accurately captured and executed Prepare regular reporting packages for internal stakeholders and senior leadership Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor's degree in engineering, economics, finance, or a related field 3 to 5 years of experience in O&G operations, commercial, or analytical role Experience and working knowledge of both upstream and midstream operations Experience using Enverus to export and analyze permit activity, rig counts, DUCs, remaining inventory, production profiles, and offset operator activity Clear written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to internal and external audiences, with proficiency in PowerPoint Ability to work cross-functionally across multiple groups Strong skills in Excel; experience with financial models Basic ability to read and understand contract structures Working knowledge of discounted cash flow analysis and return metrics including IRR, NPV, FCF yield, and MOIC Detail oriented with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously without sacrificing accuracy Working Conditions/Environment: Operates in a professional and/or business casual office environment. title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Tech Lead), Robot Learning, Loco- Manipulation
jd_text: <h1><span style="color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">Build the Path Forward</span></h1> <p>At Path Robotics, we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.</p> <p>Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.</p> <p>We are standing up a new Robot Learning team focused on whole-body loco-manipulation for precision tasks in heavy manufacturing.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Tech Lead) for this new team. You write code, set the technical direction, make the architectural decisions the team builds on, mentor junior and intermediate engineers, and help shape how the team works.</p> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Set the ML technical direction for the team, architectural choices on perception, reasoning, and action generation; training methodology; data strategy; the path from research bet to deployed capability. As one of the first senior hires, you are designing the approach, not extending it.</li> <li>Own the architectural workstreams that define the team's research and engineering bets — multiple core build streams across action-policy learning, world-model-based supervision, and policy-orchestration interfaces.</li> <li>Design hybrid physics-ML architectures for the integrated loco-manipulation stack. Manipulation, locomotion, and the whole-body control coupling between them are not separable on legged platforms; sub-millimetre continuous-trajectory precision at the tool requires the whole-body controller to compensate for base motion in real time. Today on fixed bases; tomorrow on mobile platforms. The integration is the hard problem; you own its design.</li> <li>Own the cross-functional partnerships with hardware teams, domain experts, customer-facing assurance standards, and upstream / downstream teams. Drive a phased deployment strategy that builds production trust over time.</li> <li>Mentor and shape the team, guide junior and intermediate ICs across software, ML, robotics, and perception backgrounds; establish code-quality standards, review practices, and engineering norms; help identify and attract next hires. You write code throughout — this is a tech-lead role, not a step away from the work.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Ph.D. or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent experience.</li> <li>5+ years of hands-on robot learning experience. You have shipped sim-to-real policies on real robots, across different tasks or platforms.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership and mentorship. You have made architectural decisions on robot learning systems that others built on, and you have meaningfully shaped the development of more-junior engineers as a tech lead. This can be in academia (leading a lab subgroup, advising students) or industry.</li> <li>Deep sim-to-real expertise — domain randomisation, system identification, teacher-student distillation, sim-to-online fine-tuning. You can design a transfer strategy for a novel problem.</li> <li>Full-stack robot learning — fluent across simulation construction, policy training, data collection, real-world deployment, and failure diagnosis.</li> <li>Physics-informed ML or hybrid control experience — PINNs, neural ODEs, MPC with learned dynamics, process-model-conditioned generation, or similar.</li> <li>A defensible view on visual-reasoning-centric substrates for grounded spatial / physical reasoning.</li> <li>Push-back willingness — you can defend a non-obvious architectural commitment under pressure, and change your mind on evidence.</li> <li>Strong programming skills in Python and C++; production-quality code with reproducibility, testing, and maintainability discipline.</li> <li>Strong communication skills, able to convey complex technical concepts to a diverse audience.</li> <li>Demonstrated independent technical authority — you have set technical direction in a tech-lead capacity, leading a research subgroup, owning an architecture across multiple ICs' work, or making the architectural call on a high-profile project.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Edge inference depth (TensorRT, ONNX, edge-class deployment).</li> <li>Loco-manipulation experience — locomotion, whole-body control, and manipulation on legged platforms (quadrupeds, humanoids). The coupling between the three is the hard problem; direct hands-on experience or a defensible architectural view both count.</li> <li>Precision manipulation or surgical robotics — sub-mm accuracy tasks.</li> <li>Flow-matching action-head design at depth — direct experience with the architectural pattern.</li> <li>Visual self-supervised representation learning experience on robot or 3D-vision tasks.</li> <li>Multi-skill workflow or hierarchical policy design — skill sequencing, failure detection, control mode transitions.</li> <li>Experience building ML capability from early stage — first or second ML engineer on a team, or built a research group's infrastructure from scratch.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Why You’ll Love Working Here</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team</li> <li>Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it</li> <li>Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage</li> <li>6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total)</li> <li>401(k) retirement plan through Empower</li> <li>Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team!</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.</p> <p>If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. You will keep inbound, outbound, and reverse shipments moving across air, ocean, and ground, hold carriers to service and cost targets, and give the business a clear picture of status and risk before a delay hits production or a customer.</p> <p>Your focus is transportation operations, carrier relationships, and transport risk. You will manage assigned lanes and carriers, recover disruptions, support routing and rate decisions, and coordinate with suppliers, carriers, internal teams, and trade/compliance partners so freight arrives on time and in spec.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee carrier management, including daily operations, shipment flows, service quality evaluation, and performance monitoring</li> <li>Monitor carrier performance and implement corrective actions when necessary to ensure service quality and compliance</li> <li>Tracks, traces, and updates status for inbound and outbound materials, and consumer products and acts as the point of contact for logistics-related issues for Starlink logistics</li> <li>Mitigate transport-related risks by identifying potential issues and implementing appropriate risk management strategies</li> <li>Manage exceptions and disruptions in transportation operations, proactively finding solutions to minimize impact on supply chain operations</li> <li>Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and coordination across different functions, such as procurement, sales, and customer service</li> <li>Develop and maintain strong relationships with carriers to ensure reliable and cost-effective transportation services</li> <li>Collaborate with carriers to negotiate rates, service levels, and support with the development of contract terms and service requirements</li> <li>Stay up-to-date with industry trends and regulations, implementing best practices in carrier management and transport risk mitigation</li> <li>Analyze transport data and metrics to identify areas for improvement and cost reduction</li> <li>Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to provide updates on transportation operations and address any issues or concerns</li> <li>Reports daily status to business stakeholders and weekly logistics statuses as required</li> <li>Ensure business practices not only guarantee the movement of products in a quality manner, but also meet those needs outlined in regulatory documentation, internal requirements, and customer flow-downs</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC chains</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, engineering, or a science discipline</li> <li>Proven intermodal networks and knowledge of global supply chain and logistics markets and networks</li> <li>Import and export experience with compliance with ITAR and C-TPAT regulations</li> title: Manager, Logistics (Inbound & CapEx)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, LOGISTICS (INBOUND &amp; CAPEX)</strong></p> <p>As the Manager of Logistics, you will own the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of inbound logistics, fulfillment networks, and global transportation operations. You will drive carrier performance, develop and refine KPI methodologies, lead sourcing strategy and carrier partnerships, and expand logistics and transport networks that support freight, e-commerce, and industrial projects. This role has end-to-end accountability for network health, cost optimization, and operational excellence across domestic and international movements.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop, execute, and continuously evolve enterprise-wide logistics strategies, programs, and initiatives that optimize inbound logistics, fulfillment networks, and end-to-end transportation performance, directly enabling the achievement of aggressive volume, cost, and profitability targets while supporting rapid business growth.</li> <li>Establish and manage robust carrier performance management frameworks, including the design and maintenance of comprehensive KPIs, scorecards, and real-time reporting tools; leverage data analytics to identify trends, drive measurable operational improvements, and ensure the overall health and resilience of the global logistics network.</li> <li>Lead strategic sourcing initiatives and cultivate high-performing carrier partnerships through end-to-end management of RFPs, contract negotiations, rate and tariff optimization, and ongoing performance governance with third-party logistics providers and transportation partners.</li> <li>Drive the global expansion and optimization of logistics and transportation networks to support freight, e-commerce, and complex industrial project requirements, proactively identifying and onboarding new lanes, transportation modes, and service providers as business needs evolve.</li> <li>Analyze, model, and redesign inbound and outbound transportation, distribution methods, and network architecture to deliver cost-effective, scalable, and operationally efficient solutions that reduce lead times and improve service levels.</li> <li>Define, implement, and evolve a comprehensive set of Key Logistics Performance Indicators (KPIs) and executive-level dashboards that provide real-time visibility into network health, carrier performance, fulfillment operations, and overall supply chain effectiveness.</li> <li>Identify, prioritize, and lead cross-functional cost-reduction and process-optimization initiatives across internal and external logistics spend, including packaging design, routing optimization, mode selection, and end-to-end process improvements.</li> <li>Partner closely with Supply Chain, Production, and Engineering teams to align logistics strategies with broader business objectives and ensure seamless support for new product introductions, production ramps, and project launches.</li> <li>Collaborate with Global Compliance, Customs, Tax, Finance, and Supply Chain stakeholders to ensure full adherence to all regulatory, customs, brokerage, duty, Incoterms, and trade compliance requirements while proactively identifying opportunities to reduce landed costs and streamline processes.</li> <li>Develop, document, and institutionalize best practices for internal logistics operations, product flow optimization, packaging specifications, and material handling systems to drive consistency, safety, and efficiency across the organization.</li> <li>Prepare, manage, and own the annual logistics budget for all inbound and outbound transportation spend, including forecasting, variance analysis, and strategic recommendations to optimize resource allocation.</li> <li>Serve as the primary escalation point for complex logistics issues, leading root-cause analysis, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and driving accountability with both carriers and internal stakeholders to minimize disruption and improve long-term performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>5+ years of demonstrated experience developing and improving KPI frameworks and carrier performance management programs.</li> <li>5+ years of experience leading sourcing strategy, carrier negotiations, and partnership management.</li> <li>5+ years of proven people management experience, including leading, developing, and supporting logistics teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience managing complex international and domestic inbound and outbound logistics networks, fulfillment networks, or global transportation operations.</li> <li>Proven track record of scaling logistics operations and network capacity by 10x or more.</li> <li>Experience leveraging network size and shipment volume to optimize spend and improve competitive advantage.</li> <li>Proven track record expanding logistics networks to support freight, e-commerce, and industrial/manufacturing projects.</li> <li>Strong background in 3PL/4PL management, freight forwarding and ocean/air/domestic, with proven ability to manage and leverage relationships to scale operations, accelerate solution delivery, and drive strong network performance.</li> <li>Experience with ITAR, C-TPAT, HTS/Schedule B, Incoterms, and international compliance.</li> <li>Proficiency with MRP/ERP systems, logistics platforms, and data analytics tools.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.</li> <li>Experience supporting high-growth or high-mix manufacturing environments.<br>Experience developing and supporting complex global logistics networks and supply chains.</li> <li>Experience with procurement and development of solutions for freight, warehousing, e-commerce, and special project services.</li> <li>Experience managing logistics compliance and regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Experience preparing and managing logistics budgets and driving cost reduction initiatives.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with experience using data to measure network health, carrier performance, and operational efficiency.</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Tax and Operations teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span title: Manager, Supply Chain (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, SUPPLY CHAIN (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The SpaceX supply chain organization is critical to Starship's mission. To capitalize on SpaceX’s technological and market-changing successes, our team will help manage an agile yet robust supply chain that enables the company's competitive advantage. The department includes procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics, and inventory. SpaceX's supply chain will play a key role in enabling it to meet ambitious growth targets and help make us a multi-planetary species.</p> <p>The Manager of Supply Chain at SpaceX is responsible for defining and implementing policies and strategies for near- and mid-term sourcing results. The incumbent will make strategic decisions that impact the department and have broad influence across SpaceX organizations. Success in this role will require strong communication skills, sourcing intuition and best practices, and commodity management experience to systematically grow and mature SpaceX suppliers into strategic partners.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Manage the Starship team of Supply Chain Sourcing Managers and Specialists. Lead, direct, and review the teams' work, spending substantial time on people management responsibilities. Responsible for defining the structure of the teams and providing mentorship and strategic development planning for first- and second-level direct reports</li> <li>Manage the team by providing clear direction that aligns with the strategy and priorities of the company</li> <li>Hire, develop, and retain top talent to meet current and future business needs</li> <li>Demonstrate innovation, technical excellence, attention to detail, self-direction, &amp; courage</li> <li>Develop and enhance transactional processes to gain organizational efficiency</li> <li>Manage KPIs, including inventory and spend to match program targets</li> <li>Ensure accurate system signals, including accuracy of demand signals (so that they match program rate), BOMs, upstream and downstream lead times, etc.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Supplier Development:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Manage vendor relationships and grow the supply base as needed in alignment with the broader team sourcing strategy</li> <li>Assess supplier capabilities, technologies, and their ability to execute component/assembly manufacturing requirements successfully. Manage validation exercises to demonstrate initial feasibility through full-scale production of transferred work</li> <li>Manage supplier improvement programs. Drive improvements utilizing Lean methodologies, supplier scorecards, and supplier audits, ensuring supplier compliance while driving systematic problem-solving and process improvement plans to deliver value</li> <li>Provide program leadership necessary to ensure that product quality, delivery, and cost achieve business and customer expectations</li> <li>Interface with Starship teams to prioritize supplier development needs by commodity to improve cost competitiveness or supply constraints</li> <li>Drive supplier selection through robust qualification processes</li> <li>Deliver results as measured by key metrics such as part yield, cost, defect rate, etc.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <li><strong>Self-Management &amp; Relationship Management:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Be assertive, optimistic, resilient, and welcoming of change</li> <li>Engages interest and participation of others and has a collaborative approach to working together</li> <li>Contribute to the team proactively</li> <li>Be self-aware and able to work on own initiative</li> <li>Show moral courage, openness and honesty in all dealings</li> <li>Develops and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure optimal performance</li> <li>Communicate efficiently across internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Take a diplomatic approach to relationships</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced degree and 4+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 10+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Engineering</li> <li>Purchasing</li> <li>Contract negotiation</li> <li>Material or production planning</li> <li>Operations or supply chain management</li> <li>Material cost control</li> <li>Master production scheduling</li> </ul> <li>2+ years of experience in personnel management with formal direct reports</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity or experience working with aerospace components</li> <li>Strong ability to read drawings and blueprints, with an understanding of manufacturing complexity</li> <li>Experience with technical procurement, manufacturing, or designing production components</li> <li>APICS certification</li> <li>Lean Six Sigma certification</li> <li>Ability to prove a strong track record of leadership and team building</li> <li>Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed and positive impact</li> <li>Ability to learn quickly and prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs</li> <li>Exceptional analytical and organizational skills</li> <li>Excellent customer service skills, produce exceptional work at all times, highly self-motivated</li> <li>Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills</li> <li>Strong technical knowledge and skills in current technologies and applications (e.g., MS Office Suite, SQL, Power BI, etc.)</li> <li>Detail-oriented and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment</li> <li>Holds themselves to the highest ethical standards and conducts all activities with the highest integrity</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to pass an Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral</li> <li>Must be able to travel - up to 50% of the work week; travel may be required, including international travel</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones</li> <li>This position is based in Starbase, TX, and requires being onsite; remote work is not considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Manufacturing Engineer, Supply Chain (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><span data-teams="true"><strong>MANUFACTURING ENGINEER, SUPPLY CHAIN (STARSHIP)</strong></span></p> <p>SpaceX demands a new type of supply chain. We require our suppliers to provide premium quality with rapidly evolving designs at increasingly ambitious volumes. We are actively looking for candidates who possess comprehensive knowledge of manufacturing and quality tools and have unrelenting motivation to enable suppliers for success. This position will support our Starship program and requires a combination of proven leadership and technical capabilities.</p> <p>This is a highly technical position that requires practical experience in manufacturing engineering and new product development through to stabilized production for an array of fabrication processes (components and assemblies) used in rockets and rocket engines.&nbsp;The ideal candidate will have a broad and thorough understanding of propulsion/fluid system component fabrication including extrusions, draw forming, welded and seamless tubing, cutting, and assembly, along with associated processes. This candidate should have the desire and capability to take on new challenges in unfamiliar areas to help enable our mission to Mars.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the technical point of contact for assigned parts and assemblies of the rocket, solving emergent challenges at suppliers, and mitigating risk to the manifest by addressing high-impact manufacturing and quality challenges</li> <li>Own the new product introduction of new assemblies on the rocket, including determining the ideal manufacturing method, identifying suppliers, and developing a reliable process for ramping to rate. This individual is expected to be the extreme owner for the process at suppliers for new parts, drawing changes, or when re-sourcing existing parts to a new supplier</li> <li>Conduct design for manufacturing (DFM) reviews to ensure parts are manufacturable at early stages, preferably prior to sourcing</li> <li>Work with procurement to find exceptional suppliers and vet them appropriately for quality and ability to meet our aggressive takt times</li> <li>Create and develop specifications as needed to flow down quality and manufacturing requirements to the supply base</li> <li>Scope out new changes at the supplier, at SpaceX or both, as appropriate, drive further actions to closure, and re-source to new suppliers where appropriate</li> <li>Create and disposition issue tickets where needed, working with engineering counterparts to implement, but not limited to, required re-work, repair or use as-is disposition</li> <li>Become thoroughly familiar with your assigned parts and the processes that make up the overall assembly and become the primary point of contact for supply chain related defects on your parts</li> <li>Demonstrate innovation, technical excellence, attention to detail, self-direction and courage to push the technical envelope which is conventionally held in the industry.</li> <li>Lead containment activities on assigned parts, working with cross-functional counterparts to agree on scope, path forward and ultimate resolution</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>1+ in engineering or business</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of propulsion/fluid systems and the respective component manufacturing processes including: raw materials, draw forming, extrusions, seamless and welded tubing, pipe manufacturing, bending, welding, proof/pressure testing, and other forming &amp; assembly processes.</li> <li>Fundamental understanding of sheet metal forming, cutting, and assembly processes, particularly in stretch forming (longitudinal and transverse), stamping (progressing and transfer), spin forming, roll forming, roll bending, press brake forming, hydroforming and tube forming/bending of primarily, but not limited to, stainless and carbon steels.</li> <li>Experience with machining and ancillary operations such as milling, turning, and tube cutting of materials</li> <li>Experience with engineering drawings, modeling, GD&amp;T, etc.</li> <li>General familiarity with welding (TIG, MIG and orbital tube welding) of stainless and carbon steels is a plus</li> <li>Knowledge of supplier quality processes (production part approval process, advanced product quality planning, first article inspection reports, etc.)</li> <li>Knowledge of statistical techniques and methods, e.g., design of experiments, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.</li> <li>Experience with quality systems (ISO 9000/TS/AS9100/NADCAP) and MRP/ERP systems</li> <li>Disciplined title: Operations Engineer, Supply Chain (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>OPERATIONS ENGINEER, SUPPLY CHAIN (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. As an Operations Engineer within the Starlink program you will analyze, develop, and implement tactical and strategic business processes for the supply chain group to create high impact, efficient, economical solutions. Ideal team members are highly autonomous individuals that excel in flexible environments and bring clarity and informed decision-making to our leadership teams that drive the organization.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build relationships with cross-functional groups to identify, prioritize, and lead challenging projects to completion and take ownership for the success and sustainability of actions</li> <li>Create dashboards, models, and other types of reporting to enable strategic visibility and build a business case for improvement efforts</li> <li>Review and analyze gathered data to identify opportunities for efficiency gains and drive improvement for both supplier and internal processes</li> <li>Anticipate and identify operational challenges within the organization, lead problem formulation, determine root cause, and develop creative and effective solutions</li> <li>Contribute to a systems roadmap and work with broader application software team to support ERP tools development &amp; supplier-facing portal enhancements</li> <li>Develop, standardize and continuously improve supply chain metrics</li> <li>Drive for results and customer satisfaction by collaborating with teams, leading projects, and continuously spearheading improvements in supply chain</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or operations/supply chain management</li> <li>1+ years of experience in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, or software engineering</li> <li>1+ years of experience with SQL or business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Grafana)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years using SQL, Python, and business intelligence tools (PowerBI, Tableau)</li> <li>Degree in industrial and systems engineering, operations or supply chain management</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and use data to drive systemic improvements for the business.</li> <li>Proficient in identifying system enhancement opportunities, understanding end user requirements, and the ability to translate requirements into design requirements</li> <li>Understanding of business concepts relating to supply chain management (procurement, sourcing, material movement/logistics, supplier quality, etc.)</li> <li>Demonstrated experience managing simultaneous projects with tight deadlines and navigating ambiguous problem statements</li> <li>Experience with sharing information and influencing others across organizational lines, internally, and externally</li> <li>Proficient in Microsoft Office 365, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint</li> <li>Experience with lean, six sigma, and related production principles</li> <li>Experience or education in management science and engineering, operations engineering, operations research, or industrial engineering</li> <li>Ability to work both autonomously and jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. SUPPLY CHAIN PLANNER, XAI (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>As a member of the Starlink Supply Chain Planning team you will support an elite group of engineers and supply chain professional to establish and maintain the signals that drive the business and enable production of the Starlink satellite constellation. Our team moves quickly and you must too. SpaceX has the unique ability and desire to influence and shape suppliers to be better with us as we challenge our supply chain on cost, quality, and speed of execution. This role’s scope will help develop the factory of the future.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy and audit bill of materials in MRP systems in preparation for production at rate</li> <li>Establish/Manage inventory level targets, review line of balances, align demand supply signals and allocations, maintain product master data, and develop expertise in in-house systems and reports</li> <li>Mitigate risk and ensure continuity of supply by constructing and executing a well-thought-out supply plan that fulfills the needs of the product on time and with <li>Coordinate with engineering, production, and quality organizations to determine change cut in and reduce obsolescence of material and eliminate/reduce quality issues</li> <li>Partner with internal stakeholders on implementing advanced supply chain strategies for risk mitigations like long-term purchases and strategic safety stock</li> <li>Proactively manage inventory, and prevent stock outs while optimizing the utilization of SpaceX working capital</li> <li>Develop and maintain good relationships with manufacturing, engineering, and supply chain teams to enable the mission</li> <li>Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures and government regulations</li> <li>Proactively update SpaceX management and engineering teams on all critical supply issues</li> <li>Analyze supply chain data and report metrics around the health of MRP and the businesses execution against it</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 3+ years of experience working in one or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li>Engineering</li> <li>Purchasing</li> <li>Contract negotiation</li> <li>Material or production planning</li> <li>Operations or supply chain management</li> <li>Material cost control</li> <li>Master production scheduling</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical knowledge in a commodity – for example, machining, sheet metal fabrication, tube bending and assembly, weldment assembly, purchasing/planning functions</li> <li>SQL Experience</li> <li>PowerBI experience</li> <li>Advanced skills in MS Excel and Project, able to create pivot tables or macros, and analyze data</li> title: Sr. Technical Project Lead (Silicon Engineering)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p class="ms-outlook-mobile-reference-message"><strong>SR. TECHNICAL PROJECT LEAD (SILICON ENGINEERING)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable. Your efforts will help deliver cutting-edge silicon solutions that will expand the performance and capabilities of the Starlink network.&nbsp; &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leverage experience and technical background to drive complex and challenging silicon projects from kick-off through production</li> <li>Track and communicate schedules and milestones for front-end and backend ASIC development tasks</li> <li>Work with multidisciplinary teams to introduce new silicon to drive fast as possible bring-up</li> <li>Collaborate with silicon team and supply chain to find suppliers for silicon development</li> <li>Lead discussions with internal and external teams to identify and rectify issues</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li>8+ years of Technical Project or Program Management experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li>Project leadership of satellite and/or consumer product lifecycle(s)</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both written and verbal to communicate with stakeholders across the company</li> <li>Knowledge and experience with digital and/or analog/RF ASIC design processes from project kick-off to tape-out</li> <li>Knowledge and hands on experience working with external IP and EDA tool vendors</li> <li>Experience working with advance node fabs, package substrate and OSAT partners&nbsp;</li> <li>In-depth understanding of the steps required to go from engineering wafers to mass production</li> <li>Silicon project management skills with experience in most or all of the following areas: <ul> <li>Silicon design, bring-up, qualification, and ramp-up to production</li> <li>Pre-silicon testing with emulation or FPGA platform</li> <li>Wafer and package part ATE testing</li> <li>Silicon packaging</li> <li>Silicon reliability and package qualification for mission profile</li> <li>PCB schematics and layout</li> <li>Silicon software drivers and diagnostic scripts</li> </ul> </li> <li>Ability to work in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements</li> <li>Proficiency in project/program management tools such Jira, Smartsheet, confluence or equivalent tools&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to travel when needed (typically &lt;10%)</li> <li>Ability to work extended hours and prevent stock-outs while optimizing utilization of SpaceX working capital</li> <li>Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with manufacturing, engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to achieve mission success</li> <li>Ensure compliance with all company policies and procedures, government regulations, and laws</li> <li>Proactively update SpaceX leadership and engineering teams on critical PCB/PCBA supply issues, shortages, and recovery plans</li> <li>Analyze supply chain data and report on MRP health metrics and their relation to business goals; implement analytical title: Trader, Natural Gas (Supply Chain)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>TRADER, NATURAL GAS (SUPPLY CHAIN)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is on a fast track to become the market leader in various product categories like US-based human spaceflight, rapid vehicle reusability, internet services through the Starlink constellation, and other exciting projects. The SpaceX supply chain is a critical player in our operations to efficiently fuel our aspirations. To capitalize on SpaceX’s technological and market-changing successes, the Trader will be part of managing an agile, yet robust, supply chain that will enable a competitive advantage for SpaceX. This role focuses on physical and financial natural gas trading and supply optimization to secure reliable, cost-effective energy commodities that support launch operations, vehicle production, and related infrastructure. SpaceX's supply chain will play a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet these ambitious growth targets and greatly contribute to making humans a multi-planetary species.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Establish and lead a new, lean natural gas trading team responsible for originating, structuring, and executing physical and financial natural gas transactions to support SpaceX’s growing power and fuel needs.</li> <li>Develop and execute directional, spread, physical, and financial trading strategies for natural gas to reduce supply risk, ensure on-time delivery, and align with company strategy.</li> <li>Identify pricing inefficiencies, market distortions, and opportunities across tenors, hubs, pipelines, storage, and products; generate and manage profit and loss statement (P&amp;L).</li> <li>Manage trading positions in response to fundamental, technical, weather-driven, fuel/emissions, regulatory, and operational signals.</li> <li>Maintain strong discipline in position development, risk management, and trade execution.</li> <li>Act as a market intelligence provider on natural gas categories, pipelines, storage, power purchase agreements, cryogenic commodities, and related markets.</li> <li>Benchmark, track, and analyze performance metrics, P&amp;L, sourcing/trading trends, and results against budget/targets on a regular basis to demonstrate continuous improvement and progress against strategic objectives.</li> <li>Recruit, mentor, and scale a small high-performing team of traders and analysts; set clear performance standards and foster a culture of ownership, speed and accountability. Manage the trading floor transactions to ensure operational requirements and financial goals are met.</li> <li>Develop and maintain key internal stakeholder relationships (engineering, finance, legal) and external relationships with counterparties, brokers, suppliers, and market participants to evaluate sourcing/trading models, optimize value, support deal flow, and ensure continuity of supply.</li> <li>Conduct comprehensive market, supplier, and counterparty analysis to formulate strategic plans that identify new sources, optimize cost models, and proactively ensure supply continuity for upcoming production, launch, and new product introduction campaigns.</li> <li>Execute requests for information (RFIs), requests for proposal (RFPs), bid events, and negotiations; administer multimillion-dollar contracts and independently negotiate terminology, pricing, technical/scope requirements, terms involving responsibility, liability, indemnification, intellectual property, export compliance, and risk allocation.</li> <li>Build a team responsible for scheduling, planning and model enhancement, supply/demand analysis (factoring regional and global dynamics), and broader desk/strategy development. Mentor junior team members as appropriate.</li> <li>Ensure all trading and sourcing activities are conducted within appropriate authorities, risk guidelines/controls, compliance/regulatory frameworks (including applicable CFTC/FERC or equivalent), and company policies. Maintain highest ethical standards and integrity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 4+ years of experience working in:</li> <ul> <li>Natural gas or energy commodity trading</li> <li>Material cost control / energy markets analysis</li> <li>Engineering or finance related to energy commodities</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong knowledge of US (and/or global) natural gas markets, including experience with pipeline/storage optimization, physical and financial trading, hubs, and related infrastructure.</li> <li>Understanding of utilities, power purchase agreements, pipelines, cryogenic commodities, gas system equipment, LNG, or oil &amp; gas sector.</li> <li>Demonstrable track record of trading P&amp;L generation, commercial impact, or significant cost savings/supply optimization in natural gas or related energy markets.</li> <li>Established relationships with market counterparties, brokers, suppliers in the oil/gas/power sector, and experience with deal development/structured opportunities.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficiency analyzing large datasets with advanced Excel, SQL, PowerBI, and preferably Python or similar tools.</li> <li>Firm understanding of risk management, position management, and regulatory frameworks applicable to natural gas markets.</li> <li>Experience sourcing/trading from a global supply base using various contractual models; strong budget tracking and cost analytical skills.</li> <li>Experience with trade capture systems (e.g., Endur or similar) is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to travel – up to 50% work week travel may be required, including international travel.</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet major milestones; flexibility and availability to support trading/operational activities (including potential 24/7 market coverage as required).</li> <li>This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being on-site – remote work not considered.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>BIM SPECIALIST (ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS MODELING) </strong></p> <p>Building on the rapid advancement of the Starship program, SpaceX is seeking to rapidly develop and retrofit launch infrastructure facilities to support vehicle builds and re-flight refurbishments. We are seeking a Building Information Modeling (BIM) Specialist to lead the modeling, integration and coordination of electrical systems for multi-disciplinary Starship and Super Heavy Booster tooling systems, and facilities infrastructure. This position will serve as a key technical resource, supporting project teams and fostering strong BIM practices throughout the project lifecycle.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop, maintain, and upgrade detailed 3D BIM models of electrical systems (power distribution, control systems, data acquisition, wire harnesses, routing, cable management, hardware mounting, and equipment placement) using industry-standard software such as Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD,or NX</li> <li>Own, draft, redline, and maintain electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, panel layouts and prepare related documentation while coordinating 3D model placement of electrical systems with the system Responsible Engineers</li> <li>Integrate electrical systems with architectural, structural, mechanical, plumbing (MEP), and other disciplines for Starship facilities and production tooling, in a safe, economical, and reliable way. Lead coordination of electrical systems into living facility models, owning end-to-end integration and electrical documentation ownership</li> <li>Generate construction documents, quantity takeoffs, visualizations, and as-built drawings from BIM models to support bidding, procurement, on-site execution, and long-term reliability improvements for electrical infrastructure and production systems</li> <li>Act as a liaison between project stakeholders, internal tooling teams, production leadership, responsible engineers, internal design and construction teams, and third-party consultants throughout the project life cycle</li> <li>Perform clash detection, model coordination, and constructability reviews focused on electrical systems to identify and resolve conflicts early in design and construction phases</li> <li>Support the development and maintenance of SpaceX BIM standards, protocols, and workflows for electrical infrastructure; act as the primary technical resource for electrical BIM issues</li> <li>Lead transition of electrical BIM workflows (including data migration, process documentation, and training); actively drive continuous improvements and optimizations for team processes, quality improvements, faster build times, lower maintenance, project kitting, communication, and feedback loops</li> <li>Support review and interpretation of power system studies, field data, and electromechanical integration; perform daily task prioritization and risk mitigation; participate in cross-functional meetings providing electrical BIM expertise to inform design decisions</li> <li>Perform other related duties as assigned to ensure an efficient and effective work environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering, or construction management; or associates or vocational certification in electrical design, construction drafting, or design technologies</li> <li>1+ years of experience in a 3D drafting or BIM specialist/modeling role</li> <li>1+ years of experience working with electrical systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Occupational trade school qualification or experience working in an electrical technical role or in the electrical field</li> <li>Working knowledge of NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code), NFPA 70E, NFPA 79 &amp; UL508A codes</li> <li>Proficiency with BIM tools such as Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD Electrical, NX, and/or SolidWorks</li> <li>Proficiency in clash detection, federated modeling, interdisciplinary coordination workflows, and constructability reviews for large-scale or high-rise projects</li> <li>Experience drafting and maintaining electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, and as-built drawings with strong ownership of documentation practices and revision control</li> <li>Experience modeling electrical systems in industrial environments</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to independently drive projects, manage multiple priorities, and succeed in a high-paced team environment with evolving needs</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>This position is based in Starbase, TX and requires being onsite - remote work not considered</li> <li>Must be willing to travel to various SpaceX locations for mission critical projects</li> <li>Flexible to work extended hours and/or weekends to align with residential project deadlines and site operations</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>FULL STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER, MANUFACTURING SYSTEMS</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.</p> <p>Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>INTEGRATION ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>As an Integration Engineer you will be responsible for establishing requirements and developing tooling and processes to enable at-rate production of the most powerful rocket ever made. Your role will focus on integration of avionics, propulsion, and structural assemblies, and you will work with both design engineering and technician teams daily. You will be well-positioned to influence overall vehicle architecture, with a focus on design for reliability and manufacturability.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate as a systems level engineer to collect production requirements then plan and execute the build, integration, and validation of flight hardware to those requirements</li> <li>Design and implement tooling solutions to eliminate assembly error, improve quality, and accelerate build</li> <li>Automate novel processes to ensure repeatability on a large scale production line</li> <li>Prove that a subsystem work center meets cycle time requirements, or own the design change required to meet target cycle time</li> <li>Become a subject matter expert for the build of a vehicle level system like aero control surfaces, propellant feed systems, actuation systems, thermal protection systems, secondary structures, avionics, primary structure, etc.</li> <li>Generate and maintain design for manufacturing requirements for the processes used to build Starships and Super Heavy Boosters</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of hands-on engineering experience (design teams and previous internships qualify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master's degree in an engineering GD&amp;T concepts</li> <li>Experience with large steel structure construction (civil, naval, or mechanical)</li> <li>Experience in process development, facility and line layouts, error-proofing, title: Integration Engineer, Heatshield (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>INTEGRATION ENGINEER, HEATSHIELD (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>Starship requires a robust Thermal Protection System (TPS) to withstand the extreme heat generated during atmospheric reentry at hypersonic speeds. The thermal hardware team is responsible for the design, analysis, integration, and continuous improvement of Starship's reentry heatshield and structures. As a mechanical engineer, you will drive the development of the next-generation heat shield from concept and detailed mechanical design to thermal-structural modeling, qualification testing, production, integration, flight rationale, and post-flight data-driven optimizations. At Starbase, you will have the opportunity to work in an exciting and dynamic environment, dividing your time between the office and the production floor to ensure the delivery of the best-engineered product and ultimately mission success.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop, test, and qualify new or refined thermal protection system solutions for our Starship architecture</li> <li>Own the outcome and set up the end-to-end solutions to thermal challenges from idea to flying hardware</li> <li>Work with production on resolving issues on the floor and on the vehicle with our flight hardware</li> <li>Analyze and troubleshoot post-flight conditions on vehicle heatshields to drive vehicle changes and improvements</li> <li>Coordinate with analysis, avionics, structures, supply chain, and reliability engineers to drive multidisciplinary projects</li> <li>Work with outside vendors, suppliers, and testing resources to bring in new materials, capabilities, or processes</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in material science, mechanical engineering, materials engineering, or aerospace engineering</li> <li>1+ years of engineering experience designing, analyzing, or building mechanical or thermal systems (internship and school projects experience qualify)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience working on thermal protection systems</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in aerothermal heating on reentry vehicles</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in the materials and mechanisms by which thermal protection systems operate</li> <li>Hands-on experience with hardware that has had to perform in challenging thermal environments such as rockets, reentry vehicles or other extreme temperature applications</li> <li>Ability to drive open-ended design and development challenges</li> <li>Familiarity and experience with production, installation, qualification, and use of thermal protection system materials</li> <li>Experience using Siemens NX, or similar CAD software</li> <li>Ability to perform basic thermal or mechanical analysis</li> </ul> jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.</li> <li>Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.</li> <li>Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.</li> <li>Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.</li> <li>Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.</li> <li>Ensure enterprise network administration and deployment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.</li> <li>Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).</li> <li>Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.</li> <li>Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.</li> <li>Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.</li> <li>Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).</li> <li>Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.</li> <li>Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.</li> <li>Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.</li> </ul>
