title: IT Systems Administrator, Test Operations (2nd Shift)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, TEST OPERATIONS (2ND SHIFT)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our test operations environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained test operations cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.</li> <li>Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.</li> <li>Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.</li> <li>Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.</li> <li>Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.</li> <li>Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate.</li> <li>3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.</li> <li>Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.</li> <li>Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).</li> <li>Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.</li> <li>Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.</li> <li>Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.</li> <li>Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).</li> <li>Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.</li> <li>Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.</li> <li>Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.</li> <li>Must have valid driver's license.</li> <li>Ability to lift up to 30lbs.</li> <li>Ability to work at heights.</li> <li>Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.</li> <li>Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed.</li> <li>Must be available for the second shift beginning at 1:30pm.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Launch Engineer, Fluid Systems (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LAUNCH ENGINEER, FLUID SYSTEMS (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>Aggressively-paced, constantly-evolving, results-focused, real-as-it-gets engineering positions available for the ambitious. We design, build, activate, modify, improve, and maintain the fluid systems that fuel the most powerful rocket in the world. Aimed at pivoting and fixing issues every day, you can plan on having your skills put to the test, having hardware you designed, made, and installed the same day in a development-focused environment. From tens of thousands of gallons per minute of cryogens to tens of pounds per second of high-pressure gas, we develop clever solutions to meet the needs of a demanding launch and test program both today and in the future.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze, design, and build systems that support critical rocket launches and testing</li> <li>Cradle-to-grave project ownership through hosting design reviews, project decision justification, equipment procurement, and coordination and assistance of the construction of your ideas</li> <li>Design modular hardware capable of being manufactured at volume for future launch sites across the world</li> <li>Apply interdisciplinary engineering skills in fields of system-level process design and initial sizing, detailed pressurized fluid and thermal analysis, structural engineering, materials, and component selection, and cost/schedule optimization</li> <li>Work directly with technicians and support groups to build your designs, and fix real-world problems on the fly</li> <li>Maintain a tight feedback loop with the launch operations team to rapidly alter plans as necessary to meet tight deadlines</li> <li>Activate and troubleshoot equipment to achieve design objectives and iterate system maintenance strategies to reduce future downtimes</li> <li>Independently evaluate complex problems and arrive at solutions to seemingly impractical problems that best support the program</li> <li>Hands-on approach to tackling daily field projects necessary to keep the company launching rockets</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in physics, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of hands-on build or design experience (internship, club, and competition team experience qualifies)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively</li> <li>Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while maintaining a high sense of urgency in a high-paced, challenging work environment</li> <li>Willingness to perform other related duties to ensure an efficient and effective work environment</li> <li>Experience with quick thinking and problem-solving in stressful situations</li> <li>Experience solving challenges posed by short deadlines</li> <li>Strong fundamental intuition of fluid and/or structural/mechanical systems</li> <li>Creativity to imagine and design for reliability, efficiency, and maintainability from scratch</li> <li>General hands-on experience with machining, welding, and other fabrication techniques is a plus</li> <li>Experience with instrumentation, testing, data review and analysis, verification against a model</li> <li>3+ years of mechanical, fluids, or thermal design experience in an industrial setting or equivalent</li> <li>Experience with high-pressure and cryogenic fluid systems&nbsp;and components</li> <li>Experience producing drawings for welders and machine shop fabrication</li> <li>Collaborative team player, eager to find the best solution while balancing cost and schedule</li> <li>Acute attention to detail, ability to see interactions with other systems to avoid problems</li> <li>Intermediate skill level using CAD (NX a plus)</li> <li>Ability to verify designs with simplified hand calculations; experience in finite element analysis (FEA) or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is a plus</li> <li>American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) piping and pressure vessel design experience</li> <li>Creative and passionate approach to addressing opportunities and challenges, and an enthusiastic, self-motivated, positive can-do attitude</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to respond to emergencies to support priority projects, missions, and launches</li> <li>Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed; flexibility is required</li> <li>Ability to work in extreme outdoor environments when needed – heat, cold, wind, rain, etc.</li> <li>Ability to work in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise</li> <li>Working conditions may be in tight quarters and physical dexterity is required</li> <li>Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings, and climbing hand over hand</li> <li>Ability to lift heavy objects up to 25 lbs. unassisted</li> <li>Ability to work on ladders, lifts, and at elevated heights (up to 300 feet) with proper personal protective equipment (PPE)</li> <li>Stand: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Sit: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Push/Pull: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. title: Lead Automation and Controls Engineer, Silicon Technology (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD AUTOMATION AND CONTROLS ENGINEER, SILICON TECHNOLOGY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation, providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact. As we continue to upgrade and expand the constellation, we’re looking for best-in-class engineers and leaders to join the team.</p> <p>In true SpaceX fashion, Starlink is taking the next step in vertical integration by bringing advanced silicon packaging and assembly in-house for development and manufacturing. We are looking for a hands-on, creative, and driven Lead Automation and Controls Engineer to spearhead the automation for our internal advanced silicon packaging lines. The Lead Engineer will be responsible for architecting and scaling the automation systems that allow for meaningful reduction of both user terminal cost and risk of global supply chain calamities limiting production capability of Starlink. Engineers on this team are curious, love to learn new things, and work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs as we strive to deliver high-impact technology on a massive scale.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team that architects and optimizes high-output factories of the future</li> <li>Set the bar for technical excellence across the team, and create opportunities for the team to continually improve</li> <li>Recruit the best engineering talent to the team</li> <li>Challenge the team to develop new processes and deploy entire factories rapidly with high machine reliability and safety standards</li> <li>Collaborate closely with automation, mechanical, process, safety, production and maintenance leadership to identify high-impact projects and opportunities for improvement</li> <li>Ensure a strong focus is placed on safety and maintain an excellent safety record</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in engineering discipline</li> <li>3+ years of professional experience in an automation engineering role</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineers and technicians on a project basis or through a leadership role with evidence of ability to give strong technical direction and mentorship skills</li> <li>Experience developing and tracking roadmaps, and motivating a team to achieve them</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to take initiative, communicate effectively, and work both independently and within a team</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex concepts, problems, solutions, schedules, and budgets clearly to all levels within a fast-paced organization</li> <li>Semiconductor industry work including with SECS/GEM protocol</li> <li>Experience interfacing with equipment suppliers for developing and enforcing machine requirements</li> <li>Experience with as many of the following parts of our core technologies: <ul> <li>Applied understanding of SECS-GEM – and how to integrate into a Manufacturing Execution System (MES)</li> <li>Familiarity with SEMI organization semiconductor standards</li> <li>Motion systems design (gantries, robotics, conveyance, motors, actuators, pneumatics/hydraulics, sensor selection and integration)</li> <li>Electrical sizing of motors, cables, circuit protection, VFD’s, motor starters, various other motion systems</li> <li>Design of fail-safe electrical circuits using both safety logic controllers and safety-rated relays</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and commissioning high quality electrical panels and electro-mechanical systems with appropriate safety considerations in mind</li> <li>Proficiency in understanding and creating electrical schematics (EPLAN preferred)</li> <li>Working knowledge of ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA standards and NEC, NFPA, UL508A electrical codes for safeguarding factory systems the team designs and implements</li> <li>Fieldbus networking protocols, preferably EtherCAT, Profinet, Profisafe, Ethernet/IP</li> <li>HMI, SCADA, IoT (MQTT, OPC-UA), Ignition systems with focus on user friendly navigation and machine health monitoring and control</li> <li>PLC programming, preferably Beckhoff TwinCAT structured text programming</li> <li>Fundamental structures hand calculations and ability to design for strength and stiffness</li> <li>CAD and product lifecycle management programs to generate detailed designs and drawing packages utilizing geometric dimensioning and This is a fast-paced, hands-on, constantly evolving, real-as-it-gets engineering position available for the ambitious. We design, build, activate, modify, and maintain the fluid and mechanical systems that power, restrain, and measure the most powerful high-volume rocket engines in the world. In this dynamic environment, you can expect your engineering skills to be put to the test and the hardware you designed to be built and installed the very same day. From thousands of gallons per minute of cryogens to tens of pounds per second of high-pressure gas, we develop clever solutions to meet the needs of a demanding test program both today and in the future. We have open positions ranging from entry-level to very experienced engineers to add value to the SpaceX mission.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze, design, and build jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PLATFORM INTEGRITY MANAGER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX, we are committed to ensuring the service remains a force for good and sustains trust worldwide: both connecting the unconnected and executing thorough processes to detect and prevent misuse by illicit operators. We are looking for an experienced Platform Integrity Manager, known internally as Customer Integrity &amp; Threat Detection Manager, to detect, disrupt, and investigate potential misuse of the service—including proactively combating and deterring illicit operators. title: Power Systems Engineer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>POWER SYSTEMS ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>As a member of the Construction Projects Team, you will work with engineers across multiple disciplines to design, build, and activate infrastructure that will enable SpaceX to achieve its long-term mission. This team is responsible for the delivery of large capital projects to various internal customer groups across the company. This position is based out of the Bastrop site in the Bastrop, TX area. Travel may accompany this role, and based on business needs, opportunities to work at other SpaceX facilities may occur in the future.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the project team, consulting engineers and contractors throughout the entirety of the engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning process for power-specific scope items</li> <li>Develop and issue drawings, design documentation, and reports for aerospace, industrial, and commercial type projects</li> <li>Write, negotiate, and manage construction contracts with subcontractors across multiple disciplines through contract close-out</li> <li>Resolve design and construction conflicts in the field in real-time</li> <li>Coordinate with electrical utility provider for design/engineering to ensure reliable power service to critical site infrastructure</li> <li>Interact with engineers, contractors, vendors, fabricators, and project stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or electrical engineering technology</li> <li>3+ years of professional experience with the design or build of commercial or industrial power systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Primary experience with electrical and power distribution systems (&lt;600Vac)</li> <li>Working knowledge of delta/wye transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, building lighting, building construction specifications, and facility grounding</li> <li>Experience with critical power infrastructure including UPS systems, backup generators, and automatic transfer switches</li> <li>Experience creating and implementing process/design solutions with minimal impact on business operations</li> <li>Able to quickly assess an issue and assist technicians with troubleshooting and repair</li> <li>Ability to work in a high-concentration, high-stress title: Sr. Electrical Engineer (Power Systems)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. ELECTRICAL ENGINEER (POWER SYSTEMS)</strong></p> <p>As a member of the Construction Projects team, you will work with engineers across multiple disciplines to design, build, and activate infrastructure that will enable SpaceX to achieve its long-term mission. This team is responsible for the delivery of large capital projects to various internal customer groups across the company. This position is based out of the McGregor Rocket Development Facility. Travel will accompany this role, and based on business needs, opportunities to work at other SpaceX facilities may occur in the future.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate and grow with the multi-disciplinary SpaceX Construction Projects team by performing (power-specific) engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities for a variety of critical and fast-paced company projects.</li> <li>Develop and issue drawings, design documentation, and reports for aerospace, industrial, and commercial type projects</li> <li>Write, negotiate, and manage construction contracts with subcontractors across multiple disciplines through contract close-out</li> <li>Resolve design and construction conflicts in the field in real-time</li> <li>Coordinate with the electrical utility provider for design/engineering to ensure reliable power service to critical site infrastructure</li> <li>Interact with engineers, contractors, fabricators, and project stakeholders</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or electrical engineering technology</li> <li>6+ years of professional experience with the design or build of commercial or industrial power systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Primary experience with electrical and power distribution systems (&lt;600Vac)</li> <li>Working knowledge of delta/wye transformers, switchgear, motor control centers, building lighting, building construction specifications, and facility grounding</li> <li>Experience with critical power infrastructure, including UPS systems, backup generators, and automatic transfer switches</li> <li>Experience creating and implementing process/design solutions with minimal impact on business operations</li> <li>Ability to quickly assess an issue and assist technicians with troubleshooting and repair</li> <li>Ability to work in a high-concentration, high-stress environment, under possible extended work hours and tight deadlines</li> <li>Acute attention to detail, ability to see interactions with other systems to avoid problems</li> <li>AutoCAD/Revit – beginner to intermediate skill level</li> <li>Familiarity with the National Electric Code, National Fire Protection Association, and International Building Code</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="text-align: left;">Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights</li> <li title: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer, OS/Platform (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><div> <div> <p><strong>SR. EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER, OS/PLATFORM (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a Sr. Embedded Software Engineer on the Starlink program, you will be solving challenges underpinning every aspect of the program’s growth. The areas you could have an impact on could include, but are not limited to:</p> <ul> <li>Bringing up next generation space grade silicon, including in house designed system on chip and peripherals.</li> <li>Develop software from the early stage boot loaders to business logic with an emphasis on deterministic, secure, and performant platform for all of SpaceX Linux based spacecraft and grounds-based components.</li> <li>Infrastructure and tools to enable rapid development and testing of new features for all OS/platform features.</li> </ul> <p>Our software engineers are responsible for the complete lifecycle of the software they create, including development, testing, and support.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Maintain and update in house branches of OSS software such as Linux, Buildroot, and u-boot</li> <li>Support secureboot and runtime security of all Linux based satellite components</li> <li>Maintain the spacecraft Ethernet network and connectivity</li> <li>Develop, deploy and test spacecraft software update process</li> <li>Support in-house System on Chip and peripheral through the life-cycle of the part</li> <li>Support OS/Platform specific test infrastructure</li> <li>Development and support device drivers for third party and in-house components</li> <li>Be the first software team to receive new satellite components</li> <li>Interface with Silicon, Electrical, and Application Software Engineers to bring hardware from prototype stage to on on-orbit operations</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or a STEM discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering; OR 7+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of a degree</li> <li>Development experience in C, C++, python and/or rust</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Linux Kernel Up streamed patches preferred</li> <li>Knowledge of networking and Linux networking stack&nbsp;</li> <li>Good knowledge of computer architecture and modern secure boot flows&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with ARM embedded system</li> <li>Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment &amp; continuous monitoring</li> <li>Creative approach to problem solving, exceptional analytical skills and engineering fundamentals</li> <li>Strong skills in debugging, performance optimization, and unit testing</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both written and verbal</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul> </div> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Sr. Fluids Systems Engineer, Solar Cell Factory (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. FLUIDS SYSTEMS ENGINEER, SOLAR CELL FACTORY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>The Solar Cell team is revolutionizing power generation for space applications through advanced solar cell manufacturing. We're scaling production of high-efficiency solar cells to support sustainable energy solutions for Starlink constellations, launch vehicles, and beyond. As a Sr. Solar Cell Factory Fluids Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize fluid systems for the delivery of critical gases and chemicals in solar cell fabrication. This role requires a detail-oriented engineer passionate about safe handling of hazardous materials in a high-volume manufacturing environment, ensuring reliable supply to processes like vacuum deposition and etching while minimizing risks and maximizing efficiency in our cutting-edge solar cell factory.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and activate fluids systems for the distribution of key gases (e.g. specialty and bulk gases), chemicals (e.g., hydrofluoric acid, solvents) and exhaust systems used in solar cell processes, including tanks, pumps, heat exchangers, gas panels, valves, scrubbers, and abatement systems</li> <li>Cradle-to-grave project ownership including requirement definition, design, justification of key decisions, equipment procurement, build coordination, commissioning and project management throughout</li> <li>Design modular systems capable of being manufactured at scale for future solar production facilities</li> <li>Apply fluids/mechanical engineering skills such as P&amp;ID development, equipment sizing, detailed fluid and thermal analysis, system-level CONOP development, structural analysis, materials and component selection.</li> <li>Perform safety/hazard assessments (ex. FMEAs, HAZOPs) to ensure appropriate hazardous system design, including emergency shutdown CONOPs, redundancy, and general compliance with hazardous material safety standards</li> <li>Design, build, and deploy data acquisition and control systems for fluid facilities control and monitoring</li> <li>Collaborate with process engineers to integrate fluid systems with manufacturing equipment and optimize delivery rates, purity levels, and recovery/recycling of process fluids to support high-yield production</li> <li>Support installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of fluid systems, working closely with facilities operations, EHS, automation, and procurement teams to resolve issues and implement improvements</li> <li>Ensure regulatory compliance with OSHA, EPA, ASME, NFPA, and SEMI standards for chemical and gas handling in semiconductor-like environments</li> <li>Track system performance metrics (e.g., flow rates, contamination levels, downtime) and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, such as lean manufacturing and sustainability efforts for fluid reuse</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, aerospace engineering, or other engineering discipline</li> <li>5+ years of professional fluids systems design experience&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in engineering or related field</li> <li>2+ years of experience in fluid systems design, particularly with gases or hazardous chemicals in manufacturing or semiconductor industries</li> <li>2+ years of experience in photovoltaic, semiconductor, or thin-film deposition manufacturing</li> <li>Knowledge of safety protocols for handling pyrophoric materials (e.g., silane) and toxic gases/chemicals (e.g., phosphine, HF)</li> <li>Knowledge of ASME B31.3, SEMI S2/S8 standards and experience with cleanroom HVAC integration for fluid systems</li> <li>Familiarity with cleanroom fluid systems, gas cabinets, scrubbers, and wastewater neutralization for solar cell fabrication</li> <li>Familiarity with air separation units (ASUs) for gaseous nitrogen production.</li> <li>Certification in process safety (e.g., CSP, Six Sigma Green Belt) or hazardous materials handling</li> <li>Proficiency in fluid dynamics software (e.g., ANSYS Fluent, Pipe-Flo) and CAD tools (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks) for system modeling and diagramming</li> <li>Experience with process safety management, including risk assessment and regulatory compliance</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, iterative environment and collaborate across multidisciplinary teams</li> <li>Ability to work independently, take initiative, and communicate effectively</li> <li>Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while maintaining a high sense of urgency in a demanding work environment</li> <li>Creativity to imagine and design for reliability, efficiency, and maintainability from scratch</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong><strong> </strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to travel&nbsp;frequently&nbsp;for work, potentially for extended periods of time during machine buyoffs and startup&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to lift 25 lbs. unassisted&nbsp;</li> <li>Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are&nbsp;generally required&nbsp;to perform the functions of this position&nbsp;</li> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support critical milestones</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Sr. IC Packaging Test Engineer, Silicon Technology (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>Sr. IC PACKAGING TEST ENGINEER, SILICON TECHNOLOGY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to those that need it most. We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that is capable of delivering high-speed internet to even the most remote locations. We also design, build, and ship the hardware that sits in the homes of our customers all around the world. And while our hardware and network are incredibly advanced, we keep the end-user experience impressively simple - our customers have internet within 10 minutes of unboxing.</p> <p>In true SpaceX fashion, Starlink is taking the next step in vertical integration by bringing integrated circuit packaging and assembly in-house for development and manufacturing. We are looking for talented hands-on and dynamic test engineers with expertise in semiconductor packaging and wafer test. You will work closely with test equipment manufacturers and in-house chip &amp; system designers to develop and release production test solutions. You will assume full ownership of packaged component and wafer test as we strive to make Starlink more affordable to those that need it most.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own electrical test equipment definition for packaging and wafer level production testing</li> <li>Bring-up of test equipment and test programs for mass manufacturing</li> <li>Create automated test equipment (ATE) test programs and test plans</li> <li>Define full and comprehensive testing requirements to ensure product conformance</li> <li>Schematic and electrical review for all test equipment</li> <li>Supplier test interface for implementing new features, cost, and productivity improvements</li> <li>Implement advanced testing solutions for SpaceX next generation products</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, physics, or other applied engineering discipline &nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years of programming experience in C/C++/Visual/Python</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years industry experience with microelectronics packaging development</li> <li>Advanced technical degree</li> <li>Expertise in developing digital, high-speed and RF semiconductor test programs for production</li> title: Sr. Manager, Starlink Enterprise Accounts (Civilian Government Programs)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. MANAGER, STARLINK ENTERPRISE ACCOUNTS (CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT PROGRAMS)</strong></p> <p>Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, is delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world. As a leader on the Starlink Enterprise Accounts team, you will develop and manage a team that is responsible for delighting Starlink Federal Civilian government customers at scale. You and the team will be responsible for managing enterprise contracts to rapidly drive realization of revenue, doing it scalably, and working closely with counterparts on Starlink cross-functionally. A key challenge will be driving a culture that both maximizes customer happiness, citizen onboarding and minimizes the input required by the team.</p> <p>The Enterprise Customer Success team serves as the point of contact for customers from contract signature, through successful activation, ensuring all contract terms are fulfilled while and identifying new opportunities to generate business with enterprise customers. Prior to contract signature, the team will have a key role in ensuring that the commitments we make are ones we can successfully execute to.</p> <p>In the past year, the Starlink team has signed contracts with Civilian government customers who deliver programs at a pace and for use cases previously not possible. The team has designed the product to be self-service, and we need to similarly evolve our team and systems to enable large organizations to deliver and scale Starlink in a programmatic way, minimizing humans-in-the-loop.</p> <p>Our ideal candidate is a self-starter that has a passion for making customers deliriously happy, building excellent teams, and managing complex cross-functional projects.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, deliver, and rapidly implement strategy and growth plans for delivering Starlink to Civilian government programs</li> <li>Grow and build the enterprise account management function within Starlink</li> <ul> <li>Hire and lead an exceptional team</li> <li>Identify and build necessary tools and capabilities to manage accounts in a scalable way, working closely with the application software and finance teams to automate as much as possible</li> <li>Develop internal goals and metrics/visualizations to measure and communicate success</li> </ul> <li>Manage all aspects of non-technical project management for Civilian government accounts</li> <ul> <li>Work with internal and external stakeholders to finalize commercial government subsidy contracts, serving as a final check before contract signature to ensure we are poised for success and any risks are captured/communicated internally</li> <li>Ensure that contract requirements are delivered on time and meeting contract requirements</li> <li>Take an extreme ownership approach to realizing activation goals and forecasted revenue on or ahead of schedule</li> <li>Identify and broadly/loudly communicate readiness levels, requirements, schedules, and risks</li> </ul> <li>Own the customer interface from contract signature onwards including onboarding, ongoing account management, and long-term retention/growth of the relationship and revenue</li> <ul> <li>Build relationships with customer points of contact to identify requirements and manage expectations, driving revenue realization as quickly as possible</li> <li>Collect, communicate and champion customer feedback internally to influence and steer programmatic and technical development required to maintain and grow enterprise business</li> <li>Retain and grow the value of accounts</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree</li> <li>10+ years working with Civilian government executives and customers to support a technical product/service</li> <li>5+ years of direct people management experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience working with government customers and system integrators</li> <li>Exceptional customer interface skills, including excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to tailor communications appropriately to level (working-level to executive-level) &nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent negotiation and conflict resolution skills</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to quickly and successfully grow and develop an excellent team and new function, including ability to develop and coach team members and ability to scale non-linearly</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, autonomously driven, and demanding start-up atmosphere</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to champion and lead significant projects and business initiatives, including ability to manage in an environment with competing priorities</li> <li>Familiarity with existing Starlink products, services and customer support systems/processes</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to support critical milestones or operations shifts</li> <li>Must be willing to travel to other SpaceX offices and customer locations as needed</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Sr. Site Reliability Engineer, Platform Infrastructure
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. SITE RELIABILITY ENGINEER, PLATFORM INFRASTRUCTURE&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX. Manufacturing is how SpaceX turns designs into hardware. The compute, storage, and networking that run our factories must be as reliable as the products we build. This team owns infrastructure supporting Starship, Starlink, Starshield, and Terafab. This position will have a direct impact on factory uptime, throughput, and production scale across programs.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has strong software engineering fundamentals and a passion for infrastructure: reliability, stability, proactive maintenance, and scalability. You understand the system before you change it, solve hard problems, communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates, and take ownership of work that manufacturing depends on.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required. We value smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who treat teammates with fairness, respect, and support, and who want to take full ownership of challenging problems to help make humanity multi-planetary.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deploy, upgrade, operate, maintain, and scale compute, storage, and networking for manufacturing systems across Starship, Starlink, Starshield, and Terafab</li> <li>Manage infrastructure as code and use observability to provide a complete picture of platform health</li> <li>Design for reliability, stability, and scale; find and remove bottlenecks with measurement and engineering</li> <li>Practice proactive maintenance: capacity planning, lifecycle management, and reducing toil before it becomes an incident</li> <li>Partner with software engineers, manufacturing stakeholders, and site teams to build operable, maintainable systems</li> <li>Improve the full lifecycle—from design through deployment, operation, and continuous refinement</li> <li>Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems</li> <li>Provide high-quality support to manufacturing and engineering users</li> <li>Communicate clearly with stakeholders and teammates</li> <li>Participate in on-call and travel to sites as needed for deployments, incidents, and cross-site reliability</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or an engineering discipline; OR 7+ years of professional experience in SRE or DevOps in lieu of a degree</li> <li>3+ years of experience with Python and Python-based development frameworks</li> <li>Experience with Linux operating systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with compute, storage, and/or networking infrastructure in production</li> <li>Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or similar)</li> <li>Containers and virtualization (Docker, Kubernetes, vSphere, QEMU, KVM, etc.)</li> <li>Databases and data modeling (Postgres, Clickhouse, etc.)</li> <li>Ability to translate high-level requirements into implementations from first principles</li> <li>Comfort with mission-critical systems and appropriate urgency and care</li> <li>Skillful communication with customers, peers, and management</li> <li>Comfort operating across multiple sites and manufacturing programs</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>Must be able to travel to different sites (Hawthorne, CA; Redmond, WA; Cape Canaveral, FL; Starbase, TX)</li> <li>Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral&nbsp;</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Sr. Technical Business Development Manager (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. TECHNICAL BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT MANAGER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink has fundamentally changed what’s possible for satellite-based internet access. As Starlink continues to scale globally, significant growth opportunities lie in developing new commercial models that expand how consumers access and use the service. These opportunities span emerging markets, underserved consumer segments, and use cases that require thoughtful collaboration between commercial strategy and technical execution.</p> <p>The Starlink team is hiring a Senior Technical Business Development Manager to identify, develop, and commercialize new business models that unlock these opportunities. This is a hybrid role that demands strong commercial instincts combined with deep technical fluency — the ability to assess a customer environment, understand what’s technically feasible, and translate that into a viable go-to-market model. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of product, engineering, and commercial strategy, helping define how Starlink expands into new markets and customer segments.&nbsp;This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for someone who can build the commercial thesis for new opportunities, validate it with prospective partners and customers, and stand up the foundation for entirely new lines of postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates</li> <li>Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking</li> <li>Discuss candidates you have screened with your title: Sr. Yield Engineer, RF Final Test Integration (Starlink/Akoustis)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR.YIELD ENGINEER, RF FINAL TEST INTEGRATION (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)</strong></p> <p>Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink.&nbsp;We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Yield Engineer to join our RF device manufacturing team. This role focuses on correlating RF final test results with front-end wafer-level performance to identify and eliminate root causes of yield loss. You will be responsible for developing and implementing RF test solutions, managing test workflows, and driving process improvements across wafer probe and final test operations. The ideal candidate brings experience in RF test development, yield analysis, and statistical process control, with a passion for solving complex yield issues in a fast-paced, high-mix production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement RF test cases and calibration procedures for BAW filter devices operating in the 2 GHz to &gt;10 GHz range</li> <li>Establish strong linkages between wafer probe data and final RF test performance, driving root cause analysis of yield detractors</li> <li>Use statistical tools such as SPC and DOE to monitor, control, and improve yield across the manufacturing flow</li> <li>Develop and maintain Cost of Ownership (CoO) and risk models to evaluate probe test strategies and ensure effective test coverage</li> <li>Sustain and optimize workflow and throughput in a high-mix RF test work center, driving continuous improvements in cycle time and cost</li> <li>Collaborate with design teams to provide feedback on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and yield optimization opportunities</li> <li>Lead and mentor test operators, ensuring proper execution of test plans and maintenance of clean, organized workflows</li> <li>Support installation and qualification of new test tools, including both capability enhancements and capacity expansions</li> <li>Work closely with operation team and tool vendors to resolve equipment and process-related issues</li> <li>Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering instructions, and test documentation</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or other STEM discipline</li> <li>5+ years of experience in RF testing, yield engineering, or semiconductor manufacturing(internship or professional)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in RF test development or semiconductor yield engineering</li> <li>Working knowledge of RF measurement principles, including S-parameters, insertion loss, return loss, and calibration</li> <li>Familiarity with RF BAW filter technology and associated test challenges</li> <li>Experience using automated probe stations, VNAs, and RF measurement tools</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to perform data analysis, root cause analysis, and yield correlation</li> <li>Proficiency in Statistical Process Control (SPC), DOE, and related quality improvement methodologies</li> <li>Familiarity with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB) for test or data analysis is a plus</li> <li>Ability to work independently and cross-functionally in a high-mix, fast-paced production environment</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills for collaboration across engineering, operations, and design teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be This is a group of highly skilled technicians and automation specialists. As the team Supervisor, you and your team will be at the center of fabricating all engineering R&amp;D and factory build-outs supporting exciting programs like high volume Starlink User Terminal assembly line technologies, PCB manufacturing, silicon packaging, and brand new products yet to be dreamed of.</p> <p>You will manage a diverse team of fabrication, assembly, electrical, and automation experts in close partnership to key engineering leaders across Starlink, with expectation to grow the capabilities, skills, and output of a fast-growing team and Bastrop site. Your ability to lead in a highly dynamic environment will have immense impact on the output of Starlink products being distributed to the entire world.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead a group of technicians and specialists that fabricate, build, integrate, and deploy Starlink factory equipment and tooling</li> <li>Collaborate with the broader development operations and automation teams to achieve factory infrastructure deployment targets and milestones</li> <li>Manage tooling/testing equipment and infrastructure required to support engineering, automation, and product development projects</li> <li>Manage the parts inventory used to build standard factory assets, set targets for the team, and drive continuous improvement</li> <li>Provide mentorship to technicians/specialists and assist with design decisions, project strategies, and technical problems</li> <li>Provide technical support and feedback to engineering groups on tooling, fabrication, testing, and maintenance</li> <li>Ensure technicians and specialists on the team have the training, tools, and materials needed to carry out their duties – including creating and giving safety trainings to all members of the team</li> <li>Identify and execute on projects that improve overall program success and progress</li> <li>Take input from partner teams to align team priorities with broader program priorities</li> <li>Improve factory safety and efficiency through regular auditing and continuous improvement</li> <li>Enforce area standards and rules (including bi-annual reviews, disciplinary action, and time management)</li> <li>Report on project status and critical path items to management and key stakeholders for alignment</li> <li>Provide surge support and leadership as needed by traveling to other SpaceX sites to deploy factory assets</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of professional experience in machining, maintenance, or production/manufacturing; OR 5+ years of professional experience in machining, maintenance, or production/manufacturing in lieu of a degree</li> <li>2+ years of professional experience managing a team or leading projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of conventional machining, CNC programming, machining operations, and quality inspection procedures</li> <li>Experienced in welding techniques, fabrication processes, and precision mechanical assembly operations</li> <li>Experience managing large scale electromechanical projects by coordinating resources appropriately and collaborating with cross functional teams to achieve program objectives</li> <li>Knowledge of electrical The supervisor of power generation fluid systems will lead technicians fabricating, installing, testing, and commissioning piping and components for natural gas, instrument air, demineralized water, cooling water, aqueous ammonia, and associated valves, pumps, heat exchangers, and instrumentation — from prefab/spool yard through field tie-in. a team that can eventually cover day and night operations.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supervise prefab/spool-yard and field fluid-system work, including daily schedules, workflow, and multi-shift handoff</li> <li>Lead and manage a staff of fluid systems technicians, including hiring input, training, and all performance-management tasks</li> <li>Organize, assign, and track work so spool fabrication, install, field tie-in, test, and punchlist move cleanly across shifts</li> <li>Fabricate, install, and personally tie in (and hold the crew to the same standard) fluid system components from P&amp;IDs, isometric drawings, and engineering sketches, including: <ul> <li>Stainless steel, carbon steel, and aluminum piping and tubing, including large-bore</li> <li>Ball, check, control, and isolation valves</li> <li>Pumps, strainers, heat exchangers, and dry coolers</li> <li>Pressure regulators, relief devices, sensors, and gauges</li> </ul> </li> <li>Own plant fluid systems for aeroderivative / industrial gas-turbine power generation, including natural gas fuel, instrument air, demineralized water, cooling water, and 19% aqueous ammonia (SCR) systems</li> supervise hydrostatic, pneumatic, and leak testing; troubleshoot and repair issues found during activation or production use</li> <li>Connect and verify instrumentation (pressure transducers, thermocouples, flow, and similar) as required for system checkout</li> <li>Assess skillsets, identify training needs, and build training so the crew can work natural gas, 19% aqueous ammonia, instrument air, demin, and cooling systems safely</li> <li>Monitor labor hours and overtime; implement time-management and improvement plans with the staff</li> <li>Provide data and reporting to support departmental metrics and improvement objectives</li> <li>Ensure product quality and conformance to specifications, codes, and engineering requirements</li> <li>Maintain tooling, consumables, and critical-spares inventory</li> <li>Improve area safety and efficiency through regular auditing and continuous improvement (lockout/tagout, hot work, line break, chemical handling)</li> <li>Initiate and foster cooperation with millwrights, electrical, engineering, OEM advisors, construction, and datahall operations</li> <li>Continuously improve processes and crew efficiency, utilization, and productivity</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>5+ years of hands-on experience fabricating, installing, testing, and/or commissioning industrial fluid systems (piping, tubing, valves, pumps, and instrumentation)</li> <li>2+ years of experience leading a crew, shift, or project (supervisor, lead, or equivalent) in a production, construction, test, or plant environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of fluid-system fabrication and install in a fast-paced power generation, industrial, or mission-critical facilities environment</li> <li>Experience tying in pipe (field fit-up and connection of fabricated spools or systems — not supervision-only)</li> <li>Direct experience on gas-turbine or combined-cycle balance-of-plant systems (fuel gas, demineralized water, condensate/feedwater, cooling water, lube oil, or similar)</li> <li>Hands-on work with one or more of: natural gas piping, aqueous or anhydrous ammonia systems, demineralized water, high-purity water, or data-center cooling (chilled water, condenser water, dry coolers)</li> <li>Experience bringing a fluid system from development / first article into repeatable production or commissioned plant operation</li> <li>Experience with pneumatic/hydraulic system fabrication and high-pressure liquid and gas testing</li> <li>Ability to read P&amp;IDs, isometric drawings, and OEM manuals and turn them into field work</li> <li>Familiarity with applicable piping codes and practices (e.g. ASME B31.1 / B31.3), lockout/tagout, and line-break / energy-isolation procedures</li> <li>Professional experience with calibrated measuring instruments</li> <li>Experience using heavy equipment (overhead cranes, forklifts, manlifts)</li> <li>Able to adapt to changing work assignments in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to hire, train, and retain a high-performing technician crew</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and weekends, which varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility required</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required title: Technical Recruiter (McGregor)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>TECHNICAL RECRUITER</strong></p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <p>As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding of top talent candidates to fill mission-critical positions (pun intended). In many cases, you are candidates’ first encounter with SpaceX, and it is your job to represent the company with professionalism, pride, and enthusiasm. We work in teams and focus on collaboration yet require a high degree of autonomy. So, while you are not expected to simply go it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run with daily, including, but not limited to:</p> <ul> <li>Meet with your client groups to discuss headcount, new requisitions, hiring strategy, and/or interview feedback – you truly act as a partner to your clients and not merely as an order taker</li> <li>Screen candidates who apply to requisitions – as the SpaceX name brand grows, our job postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates</li> <li>Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking</li> <li>Discuss candidates you have screened with your client groups and recommend top candidates for interviews</li> <li>Give tours to candidates before their onsite</li> <li>Attend interviews alongside your client groups to act as another set of eyes and ears in evaluating candidates</li> <li>Once candidates are approved for hire, you will begin the offer process including initiating background checks, negotiating offer packages and extending offer letters</li> </ul> <p>Some days you will have multiple candidates coming onsite for interviews and you will spend that time giving tours and coordinating the candidate experience.&nbsp;Other days, you will need to fill your candidate pipeline and will spend the majority of the day screening/sourcing candidates.&nbsp;No day is the same here and the pace moves fast, but ultimately your job is to effectively attract, organize, and manage the flow of the country’s most talented individuals.</p> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of recruiting experience; or associate degree and 2+ years of experience; or 3+ years of professional experience as a recruiter in lieu of a degree</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of technical recruiting experience</li> <li>2+ years of SGA recruiting experience</li> <li>Experience with in-house recruiting</li> <li>Experience with high volume recruiting</li> <li>Experience recruiting electrical, mechanical and aerospace engineers</li> <li>Experience recruiting skilled labor</li> <li>Strong tenure with demonstrated success in recruiting roles</li> <li>Full life cycle recruiting experience, from sourcing to closing</li> <li>Comfort with reviewing, evaluating and reporting on recruiting data</li> <li>Ability to distinguish between the top 50% and the top 5% of talent within their respective fields</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise in non-standard recruiting methods: cold calling candidates and companies, organizing and executing ad hoc networking events, identifying industry experts and finding unique methods to engage with them, creating unique targeted sourcing campaigns, etc.</li> <li>Comfortable interfacing directly with hiring managers including director and VP level technical leaders</li> <li>Ability to build strong relationships with both hiring managers and candidates</li> <li>Ability to accurately present but not oversell candidates to client groups; influence decisions by acting as the subject matter expert on talent but avoid dictating client decisions</li> <li>Ability to multi-task and operate with little direction while still being an active team member</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>This position requires being onsite full-time – hybrid and remote work will not be considered</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Yield Engineer, RF Final Test Integration (Starlink/Akoustis)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>YIELD ENGINEER, RF FINAL TEST INTEGRATION (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)</strong></p> <p>Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink.&nbsp;We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Yield Engineer to join our RF device manufacturing team. This role focuses on correlating RF final test results with front-end wafer-level performance to identify and eliminate root causes of yield loss. You will be responsible for developing and implementing RF test solutions, managing test workflows, and driving process improvements across wafer probe and final test operations. The ideal candidate brings experience in RF test development, yield analysis, and statistical process control, with a passion for solving complex yield issues in a fast-paced, high-mix production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement RF test cases and calibration procedures for BAW filter devices operating in the 2 GHz to &gt;10 GHz range</li> <li>Establish strong linkages between wafer probe data and final RF test performance, driving root cause analysis of yield detractors</li> <li>Use statistical tools such as SPC and DOE to monitor, control, and improve yield across the manufacturing flow</li> <li>Develop and maintain Cost of Ownership (CoO) and risk models to evaluate probe test strategies and ensure effective test coverage</li> <li>Sustain and optimize workflow and throughput in a high-mix RF test work center, driving continuous improvements in cycle time and cost</li> <li>Collaborate with design teams to provide feedback on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) and yield optimization opportunities</li> <li>Lead and mentor test operators, ensuring proper execution of test plans and maintenance of clean, organized workflows</li> <li>Support installation and qualification of new test tools, including both capability enhancements and capacity expansions</li> <li>Work closely with operation team and tool vendors to resolve equipment and process-related issues</li> <li>Create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), engineering instructions, and test documentation</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, physics, materials science, or other STEM discipline</li> <li>1+ years of experience in RF testing, yield engineering, or semiconductor manufacturing(internship or professional)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience in RF test development or semiconductor yield engineering</li> <li>Working knowledge of RF measurement principles, including S-parameters, insertion loss, return loss, and calibration</li> <li>Familiarity with RF BAW filter technology and associated test challenges</li> <li>Experience using automated probe stations, VNAs, and RF measurement tools</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to perform data analysis, root cause analysis, and yield correlation</li> <li>Proficiency in Statistical Process Control (SPC), DOE, and related quality improvement methodologies</li> <li>Familiarity with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, LabVIEW, MATLAB) for test or data analysis is a plus</li> <li>Ability to work independently and cross-functionally in a high-mix, fast-paced production environment</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills for collaboration across engineering, operations, and design teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to meet critical milestones</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and internationally for supplier and manufacturing support</li> title: Lead Materials Coordinator, Test Sites
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><h3><strong>ABOUT THE JOB</strong></h3> <p>As a Lead Materials Coordinator, you will join our Deployment Operations team supporting one of Anduril's Test Sites. title: ASIC/SOC DFT Engineer (Silicon Engineering)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><div> <p><strong>ASIC/SOC DFT ENGINEER (SILICON ENGINEERING)</strong></p> <div> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.&nbsp;</p> </div> <div> <p>We are seeking a motivated, proactive, and intellectually curious engineer who will work alongside world-class cross-disciplinary teams (systems, firmware, architecture, design, validation, product engineering, ASIC implementation). In this role, you will be developing cutting-edge next-generation ASICs for deployment in space and ground infrastructures around the globe. These chips are enabling connectivity in places it has previously not been available, affordable or reliable.
