title: Business Operations Analyst (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>BUSINESS OPERATIONS ANALYST (STARLINK)&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, Starlink is leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy the world's most advanced broadband internet system and largest satellite constellation to provide fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide, connect humanity, and fund Mars colonization.</p> <p>Starlink Business Operations combines traditional planning and analysis with broader business decision-making and strategy, directly supporting SpaceX’s leadership. Business Operations is embedded in daily operations, supporting both near-term execution and long-term planning. Team members are expected to analyze data and provide recommendations and to lead cross-functional decision-making and implementation of the recommendations. Starlink Business Operations is lean and dynamic, operating with a fluid structure that favors high agency. We expect high performers to expand their scope across the program’s most critical bottlenecks.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Own global S&amp;OP (Sales &amp; Operations Planning) for specific hardware products to convert hardware into active, happy, paying customers</li> <li>Analyze key performance indicators, especially active subscribers, network utilization, produce-to-activate latency, inventory turnover, and hardware unit economics (CAC, payback period); includes developing complex S&amp;OP models and decision-making tools</li> <li>Translate analysis into strategic insights and hardware mix strategy to accelerate hardware adoption, maximize lifetime value, and minimize working capital</li> <li>Orchestrate global supply allocation and demand forecasting by synthesizing complex demand signals against dynamic, geographically specific network capacity constraints, working directly with Network Engineering</li> <li>Drive resource planning for specific verticals, including the execution of critical hardware ramp and sunset plans in close collaboration with Hardware &amp; Manufacturing Engineering</li> <li>Enable and accelerate go-to-market execution for products post-licensing and certification to ensure zero-latency deployment</li> <li>Identify initiatives for improvement of Starlink’s operational trajectory, including developing, tracking, and executing business initiatives with SpaceX’s leadership</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's Degree in engineering, mathematics, computer science, data science, physics, or other quantitative field</li> <li>1+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, product management, operations, FP&amp;A, consulting, banking, or entrepreneurship</li> <li>1+ years of experience in Excel or programming</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Evidence of exceptional ability, especially within an ambiguous environment</li> <li>Quantitative dual degree in engineering field and economics or business field and/or equivalent professional experience</li> <li>Demonstrated success driving tangible impact/influencing within a broader organization</li> <li>Extreme sense of urgency and ownership; bias toward action and automation</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements</li> <li>Strong proficiency in SQL and Python; ability to handle large datasets independently</li> <li>Excellent analytical modeling skills (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Looker)</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with senior business leaders</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="none">Must be available to work onsite full time (no hybrid or remote work), as well as, extended hours and weekends when needed</span></li> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="5" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1">Willingness to travel to customer sites, other SpaceX locations, and events as needed<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Business Operations Manager (Starlink Growth)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK GROWTH)</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Starlink is a revolutionary satellite constellation, delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world – bringing an unprecedented opportunity to significantly impact communities, businesses, and governments worldwide. The North American Business Development team is seeking a<strong>&nbsp;</strong></span><span data-contrast="auto">Business Operations Manager</span><span data-contrast="auto"> to serve as a pivotal partner to help define where the team focuses and how it executes. This role owns the operational backbone of North American Business Development initiatives, while also driving foundational strategy work that shapes the team’s long-term direction. It’s vital that Starlink deals and partnerships be optimized for speed and for scale. This role requires deep program management and business operations expertise, comfort working with both people and data, and fluency in financial analysis, reporting, and the day-to-day mechanics that make Starlink business development initiatives run.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The ideal candidate combines strong program management, business operations, and chief-of-staff capabilities with strategic rigor and long-term vision. This is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of connectivity technologies with a world-class team focused on connecting every household and traveler.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the operationalization of existing and upcoming business development initiatives, driving program management, deal pipeline tracking, cross-functional coordination, and execution discipline so initiatives move with speed and scale&nbsp;</li> <li>Build and maintain the inner workings of deal constructs and third-party integrations: tracking systems, reporting cadences, financial and operational metrics, accountability frameworks, and status visibility for leadership&nbsp;</li> <li>Partner closely with business development vertical leads, product, marketing, engineering, finance, and legal to ensure clear ownership, timely execution, and clean handoffs from opportunity through launch and scale</li> <li>Collect, synthesize, and surface customer, channel, and internal feedback to influence operational excellence and optimize deal tracking of the Business Development team</li> <li>Conduct new vertical research, develop big-bet hypotheses, and perform structured assessments of target partners and channels to inform team prioritization and resource allocation</li> <li>Report on progress of strategy and operations initiatives, presenting insights, risks, and recommendations directly to Starlink leadership</li> <li>Support outreach, intake, and qualification of strategic opportunities; synthesize findings into clear recommendations for the Business Development team</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement of team processes, tools, and operating rhythms to increase throughput, clarity, and accountability across growth workstreams</li> <li>Conduct ongoing market and competitive analysis to identify consumer trends, channel opportunities, and emerging technologies relevant to Starlink’s ecosystem&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1;"><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li style="line-height: 1;">Bachelor’s degree</li> <li>5+ years of experience in business operations, program management, strategy, consulting, investment banking</li> <li>3+ years of experience driving execution of revenue or growth-oriented programs, including tracking, reporting, and operationalizing commercial initiatives&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1;"><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or a related field&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven background in program management, business operations, or chief-of-staff roles supporting high-growth or commercial teams in technology, telecommunications, utilities, or subscription-based services</li> <li>Experience in management consulting or investment banking, with demonstrated ability to structure problems, build rigorous analyses, and drive recommendations to action</li> <li>Familiarity with business development or partnerships in consumer technology, telecommunications, or adjacent sectors – valuable but secondary to operationalizing deal flow and strategic strengths</li> <li>Strong analytical, financial modeling, and data fluency; comfort with accounting concepts, KPI design, and building clear reporting for leadership</li> <li>Demonstrated success operationalizing complex commercial or product initiatives and driving them from concept through execution and scale</li> <li>Independently motivated with a track record of project ownership, prioritization under ambiguity, and delivering measurable results</li> <li>Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills; able to work effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders</li> <li>MBA or master’s degree with a business or technical focus preferred&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1;"><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>Willingness to travel approximately 25-50% of the time to customer locations and other SpaceX locations as required&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Business Operations Manager (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best-in-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>The Business Operations Manager (Starlink) role sole is to enable human life on Mars and proliferate humanity’s freedom to communicate through profit improvement at SpaceX. The role combines data analytics with broader business planning, decision-making, and strategy, directly supporting SpaceX leadership. Business operations is embedded in daily operations, supporting both near-term execution and long-term planning. Team members are expected to analyze data and provide recommendations and to lead cross-functional decision-making and implementation of the recommendations. Our team is lean and dynamic, supporting several subgroups: Supply chain, engineering, manufacturing, sales, and growth. We encourage scope increase and variation across subgroups for high performers.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze key performance indicators, especially cost per unit, revenue, cost of sales, operating expenses and capital expenditures (includes developing business models and decision-making tools)</li> <li>Provide strategic insights and conclusions based on this analysis</li> <li>Guide planning and resource management (e.g., headcount, investment, etc.) for specific verticals within SpaceX, including development of business models</li> <li>Identify initiatives for improvement of SpaceX’s business outlook, including developing, tracking, and executing business initiatives with SpaceX’s leadership</li> <li>Work with stakeholders to analyze the impact of proposed business decisions (including actual performance) on SpaceX’s business health</li> <li>Manage investments/planning for Supply Chain, Sales, Manufacturing, and Engineering (e.g. return on investment analyses for new technology development, resource planning, marketing, etc.)</li> <li>Track, report, and proactively manage profit improvement (e.g. design proposals, supply chain initiatives, sales and marketing efforts) on existing products</li> <li>Support product development by establishing cost targets and guiding Supply Chain, Sales, Engineering, Design, and Manufacturing decisions towards attainment of these targets (i.e. cost vs. performance tradeoffs)</li> <li>Evaluate major CapEx decisions, expansion plans, and business cases on automation, manufacturing scope, insource vs. outsource choices, and location</li> <li>Lead manufacturing cost and sales revenue improvement for all products, including feedback on estimated manufacturing costs and revenue potential for future programs, identification of focus areas for cost and revenue improvement, and execution of identified initiatives</li> <li>Drive cost and revenue optimization in product development for existing and future products with a focus on establishment and attainment of cost and revenue targets</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or economics</li> <li>4+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, product management, operations, FP&amp;A, consulting, banking, or entrepreneurship</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>4+ years of experience in Excel or programming</li> <li>Evidence of exceptional ability, especially within an ambiguous environment</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements</li> <li>Demonstrated success driving tangible impact/influencing within a broader organization</li> <li>Excellent analytical skills (e.g. Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Power Query, Microsoft Office applications, Excel modeling, or similar data manipulation tools etc.)</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly with senior business leaders</li> <li>Extreme sense of urgency and ownership</li> <li>Bias toward action and automation</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills (examples: leading a student organization or working successfully in teams)</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail</li> <li>Ability to work cross-functionally with different groups and teams</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements</li> <li>Ability to work independently and in a team, take initiative, and communicate effectively</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>This position may require the travel between our sites</li> <li>Ability to work And while our hardware and network are incredibly advanced, we keep the end-user experience impressively simple - our customers have internet within 10 minutes of unboxing.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a Chemical Engineer on Starlink, you will spearhead state of the art production processes for our printed circuit boards (PCBs). The success of Starlink depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, throughput, security, and user experience of the products that you deliver.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Execute new product introduction builds</li> <li>Program, load, and operate automated equipment</li> <li>Triage non-conforming product and drive resolution and preventative actions</li> <li>Resolve production issues while ensuring design integrity, product quality, and delivery timelines</li> <li>Facilitate a close relationship with the engineering team during design, build, and test to provide design feedback; provide clear communication between the design engineering team and the production floor</li> <li>Lead efforts to uncover root-cause and develop a permanent resolution on issues found during production</li> <li>Ensure the successful transition of products from development to volume production</li> <li>Identify continuous improvement opportunities for yield, performance, and cost</li> <li>Define maintenance schedules and support activities</li> <li>Understand data trends</li> <li>Debug hardware and software failures&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering, math, or science discipline OR high school diploma or equivalency certificate and 3+ years of professional experience in a hands-on manufacturing environment in lieu of a degree</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Associate or bachelor's degree in an engineering, math, or science discipline and 3+ years of professional experience working in a hands-on manufacturing environment</li> <li>Experience with PCB manufacturing equipment in a production setting, or experience with PCB processes including: Copper plating, chemical etching, photolithography, layup/lamination, CNC drill/trim, waste water treatment, and/or plasma etching systems</li> <li>Experience with applying Lean manufacturing principles</li> <li>Ability to create and deliver presentations for design and manufacturing readiness reviews</li> <li>Experience transitioning products from design to manufacturing as part of a cross-functional team in a fast-paced iterative design environment</li> <li>SPC knowledge and experience applying statistical methods to track process capability</li> <li>Demonstrated experience designing tooling in a manufacturing environment</li> <li>Experience handling flammable, toxic, corrosive, or hazardous chemicals</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to begin work training on 1st shift (5:00 AM–5:00 PM) for initial 30 days</li> <li>Must be willing to work one of the following schedules upon completion of training (B, C, and D shift preferred): <ul> <li>A-Shift: 5:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Sunday - Tuesday and every other Wednesday)</li> <li>B-Shift: 5:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Thursday - Saturday and every other Wednesday)</li> <li>C-Shift: 5:00 PM - 5:00 AM (Sunday - Tuesday and every other Wednesday)</li> <li>D-Shift: 5:00 PM - 5:00 AM (Thursday - Saturday and every other Wednesday)</li> </ul> </li> <li>Must be able to work all shifts and available for overtime and weekends as needed</li> <li>Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position</li> <li>Ability to lift up to 25lbs unassisted</li> <li>Ability to stand, climb, walk, and work with object overhead</li> <li>Willing to travel to other SpaceX sites and/or vendors for potentially extended periods of time including international</li> </ul><div jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">CHEMICAL TEXTURING EQUIPMENT ENGINEER, SOLAR CELLS (STARLINK)</span></strong></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Starlink&nbsp;believes in providing fast, reliable internet to those that need it most. We design, build, and launch the world's largest and most advanced satellite constellation that&nbsp;is capable of delivering&nbsp;high-speed internet to even the most remote locations.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As a Chemical Texturing Equipment Engineer you will own the chemical processing equipment (wet chemical texturing tools, wet chemical preclean tools) used to manufacture silicon heterojunction solar cells at massive scale. You will work closely with our existing Texturing Process Engineering team to ensure world-class equipment performance, reliability, and uptime. While the process team focuses on surface morphology, light trapping, and cell efficiency, you will be the hardware owner responsible for tool availability, stability, and scaling to support our ambitious goals.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Your work will form the backbone of the&nbsp;Starlink&nbsp;network (photons of sunlight in is directly proportional to photons of data out to customers!) and help provide internet to tens of millions of customers all around the world. You will spearhead state of the art production equipment for an internal solar cell production line, providing high efficiency and high-quality solar cells for both our latest generation&nbsp;Starlink&nbsp;satellites and for Starship missions to the Moon and Mars.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:200,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="12" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1"><span data-contrast="auto">Work with facilities and process engineering teams to install, qualify, maintain, and continuously improve high-throughput texturing&nbsp;and preclean&nbsp;equipment for heterojunction silicon solar cell&nbsp;manufacturing</span></li> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="12" data-list-defn-props="{&quot;335552541&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:720,&quot;335559991&quot;:360,&quot;469769226&quot;:&quot;Symbol&quot;,&quot;469769242&quot;:[8226],&quot;469777803&quot;:&quot;left&quot;,&quot;469777804&quot;:&quot;&quot;,&quot;469777815&quot;:&quot;multilevel&quot;}" data-aria-posinset="1" data-aria-level="1">Drive equipment reliability and uptime to support very large volume production with minimal downtime. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p class="s3"><strong><span class="s2">CIVIL ENGINEER, STARBASE INFRASTRUCTURE<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span></span><span class="s2">(STARSHIP)</span></strong></p> <p class="s3">As a member of the<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>Starship Infrastructure and Construction<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>Team,<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>you will work with a group of elite engineers to design, build, and activate infrastructure for a variety of projects at Starbase as well as other SpaceX Facilities. You will have the opportunity to drive positive changes in a fast-paced and low-drag environment. This includes owning tasks/projects from start to finish, with the goal of making the SpaceX campus a world-class facility that can support the mission of enabling life beyond Earth. This position is based in Starbase, South Texas (Brownsville/South Padre Island area).</p> <p class="s3"><strong><span class="s2">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li class="s3">Develop and issue drawings, design documentation, and reports for aerospace, industrial, and commercial-type land development projects</li> <li class="s3">Perform all calculations necessary for grading and drainage, stormwater control facilities, water quality, domestic water distribution, and other underground utilities</li> <li class="s3">Collaborate and grow with a multi-discipline infrastructure project team by performing civil-specific engineering, procurement, and construction activities for a variety of critical and fast-paced company projects</li> <li class="s3">Drive coordination and design necessary to obtain local, state, and federal permits as it relates to land development and utility construction projects</li> <li class="s3">Manage the civil aspects of construction projects in the field, including quality control, conflict resolution, and coordination of a multi-disciplinary contractor team</li> <li class="s3">Prepare cost estimates, project schedules, and project cost control reports</li> <li class="s3">Interact with contractors, fabricators, owners, and internal clients to develop project requirements, schedule, and cost estimates prior to project implementation</li> <li class="s3">Resolve design and construction conflicts in the field in real time</li> </ul> <p class="s3"><strong><span class="s2">BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</span></strong></p> <div class="s5"> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or a related engineering discipline&nbsp;</li> </ul> </div> <p class="s3"><strong><span class="s2">PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</span></strong></p> <div class="s5"> <ul> <li>2+ years of civil technical experience with working knowledge in construction</li> <li>Proficiency in technical skills in<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>pump design,<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>storm water management, hydraulics, hydrological analysis, grading and other site development related designs</li> <li>Understanding of other disciplines such as electrical, piping, geotechnical, electrical and surveying</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Professional Engineering (PE)<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>or Engineer-in-Training (EIT)<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>license</li> <li>Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while maintaining a high sense of urgency in a high-paced, challenging work environment</li> <li>Experience with project management of major construction projects including estimating, cost control, schedule, and contractor management</li> </ul> </div> <p class="s3"><strong><span class="s2">ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</span></strong></p> <div class="s5"> <ul> <li>Physical effort with lifting and carrying materials or equipment (up to 25 lbs.)</li> <li>Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain</li> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and weekends when needed, based on site operational needs; flexibility required</li> <li>Ability to remain focused while working in hazardous environments, while wearing appropriate PPE</li> <li>Valid driver’s license</li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. This team is responsible for the delivery of large capital projects to various internal customer groups across the Company. This position is currently based out of the Bastrop area. This position is based in McGregor, TX.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the project team, consulting engineers, and contractors throughout the entirety of the civil and title: CMF Designer - Color, Material, and Finish (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>CMF DESIGNER</strong></p> <p>As a Color, Material, and Finish Designer on the Starlink team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the look, feel, and quality of next-generation consumer electronics and hardware that connect the world. You’ll contribute to the full development and execution of innovative materials, colors, and finishes, bringing deep expertise to elevate product aesthetics, durability, and user experience while pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in high-volume manufacturing.&nbsp;</p> <p>You’ll lead CMF innovation, select and implement the highest-quality materials and processes, and collaborate closely with design, engineering, and operations teams as well as external suppliers to deliver production-ready solutions.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze, refine, and approve colors, materials, and finishes across active projects to ensure they meet the highest standards of quality and brand alignment</li> <li>Curate and maintain a robust internal library of cutting-edge, inspirational materials and finishes, proactively sourcing innovative options to fuel Starlink’s design evolution</li> <li>Ideate, visualize, and develop compelling CMF design proposals that push creative and technical boundaries</li> <li>Craft impactful digital and physical CMF presentations that articulate a bold, forward-looking vision for the Starlink product ecosystem</li> <li>Partner with cross-functional teams (design, engineering, and manufacturing) to strategize and successfully implement production-ready CMF solutions</li> <li>Protect and execute design intent through precise color tuning, material mastering, and oversight across all product commodities</li> <li>Guide CMF execution from early prototypes through full-scale production, ensuring seamless translation from concept to hardware</li> <li>Build and nurture strong supplier and vendor relationships, continuously identifying new resources to enable groundbreaking material innovation</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a design discipline (i.e. industrial, transportation, product, architecture) and 1+ years professional CMF experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep technical expertise in mass production, manufacturing processes, and a wide range of materials, with proven ability to deliver high-quality CMF designs under tight deadlines</li> <li>Exceptional color acuity, including the ability to pass the Munsell Hue Color Test with a perfect score</li> <li>Strong proficiency in 2D and 3D visualization tools such as Photoshop, Illustrator, Blender, KeyShot, and similar software</li> <li>Outstanding visual, verbal, and presentation skills, able to clearly communicate complex CMF concepts and influence stakeholders</li> <li>Skilled at building and maintaining effective cross-functional relationships with design, engineering, manufacturing, and external partners</li> <li>Highly self-motivated, adaptable, and organized, with the ability to successfully manage multiple parallel projects in a fast-paced environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong visual portfolio is mandatory for consideration</li> <li>This is not a remote or hybrid position and will require relocation if not already local to the Austin, TX area</li> <li>Position occasionally requires the ability to work extended hours, weekends and offsite when needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR Inspect feature tolerances by selecting the tool with the required accuracy</li> <li>Perform complex inspections on mechanical parts, components, assemblies and materials</li> <li>May include but is not limited to purchased parts, in-process and final assemblies, and materials for workmanship and conformance to specifications/drawings</li> <li>Program and setup Articulating Arm (ex. Romer), CMMs to achieve the desired inspections</li> <li>Perform documentation review and verification of certifications, specifications, and conformance to design and specification requirements</li> <li>Inspect flight hardware at the supplier according to engineering drawings, purchase order(s), industry standards, and SpaceX specifications</li> <li>Ensure that all parts meet SpaceX specifications and standards or that any non-conformance is documented at the supplier</li> <li>Support the development of inspection plans at suppliers</li> <li>Support supplier corrective action process, including verifying corrective action implementation</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>3+ years of precision mechanical inspection experience</li> <li>3+ years of programming and running CMM or Faro Arm experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Aerospace precision inspection experience</li> <li>Practical experience working within quality management systems (AS9100 and ISO 9001)</li> <li>CMM Programming with PC-DMIS software</li> <li>Romer Arm experience with Verisurf software</li> <li>Basic understanding of electronics inspection and propulsion valve operation</li> <li>Solid computer skills in Microsoft Word, Outlook and Excel</li> <li>Statistical process control experience</li> <li>Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of managing priorities and tasks as delegated</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specification using ASME Y14.5. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>CNC PROGRAMMER, DEVELOPMENT (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is developing a low-latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. The Starlink R&amp;D team is responsible for the fabrication and assembly of prototype development, production tooling, and automation equipment for the rapidly growing Starlink consumer electronics business. Technicians work closely with the engineering team to execute high-impact projects that expand and improve the Starlink product assembly lines from early-stage development to the highest volume production capable systems at SpaceX.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive CNC mill programming and operations to optimize efficiency and productivity</li> <li>Spearhead the expansion of CNC capabilities to expedite product development cycles</li> <li>Fabricate electromechanical production and test systems using a wide array of tools, machines, and equipment and collaborate with engineering to deliver solutions</li> <li>Work creatively to fabricate components using a wide range of equipment such as mills, lathes, welding, brakes, presses, and CNC processes</li> <li>Assemble complex integrated assemblies that may include mechanical precision assembly, high and low voltage wiring, and pneumatics</li> <li>Interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and build instructions to complete assembly and fabrication processes for critical tooling and equipment</li> <li>Maintain and support the operation of the development shop by enforcing proper workflow, safety, tidiness, and inventory control of consumables and equipment</li> <li>Perform and promote 5S principles of organizing and sustaining an efficient and presentable team work space</li> <li>Work creatively and innovate to support team goals by always being prepared to challenge the status quo and develop unique solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>3+ years of experience in mechanical fabrication (component assembly, welding, machining, hand tools, title: CNC Programmer, NX CAM (IGT Blades & Vanes) - Level 4/5
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">CNC PROGRAMMER, NX CAM (IGT BLADES &amp; VANES)</span></strong></p> <p>The CNC Programmer will support SpaceX’s new industrial gas turbine (IGT) blades and vanes manufacturing line in Bastrop, Texas. Day-to-day work is NX CAM programming, especially 5-axis milling of airfoils, roots, and shrouds on high-temperature superalloys (including nickel-based materials). You will work with machinists, leads, engineering, CNC Specialists, and operations to ship quality programs, prove them out, and keep the line moving.</p> <p>This is a full-time, on-site role on a project team installing and ramping the line. The line also uses grinding, sinker EDM, wire EDM, trailing-edge machining, laser drilling, and stem drilling. You do not need to be an expert in every process on day one; we are hiring a strong 5-axis mill programmer who will ramp on the other cells under Specialist and lead guidance. Mechanical design of simple shop aids (brackets, holders, rigging, fixtures) is a plus. title: CNC Specialist (NX CAM) - Blades & Vanes
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. This role works with vendors, machinists, programmers, engineering, and operations with a high level of autonomy, critical thinking, and accountability for equipment, consumables, processes, and output. The CNC Specialist will support the new blades and vanes line in Bastrop, Texas, and must have a strong understanding of programming, equipment, and consumables for: milling, grinding, sinker EDM, wire EDM, trailing-edge machining, laser drilling, and stem drilling on high-temperature superalloys (including nickel-based materials). Mechanical design of functional shop aids (brackets, holders, rigging, fixtures) is expected.</p> <p>This role sits on a project team selecting, installing, and commissioning the line. We need a high-ownership Specialist who ships results, unblocks other teams, and does not wait to be asked.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Use NX CAD/CAM to program all blades/vanes processes: 5-axis milling, grinding, sinker EDM, wire EDM, trailing-edge machining, laser drilling, and stem drilling.</li> <li>Own a comprehensive level of process knowledge: machine capability, workholding, electrodes/wire/wheels/nozzles and other consumables, parameters, and quality outcomes for each process above.</li> <li>Verify NC files (e.g. Vericut) and own revision control on programs, setup sheets, and process documentation.</li> <li>Select tooling and consumables; set parameters for superalloys; be accountable for tool/consumable life, cycle time, and part quality.</li> <li>Drive DFM: recommend and implement drawing/process changes; own the process decision.</li> <li>Design fixtures, brackets, holders, and rigging required to run the line.</li> <li>Support equipment selection, vendor engagement, and commissioning, including FAT and SAT as required, for mill, grind, EDM, laser, and related cells.</li> <li>Troubleshoot common machine, program, consumable, and process issues; train operators and CNC Programmers; act as technical backup on the floor.</li> <li>Own process development through prove-out to stable production; meet performance goals and escalate only when the issue is beyond the cell.</li> <li>Drive process improvements and support other teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma/equivalency certificate.</li> <li>5+ years of CNC programming experience in NX.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of CNC programming in NX, including experience as a manufacturing engineer or lead programmer on blades/vanes.</li> <li>Demonstrated ownership of turbine blade or equivalent airfoil processes (programming, tooling, probing, and prove-out).</li> <li>Working knowledge of milling plus two or more of the following: grinding, sinker EDM, wire EDM, trailing-edge machining, laser drilling, and stem drilling, including equipment and consumables.</li> <li>5-axis mill airfoil work: Starrag/Liechti (LX, NB, STC, Turbomill/g-Mill), Hermle C-series, DMG MORI DMU/DMC, Makino D-series/MAG, GROB, Mazak VARIAXIS, Okuma MU-V, or equivalent.</li> <li>IGT (or aero turbine) blades, vanes, or high-precision airfoils on superalloys.</li> <li>Sinker and wire EDM (GF/Agie, Makino, Sodick, Mitsubishi, or equivalent), including electrodes, wire, and dielectric/consumable selection.</li> <li>Cooling holes and stem drilling: fast-hole EDM and/or laser (Winbro, Huffman, Current EDM, Belmont, GF laser, or similar), including diffusers through base metal and TBC; electrodes, nozzles, assist gas, and related consumables.</li> <li>CNC grinding/trailing-edge: IMM, Blohm/Mägerle/United Grinding, or equivalent; wheels, dressing, and finish-to-print.</li> <li>Metrology (CMM, 3D scanning, on-machine probing).</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to lift 25 lbs. unassisted.</li> <li>Lifting, standing, climbing, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, stretching, and carrying are generally required.</li> <li>Travel to vendors for FAT as required.</li> <li>Must be willing to work overtime and/or weekends if needed.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Construction Safety Engineer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>CONSTRUCTION SAFETY ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>As part of a team of technicians and engineers, you will provide technical expertise and assist in the implementation of all Environmental, Health and Safety programs at the McGregor, TX rocket-engine test site. The ideal candidate is highly skilled in both environmental and occupational safety, is hands-on in a high-energy test environment, and can manage contractor and contingent-labor EHS with the same rigor as employee programs. We work as a highly integrated team and job responsibilities will include helping other programs to ensure the overall success of SpaceX.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with test engineers, stand crews, and technician teams to perform detailed safety reviews of complex hazardous operations (hot fire, propellant loading, pressurization, ordnance, cryogenics, and post-test recovery) to ensure safe execution.</li> <li>Lead or assist in all aspects of incident investigations, including initial follow-up, root cause analysis, and corrective action development and closure; enter events in Safety Net and drive closure with operations leadership.</li> <li>Collaborate with department leadership to complete job hazard assessments and implement health and safety policies and procedures for Merlin, Raptor, fabrication, civil/construction, and support shops.</li> <li>Implement and develop safety and health programs including but not limited to OSHA general industry and construction standards; HAZCOM, hazmat, cryogenics, compressed gases, and rocket propellants (LOX, RP-1, methane); confined space, fall protection, lock-out/tag-out, hot work, and fire watch; powered industrial trucks, aerial lifts, cranes/rigging, and heavy equipment; and radiation and laser safety as applicable to test and shop operations.</li> <li>Develop safety solutions that resolve EHS hazards/concerns within cost and schedule constraints following a safety order of precedence to include elimination, substitution, engineering controls, work practice controls, training, and personal protective equipment (PPE) to ensure that safety of personnel, property, and the environment are within acceptable risk boundaries.</li> <li>Monitor employee and non-employee worker exposure to physical and chemical hazards; recommend and implement controls to eliminate exposure.</li> <li>Inspect facilities, test stands, machinery, and safety equipment in order to identify and correct potential hazards and ensure compliance with all applicable regulations.</li> <li>Develop, implement and maintain safety contingency plans (fires, spills, lightning/range clear, test abort, etc.) and confirm contractors and contingent workers are included in those plans.</li> <li>Maintain compliance with all applicable regulations established by OSHA, EPA, CERCLA, RCRA, DOT, ATF, TCEQ, TRRC, NFPA, NIOSH and other applicable regulatory agencies.</li> <li>Perform environmental compliance and due diligence audits to ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory agencies.</li> <li>Own McGregor implementation of the Contractor EHS Management Program for vendor-supervised contractors and subcontractors (construction, civil, specialty trades, field service), including company safety-critical qualification, purchase-order safety-critical work selection, worker guidelines, site orientation, job hazard assessments / site-specific safety plans, audits, and violation tracking.</li> <li>Own McGregor implementation of employee-equivalent EHS training for SpaceX-supervised contingent labor (staffing-agency workers directed by SpaceX), using the same Learning courses and Personnel Qualifications skills as the equivalent employee role rather than contractor-only site awareness.</li> <li>Classify incoming non-employee labor (vendor contractor vs. contingent worker vs. visitor) with the SpaceX designated person, Security, Purchasing, and HR so the correct EHS path is used.</li> <li>Build and maintain a McGregor roster of on-site contractors and contingent workers joined to training and qualification status; do not permit unsupervised hazardous work (height, LOTO, confined space, hot work, powered industrial trucks / aerial lifts, crane, respirator) until the matching employee or contractor control is complete.</li> <li>Stand up and instruct live and site EHS orientation and practicals used at McGregor (confined space, LOTO, fall protection, hot work / fire watch, boom and scissor lift, respirators), including enrollment of contingent workers onto the employee path and contractors onto the contractor path.</li> <li>Partner with test, facilities, civil/construction, and trade supervisors so pre-mobilization packages (site-specific safety plan, JHA, proof of training, rescue plans, equipment) are complete before contractor work starts, and so contingent workers are on SpaceX JHAs for the crew they join.</li> <li>Investigate contractor and contingent-worker incidents; determine host-employer OSHA recordability when SpaceX directs the work; issue findings to the labor supplier or contracting company and to Purchasing as required.</li> <li>Report McGregor contractor and contingent-labor leading and lagging indicators (orientation completion, overdue qualifications, audit findings, Safety Net events) to site EHS leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree.</li> <li>3+ years of experience in the design, development and operational oversight of environmental, health and safety disciplines (student project team or internship experience qualifies); OR a master's degree.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in engineering, occupational health and safety, environmental science, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Direct experience managing on-site contractors, construction EHS, and/or contingent / staffing-agency labor (qualification, orientation, audits, and incident investigation).</li> <li>Working knowledge of OSHA 1910 and 1926, host-employer / dual-employer duties, and distinguishing vendor-supervised contractors from SpaceX-supervised contingent labor.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of process safety management methods and best practices with pressure systems, cryogenics, and chemical processes.</li> <li>Experience in engine/propulsion test, aerospace, manufacturing, chemical, or similar high-hazard industrial environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to research and apply the best industrial and working practices to provide effective services.</li> <li>Strong understanding of industrial hygiene programs including respiratory protection, hearing conservation, ergonomics, and chemical exposure prevention.</li> <li>Strong knowledge and experience in interpreting, applying and documenting federal, Texas, and local safety and environmental regulations (OSHA, EPA, TCEQ, TRRC, ATF, DOT).</li> <li>Experience with emergency response communication and incident management in incidents involving hazardous and non-hazardous material releases to air, soil, and water.</li> <li>Familiarity with learning management and qualification systems (Personnel Qualifications, Safety Net, JHA) or equivalent.</li> <li>Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).</li> <li>Strong organizational and communication skills; able to stop work and influence test, construction, and trade leadership.</li> <li>ASP, CSP, CIH, CHMM, or similar credential; OSHA 30 General Industry and/or Construction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>This is not a remote or hybrid position and will require relocation if not already local to the McGregor, TX area.</li> <li>Position occasionally requires the ability to work extended hours, nights, and weekends when needed to support test operations and contractor mobilization.</li> <li>Must be able to work in outdoor test-stand and construction environments, including heat, noise, and elevated work, with required PPE.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Controls Technician
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>CONTROLS TECHNICIAN</strong></p> <p>The controls technician supports building and maintaining our data and control systems. These systems include different data collection and control hardware, wiring, interface harnesses, and many types of sensors. The goal of the data and control systems team is to meet test needs for safe, low-cost, and reliable access to space.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform complex technical assignments involving instrumentation and data acquisition/processing systems</li> <li>Maintain, calibrate, configure, monitor, test, troubleshoot, install, and repair instrumentation, process controls, data acquisition systems, and electrical systems</li> <li>Investigate, diagnose, correct, and document instrumentation or system malfunctions</li> <li>Analyze results of calibrations and processed data, and assist in the interpretation of test data</li> <li>Adjust, repair, or replace faulty components of test setups and equipment</li> <li>Lay out, build, test, troubleshoot, repair, and modify developmental and production electrical and electronic units, assemblies, components, parts, equipment, and systems</li> <li>Configure the data acquisition hardware</li> <li>Perform wire terminations to a variety of instruments and verify sensor health: pressure transducers, thermocouples, valves, limits, and flow meters</li> <li>Install connectors, connector pins, terminals, and lugs</li> <li>Perform continuity checks, locate and correct wiring errors using measuring instruments such as ohmmeters and sequential continuity checkers</li> <li>Adjust, calibrate, align, and modify circuitry and components, and record effects on unit performance</li> <li>Read and interpret planning documents, schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, drawings, manuals, blueprints, and engineering sketches</li> <li>Perform layout and wiring of electrical panels</li> <li>Collaborate with design engineers to troubleshoot failures and issues derived from test data</li> <li>Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Associate degree in instrumentation, control technology, electrical systems, or other electrical field (3+ years of professional experience working with controls or electrical systems will be considered in lieu of a degree)</li> <li>2+ years of experience working with instrumentation such as pressure transducers, thermocouples, valves, flow meters, multimeters, or oscilloscopes</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working with any of the following instrumentation: resistance temperature devices (RTDs), silicon diode temperature devices, strain gauges, load cells, displacement transducers, pressure transducers, thermocouple, and flow meters (turbine, coriolis, and ultrasonic)</li> <li>Basic knowledge of Wheatstone bridge theory, ability to apply Ohm's law, and an understanding of direct current (DC) electronics</li> <li>Operational knowledge of an oscilloscope and multi-meter, soldering wires and connectors, operation of various crimping tools, wire stripping, continuity testing, pinning out a military type connector, routing and tie wrapping cables, drilling and tapping holes, and building junction boxes</li> <li>System-level troubleshooting skills and the ability to logically solve instrumentation system problems and determine corrective action</li> <li>Experience with Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and motor starters, and knowledge in troubleshooting</li> <li>Knowledge in signal conditioning concepts for various types of sensors, to include the following: thermocouple Types K, S, and E; TC bonding concepts: resistance weld on and adhesive bond on types; TC probes through thermowell sheaths; cold junction compensation concepts</li> <li>Background should include experience with the following devices: DC power supplies, DC-DC converters, uninterruptible power supply (UPS) installations, heat shrink tubing, cable harnessing, lacing, and proper strain relief concepts</li> <li>Working knowledge of transducers, operational amplifiers, and the knowledge of measurement techniques for temperature, pressure, flow, displacement, vibration, and the application of strain gauges is also highly desired. Ability to identify required data, data acquisition plans, and test parameters, and set up equipment to conform to these specifications</li> <li>Working knowledge of multiple bus architectures (Peripheral Component Interconnect (PCI)/Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe), PCI eXtensions for Instrumentation (PXI)/PXI Express (PXIe), General Purpose Interface Bus (GPIB), Serial, Universal Serial Bus (USB), etc.) and data communication technologies</li> <li>Demonstrated capabilities in the development of comprehensive project plans that include all tasks, stage/gate milestones, and reviews necessary to successfully develop and implement solutions</li> <li>Intermediate skill level using Windows Operating Systems</li> <li>Intermediate skill level using Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, OneNote)</li> <li>Knowledge in data acquisition concepts, hardware, and interfacing (Signal Conditioning eXtensions for Instrumentation (SCXI) and PCI eXtensions for Instrumentation (PXI) based)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain</li> <li>Must be available for overtime and weekends as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required</li> <li>Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise</li> <li>Stand: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Sit: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Push/Pull: Up to 75lbs. (unassisted) between 1 to 2 hours per day</li> <li>Overhead reach: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Walk: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. (unassisted) between 1 to 2 hours per day</li> <li>Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Kneel/Crouch: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Upper body twist: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees 6 hours or greater per day</li> <li>Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>CRANE AND HEAVY EQUIPMENT SPECIALIST (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The Crane and Heavy Equipment Specialist is a highly skilled and respected professional responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency of complex lifting and heavy equipment systems, including cranes, heavy lifting equipment, and related support systems. This role requires advanced technical expertise, leadership, and coordination across multiple teams to ensure mission-critical operations are executed flawlessly. The specialist is a proactive leader who drives safety, mentors team members, and implements innovative solutions to enhance team performance and system reliability. SpaceX doesn’t shut down production for maintenance, and instead, we find ways to predict failures and perform the maintenance without interrupting production. This role will require direct work with the engineers and technicians who design and build unique machines and perform risk analysis together to map out the maintenance strategy and find the best condition monitoring systems to monitor the performance.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair cranes and heavy equipment, ensuring team proficiency systems</li> <li>Create basic and complex work orders from scratch for assemblies</li> <li>Provide preventative and corrective maintenance on various complex lifting and heavy equipment systems</li> <li>Develop complex rework work order dispositions, including custom hardware installs without design references and functional/leak checks post-rework</li> <li>Drive forklifts and other company equipment</li> <li>Design and create specialized tooling to complete projects or tasks</li> <li>Trains and mentors the operations team to ensure equipment operators are capable of self-diagnosing, troubleshooting, and performing common repairs</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>2+ years of experience with crane and heavy equipment service and maintenance</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Able to adapt to constantly changing work assignments and fast-paced work regulations</li> <li>Understanding of basic rigging and securing best practices</li> <li>Read and interpret engineering work instructions/drawings and verify that the given load, securing method, title: Critical Lift Technician (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>CRITICAL LIFT TECHNICIAN&nbsp; (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for Booster/Ship and associated ground support equipment (GSE) movement across multiple launch sites</li> <li>Perform preventative maintenance on mobile cranes, cranes, and SPMTs</li> <li>Work with a team of technicians and engineers to ensure systems and equipment are maintained with the highest level of quality to support current and future manifest</li> <li>Utilize heavy machinery (standard and high capacity forklifts, telehandlers, mobile hydraulic/crawler cranes, SPMTs, high reach man lifts, overhead cranes) to lift and move flight hardware and associated GSE after delivery and before shipping</li> <li>Evaluate in-transit risks and provide on-site solutions to alleviate risk. Including routing, repairs, escorts, and drivers – including physical escorts across launch sites</li> <li>Make recommendations to logistics management to improve the health, timing, and safety of all movements</li> <li>Work with a team of technicians and engineers to ensure systems and mechanical equipment are built with the highest level of quality to support the successful launch of our multi-million dollar launch vehicle</li> <li>Troubleshoot operational issues found on the vehicle press system</li> <li>Maintain and install fluid system components from a schematic or drawing including ball and check valves, pressure regulators and gauges, etc.</li> <li>Set up, inspect, operate, and perform maintenance on hydraulic self-propelled modular transporters, hydraulic booms and crawler cranes</li> <li>Perform tear down and assembly of different configurations associated with Cranes and SPMTs</li> </ul> <div><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</div> </li> <li> <div>1+ years of experience on a critical lift team or a logistics/transport team</div> </li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience with SPMT operators and/or hydraulic lift trailers</li> <li>2+ years of with mobile hydraulic and/or crawler cranes for delicate lifting operations (ex. Wind farms, power plants, oil refineries) and 2+ years of experience in rigging</li> <li>NCCCO/NCCER certifications in crane, rigging, ironworking, and heavy equipment operations (ex. TLL, TSS, LAT, OVR, RIG-I/II, SGP)</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret engineering work instructions/drawings and verify that the given load, securing method, transport, and loading/unloading processes are carried out successfully and in accordance with transport or lift plan</li> <li>Experience with organization and ability to multi-task, detail-oriented while also working within time constraints and deadlines</li> <li>Associate degree in aerospace technology or equivalent area of study</li> <li>Experience maintaining and troubleshooting complex fluid and mechanical systems</li> <li>Familiarity with calibrated measurement devices including load cells, multimeters, calipers, torque wrenches, depth gauges, and micrometers</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and weekends, which varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility required (day shift: 6 AM - 6 PM and night shift: 6 PM - 6 AM)</li> <li>Ability to pass Airforce background check for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg</li> <li>Able to tilt, dip, and turn suspended loads to maneuver over, under, and/or around obstacles using multi-point rigging techniques</li> <li>Flexibility to travel 25-50% of the time</li> <li>Valid Driver’s license</li> <li data-uuid="4abe761b-cfe5-4e76-b910-d7b91165de27">Stand: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="0a9f42a9-1a72-494b-9377-1a2913a88e7e">Sit: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="c36b5dae-6610-43f3-92c6-b00127f20ccf">Push/Pull: Up to 75lbs. (unassisted) 1-2 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="bccaed05-c380-4e81-979a-5d30d3676a96">Overhead reach: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="40279d29-4b87-42c0-9804-40e357faa856">Walk: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="df78660b-e76b-402b-93a4-ab08c162d1b5">Lift/Carry: Up to 50lbs. (unassisted) 1-2 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="aaeb016b-c4ca-4d94-a4a6-ac068d53a57d">Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="5fe947ca-159b-4a2e-97b8-7eabe57fa271">Kneel/Crouch: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="3edff263-c521-4c29-8489-b83791bf6b55">Upper body twist: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="47fc1e37-29a2-4e10-a489-6611c0901870">Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees: up to 3 hours per day</li> <li data-uuid="e6975fca-0907-4338-8a3d-a1b552e0d6fc">Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, using an air purifying respirator, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Customer Support Associate, Bilingual - Ukrainian (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>CUSTOMER SUPPORT ASSOCIATE, BILINGUAL - UKRAINIAN (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, will deliver low-latency broadband internet worldwide. As an early member of the Starlink Customer Support team, you will be the face of Starlink to our customers, ensuring they have an exceptional overall experience.<br><br>In this role, you will triage, troubleshoot, and resolve customer issues. You will analyze trends, identify gaps, and design simple, effective support interventions that improve our customers' experience. We're looking for excellent problem solvers who move quickly and proactively and are obsessed with the success of our customers. This role is ideal for someone looking to join a scrappy, early-stage Support team and set the tone for how we help our customers.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Triage and resolve customer issues across multiple channels (digital, voice, etc.). Be a relentless internal advocate for the customer within SpaceX</li> <li>Provide technical support to customers using hardware, software, and network expertise</li> <li>Surface product, process, and training issues by pairing quantitative and qualitative methods. Be the voice of the customer, in the language of the business</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams to create and improve troubleshooting workflows and resolve root-cause issues</li> <li>Create and maintain an internal knowledge base and help center collateral</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>1+ years of experience in a front-line customer support role</li> <li>Fluent in English and Ukrainian</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excellent problem-solving and sleuthing skills. You go beyond just the apparent and available answer and do what it takes to satisfy the customer.&nbsp;You are relentless and own it</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Talking with others comes naturally, you derive satisfaction from resolving their&nbsp;issues, and you can distill complex concepts into the simplest explanations</li> <li>Excellent empathy, active listening, and resiliency skills. You internalize customer concerns, solve them, and keep it positive</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and time management skills. You take pride in your craft</li> <li>Willingness and ability to flex weekend and night shift hours as needed to support our growth</li> <li>Experience in a training, learning and development, analytics, service design, vendor management, or content management role</li> <li>Start-up, consulting, or other demonstrated experience in a high-growth, fast-paced environment</li> <li>Technical aptitude - experience with networking, hardware troubleshooting, software development, etc.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available to work scheduled shifts, including holidays</li> <li>Must be available to work overtime hours and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>This is <strong><u>not </u></strong>a remote position and will require relocation if not already local to the Bastrop, TX area</li> <li>After 1 week of classroom training Monday to Friday 9AM-5:30PM, must be available to work 10 hours a day on one of the following shifts:&nbsp;</li> <ul> <li><span data-teams="true">Saturday - Wednesday: 3:30 PM - 2 AM</span></li> <li><span data-teams="true">Monday - Friday: 3:30 PM - 2 AM</span></li> <li><span data-teams="true">Sunday - Thursday: 7 PM - 4 AM&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
