title: Lead Security Officer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD SECURITY OFFICER</strong></p> <p>The Lead Security Officer is an elite security professional who performs advanced physical security assessments and threat simulations to test the defenses of SpaceX facilities and assets. Your expertise will help identify vulnerabilities and improve the overall security posture of the organization. This role requires a unique blend of physical security expertise, tactical training, and analytical skills, with the ability to make split-second decisions in high-stress environments.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;<br></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Red Team Operations:</strong> <ul> <li>Conduct physical security assessments and penetration testing of SpaceX facilities, including buildings, data centers, and other critical infrastructure.</li> <li>Develop and execute complex threat scenarios to test the effectiveness of security measures, including access control, surveillance, and alarm systems.</li> <li>Collaborate with security teams to identify vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Special Operations:</strong> <ul> <li>Provide rapid response capabilities to support security incidents, including but not limited to, intrusions, breaches, or other high-risk situations.</li> <li>Work closely with security personnel to contain and resolve incidents, ensuring the safety of personnel and assets.</li> <li>Develop and maintain security protocols, procedures, and training programs to ensure readiness and effectiveness.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Threat Assessment and Analysis:</strong> <ul> <li>Conduct research and analysis to identify potential threats to SpaceX facilities and assets, including insider threats, terrorism, and cyber-physical attacks.</li> <li>Develop and maintain threat profiles, including adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).</li> <li>Collaborate with intelligence teams to stay informed about emerging threats and trends.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Decision-Making in High-Stress Environments:</strong> <ul> <li>Make split-second decisions in high-stress environments, prioritizing the safety of personnel and assets.</li> <li>Apply analytical and critical thinking skills to rapidly assess situations and develop effective response strategies.</li> <li>Maintain a calm and focused demeanor in high-pressure situations, ensuring effective communication and coordination with team members.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Training and Exercises:</strong> <ul> <li>Develop and conduct training exercises for security personnel, including scenario-based training, tabletop exercises, and live-fire drills.Design and execute complex security exercises to test response procedures, including SWAT deployments and incident response.</li> <li>Evaluate exercise outcomes and provide recommendations for improvement.</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Additional Duties:</strong> <ul> <li>Maintain a high level of physical fitness and proficiency in tactical skills, including firearms, hand-to-hand combat, and tactical driving.</li> <li>Stay up-to-date with industry best practices, emerging threats, and advances in security technology.</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including security, engineering, and facilities management, to ensure a holistic approach to security.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate.</li> <li>5+ years of experience in the military, law enforcement, overseas security contracting, or advanced corporate security realm.</li> <li>1+ years of experience with executive protection, mobile asset protection, or emergency response team experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed training in SWAT operations, including tactical response and crisis management, or military special operations.</li> <li>Proficiency in firearms, defensive tactics, and tactical driving.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as security management, criminology, or international relations.</li> <li>Experience in red teaming, penetration testing, or threat assessment.</li> <li>Combat medic, EMT-B, or paramedic related experience.</li> <li>Advanced medical emergency training (TCCC/TECC/Combat Lifesaver).</li> <li>Familiarity with security protocols, including access control, surveillance, and alarm systems.</li> <li>Knowledge of threat intelligence, including insider threats, terrorism, and cyber-physical attacks.</li> <li>Experience with exercise design and execution, including scenario-based training and tabletop exercises.</li> <li>Computer based proficiency with Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with minimal supervision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Availability to work any schedule needed, to include overtime, nights, weekends and rotating.</li> <li>Position is subject to enhanced pre-employment screening, including a background check, psychological test, bi-annual physical fitness test, and a drug and alcohol test.</li> <li>Position is subject to random drug and alcohol testing.</li> <li>Ability and willingness to occasionally stand in a static position for extended periods.</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to 15% of time in support of SpaceX Security requirements should the need arise.</li> <li>Valid driver’s license.</li> <li>Possess or be eligible for a valid state security officer license.</li> <li>Eligible for a US Government security clearance.</li> <li>Ability to effectively execute duties in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Lead Software Engineer, Application Software (Manufacturing)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER, APPLICATION SOFTWARE (MANUFACTURING)</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service.</p> <p>Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.</p> <p>As a Lead Software Engineer on the Application Software team, you will have the opportunity to lead a team of highly skilled engineers both from a technical and personnel development perspective.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Directly manage a team of software engineers</li> <li>Own all aspects, including prioritization, implementation, and delivery, of a system roadmap</li> <li>Provide strong technical leadership with a focus on continuous improvement</li> <li>Manage and track multiple priorities while maintaining a focus towards common project goals</li> <li>Develop highly reliable and available software systems</li> <li>Maintain highest standards of excellence, never settle for the status quo</li> <li>Collaborate with other leaders in the department, and across the company, to ensure success for SpaceX</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or science discipline and 3+ years of software development experience; OR 6+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree</li> <li>1+ years of experience with object-oriented programming</li> <li>1+ years of experience with leading software teams or projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Programming experience in Python, C#, .NET, Go, Java, or similar object-oriented language</li> <li>Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework</li> <li>Experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies</li> <li>4+ years of experience building single page web applications</li> <li>Expertise in designing software systems</li> <li>Expertise in testing and infrastructure</li> <li>Expertise in profiling and improving application performance</li> <li>Domain expertise in manufacturing systems</li> <li>Strong desire to mentor and grow employees</li> <li>Able to collaborate across group and department lines with a wide range of engineers and managers, including networking and working in a team development environment</li> <li>Excellent communication and teamwork skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>Must be willing to travel when needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>LEAD STARSHIP ENGINEER (SHIP VEHICLE ASSEMBLY)</strong></p> <p>The Lead Starship Engineer will be responsible for the production of the Starship airframe weldment. This includes assembling the Integrated Payload Volume, the PEZ, Raceway, Tank Cleaning, and Megabay 2 Stacking. This position will work directly with integration, propulsion, and quality partners in the Starfactory and hand off to airframe integration.</p> <p>Production encompasses a wide range of pressurized components, propulsion systems, structures, avionics, tooling design, and process development. The lead engineer ensures the efficiency, cost, and quality of these systems while developing a team of engineers who own discrete assemblies and project scope. The lead engineer is accountable for scoping the team and growing the depth chart to support new vehicles and ultimately staff the Gigabay.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop a team of build engineers designing the production system&nbsp;</li> <li>Mentor and foster the continual technical and professional development of team members&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop lean manufacturing processes, factory infrastructure, tools, and documentation to enable efficient and high-rate production</li> <li>Work with the design engineering team to drive simplicity into the vehicle systems at a complex level&nbsp;</li> <li>Build long-term direction for vehicle architecture and factory infrastructures to meet the evolving needs of the program and company&nbsp;</li> <li>Coordinate and execute development, qualification, and acceptance testing of systems and tooling needed to meet hardware deadlines&nbsp;</li> <li>Create original CAD models and prints for flight and/or tooling components&nbsp;</li> <li>Execute design for manufacturability changes to enhance production efficiency&nbsp;</li> <li>Create and maintain build schedules and detailed work instructions&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop process parameters, requirements, and drive next generation architectures&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in mechanical, manufacturing, or aerospace engineering&nbsp;</li> <li>2+ years of process development and build experience on integrated assemblies (internship and academic experience not applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Master's degree in engineering discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience recruiting, training, and managing a high performing team with wide scope&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with process development, facility and line layouts, and error-proofing&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience owning the outcome of large integrated build and test scope, inclusive of both new product introduction and mature build execution</li> <li>Experience with fluid dynamics and pressurized components (valves, regulators, tubes, pipes, etc.)&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience leading operation-critical part mechanical design, including basic structures, fluids, electrical calculations and design considerations&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with CAD and FEA software packages&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with Unigraphics NX and Teamcenter CAD and PLM systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and organizational skills&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Flight hardware typically is built in tight quarters and physical dexterity is required&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings and climbing hand over hand&nbsp;</li> <li>Occasionally exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain&nbsp;</li> <li>Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise&nbsp;</li> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and weekends depending on site operational needs</li> <li>Flexibility to travel to remote build sites – up to 15%</li> <li>Stand: Up to 3 hours per day</li> <li>Sit: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Push/Pull: Up to 50lbs. (unassisted) Up to 15 minutes per day</li> <li>Overhead reach: Up to 3 hours per day</li> <li>Walk: Up to 3 hours per day</li> <li>Lift/Carry: Up to 25lbs. (unassisted) Up to 15 minutes per day</li> <li>Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 1 hour per day</li> <li>Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees: up to 30 minutes per day</li> <li>Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, using an air purifying respirator, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Learning Guide
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Our school consists of four studios: Spark (Grades K-2), Discovery (Grades 3-5), Adventure (Grades 6-8), and Launch Pad (Grades 9-12). This is not a traditional school model. In all areas of school life, our learners are empowered to be in the driver’s seat of their learning. We combine elements of the Montessori method with Socratic guiding, hands-on experiential missions, rigorous curricula, and adaptive technology. We support each student on their personalized journey by fostering an engaging learning environment that feels more like an adventure than school, while still upholding highly rigorous academic standards. Our real-world missions culminate in a public exhibition of learning every 6-8 weeks to allow our students to demonstrate their brilliance in multiple ways.</span></p> title: Machine Maintenance Engineer, Tool & Die
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">MACHINE MAINTENANCE ENGINEER, TOOL AND DIE</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, the Starlink satellite constellation, is our solution to providing reliable internet to the entire world. We are looking for a Machine Maintenance Engineer for the Bastrop Tool and Die shop. This department produces dies (also known as tools or molds) used in injection molding, high pressure die casting, and stamping. Those dies are the building blocks that enable in-house high-volume production for user terminal components.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Maintenance Engineer is the primary technical resource for maintenance technicians on planned and unplanned repairs, modifications, and upgrades of Tool and Die machine tools and shop equipment. This role takes end-to-end ownership of equipment improvement projects from concept through design and implementation. The job is to maximize CNC, EDM, grinder, crane, and related equipment availability so die build rate is not set by a down machine.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The success of Starlink depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, and throughput of the products that you deliver. This role will be an ideal next career step if you seek a fast-paced/dynamic environment, thrive on solving difficult problems where resolutions have high impact, and love the challenge of building something from scratch.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Lead maintenance technicians to troubleshoot and resolve technically complex machine-tool failures</span><span jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MACHINE MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR (STARLINK) - MULTIPLE SHIFTS</strong><br><br>At SpaceX, we are applying decades of experience designing, building, and flying rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink—the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the largest satellite constellation ever built and already delivers fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, manufacture, test, and operate every element of the system: thousands of satellites, user terminals that connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that ties it all together. We are only beginning to realize Starlink’s potential global impact and are seeking exceptional talent to help maximize its value for communities and businesses around the world.</p> <p>SpaceX is looking for an experienced Machine Maintenance Supervisor to lead maintenance operations that support Starlink production and operations. In this role, you will build and develop a high-performing maintenance team and establish the processes, standards, and culture needed for excellence. You will manage schedules, workflows, and resources in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while ensuring equipment reliability and uptime that directly enable Starlink’s mission.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the build-out and development of a high-performing team of multi-skilled technicians capable of supporting the full range of process equipment used in Starlink production</li> <li>Establish and continuously refine Preventive Maintenance (PM) work plans and schedules for all assets</li> <li>Drive collaboration with engineers and planners to define corrective maintenance strategies and target completion dates based on failure analysis, ensuring they feed into robust Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules</li> <li>Spearhead the partnership gaps</li> <li>Manage daily activity logging, major breakdown reporting, workforce shift utilization, and absence requests to ensure full operational visibility and control</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MACHINE MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable.</p> <p>We are looking for talented, creative, and driven technicians to drive manufacturing output and yield. You will have ownership of one or more process areas and will have the opportunity to directly impact Starlink’s products. You will have frequent interaction with engineering teams and leadership and will participate in developing and validating new equipment, processes, and technologies. The success of Starlink depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, throughput, security, and user experience of the products that you will manufacture.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform planned maintenance and unplanned repairs of production line equipment that includes copper electroplating, chemical etching, ultrapure process water treatment, solder mask printing, automated laser and mechanical drilling, PCB layup and lamination, and/or plasma etching systems</li> <li>Perform planned maintenance and unplanned repairs of production line assets that includes SMT line equipment, epoxy dispensing printers, conveyor systems, thermal chambers, test reliability chambers, and vacuum systems</li> <li>Read and utilize schematics (mechanical/electrical/pneumatic/hydraulic) to troubleshoot systems down to the component level</li> <li>Read and safely execute lockout tagout procedures</li> <li>Utilize diagnostic equipment to monitor equipment performance, diagnose root cause, and make reliability improvement recommendations</li> <li>Use schematics, hand tools, electrical gauges, and common test equipment for calibration, diagnosis and repair, or maintenance of equipment</li> <li>Communicate with suppliers, specify requirements, get quotations, and submit purchase requisitions to purchase necessary items</li> <li>Provide feedback and work with maintenance and engineering and vendor teams to drive root cause of equipment downtime</li> <li>Conduct training for production personnel</li> parts lists, min/max levels, optimal spares inventory, parts criticality analysis.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline</li> In addition, the Maintenance Engineer acts as the accountable engineering resource in driving the design, build, and installation stages of new and modified assets as well as provides technical support to maintenance management, technicians, and production personnel to prevent and mitigate operational issues of critical equipment.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work title: Manager, Automation & Controls Engineering (Power Generation & Utilities)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, AUTOMATION &amp; CONTROLS ENGINEERING (POWER GENERATION &amp; UTILITIES)</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Manager of Automation and Controls Engineering to own the design, build-out, commissioning, and continuous improvement of automation, controls, and electrical systems across SpaceX’s critical power generation and utility infrastructure at Starbase. This role is involved in every major facility that supports Starship production, launch, propellant generation, terrestrial data centers, and site operations — with a primary focus on industrial power generation assets, utility-scale and low-voltage electrical power systems, and the associated balance-of-plant.</p> <p>If it has a gas or steam turbine control system, a switchgear lineup, a plant electrical distribution network, a SCADA/DCS point, a control loop, or a supporting utility/process system (water, wastewater, fuel gas, HVAC, cooling) that must run reliably at scale, this team designs it, specifies it, commissions it, and keeps it running. As a Manager, you will lead a team of Automation and Controls Engineers in a high-reliability, fast-paced environment. This is a hands-on technical leadership role — you will review P&amp;IDs, challenge control philosophies, dive into DCS/PLC architecture, electrical protection schemes, and commissioning details, not just manage a roadmap. You will scale both the team and the systems as Starship production and launch cadence increase.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the automation and controls engineering scope for all power generation projects and assets (gas turbine simple cycle, combined cycle, and steam turbine systems), including DCS/SCADA architecture, PLC systems, turbine control interfaces, instrumentation, and control networks — from control philosophy through commissioning and ongoing reliability.</li> <li>Own controls and electrical integration for utility-scale and low-voltage electrical power systems, including switchgear, protection and metering, plant electrical distribution, and power system controls in compliance with NFPA 70/70B/70E, NESC, and IEEE standards.</li> <li>Lead mechanical and electrical balance-of-plant (BOP) controls scope across power generation assets — fuel gas systems, HVAC, fire protection, compressed air, cooling water, and auxiliary systems.</li> <li>Direct automation and controls scope for supporting utility and process systems, including raw water intake, demineralization, wastewater treatment, cooling water, and industrial gas systems.</li> <li>Build, mentor, and manage a team of automation and controls engineers and technicians; scale the team in line with power generation capacity growth and Starship production/launch rate targets.</li> <li>Review and approve control philosophy documents, I/O lists, control narratives, single-line diagrams, electrical/pneumatic schematics, cause-and-effect diagrams, and control panel designs produced by the team and by EPC contractors/vendors.</li> <li>Interface directly with internal engineering disciplines, construction teams, OEMs (turbine, HRSG, BOP, and electrical equipment vendors), and contractors to ensure controls and electrical scope is fully integrated and commissioned on schedule.</li> <li>Drive standardization of control system architecture (DCS/PLC/SCADA), cybersecurity posture, documentation, and engineering practices across power generation and utility facilities to enable design reuse and faster deployment.</li> <li>Own field commissioning support for automation, controls, and electrical systems, including loop checks, functional testing, protection testing, start-up, and hand-off; support root-cause investigations and reliability improvements across operating assets.</li> <li>Develop SOWs, negotiate, and manage contractor work as needed to support power generation and utility build-out.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related engineering field.</li> <li>8+ years of experience in automation and controls engineering, with direct experience on industrial power generation projects (gas turbine, combined cycle, or steam systems preferred) or large-scale critical power infrastructure.</li> <li>3+ years of experience directly managing or leading a team of engineers (and preferably technicians).</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated hands-on experience with DCS and/or PLC/SCADA platforms used in power generation or heavy industrial applications.</li> <li>Experience working across the full project lifecycle: design, procurement, construction support, commissioning, and operations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of electrical power systems (utility-scale and low-voltage), switchgear, protection, metering, and their interface with automation and controls.</li> <li>Experience designing or reviewing industrial electrical control panels and electrical schematics.&nbsp;</li> <li>Direct experience with gas turbine or combined-cycle power plant controls (turbine control systems, HRSG controls, plant-wide DCS integration, and BOP controls).</li> <li>Experience with utility-scale electrical power systems controls, protection schemes, and SCADA integration.</li> <li>Experience with water treatment plant automation, wastewater systems, industrial gas/fuel gas systems, or process cooling systems supporting power generation.</li> <li>Experience designing and commissioning PLC, HMI, and SCADA applications in high-reliability industrial or power environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with major industrial platforms (e.g., Emerson, ABB, Siemens, Allen-Bradley, SEL) and Ignition SCADA.</li> <li>Experience with IEC 61131 programming, industrial networking (IT/OT), and major industrial protocols such as Modbus, DNP3, etc.</li> <li>Experience managing EPC contractor and OEM interfaces on multi-discipline power or capital projects.</li> <li>PE license in Electrical or Controls Engineering (or willingness to pursue).</li> <li>Experience scaling a controls engineering function within a fast-growing organization.</li> <li>Strong background in control panel design (NFPA 79 / UL 508A) and electrical schematic tools (EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, etc.).</li> <li>Familiarity with industrial control system cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., NERC CIP or equivalent).</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to remain deeply technical while mentoring engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Willingness to perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.</li> <li>Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support power generation, production, and launch operations.</li> <li>Ability to remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.</li> <li>Ability to lift up to 25 lbs unassisted.</li> <li>Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies as needed.</li> <li>Must be able to work on-site at Starbase, TX, with potential travel to other SpaceX facilities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><h4><strong>MANAGER, FACILITIES OPERATIONS (STARLINK)&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>SpaceX is committed to developing revolutionary space technology, with the ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets. We are looking for a talented Facilities Operations Manager to oversee the operation and maintenance of critical facility systems for the Starlink Bastrop production building. This position is directly responsible for ensuring our plant utilities and infrastructure operate at peak performance – minimizing downtime, optimizing efficiency, and supporting high-volume manufacturing operations.</p> <h4 id="Manager,FacilitiesOperations(Starlink)-RESPONSIBILITIES">RESPONSIBILITIES</h4> <ul> <li>Lead a team of technicians and specialists in the execution of preventative and corrective maintenance, spare part control, and general troubleshooting of plant utilities including electrical systems, emergency backup power, HVAC (ARU, AHU, FCU, DOAS, fans), chilled water, heating hot water, process water, compressed air, scrubbers, city water, natural gas, and process waste streams</li> <li>Drive organizational excellence through the creation of standardized KPI metrics and ensure accountability at all levels</li> <li>Oversee the development and implementation of advanced maintenance methodologies to improve equipment uptime, efficiency, and cost control</li> <li>Manage work ticketing system to ensure correct staff and timely responses to break/fix requests</li> <li>Manage third-party service providers to ensure services meet SpaceX standards and terms of contract</li> <li>Partner with construction team to develop, plan and execute site improvement projects</li> <li>Own cranes and related material handling systems (initial ownership; potential future transition)</li> <li>Support 24/7 facility operations including off-hours and emergency response protocols</li> </ul> <h4 id="Manager,FacilitiesOperations(Starlink)-BASICQUALIFICATIONS">BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</h4> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience with facilities operations or critical systems management in a manufacturing or industrial environment</li> <li>Knowledge and understanding of infrastructure systems – HVAC, hydronics, compressed air, electrical distribution, generators, fire suppression, and other critical facility systems</li> </ul> <h4 id="Manager,FacilitiesOperations(Starlink)-PREFERREDSKILLSANDEXPERIENCE">PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li>Proficiency in Microsoft applications such as Excel, Outlook, Word and PowerPoint</li> <li>Excellent communication skills (oral and written)</li> <li>Strong work ethic and drive for constant improvement</li> <li>Ability to independently and effectively manage projects in an extremely fast paced and changing environment</li> <li>Experience with CMMS and predictive maintenance strategies</li> <li>Track record of implementing cost-saving or utility efficiency improvements</li> </ul> <h4 id="Manager,FacilitiesOperations(Starlink)-ADDITIONALREQUIREMENTS">ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS</h4> <ul> <li>Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Provide 24/7 on-call support of all critical activities and emergency situations</li> <li>Valid driver’s license</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Manager, Gateway Electronics Engineering (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, GATEWAY ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING (STARLNK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to serve populations with little or no connectivity. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. Starlink also designs, builds, and delivers high-volume consumer hardware that allows users to connect to these satellites within minutes of unboxing, as well as our advanced gateways that we deploy regionally throughout the world. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>As the Electronics Manager on the Starlink team, you will be responsible for the design, performance, and reliability of next-generation gateways - ultimately ensuring that our ground station antenna hardware can withstand the harshest environmental conditions while maintaining reliable communication with millions of users on a global scale. You will interact regularly with senior leadership to influence the fundamental operation of our constellation and network while collaborating with electrical, silicon, software, mechanical, and manufacturing teams to steer this project from initial concept development to full-scale production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a team of 5-10 engineers to rapidly design, develop, and validate highly reliable electronics for our gateway systems</li> <li>Drive electrical architecture, specification, component selection, circuit board design, implementation, verification, board bring-up, and debugging</li> <li>Define and manage all key project milestones and deliverables</li> <li>Maintain alignment with key partners such as antenna, software, mechanical, networking, thermal, manufacturing, and production test teams to drive overall business success</li> <li>Compile and maintain lessons learned to influence future designs. Understand and implement long-term technical and business solutions that meet/exceed goals to deliver for our customers and Starlink’s vision</li> <li>Drive product architecture with a focus on innovative solutions to achieve low cost, greater performance, best user experience, and extended reliability. Implement automated design validation tests and production tests as necessary</li> <li>Recruit, develop, and promote a team of exceptional engineers and/or specialists responsible for designing, analyzing, building, and testing existing and new Starlink gateways. Set standards, and hold the team accountable to deliver with high technical rigor and discipline</li> <li>Own and build out associated engineering lab or development workspaces; hire necessary team members to deliver assets required, and efficiently manage associated capital spend</li> <li>Consistently contribute effort, leadership, and creative thinking to solving complex problems in a collaborative fashion and under tight deadlines. Above all, remain dependable, which means being unfazed by ambiguity or major changes in strategic direction</li> <li>Ensure a strong focus is placed on safety and maintain an excellent safety record</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or other engineering/STEM discipline</li> <li>7+ years of professional experience with hardware design/development or electronics test engineering</li> <li>3+ years of management experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS &amp; EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience managing large and multidisciplinary technical projects, ideally driving hardware design from concept through production; strong emphasis on full life-cycle development of new hardware products and not small incremental updates to legacy hardware</li> <li>Significant experience rapidly designing and delivering highly-reliable products, especially for harsh or high stakes environments in the field</li> <li>Significant experience designing and implementing mixed-signal circuit boards from concept through production using processors, FPGAs, Ethernet, multi-GHz Serdes, DRAM interfaces (DDR4), I2C, SPI, operational amplifiers, analog to digital and digital to analog converters, and power supply components</li> <li>Significant experience testing, troubleshooting, and debugging electronics&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills when designing and qualifying hardware for EMC/EMI compliance and thermal management</li> <li>Strong understanding of computers and programming languages (Python, C/C++)</li> <li>Strong understanding of computer networking and interfaces (10/100/400/800G networking/Tbps switches)</li> <li>Strong understanding of optical networking architectures and fundamentals</li> <li>Experience in desktop/server Linux and embedded operating systems</li> <li>Experience leading a diverse team of engineers, while providing technical direction and strong mentorship</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex concepts, problems, and solutions clearly and effectively to all levels within the organization</li> <li>Ability to manage multiple concurrent programs and be able to discuss configuration, execution, and results in a technical manner</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must travel to other SpaceX sites (Hawthorne, CA and Redmond, WA) as needed to interface with team members and drive technical projects</li> <li>Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANAGER, MATERIALS MANAGEMENT (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The Materials Management team is a critical element of the Supply Chain organization and is responsible for supplying the materials needed to manufacture SpaceX’s rockets and spacecraft. Our goal is to become a leader in inventory accuracy and material flow efficiency. The Manager will provide extreme ownership of all aspects of material flow by working to exceed customer expectations and leading continuous improvement and execution of inventory activities within their network.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform administrative duties, including but not limited to project implementation and oversight, periodic reviews with team members, one-on-one mentoring, personnel training, customer alignment, system compliance, supply ordering, and area upkeep</li> <li>Support and maintain data driven goals and objectives for receipt, stow, pick, pack, and final mile delivery to work centers within their network</li> <li>Understand the processes, procedures, and needs of the business to develop strategy, business metrics, and goals jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (AMERICAS)</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:480,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As the </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Americas),</span></strong><span data-contrast="none"> you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across the United States, Canada, and Latin America. The region includes large, established customers as well as customers expanding Starlink across new countries, sites, and use cases. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink across hardware, service, data, and other products, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Across the Americas, this means operating across different markets, currencies, billing and tax requirements, logistics models, and customer needs while maintaining a consistent commercial strategy.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where the next opportunities and risks are, and make sure your team follows through.</span><span title: Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Asia-Pacific & Oceania)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (ASIA-PACIFIC &amp; OCEANIA)</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:480,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As the </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Asia-Pacific &amp; Oceania),</span></strong><span data-contrast="none"> you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across Asia-Pacific, including Australia, New Zealand, and the Pacific Islands. The region spans a broad set of countries, time zones, regulatory environments, and customer needs, with resellers often operating across multiple markets. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Across Asia-Pacific and Oceania, turning an opportunity into revenue can depend on product availability, capacity, local billing requirements, regulatory readiness, logistics, and activation. You will help the team navigate those constraints while keeping the focus on growth.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. title: Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Europe, Middle East & Africa)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">MANAGER, STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS (EUROPE, MIDDLE EAST &amp; AFRICA)</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:480,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Starlink provides high-speed, low-latency internet to customers around the world. Our enterprise resellers bring Starlink to businesses across a wide range of markets and use cases.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As the </span><strong><span data-contrast="none">Manager, Starlink Customer Success (Europe, Middle East &amp; Africa),</span></strong><span data-contrast="none"> you will lead the team responsible for our enterprise reseller business across EMEA. This is a large and diverse region where customers may operate across multiple countries, currencies, legal entities, regulatory environments, and Starlink products. You will manage Customer Success Managers, Leads, and Specialists and be accountable for the performance and growth of the existing book.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Your team is responsible for growing revenue with existing customers, expanding their use of Starlink, and maintaining strong commercial relationships. Doing that across EMEA requires navigating significant differences between markets, including local billing and tax requirements, payment practices, import and logistics constraints, regulatory requirements, and product availability. You will be expected to understand those differences without losing sight of the commercial opportunity across the region.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">This is a player-coach role. You will set clear priorities, coach and develop your team, and hold a high bar for performance. You will also stay close to key customers and step into the most important growth opportunities, renewals, payment issues, and escalations. We expect you to know your book, understand where growth is accelerating or blocked, and make sure your team follows through.</span><span title: Manager, Starlink Engineering (Starlink PCBA SMT)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p class="xmsonormal"><strong>MANAGER, PCBA SMT ENGINEERING (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p class="xmsonormal">SpaceX is developing a low-latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of people around the world. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable. To enable our goal of “Connecting the Unconnected,” SpaceX is ramping up production of our User Terminal Kit manufacturing facility in Bastrop, Texas (Greater Austin), which will bring hundreds of high-skill manufacturing jobs to the area.</p> <p class="xmsonormal">SpaceX is also leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth.</p> <p class="xmsonormal">We are looking for a hard-driving and well-rounded leader, capable of taking charge of a broad array of responsibilities associated with developing and growing a new production organization. You will be responsible for building out the production team that will operate and maintain this equipment. You will be responsible for establishing the standards by which this team operates, and shepherding the program from the startup phase into a disciplined production organization. This individual must have the capability to rapidly become a subject matter expert on multiple complex production operations. You must be capable of operating successfully within a chaotic startup environment while identifying and executing on actions needed to ensure mission success.</p> <p class="xmsonormal"><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="xmsonormal">Manage, recruit, and develop a team of manufacturing engineers, lead engineers, and specialists for Starlink PCBA manufacturing.</li> <li class="xmsonormal">Set technical standards and hold the team accountable for delivery.</li> <li class="xmsonormal">Lead manufacturing development strategy for SMT/PCBA, including capacity, line architecture, and process capability.</li> <li class="xmsonormal">Own quality, delivery, cost, yield, and equipment performance at high-volume throughput.</li> <li class="xmsonormal">Own factory layout, material flow, equipment, tooling, spares, and build-process strategy from receiving through test, including capital spend, vendor selection, and automation justified by ROI.</li> <li class="xmsonormal">Drive new products from design into production. Own NPI readiness, process qualification, and rate ramp, and influence design for manufacturability and testability (DFM/DFT).</li> <li class="xmsonormal">Align daily with production, design, test, supply chain, and quality. Serve as the escalation path for line issues and drive root cause to permanent corrective action.</li> <li class="xmsonormal">Define production data, SPC, and MES/MRP/ERP requirements. Keep process, equipment, and training records current.</li> <li class="xmsonormal">Ensure a strong focus on safety and ESD control and maintain an excellent safety record.</li> </ul> <p class="xmsonormal"><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li class="xmsonormal">Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li class="xmsonormal">5+ years of experience in one or more of the following:</li> </ul> <ul type="disc"> <ul type="circle"> <li class="xmsonormal">Electronics development and/or production</li> <li class="xmsonormal">SMT production</li> </ul> </ul> <ul type="disc"> <li class="xmsonormal">2+ years of experience leading a team of 10+ individuals as direct reports</li> </ul> <p class="xmsonormal"><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANUFACTURING ENGINEER, BLADES AND VANES</strong></p> <p>Working directly in the materials engineering group, this position owns equipment installation, commissioning, and process development for selected areas the blades and vanes investment casting line, from ceramic cores through wax, shell, and cast. A counterpart owns post-cast operations (shell removal through coating). Experience in any cores-through-cast area is welcome. The role starts with commissioning, then transitions to process ownership in the area where the engineer is strongest, always with a strong equipment foundation.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead commissioning, Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), supplier management, and customization of pre-cast equipment, including VIM furnaces, ceramic and wax injection machines, shell dip lines, and thermal systems (kilns, dewax autoclaves, burnout and preheat furnaces).</li> <li>Coordinate supplier-defined facilities and services: power, water, waste, controls, network, connectivity, and MES.</li> <li>After commissioning, take process ownership of assigned cores-through-cast operations, drive production-ready capability, and own cost, rate, yield, and quality.</li> <li>Specify, design, and implement tools, fixtures, process aids, and additional equipment to hit rate, quality, and yield targets.</li> <li>Develop and maintain work instructions, process specifications, PFMEAs, control plans, and change-control documentation.</li> <li>Own EHS and process safety for assigned equipment, including high-temperature, vacuum, pressure, and chemical operations.</li> <li>Troubleshoot equipment and process issues on the floor; lead root-cause analysis and implement robust corrections.</li> <li>Collaborate with Materials, Design, Quality, Facilities, Controls, Production, Maintenance/Reliability, and EHS, including technicians and operators.</li> <li>Lead technical projects and mentor junior engineers and technicians; provide technical guidance and promote skill growth and team cohesion. Senior individual-contributor role, not a people-manager position.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, manufacturing, industrial, electrical, chemical, materials science, or other engineering discipline.</li> <li>1+ years of equipment, manufacturing, or process engineering, including hands-on installation, commissioning, FAT/SAT, and supplier management.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Experience in at least one major area of investment casting or a closely related high-temperature/precision process, and the ability to learn the full cores-through-cast flow.</li> <li>Strong mechanical aptitude with working knowledge of electrical, controls, automation, and facilities. Able to support or transition into maintenance and reliability for assigned equipment.</li> <li>Works independently, delivers under tight schedules, and communicates effectively with suppliers, technicians, and cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Direct experience with VIM furnaces, ceramic/wax injection, kilns/ovens, autoclaves, dip lines, core leachers, HIP, heat treat, AGVs, or related process equipment.</li> <li>Breadth across mechanical, electrical, materials, controls, and automation.</li> <li>Experience integrating equipment with MES and plant networks.</li> <li>Lean/Six Sigma or equivalent structured problem-solving.</li> <li>Prior mentoring of engineers and technicians, or technical leadership of project teams.</li> <li>Aerospace, energy, or other high-reliability casting or precision manufacturing.</li> <li>Hands-on maintenance, reliability, or equipment-sustainment experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Travel approximately 15% for equipment commissioning and FATs; extended hours or weekends as required during commissioning and ramp.</li> <li>Ability to lift up to 25Ibs unassisted.</li> <li>Standing/walking for long periods of time.</li> <li>Willingness to work long hours and weekends as necessary to accommodate manufacturing and test campaigns.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MANUFACTURING ENGINEERING SPECIALIST (STARLINK) - 2ND SHIFT</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the world.</p> <p>The success of Starlink depends on the quality, reliability, cost, manufacturability, throughput, and security of the products that you deliver. If you seek a fast-paced, dynamic environment; if you thrive on solving difficult problems where resolutions have high impact; and if you love the challenge of building something from scratch, then this role will be an ideal next career step. We are looking for talented manufacturing specialists to help establish new manufacturing and test processes and support full-scale production for the user terminal (a high-volume manufactured product that consumers will have in their homes).</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Troubleshoot automated equipment and recurring line issues, and implement fixes with engineering and maintenance</li> <li>Triage non-conforming products and drive resolution and preventative actions</li> <li>Identify continuous improvement opportunities for yield, performance, and cost</li> electrical, pneumatic, or mechanical faults</li> <li>Experience with electromechanical assembly or test on manual and automated processes</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings title: Materials Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MATERIALS ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink is building the world's largest satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable internet to people who need it most—and powering that constellation starts on the factory floor. We are insourcing solar cell manufacturing end-to-end, from crystal growth and ingot production through wafering and cell fabrication to drive performance, cost, and scale at every step. High-efficiency, high-reliability cells made in-house are the backbone of the Starlink network: more photons in means more data out to customers around the world.</p> <p>As a Materials Engineer, you will own the critical consumables that keep our ingot, wafer, and solar cell manufacturing lines running. You will take end-to-end ownership of materials used in production—partnering with supply chain on sourcing, driving material qualification, and handing off proven materials into high-volume manufacturing. We are looking for a general Materials Engineer who is excited about metals, polymers, crystals, and process consumables; solar experience is a plus, not a requirement. If you are passionate about solving hard problems, anchor your engineering judgment with first principles thinking, and are relentless about acting with urgency, this role is for you.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own consumable materials used across ingot, wafer, and/or solar cell manufacturing lines—from initial sourcing and technical evaluation through qualification, production hand-off, and ongoing support.</li> <li>Partner closely with supply chain to identify, evaluate, and qualify suppliers for critical process materials.</li> <li>Define These systems must operate in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference.</p> <p>The Starmind team designs, builds, and operates the orbital compute fabric of the future. We develop nearly every key piece of technology in house – from the satellites’ flight computers and power systems to the fully custom compute electronics, memory, and networking that form the brain of our on-orbit data centers. As a Materials Engineer on the Starmind team, you’ll have ownership over the entire life-cycle of the hardware that enables advanced on-orbit AI processing and data center workloads. Your work sits at the intersection of process, packaging, mechanical, and thermal engineering. The Payload team is responsible for the design of industry-leading compute electronics, memory, and networking in order to achieve required domain sizes and processing workloads.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Rapidly develop high-reliability microelectronics packages, cooling systems, and radiator hardware for satellites.</li> <li>Own the full lifecycle of materials specification, validation, and process development— including device modeling, characterization of performance metrics, and materials failure analysis.</li> <li>Drive system trades, requirements capture, materials selection, prototyping, manufacturing, failure analysis.</li> <li>Build supply chains for build-up layers, plating chemicals, coatings, thermal interface materials, and other materials for compute and satellite manufacturing. title: Materials Engineer, Solar Cell Characterization
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>MATERIALS ENGINEER, SOLAR CELL CHARACTERIZATION</strong></p> <p>Starlink is building the world's largest satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable internet to people who need it most—and powering that constellation starts on the factory floor. We are insourcing solar cell manufacturing end-to-end, from crystal growth and ingot production through wafering and cell fabrication, to drive performance, cost, and scale at every step. High-efficiency, high-reliability cells made in-house are the backbone of the Starlink network: more photons in means more data out to customers around the world.</p> <p>As a Materials Engineer for solar cell characterization, you will own offline metrology and materials characterization of insourced solar cells—building the measurement capability, analysis methods, and physical understanding needed to raise cell performance and yield. You will turn electrical, optical, and materials data into root cause, and interface with process, production, and quality teams to lock in durable fixes. If you are passionate about solving hard problems, anchor your engineering judgment with first-principles thinking, and are relentless about acting with urgency, this role is for you.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own characterization and metrology strategy for insourced solar cells across cell interfaces—from method development and tool qualification through production-ready measurement recipes</li> <li>Build and maintain a suite of offline electrical, optical, and materials characterization techniques to quantify cell performance, reliability, and yield-limiting defects (e.g., I-V, quantum efficiency, PL/EL imaging, lifetime, SEM-EDS, optical microscopy, spectroscopy, and related methods)</li> <li>Lead root cause analysis for performance and yield excursions: design experiments, execute failure analysis, correlate process history with metrology signatures, and drive corrective actions to first principles</li> <li>Define measurement requirements, sampling plans, gauge R&amp;R, calibration, and acceptance criteria in partnership with process, quality, and production engineering</li> <li>Stand up and develop processes for offline metrology equipment; own data integrity, tool matching, and measurement uncertainty so results can be trusted for process decisions</li> <li>Translate characterization results into clear material and process recommendations that improve efficiency, reliability, cost, and manufacturability</li> <li>Partner with process engineering on DOEs and golden-line development; provide rapid feedback loops during recipe, materials, and equipment changes</li> <li>Document methods, specifications, FA reports, and best practices; communicate status, risks, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional partners and leadership</li> <li>Champion a culture of safety and quality in all sample preparation, chemical handling, lab operations, and production support activities</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in materials science, materials engineering, chemical engineering, or a related technical discipline</li> <li>1+ years of professional jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. We are insourcing solar cell manufacturing end-to-end, from crystal growth and ingot production through wafering and cell fabrication, to drive performance, cost, and scale at every step. High-efficiency, high-reliability cells made in-house are the backbone of the Starlink network: more photons in means more data out to customers around the world.</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">As a Materials Engineer for thin films, you will partner with solar cell process engineering on PECVD-deposited films used in insourced cell manufacturing. You will work problems of moderate to high complexity with guidance from more senior engineers and bring well-framed problems and proposed solutions to the team. If you are passionate about solving hard problems, anchor your engineering judgment with first-principles thinking, and are relentless about acting with urgency, this role is for you.</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none"><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="none"> Partner with solar cell process engineering on PECVD thin films (e.g., passivation, anti-reflection, and related dielectric or semiconductor layers), supporting materials characterization, film-property understanding, and production readiness</span></li> <li>Execute materials characterization and analysis of plasma-deposited films; correlate process conditions with thickness, refractive index, composition, lifetime, uniformity, and cell electrical/optical performance, and recommend next steps</li> <li>Build proficiency with thin-film materials, PECVD-relevant vacuum and plasma concepts, and lab/metrology methods;
