jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PROCESS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>As a Process Engineer with a focus on Starship build reliability, you will be part of a widely interdisciplinary team developing global manufacturing procedures, maximizing quality through efficient production. You will employ “reliability by any means necessary”, stretching your expertise in fabrication methods, work instructions, tooling design, inspection procedures, data gathering/visualization, and broad collaboration. You will build new processes from the ground up, and routinely grade/improve execution of existing processes, driving continuous production improvement and ultimately be responsible for build-induced vehicle risk.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop manufacturing, integration, assembly, welding, NDE, cleanliness, and checkouts processes from the ground up, then enforce consistency across different work centers.</li> <li>Design and implement tooling for work access, mechanical/avionics/propulsion testing, build fixturing, lifting &amp; rigging, and fluids.</li> <li>Define and document inspection requirements and procedures.</li> <li>Create training for production and inspection processes.</li> <li>Author planning, test plans, and training to execute processes and collect data, ensuring efficient and stable quality at increasing production volumes.</li> <li>Contain non-conforming hardware in collaboration with quality, production, and design groups to ensure systemic issues are corrected, and risk is managed for the fleet.</li> <li>Work closely with design teams to improve DFM and requirement fulfillment. Aggressively modify requirements and manufacturing process where design intent and production rate are incompatible.</li> <li>Conduct build quality reviews to identify repeat and high impact issues. Drive corrective action within and outside of your work center.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, materials engineering, manufacturing engineering, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, or engineering physics.</li> <li>1+ years in manufacturing, quality, and/or design engineering role (student project team or internship experience qualifies).</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with the build, assembly, or integration of structures, avionics, valves, fluid system components, actuators, thermal protection systems, or other aerospace components.</li> <li>Mechanical tooling or component design and design for manufacturability.</li> <li>Proficiency with 3D CAD Software such as NX, SolidWorks, or CATIA.</li> <li>Knowledge of mig, tig, laser, stud, spot, or robot welding techniques, as well as visual, penetrant, x-ray, EMAT, or other NDT processes.</li> <li>Involvement in a collegiate or hobby design project (Formula SAE, rocketry, etc).</li> <li>Proficiency with SQL and Power BI or other database/query/data visualization suite.</li> <li>You thrive in a hands-on environment and are hungry to step out of the office, onto the shop floor.</li> <li>Knowledge of metallic manufacturing techniques, processes, and equipment related to machining, bending, forming, casting, additive manufacturing, fastening, drilling, and/or bonding.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with partners/customers from a diverse set of engineering disciplines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours, weekends, and jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PROCESS ENGINEER, INDUSTRIAL WATER TREATMENT (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we are building the next generation of space infrastructure to enable large-scale AI data centers in orbit. These orbital AI platforms require massive amounts of reliable, high-efficiency solar power to support intensive computing workloads in space. To make this possible, we are standing up one of the largest solar cell manufacturing facilities in the world. We are seeking a best-in-class Process Engineer, Industrial Water Treatment to drive design, commissioning, build, and operations of ultrapure water and wastewater systems. This high-impact role will help shape process strategies from the ground up while enabling SpaceX’s ambitious vision for AI data centers in space. &nbsp;</p> <p>As a Process Engineer on the Starlink manufacturing program, you will take ownership for activating, qualifying, optimizing, and ensuring the consistency of operations for an ultrapure process water plant supporting our solar cell manufacturing lines. This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and operationalization of equipment, facilities, tooling, and manufacturing process technologies necessary for high-volume production. Your work will form the backbone for millions of next-generation of satellites used all over the world. For homes, schools, businesses, vehicles, planes, or boats, this team plays an instrumental role in ensuring high-speed connectivity is available to all who need it.</p> regulatory bodies, OEM equipment manufactures, and supplier representatives</li> <li>Identify and champion continuous improvement projects</li> <li>Develop project plans, budgets, and cost/benefit analysis for implementation of new processes or machines</li> <li>Monitor and communicate area status and risks</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in team experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years hands-on project experience in wastewater treatment</li> <li>Experience with title: Process Operator Specialist, Air Separation Unit (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PROCESS OPERATOR SPECIALIST, AIR SEPARATION UNIT (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is building its first production-scale Air Separation Unit (ASU) at Starbase to produce the high-purity liquid oxygen that powers Starship. This is not just another industrial plant—it is the critical on-site propellant factory that eliminates supply risk for the most ambitious launch vehicle ever built and lays the operational foundation for producing propellants on the Moon and Mars.</p> <p>As a process operator specialist on the ASU team, you will operate and support cryogenic distillation, turboexpanders, centrifugal compressors, molecular sieve systems, and high-purity LOX production under the direction of Lead and Level 4/5 operators. You will monitor process parameters, execute approved procedures, complete thorough field rounds, and qualify toward independent watch standing. If you thrive in high-stakes cryogenic environments, want to learn these systems from first principles, and want ownership of mission-critical hardware as you grow, this is the role for you.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor the ASU via distributed control system/human-machine interface and conduct thorough field rounds, identifying equipment and process deviations early and reporting them immediately</li> <li>Execute assigned steps of plant startups, shutdowns, mode changes, and abnormal situation response in accordance with approved operating procedures and alarm response matrices</li> <li>Support troubleshooting, maintenance, and calibration of ASU equipment including centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, turboexpanders, cryogenic distillation columns, molecular sieve beds, gas analyzers, control valves, and instrumented electrical systems</li> <li>Collect process samples, perform basic field testing, log operational data accurately, and escalate immediately when plant conditions do not match the procedure</li> <li>Execute lockout/tagout (LOTO), permit-to-work, job hazard analyses, and Process Safety Management (PSM) activities as trained and authorized, and maintain rigorous 5S, housekeeping, and visual management</li> <li>Learn and qualify on standard operating procedures for major ASU systems, support shift pass-down, and participate in continuous improvement in reliability, purity, and housekeeping</li> <li>Learn and qualify on standard operating procedures for major ASU systems; build understanding of cryogenic thermodynamics, distillation, adsorption, and equipment performance through the ASU training and qualification gates</li> <li>Support shift pass-down and leave the board and field ready for the following shift; participate in continuous improvement in reliability, purity, and housekeeping</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>1+ years of experience working in an industrial environment or plant operations dealing with air separation units, cryogenics, industrial gases, chemical, or oil &amp; gas</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience using P&amp;IDs and/or process flow diagrams as part of work (isolation or LOTO boundary definition, valve lineups, troubleshooting, or field rounds against drawings)</li> <li>Hands-on experience in a cryogenic plant, industrial gas facility, chemical plant, utilities plant, launch pad, or propellant farm</li> <li>Exposure to compressors, pumps, heat exchangers, or other industrial rotating / process equipment</li> <li>Experience with a Distributed Control System (Honeywell, Siemens, Rockwell, or equivalent) and/or HMI operation</li> <li>Familiarity with mechanical equipment isolation or basic maintenance on industrial rotating machinery</li> <li>Experience with lockout/tagout, job hazard analysis, hot work permitting, confined space, or Process Safety Management (PSM) practices</li> <li>Familiarity with 120V and 480V industrial electrical equipment (medium-voltage experience is a plus)</li> <li>Track record of catching equipment or process issues early and raising them to the shift lead</li> <li>Experience in shift operations (nights, weekends, or 24/7) in an industrial environment</li> <li>Interest in learning process behavior from first principles (thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat/mass transfer)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Anticiapted hours for this position are 6:00 AM-7:00 PM</li> <li>Role may require extended hours, weekend work, and shift schedules that vary depending on site operational needs; flexibility required</li> <li>Stand: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Sit: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Push/Pull: Up to 75 lbs. (unassisted) between 1 and 2 hours per day</li> <li>Overhead reach: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Walk: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Lift/Carry: Up to ≤ 50 lbs. title: Product Compliance Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRODUCT COMPLIANCE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation that provides fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, manufacture, and operate all parts of the system including thousands of satellites and millions of customer kits. Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. While users can get online within minutes almost anywhere in the world, we’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential. We are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for individuals, communities, and businesses.</p> <p>Product Compliance Engineers will play a critical role as SpaceX strives to deliver internet to those that need it most. They will drive regulatory efforts, impact internal design decisions, and obtain the product certifications needed to sell and ship millions of consumer-facing devices. These devices - including Starlink dishes, Wi-Fi routers, power supply, accessories, etc. – are designed and manufactured completely in-house by SpaceX. We are looking for a multi-disciplinary Product Compliance Engineer who is highly capable across EMC, Product Safety, Wireless, or Environmental compliance. This role will support broader certification needs for Starlink hardware and serve as a key technical leader for global market access programs. Engineers on the team will be hands-on, regularly interact with multiple technical disciplines, and ultimately ensure that Starlink is a global success.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRODUCTION SCHEDULER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The Production Scheduler for SpaceX's Starship program drives efficient production by developing rate-based schedules, identifying part shortages, projecting long-term departmental needs, and tracking constraints across builds while collaborating with teams to set and execute daily/weekly goals that align with overall rate targets.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist in production scheduling for a given production work center, including identifying need dates for all part shortages and projecting long-term high-level rate needs for the department</li> <li>Create a rate-based schedule for your hardware and define/track constraints across your build for the next 6+ missions</li> <li>Use an established schedule to create and generate stakeholder buy-in on various scenarios to determine optimal hardware allocation between new/refurb hardware that take into account customer needs, current mission manifest, and customer quality requirements</li> <li>Work with production teams to set, track, and execute daily and weekly goals for the work center that take into account personnel and equipment constraints but support overall rate targets</li> <li>Build strong relationships with internal suppliers and establish high-accuracy means of communication for both estimated hardware needs and completion dates</li> <li>Manage the scheduling and prioritization of your hardware at shared resources that are common to multiple departments at SpaceX</li> <li>Negotiate with peers in other departments for correct overall priority and seek creative solutions that drive the optimal business outcome</li> <li>Monitor MRP systems and leverage SQL Queries to identify hardware shortages for upcoming builds and lead the charge to pull this hardware into your production area</li> <li>Identify, develop, and implement opportunities for increased scheduling automation across the Starship Ship Engineering department with a focus on reducing the manual operations required to develop, track, and update overall schedules</li> <li>Drive down near-term and future schedule risk by conducting work-center level capacity analysis, identifying model and communication gaps that cause schedule slips, and leading initiatives (reactive and proactive) that mitigate those risks</li> <li>Lead efforts to uncover root-cause and develop permanent resolution on issues found during product builds as required to eliminate internal and external blockers to deliver product on time</li> <li>Drive conversations around assembly-level &amp; integration misalignment</li> <li>Identify and support improvement opportunities for product yield, quality, safety, cost and team efficiency</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of manufacturing scheduling, planning or operations; OR 3+ years of professional experience with manufacturing scheduling, planning or operations</li> <li>Experience using ERP/MRP systems in a production environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Remarkable problem-solving skills with a bias for speed and accuracy</li> <li>Self-motivated, quick learner, and ability to prioritize efforts to meet customer and company goals</li> <li>Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external supplier/customer relationships in a fast-moving and ever-changing environment</li> <li>Technical knowledge and skills in coding and computer applications (e.g. MS Office Suite, VBA, Smartsheet, SQL, Confluence, JIRA, Power BI, etc.)</li> <li>Strong track record of implementing continuous improvement efforts, ideally using problem solving frameworks including lean principles, six sigma, or Kaizen concepts</li> <li>Experience leading multi-disciplinary and cross-functional teams working on strategic problems</li> <li>Project management professional certification</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available for all shifts, extended hours, and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted</li> <li>Must be able to stand for extended periods - 8 hours minimum</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Production Supervisor - Assembly & SMT (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRODUCTION SUPERVISOR - ASSEMBLY &amp; SMT (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best-in-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a supervisor on the Starlink production team, you will spearhead the production of millions of consumer-facing electronic devices that we ship to customers’ homes around the world. You will manage large teams of technicians and assemblers while working closely with manufacturing and design engineers, ultimately driving the transition from prototyping to full-scale production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coordinate and steer the collective efforts of electronics production associates</li> <li>Enforce company standards, policies, and rules</li> <li>Interface with area leadership and prioritize work based on production schedule and organizational goals</li> <li>Schedule risk identification and mitigation</li> <li>Coordinate support organization efforts to minimize production interruptions</li> <li>Ensure product quality and conformance to specifications</li> <li>Process non-conforming hardware to efficiently return them to conforming state and normal product flow</li> <li>Improve area safety and efficiency through regular auditing and continuous improvement</li> <li>Optimize product flow through the factory</li> <li>Perform root cause analysis and implement corresponding corrective action plans</li> <li>Identify and eliminate defects within the area value stream</li> <li>Reduce downtime for product and personnel</li> <li>Support efforts to transition product from engineering development to full rate production</li> <li>Review drawings and technical data packages for manufacturability while providing constructive feedback to engineering/design community</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree or 5+ years of professional experience in a manufacturing, production, or logistics environment in lieu of degree or 2+ years of experience at SpaceX</li> <li>1+ years of experience leading a team or project</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>7+ years of professional experience in a manufacturing, production, or logistics environment</li> <li>2+ years of experience leading a team or project</li> <li>Lean manufacturing training and experience</li> <li>Experience monitoring, tracking, and continually improving total cost equation</li> <li>Experience with applying lean manufacturing principles and efficiency methods</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to read, interpret controlled documentation and processes such as: Cable harnesses, wiring diagrams, layout drawings, mechanical drawings, GD&amp;T, assembly procedures/work instructions, schematics, engineering drawings, and parts lists</li> <li>Familiarity with Design for Manufacturability, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and Failure Mode Effects Analysis</li> <li>PCBA, harness, electro-mechanical assembly, optical component manufacturing, and prototype development experience</li> <li>Experience preferred in fast-paced consumer electronics production environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Six Sigma certification</li> <li>Able to adapt to constant changing work assignments and fast-paced work environment</li> <li>Proficient with computers, the ability to use MS Office, shop floor management software (ERP) and related programs</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available for one of the following shifts (start and end times are approximate): <ul> <li>A Shift – 5:00am-5:00pm, Sunday-Wednesday</li> <li>B Shift – 5:00am-5:00pm, Wednesday-Saturday</li> <li>C Shift – 5:00pm-5:00am, Sunday-Wednesday</li> <li>D Shift – 5:00pm-5:00am, Wednesday-Saturday</li> </ul> </li> <li>Ability to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>Able to travel for business trips up to 10% on an ongoing basis</li> <li>Ability to lift 25 lbs. unassisted</li> <li>Ability stoop, bend, crawl, and being able to maneuver in tight spaces</li> <li>Must be willing to work onsite, remote work not title: Production Technician
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARLINK PRODUCTION TECHNICIAN</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system, providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. Our Bastrop factory builds the technology behind Starlink across printed circuit boards, custom silicon, solar cells, and more. We are looking for talented, driven technicians to drive manufacturing output and yield across our production, maintenance, and facilities teams.</p> <p>This is a hands-on technician role. We are building a strong team of technicians who are trained into the team where they will have the greatest impact and clearest path to grow. This includes PCB production, machine and facilities maintenance, silicon packaging, gateway, solar, and satellite operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable in a fast-paced, metrics-driven manufacturing environment, learns quickly, works safely, and is motivated by SpaceX’s mission to provide high speed, low-latency connectivity across the globe.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform assigned technical tasks to written work instructions, procedures, and safety standards in a high-volume manufacturing environment</li> <li>Execute startup and shutdown procedures and operate production equipment; monitor process conditions and control systems</li> <li>Perform first-level troubleshooting on production equipment and tooling; provide feedback and work with maintenance and engineering teams to drive root cause of downtime</li> <li>Use hand and power tools, precision measurement instruments (calipers, micrometers), and common test equipment for calibration, inspection, and basic repair</li> <li>Read and interpret work instructions, mechanical/electrical/pneumatic schematics, drawings, and parts lists</li> <li>Read and safely execute lock-out/tag-out (LOTO) procedures and follow all Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) for the assigned area</li> <li>Handle production and flight hardware correctly to prevent damage; perform quality inspections and identify defects and non-conformities</li> <li>Perform preventive maintenance and calibration of equipment and instruments; track schedule and maintain inventory of consumables</li> <li>Record work accurately in Warp, Factory Manual, and related manufacturing systems (travelers, tickets, work orders, logs)</li> <li>Support root cause analysis (e.g. 5-Why) for quality and process issues and implement corrective actions to improve overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)</li> <li>Recommend improvements to manufacturing processes with a focus on reducing cost and downtime and increasing yield</li> <li>Ensure 5S standards are upheld by maintaining a clean and organized work area</li> <li>Conduct or support training of production personnel; cross-train and rotate across tasks, stations, or lines as production demand shifts</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>1+ years of hands on work experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Associate’s degree</li> <li>2+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing, maintenance, facilities, skilled trades, automotive, military, or a technical/vocational school program</li> <li>Ability to read, interpret, and work from work instructions, layout drawings, mechanical/electrical/pneumatic schematics, and parts lists</li> <li>Familiarity with hand and power tools and basic precision measurement tools (calipers, micrometers, multimeters)</li> <li>Basic mechanical and/or electrical fundamentals (fasteners, pneumatics/hydraulics; Ohm’s law, multimeter use)</li> <li>Proficiently use a computer and the Microsoft Office suite</li> <li>Experience using production and inventory management software such as MES/ERP</li> <li>Experience with root cause analysis and problem solving (e.g. 5-Why, Fishbone, 8D)</li> <li>Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to work closely with other technicians and cross-functional teams</li> <li>Ability to identify and maintain priorities while working independently in a high-paced environment with minimal oversight</li> <li>OSHA 10/30, forklift, or other relevant safety certifications</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be open to work all shifts, overtime, and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position</li> <li>Must be comfortable working in a production environment, which may include loud areas, fumes/odors, and the handling of hazardous chemicals depending on the assigned team</li> <li>Must be able to wear appropriate PPE for the assigned manufacturing environment</li> <li>Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Propulsion Build Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PROPULSION BUILD ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The Propulsion Build Engineer role is responsible for developing build processes, tooling, and designs for manufacturability that will enable high rate manufacturing of vehicle fluid systems. This role will involve heavy engagement with both the design teams and the build teams across the program. The role demands close interaction with the Starship and Super Heavy hardware, including participating in and driving the physical builds and installation of the propulsion systems.</p> <p>Propulsion Build Engineers will be highly engaged in the fabrication of a wide range of pressurized components and systems, including designing tooling (assembly aide, welding, part fixturing, etc.) and processes (welding, tube bending, pipe fitting, large part movement, and large structure integration) to rapidly build the Starship and Super Heavy vehicles. The role can include designing pressurized test setups, working with cryogenic fluids, and executing testing and data review. Further along in the build, this role will be responsible for items such as integration operations sequencing, and working with technicians on installing flight-critical hardware on the vehicle. Propulsion Build Engineers will be expected to sometimes act as de-facto supervisors and advisors to production technicians, welders, and other skilled labor partners.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop manufacturing processes, techniques, and tools to enable efficient and high rate manufacturing</li> <li>Work with the design engineering team to drive simplicity into the vehicle fluids systems at every level</li> <li>Guide a team of technicians, welders, and fabricators in building high quality and functional fluid systems hardware</li> <li>Coordinate and execute development, qualification, and acceptance testing of systems and tooling needed to meet hardware deadlines</li> <li>Create original CAD models and prints for flight and/or tooling components</li> <li>Create and maintain build schedules</li> <li>Participate in design reviews internally and with suppliers and customers</li> <li>Partner with engineering &amp; production teams to generate ideas, designs, and improvements for current and next-generation vehicles</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or advanced degree in aerospace engineering, manufacturing engineering, materials engineering, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on project experience with fluid and/or mechanical systems</li> <li>1+ years of manufacturing design experience&nbsp;(internship and academic experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience with GD&amp;T concepts</li> <li>Experience with fluid mechanics, incompressible and compressible flow, and heat transfer</li> <li>Experience with pressurized components (valves, regulators, tubes, pipes, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with mechanical design, including basic structures and fluids calculations and design considerations</li> <li>Process development, facility and line layouts, error-proofing</li> <li>Experience with Unigraphics NX and Teamcenter CAD and PLM systems</li> <li>Detailed knowledge of Siemens NX or similar CAD and PLM packages</li> <li>Prior experience with developing, maintaining, and improving welding processes</li> <li>Experience with automated and manual welding processes for piping and structural applications</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Our engineers specialize in the design and execution of unique development tests for Raptor engine testing on an accelerated schedule. This role offers a constant variety of diverse engineering challenges in a fast-paced, hands-on environment. Raptor Test Engineers have the opportunity to work on one of the world’s most complex engines to date, a full flow staged combustion engine! Join the team and our journey to Mars and we solve new challenges presented by unknown frontiers.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute tests at the engine and component level to evaluate hardware performance and survivability during the mission.</li> <li>Repeated ownership of test campaigns; including test plan creation, new system activation, test operations, data review, and test stand equipment design/fabrication.</li> <li>Provide daily direction and instruction to technicians to fabricate and integrate test articles and stand equipment.</li> <li>Develop and maintain test procedures, sequences, scripts, configuration files, and software.</li> <li>Operate and troubleshoot data acquisition and control systems, wiring, and instrumentation. DAQ systems are primarily National Instruments based.</li> <li>Operate and troubleshoot fluid and mechanical systems that include low to high-pressure gaseous working fluids and rocket propellants support structures, heat exchangers, vacuum pumps, tooling, and fluid components such as valves, reliefs, burst disks, tubing, etc.</li> <li>Automate repetitive test operations to increase efficiency hazards then work to resolve such anomalies by collaborating with design engineers on improvements for test stands and flight hardware.</li> <li>Operate test console and direct a team of technicians to execute test processes.</li> <li>Analyze and review data to ensure that hardware is operating as expected utilizing numerical data analysis tools to interpret test results.</li> <li>Develop, The propulsion technician is responsible for assembly and testing of rocket hardware. This is a dynamic position that requires the flexibility to work on different systems, the ability to troubleshoot anomalies, and can work autonomously to defined schedules while keeping safety and quality at the forefront of everything that is done.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for maintaining a professional and neat work area, as well as maintaining tools,&nbsp;valves, tubes, and manifolds for advanced subassemblies&nbsp;</li> <li>Responsible for staging, build, testing, install, and proofing of production advanced subassemblies for Starship/Super-Heavy</li> <li>Verification of fluids and electrical connections using diagrams for advanced subassemblies for Starship/Super-Heavy propulsion systems</li> <li>Perform testing and operate all testing equipment needed for pressurized checkouts and use computer network systems, as well as testing procedure as described in the test instruction</li> <li>Accept or reject test units based on defined acceptance criteria, appropriately document and work with engineering to resolve non-conformances</li> <li>Perform all work according to procedures, specifications and test instructions</li> <li>Set-up and operate CNC rotary draw bending machines while conforming to tight tolerances</li> <li>Set-up and operate of CNC tube cutting equipment</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>1+ years of experience working in a manufacturing, automotive, or aerospace environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>A&amp;P license or ASE Master certification strongly desired</li> <li>5+ years of mechanical or similar experience is a plus</li> <li>Knowledge of fluid systems, pressure, temperature and flow measurement devices; title: Rack Design Engineer (Starmind)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><h4>RACK DESIGN ENGINEER (STARMIND)</h4> <p>The Starmind Compute team designs training and inference compute clusters from first principles, pushing thermal, electrical, and optical systems to the limit of physics. We operate as a highly cross disciplinary team comprised of mechanical, electrical, optical, and software engineers, all working to maximize the efficiency, reliability, and deployment speed of terrestrial computing to serve rapidly scaling demand.</p> <p>This team owns compute architecture, datacenter network design, rack builds, connectivity, in-house design of our own computers, and the manufacturing line that builds that compute. As a Rack Design Engineer, you will own the rack as a product: structure, power, cooling, service paths, and the physical integration of servers, switches, optics, and liquid cooling from first sketch through production rate.</p> <h4>RESPONSIBILITIES:</h4> <ul> <li>Own mechanical, structural, and integration design of high-density AI compute racks and associated chassis, frames, busbars, manifolds, and cable/fiber raceways</li> <li>Integrate compute, networking, power distribution, and liquid cooling into a buildable, serviceable, high-yield rack architecture</li> <li>Design for the in-house manufacturing line: DFM/DFA, fixtures, work instructions, incoming inspection, first article, and production ramp</li> <li>Close thermal, structural, and power constraints with cooling, electrical, optical, and network counterparts at the cluster level (CDUs, cold plates, quick disconnects, PDUs/busbars, high-current distribution, tray and bend-radius limits)</li> <li>Drive vendor and in-house parts from concept to qualified production, including sheet metal, extrusions, busbar, manifolds, cable management, and rack accessories</li> <li>Stand on the floor during prototype and production builds: debug fit, leak, cable dress, airflow/liquid balance, and service time; fold issues into the next revision the same day</li> <li>Produce and maintain CAD, BOMs, drawings, and build documentation that a line can run at volume</li> <li>Support cluster deployment of the racks you design, including first-site bring-up and feedback into the next hardware generation</li> <li>Partner with network, optical, electrical, and firmware teams to deploy custom compute for inference and training across SpaceX programs</li> </ul> <h4>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or another engineering discipline</li> <li>2+ years of professional experience designing electromechanical hardware that was built and shipped (internship and project experience counts toward this if the hardware was physically produced)</li> </ul> <h4>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</h4> <ul> <li>Ownership of rack, chassis, or similarly dense electromechanical products through prototype and production</li> <li>Experience or background in ethernet switching, networking, interconnects, high power distribution, and other relevant data center technologies&nbsp;</li> <li>CAD fluency in SolidWorks, Creo, or NX, with released drawings a shop and a factory can build from</li> <li>AI / HPC / GPU rack design: NVIDIA HGX/GB-class, custom OCP, or equivalent high-power liquid-cooled compute</li> <li>Liquid cooling design: cold plates, manifolds, CDUs, quick disconnects, leak detection, and coolant compatibility</li> <li>High-power rack electrical integration: busbar, PDU, 48V, high-current 3-phase, grounding, and service safety</li> <li>Cable and fiber physical design inside the rack (MPO/OSFP dress, bend radius, service loops) in partnership with optical and network engineers</li> <li>Experience taking a rack from NPI onto an in-house manufacturing line (fixtures, cycle time, poka-yoke, rework loops)</li> <li>Thermal and structural analysis (CFD, FEA) used to make a design decision</li> <li>Time at a high-velocity hardware organization: AI/GPU cloud, custom compute, or an OEM/ODM team that owned the product end to end</li> <li>Comfort in a factory or datacenter build environment, including first articles, yield, and hardware debug on the floor</li> </ul> <h4>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</h4> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed to support design releases, line bring-up, and cluster deployments</li> <li>Must be willing to travel up to 30% to manufacturing and datacenter sites</li> <li>Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted and work around active factory and datacenter hardware</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR We are seeking a creative thinker who can leverage both traditional and non-traditional approaches to identifying excellent talent and has a deep-seated passion for Starlink’s mission to connect the unconnected.</p> <p>Successful candidates will have outstanding communication skills, be self-motivated, hold themselves accountable, have a willingness and drive to manage a demanding high-volume workload, strong presentation skills, and experience working successfully in a team environment. Comfortable communicating with all levels of stakeholders.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <p>As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding of top talent candidates to fill mission critical positions.&nbsp;In many cases, you are candidates’ first encounter with SpaceX, and it is your job to represent the company with professionalism, pride, and enthusiasm.&nbsp;We work in teams and focus on collaboration yet require a high degree of autonomy.&nbsp;So, while you are not expected to simply go at it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run daily, including, but not limited to:</p> <ul> <li>Review internal and external applications, conduct passive candidate searches, interview candidates, and act as a consultative recruiting partner to clients</li> <li>Deeply understand each role's requirements and how it fits into the organization</li> <li>Develop and execute strategies focused on creating and maintaining a strong pipeline of passive talent</li> <li>Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates through clear and consistent communication</li> <li>Find creative ways to capture the attention of candidates during initial outreach stages</li> <li>Manage a high volume of clients and requisitions</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of recruiting experience; or associate degree and 2+ years of experience; or 3+ years of professional experience as a recruiter in lieu of a degree</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>2+ years of high-volume recruiting experience, ideally in the manufacturing sector</li> <li>Experience with in-house recruiting</li> <li>Experience recruiting for skilled trades (technicians, electricians, facilities, etc.)</li> <li>Strong tenure with demonstrated success in recruiting roles</li> <li>Full life cycle recruiting experience, from sourcing to closing</li> <li>Comfort with reviewing, evaluating and reporting on recruiting data</li> <li>Ability to distinguish between the top 50% and the top 5% of talent within their respective fields</li> <li>Demonstrated expertise in non-standard recruiting methods: cold calling candidates and companies, organizing and executing ad hoc networking events, identifying industry experts and finding unique methods to engage with them, creating unique targeted sourcing campaigns, etc.</li> <li>Comfortable interfacing directly with hiring managers including director and VP level technical leaders</li> <li>Ability to build strong relationships with both hiring managers and candidates</li> <li>Ability to accurately present but not oversell candidates to client groups; influence decisions by acting as the subject matter expert on talent but avoid dictating client decisions</li> <li>Ability to multi-task and operate with little direction while still being an active team member</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>This position is based in Bastrop, TX (Austin area), and requires being onsite full-time – hybrid and remote work will not be considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: RF & Wireless Compliance Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>RF &amp; WIRELESS COMPLIANCE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation that provides fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, manufacture, and operate all parts of the system including thousands of satellites and millions of customer kits. Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. While users can get online within minutes almost anywhere in the world, we’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential. We are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for individuals, communities, and businesses.</p> <p>Product Compliance Engineers will play a critical role as SpaceX strives to deliver internet to those that need it most. They will drive regulatory efforts, impact internal design decisions, and obtain the product certifications needed to sell and ship millions of consumer-facing devices. These devices - including Starlink dishes, Wi-Fi routers, power supply, accessories, etc. – are designed and manufactured completely in-house by SpaceX. We are hiring an RF/Wireless Compliance Engineer focused on regulatory certification of Starlink’s radio products and systems. You will own FCC, ISED, ETSI, and international radio compliance from design through certification and market access. Engineers on the team will be hands-on, regularly interact with multiple technical disciplines, and ultimately ensure that Starlink is a global success.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead RF regulatory strategy and certification for Starlink User Terminals and Wi-Fi products across all target markets</li> <li>Own compliance to FCC, ISED, ETSI, RED, and equivalent global wireless regulations- Manage radio testing (emissions, immunity, SAR, etc.) with accredited labs</li> <li>Work directly with RF hardware and firmware teams to implement design changes required for certification</li> <li>Prepare and maintain technical files and certification applications</li> <li>Support global market access for wireless features, including new frequency bands and power levels</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, other STEM discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>1+ years of experience in RF/wireless regulatory compliance and certification (internship experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of dedicated experience in RF/wireless regulatory compliance and certification for high-volume&nbsp;consumer electronics, industrial equipment, or information technology equipment</li> <li>Strong experience with Wi-Fi or satellite communication systems</li> <li>Deep knowledge of FCC, ISED, ETSI, RED, and key international wireless regulations</li> <li>Experience running RF compliance test campaigns</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret radio standards and translate them into actionable design requirements</li> <li>Experience supporting antenna and RF layout for regulatory success</li> <li>Track record of successfully certifying complex wireless consumer products</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must title: RF Software Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>RF SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to serve populations with little or no connectivity. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. Starlink also designs, builds, and delivers high-volume consumer hardware that allows users to connect to these satellites within minutes of unboxing, as well as our advanced gateways that we deploy regionally throughout the world. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>As an RF software engineer in the Starlink program, you will work with a team of RF engineers, DSP engineers, software engineers, hardware engineers, and end users to design and build RF capabilities for proliferated communications and remote sensing in low earth orbit. You will work in a highly collaborative and fast-paced environment, where we are exploring unsolved problems and applying the SpaceX mindset of iterating rapidly to go from design and demo to operational capability at lightning pace.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive program-level decisions on RF system designs</li> <li>Research novel solutions for unique large-scale satellite RF systems</li> <li>Design, build, validate, and automate RF test benches for full characterization of custom RF designs, often involving vector network analyzers (VNA), vector signal generators (VSG), vector signal analyzers (VSA), spectrum analyzers, load pulls, RF power meters, high-speed oscilloscopes, and other common lab equipment</li> <li>Design and build modular, scalable RF test infrastructure and test automation sequences in Python and C++ to support design validation, qualification, and production</li> <li>Work in close collaboration with hardware, FPGA, DSP, and software engineers to design and validate RF systems</li> <li>Create electromagnetic simulation models of hardware to design and evaluate performance</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of professional development experience in C/C++ or Python</li> <li>1+ years of professional experience with radio test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector signal analyzers, vector signal generators, and network analyzers</li> <li>1+ years of professional RF experience with antennas or communication systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master's degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline</li> <li>Experience with testing both active and passive RF devices such as filters, amplifiers, mixers, and upconverters/downconverters</li> <li>Experience with common RF concepts such as gain, linearity, P1dB, ACLR, EVM, PAE, S-parameters, and input/output matching</li> <li>Experience with software design principles, software architecture, design patterns, and unit/integration testing title: Ropes Access Technician (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>ROPES TECHNICIAN (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The Ropes Access Technician plays a vital role in supporting SpaceX’s Starship operations team by executing safe, innovative ropes access solutions in complex, high-stakes environments. This hands-on position involves the precise setup, maintenance, and operation of access systems essential to Starship assembly, testing, and repairs, ensuring the team meets mission-critical objectives with accuracy and safety. By performing technical tasks under supervision, collaborating with engineering and operations teams, participating in qualification training programs, and adhering to stringent safety protocols, the Ropes Access Technician contributes to operational efficiency and the broader success of Starship’s mission to advance human space exploration.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Evaluate and develop safe ropes access solutions in new and changing environments</li> <li>Manage communication, equipment integrity, and process guidelines required for safe ropes access operations</li> <li>Climb in a variety of environmental conditions to set up ropes access for teammate</li> <li>Haul team members and equipment using a variety of ropes access configurations</li> <li>Operate within and enforce SPRAT and IRATA guidelines</li> <li>Train team members proper use of Ropes Access solutions</li> <li>Develop rigging for large assemblies</li> <li>Work at heights on temporary or permanent work access solutions</li> <li>Operate personnel platforms (boom lifts, scissor lifts, etc.)</li> <li>Read and interpret engineering drawings and work instructions</li> <li>Perform work according to procedures, specifications, and test instructions</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers to develop work access solutions</li> <li>Ensure all production services are performed on time, safely and in a professional manner</li> <li>Support heavy transport or crane operations when not supporting ropes access duties</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC title: Sales Operations Manager (Starlink Channel Sales)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SALES OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK CHANNEL SALES)</strong></p> <p>Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation delivering high-speed, low-latency broadband to customers around the globe. As the Sales Operations Manager, you will own the systems, processes, and data that make our reseller channel scalable and high performing. You will operate reseller portal onboarding, co-sell registration, Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements, and pipeline reporting from the channel—then turn that information into clean systems, dashboards, and workflows that make Channel Sales, Enterprise Sales, and every member of our channel more productive. You will work closely with Channel Sales, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Product, Legal, Finance, Compliance, and GTM engineering to remove friction between direct and indirect motions and unlock efficient indirect revenue.</p> <p><strong>RESPONIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own reseller portal onboarding operations, tiering workflows, portal readiness, and clean reseller data across CRM and reseller systems—so new and existing channel members can work productively without friction</li> <li>Design and operate co-sell registration as part of the tiering approval process, ensuring required information is captured completely and consistently before approval</li> <li>Build and run the quarterly channel data collection process to capture KYC and pipeline reporting from resellers; define how data is submitted, validated, stored, and used in systems and reports with Legal, Finance, Compliance, Sales Operations, and GTM engineering</li> <li>Partner with Channel Sales on reseller performance by owning the data, reporting, scorecards, and operational insights that help Channel Sales manage the channel—without owning reseller performance management or running business reviews</li> <li>Define and enforce service levels for portal onboarding, co-sell registration, quarterly KYC/pipeline submissions, and handoffs across Channel Managers, Sales Operations, Legal, Finance, and Compliance</li> <li>Collaborate with the GTM Engineer and Data Engineer to improve data quality, automate capture of KYC and pipeline inputs, and embed reseller-safe tooling that increases productivity for Channel Sales, Enterprise Sales, and channel members</li> <li>Establish success metrics for channel operations (portal onboarding cycle time, co-sell registration completeness, quarterly KYC/pipeline submission rate and quality, data usability in reports) and continuously optimize based on field and Channel Sales feedback</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor to channel and enterprise leadership on operational bottlenecks, data readiness, and investments that scale indirect revenue and improve productivity across the channel</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree</li> <li>5+ years of experience in channel operations, reseller operations, sales operations, revenue operations, or a related go-to-market function</li> <li>1+ years of experience owning reseller or channel operational processes such as portal onboarding, registration workflows, PRM/portal operations, or channel data/reporting</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting Enterprise or complex B2B channel/reseller motions (ideally technology, SaaS, telecom, satellite/connectivity, or hardware)</li> <li>Experience designing or operating registration/tiering workflows and collecting KYC or equivalent compliance information from resellers</li> <li>Experience building systems or processes to collect recurring channel pipeline reporting and turn it into usable CRM data, dashboards, and operational insights for sales leadership</li> <li>Strong CRM discipline (HubSpot or Salesforce) and experience operating reseller portals or PRM platforms</li> <li>Data-driven mindset with ability to define and track channel ops KPIs (portal onboarding cycle time, registration completeness, quarterly submission rates, data quality, productivity impact)</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to document processes, train Channel Managers and resellers on portal/registration/data requirements, and drive cross-functional alignment without formal authority</li> <li>Experience working in high-growth, fast-paced environments with frequent product, pricing, and process changes</li> <li>Familiarity with co-sell motions, channel conflict resolution, and compliance workflows is a plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Available to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to support major product launches, reseller programs, certification events, or critical sales initiatives</li> <li>Willingness to travel as needed to support channel manager training, reseller enablement, and key events</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. This role writes and operates the software and infrastructure behind SpaceX security standards.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain technology that protects SpaceX systems, networks, and data.</li> <li>Stand up authentication and identity services, multi-factor authentication, and network access control identity.</li> <li>Automate identity lifecycle for Information Security and partner organizations.</li> <li>Run backend infrastructure that network security services depend on.</li> <li>Operate web application firewalls and other application-level security controls.</li> <li>Enforce cloud security policy, centralized configuration, and monitoring.</li> <li>Document what you run, keep it working, and advise other teams on it.</li> <li>Find threats and gaps with security and IT, then ship software and deployment changes that reduce risk.</li> <li>Deliver solutions that are scalable, repeatable, maintainable, and secure.</li> <li>Coordinate with information security, physical security, IT, HR, legal, software, and other partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience in security software development in lieu of a degree.</li> <li>Experience with Python, Go, C#, C/C++, or Rust.</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing security solutions for operating systems, distributed systems, or other enterprise / large-scale infrastructure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Writing, shipping, and operating secure software.</li> <li>Linux, Windows, and macOS system internals.</li> <li>Public key infrastructure (PKI) and related technologies.</li> <li>SAML, OIDC, and OAuth.</li> <li>TPMs and HSMs.</li> <li>TCP/IP and UDP at the level needed to build and debug services.</li> <li>Navigating large, interactive systems.</li> <li>Web APIs, HTTP-RPC, and REST.</li> <li>Hardening Windows, Linux, and macOS to enterprise security controls.</li> <li>macOS and Windows code-signing and enterprise application deployment.</li> <li>Root-cause debugging under time pressure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. title: Security Engineer (Red Team)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p></p> <p><strong>SECURITY ENGINEER (RED TEAM)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is looking for a Security Engineer to join our Information Security department to help protect and drive the SpaceX mission.</p> <p>Information drives our business and we must protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and processes across the enterprise. As a highly visible and dynamic organization, we must also value and guard against damage to our reputation and brand. It is paramount that we defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems, to guarantee the highest probability of success.</p> <p>As a member of the SpaceX Vulnerability Management team, the Security Engineer will act as a trusted partner to application software development teams. This role focuses on identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities and threats while developing and maintaining internal security tools. The role also includes hands-on work triaging bug reports, conducting Purple and Red Team activities, and continuous threat hunting. Strong communication skills and the ability to turn technical findings into practical, actionable guidance are essential.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Development of tools, processes, and guidance that make security easier to adopt without slowing delivery.</li> <li>Conduct software code reviews to identify insecure patterns and help teams remediate issues.</li> <li>Perform web application security testing using established frameworks and tools.</li> <li>Triage and validate Bugcrowd reports, coordinate with researchers, and work directly with internal teams on remediation and disclosure.</li> <li>Perform Purple Team exercises to test controls, improve detection, and close identified gaps.</li> <li>Contribute to Red Team operations or simulations, including scoping, execution support, and post-exercise analysis.</li> <li>Build and operate emerging vulnerability communication processes so teams receive timely, actionable alerts on new threats.</li> <li>Conduct continuous threat assessment by folding threat intelligence, emerging vulnerabilities, and attack trends into scanning coverage, notifications, and prioritization.</li> <li>Partner with other security sub-teams (detection/response, compliance, application security, infrastructure) to keep efforts consistent and reduce duplication.</li> <li>Escalate critical or time-sensitive issues promptly while offering practical mitigation options.</li> <li>Document findings, produce metrics, and provide regular risk summaries to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience in security software development in lieu of a degree.</li> <li>Experience with the Python programming language, GO, C#, C/C++, or Rust.</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing security solutions for operating systems, distributed systems, or other enterprise/large-scale infrastructure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities (applications, infrastructure, or cloud).</li> <li>Experience working directly with engineering teams to close findings.</li> <li>Scripting/automation experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar) and the ability to develop internal tools.</li> <li>Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls) and how they relate to vulnerability exposure.</li> <li>Reverse engineering or vulnerability development experience.</li> <li>Experience triaging or working reports from bug bounty platforms (Bugcrowd, HackerOne, or similar).</li> <li>Hands-on participation in Purple Team or Red Team exercises.</li> <li>OT Security Experience.</li> <li>Experience with continuous threat assessment, threat intelligence, or risk-based vulnerability prioritization.</li> <li>Experience developing internal security tools, dashboards, or automation pipelines (production-quality code, integrations, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with web application testing frameworks and tools.</li> <li>Experience performing software code reviews for security issues.</li> <li>Experience improving developer experience around security tooling and processes.</li> <li>Knowledge of network segmentation principles and implementation.</li> <li>Experience with asset discovery or inventory processes.</li> <li>Experience building or operating emerging vulnerability notification/alerting workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI/LLMs and MCPs.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their native security/vulnerability features.</li> <li>Experience with configuration management, patching, or infrastructure-as-code.</li> <li>Knowledge of threat modeling, risk scoring (e.g., CVSS), and prioritization frameworks.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise security controls and best practices for Windows, Linux, and macOS.</li> <li>Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical findings into business impact and concrete remediation steps.</li> <li>Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, GSEC, or equivalent) or demonstrated equivalent experience.</li> <li>Demonstrable problem-solving skills and ability to quickly determine root causes of issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. Hybrid or remote work will not be considered.</li> </ul> <p></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

Hybrid or remote work will not be considered.</li> <li>Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral.</li> </ul> <p><strong>COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:</strong><br><br>Pay Range:<br>Level 1: $130,000 - $155,000<br>Level 2: $150,000 - $195,000</p> <p>Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.</p> <p>Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
