title: Security Engineer (Vulnerability Management)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SECURITY ENGINEER (VULNERABILITY MANAGEMENT)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is looking for a Security Engineer to join our Information Security department to help protect and drive the SpaceX mission.</p> <p>Information drives our business and we must protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of systems and processes across the enterprise. As a highly visible and dynamic organization, we must also value and guard against damage to our reputation and brand. It is paramount that we defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems, to guarantee the highest probability of success.</p> <p>As a member of the SpaceX Vulnerability Management team, the Security Engineer will act as a trusted partner to application software development teams. This role focuses on identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities and threats while developing and maintaining internal security tools. The role also includes hands-on work triaging bug reports, conducting Purple and Red Team activities, and continuous threat hunting. Strong communication skills and the ability to turn technical findings into practical, actionable guidance are essential.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Development of tools, processes, and guidance that make security easier to adopt without slowing delivery.</li> <li>Conduct software code reviews to identify insecure patterns and help teams remediate issues.</li> <li>Perform web application security testing using established frameworks and tools.</li> <li>Triage and validate Bugcrowd reports, coordinate with researchers, and work directly with internal teams on remediation and disclosure.</li> <li>Perform Purple Team exercises to test controls, improve detection, and close identified gaps.</li> <li>Contribute to Red Team operations or simulations, including scoping, execution support, and post-exercise analysis.</li> <li>Build and operate emerging vulnerability communication processes so teams receive timely, actionable alerts on new threats.</li> <li>Conduct continuous threat assessment by folding threat intelligence, emerging vulnerabilities, and attack trends into scanning coverage, notifications, and prioritization.</li> <li>Partner with other security sub-teams (detection/response, compliance, application security, infrastructure) to keep efforts consistent and reduce duplication.</li> <li>Escalate critical or time-sensitive issues promptly while offering practical mitigation options.</li> <li>Document findings, produce metrics, and provide regular risk summaries to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience in security software development in lieu of a degree.</li> <li>Experience with the Python programming language, GO, C#, C/C++, or Rust.</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing security solutions for operating systems, distributed systems, or other enterprise/large-scale infrastructure.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience identifying, assessing, and remediating vulnerabilities (applications, infrastructure, or cloud).</li> <li>Experience working directly with engineering teams to close findings.</li> <li>Scripting/automation experience (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar) and the ability to develop internal tools.</li> <li>Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, firewalls) and how they relate to vulnerability exposure.</li> <li>Reverse engineering or vulnerability development experience.</li> <li>Experience triaging or working reports from bug bounty platforms (Bugcrowd, HackerOne, or similar).</li> <li>Hands-on participation in Purple Team or Red Team exercises.</li> <li>OT Security Experience.</li> <li>Experience with continuous threat assessment, threat intelligence, or risk-based vulnerability prioritization.</li> <li>Experience developing internal security tools, dashboards, or automation pipelines (production-quality code, integrations, etc.).</li> <li>Experience with web application testing frameworks and tools.</li> <li>Experience performing software code reviews for security issues.</li> <li>Experience improving developer experience around security tooling and processes.</li> <li>Knowledge of network segmentation principles and implementation.</li> <li>Experience with asset discovery or inventory processes.</li> <li>Experience building or operating emerging vulnerability notification/alerting workflows.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI/LLMs and MCPs.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their native security/vulnerability features.</li> <li>Experience with configuration management, patching, or infrastructure-as-code.</li> <li>Knowledge of threat modeling, risk scoring (e.g., CVSS), and prioritization frameworks.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise security controls and best practices for Windows, Linux, and macOS.</li> <li>Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical findings into business impact and concrete remediation steps.</li> <li>Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, GSEC, or equivalent) or demonstrated equivalent experience.</li> <li>Demonstrable problem-solving skills and ability to quickly determine root causes of issues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. Hybrid or remote work will not be considered.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer, Injection Molding (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SENIOR MANUFACTURING ENGINEER, INJECTION MOLDING (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the world.</p> <p>As a Manufacturing Engineer at SpaceX you will have the opportunity to utilize your knowledge, experience and creativity to develop novel solutions at the cutting edge of technology. We are looking for a talented engineer to sustain our current plastic injection molding production lines and help ramp our new lines to full scale production for millions of devices that will sit in our customers’ homes.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for development of plastic injection molding manufacturing processes for Starlink hardware</li> <li>Responsible for the development of the injection molding process through parameter optimization, DOE experiments, and trials that will lead to a robust process</li> <li>Responsible for implementing plug-and-play processes to production that are capable of high volume throughput (1M+ per year)</li> <li>Take direct ownership of the physical production layout, optimizing for material flow from material receiving through processes on the line</li> <li>Identify and implement safety improvement projects</li> <li>Manage strategy for production line tooling, inventory, training, and build process and ensure all are updated according to the latest design configuration</li> <li>Drive design for test (DFT) best practices and design for manufacturing (DFM) with design engineers and test engineers</li> <li>Identify automation opportunities and establish requirements as well as evaluating return on investment for each</li> <li>Work with in-house resources or vendors as necessary to develop these solutions and implement on production line</li> <li>Support production line with technical issues that cannot be addressed immediately on the line</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline or physics</li> <li>5+ years of experience in a manufacturing environment via professional work experience, project/research-based student experience, or a combination of both</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced degree in an engineering discipline</li> manufacturers</li> <li>Experience working in a highly adaptive and iterative environment</li> <li>Experience implementing automation into production processes</li> <li>Experience transitioning MANUFACTURING ENGINEER, PCBA (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>The Sr. Starlink PCBA Engineer will work inside the production organization to develop, manage, and improve the PCBA manufacturing process. Starlink needs the ability to continuously improve the quality and reliability of its products and production lines. This role looks to design production lines suitable to meet necessary rate, work with equipment suppliers to install and validate new equipment, and continuously seeks to improve the production process. We are actively looking for candidates who possess comprehensive knowledge of manufacturing and quality tools and have the motivation to work with supply chain to build a premium product at commercial scale volume.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and manage PCBA manufacturing processes and PCBA products for in-house production</li> <li>Drive processes for volume production of PCBA including manufacturing execution, nonconforming product management, configuration management, traceability tracking, and process control</li> <li>Manage new product introduction of PCBA assemblies, working closely with design engineers, and process specialists</li> <li>Use process capability analysis, gauge R&amp;R and other tools to lead new equipment selection</li> <li>Design and implement systems to improve the safety of the PCBA production line</li> <li>Manage work instructions, process documentation, and training</li> <li>Track schedule, work-in-progress levels, and defect rates of owned products</li> <li>Identify trends and opportunities for optimizing product output, quality enhancements, and cost of manufacturability</li> <li>Provide feedback to Engineering Design team to improve design for manufacturability</li> <li>Identify, root-cause, and correct SMT production and testing issues</li> <li>Drive corrective actions and process improvements on owned jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT TEST ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX, we are leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world's most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation, providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. Our mission is to design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, including thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that integrates it all. We are just beginning to explore Starlink's potential global impact and are seeking top-tier engineers to help maximize its utility for communities and businesses around the globe. </p> <p>As a Software Development Test Engineer for Starlink, you will be responsible for designing and building “hardware-in-the-loop” (HIL/HITL) test systems. These systems allow for Starlink software engineers to build technologies such as space laser mesh networks, next-generation phased array antennas, advanced collision avoidance algorithms, and much more. You will be working with a multidisciplinary<strong> </strong>team on efforts such as constructing a platform to test industrial ground antennas, high-power amplifiers, ground-to-space lasers, and more. You will also be collaborating closely with internal and external stakeholders to ensure that we provide a highly effective, user-friendly integrated test platform. </p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, build, and maintain highly reliable hardware-in-the-loop (HIL/HITL) testbeds—including surrounding infrastructure, tooling, and support equipment—for the Starlink software continuous integration system</li> <li>Develop test cases and create simulation environments that replicate on-orbit scenarios to deliver flight-like testing capabilities</li> <li>Ensure all software has an appropriate level of test coverage, balancing reliability, velocity and safety</li> <li>Pioneer innovative strategies to scale the HITL fleet in accordance with the Starlink software organization’s growing test demands</li> <li>Analyze and troubleshoot HITL test results to identify testbed issues and prevent software bugs from reaching production</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in software, electrical, mechanical, aerospace, or a related engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of professional test experience within electrical, mechanical, and/or aerospace engineering</li> <li>Development experience in Python</li> <li>Experience in CI/CD pipeline development</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE</strong>:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Experience with integration and testing of electrical, electromechanical, RF, and/or high voltage systems</li> <li>Experience Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SOFTWARE ENGINEER (THERMAL &amp; FLUID ANALYSIS)</strong></p> <p>The Thermal &amp; Fluid Analysis team supports the design and testing of Starship’s thermal and fluids systems. These include active and passive thermal control, propellant feed systems, gas systems, thermal protection, and in-space propellant management among many other subsystems. These systems must perform reliably in extreme environments from launch to recovery. In this role, you will develop software tools to support analysis, improve design processes, automate workflows, and subsequently deploy the new software/workflows to the analysis and engineering community. Your work will enable making informed decisions more quickly and thus reducing the time required to realize a self-sustaining colony on Mars.</p> <p>This role requires strong software development skills and an interest in simulation, thermal design, and fluid systems. Experience with thermal &amp; fluid system modeling technique and simulation is a major plus.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong><br>• Design software and workflows that improve mission critical validation with test and flight data<br>• Collaborate with engineers to improve reliability and performance of spacecraft systems<br>• Write clean, scalable code and maintain strong documentation</p> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong><br>• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related field<br>• 1+ years of experience coding in Python, JavaScript, title: Software Engineer, AI Satellites (Starmind)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SOFTWARE ENGINEER, AI SATELLITES (STARMIND)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Starmind team is developing key technologies to power this satellite – massive solar power generation systems, active cooling, propulsion, and the highly reliable software stack that enables our vehicles to accomplish their mission safely and autonomously.</p> <p>As a Software Engineer on the Starmind team, you’ll have ownership of the stack that will allow us to push our vehicle hardware to the limit of physics. Our software engineers are responsible for the complete lifecycle of the software they create, including development, testing, and support. We expect our engineers to close the feedback loop between software design and real-world performance. In this role, your software will have a meaningful and measurable impact on the world.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop highly reliable, real-time software designed to run on the gateways, satellites, user terminals, and switches that make up our low latency, high capacity satellite-based global network.</li> <li>Participate in and lead architecture, design, and code reviews.</li> <li>Develop prototypes and manage experiments to prove out key design concepts.</li> <li>Develop tools for software development and deployment, data analysis and visualization, and test execution across multiple environments, including virtualized hardware environments, real hardware-in-the-loop simulations, and on-orbit testing.</li> <li>Deploy reliable software, test execution, and data analysis as part of a continuous integration and release system.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or science discipline; Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the world.</p> <p>This role will support the design, construction, commissioning, and operation of large-scale, state-of-the-art Ultrapure Water (UPW) and wastewater treatment plants that enable our high-volume manufacturing operations (including one of the largest PCB manufacturing lines in North America and major solar cell manufacturing facilities). You will work closely with the wastewater engineering team and construction/facilities stakeholders to drive capital equipment procurement and construction services for complex industrial water treatment systems, including Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) facilities.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work directly with key internal stakeholders (wastewater engineering, We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a Sr. Starlink Antenna Engineer, you will have full ownership of all phased array, Wi-Fi, and other RF systems for this customer-facing hardware. In addition, you will own advanced parabolic antenna systems for our gateways/ground stations, which we deploy regionally throughout the world. manufacturing teams to steer this project from initial concept development to full-scale production.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, fabricate, and characterize APPLICATION SOFTWARE ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.</p> <p>Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. title: Sr. Automation & Controls Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. AUTOMATION &amp; CONTROLS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX's Starship spacecraft and Super Heavy rocket (collectively referred to as Starship) represent a fully reusable transportation system designed to carry both crew and cargo to Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars and beyond. Starship will be the world's most powerful launch vehicle ever developed, with the ability to carry in excess of 100 metric tons to Earth orbit. We are looking for an automation &amp; controls engineer to help SpaceX develop and build a great variety of automated solutions for Starship Production. This role will be hands-on in designing and activating hardware and software systems for the machines that make up the Starship production line. The role will also support transport and storage solutions for Starship vehicles. The successful applicant will join and be supported by a highly talented team of automation and control engineers with an amazing track record in developing any&nbsp;automated solution imaginable.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Participate in initial equipment conceptual development and carefully balance product specifications, process requirements, layout complexity, cost, and lead-time limits.</li> <li>Lay out new industrial electrical control panels that are NFPA79/NEC/UL508A compliant and create electrical, pneumatic, and fluid schematics.</li> <li>Architect, write, and debug PLC code, emphasizing generating organized, structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable code for manufacturing applications.</li> <li>Develop robot systems to aid in the automated manufacturing of various vehicle sub-components.</li> <li>Implement (ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA compliant) control reliable safety systems for safeguarding robots, gantries, conveyors, and other manufacturing title: Sr. Automation & Controls Engineer, Assembly Manufacturing (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. AUTOMATION &amp; CONTROLS ENGINEER, ASSEMBLY MANUFACTURING (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the world.</p> <p>As a member of this team you will lead creative, multi-disciplinary projects spanning machine design, robotics, motion systems, and factory health monitoring that all come together to form the innovative, high-rate factories that allow us to deliver internet to those that need it most.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and manage automation projects - this includes initial factory ideation, machine commissioning, proof of rate capability, and eventual hand-off to operational teams&nbsp;</li> <li>Architect, write, and debug PLC code with an emphasis on generating code that is organized, structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable for high-volume manufacturing applications&nbsp;</li> <li>Keep our factory safe and reliable by implementing ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA compliant systems for robots, gantries, conveyors, and other manufacturing equipment</li> <li>Generate aesthetically simple HMI screens to make complex machines easy to understand, operate, and troubleshoot</li> <li>Design electrical systems compliant to NEC, NFPA, &amp; UL508A regulations</li> <li>Stay organized by creating schedules and budgets, and then motivate the team to achieve them&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in an engineering, physics, or computer science discipline</li> <li>5+ years of experience&nbsp;in industrial or factory automation design and implementation</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Ability to engineer creative, new approaches to problems while adhering to ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA safety requirements to keep a factory safe</li> <li>Experience with Electromechanical systems</li> <li>Electrical sizing of motors, cables, circuit protection, VFD’s, motor starters, various other motion systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Design of fail-safe electrical circuits using both safety logic controllers and safety-rated relays&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial electrical systems using tools like multimeters, oscilloscopes, EMI probes</li> <li>Proficiency in understanding and creating electrical schematics and single line diagrams (EPLAN preferred)</li> <li>Field bus networks, serial communication, and Ethernet communication</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and commissioning high quality electrical panels and electro-mechanical systems with appropriate safety considerations in mind</li> <li>Knowledge of NEC, NFPA, UL508A codes with ability to ensure compliance with control system safety standards&nbsp;</li> <li>PLC programming, preferably Beckhoff TwinCAT structured text programming&nbsp;</li> <li>Programming and implementing machine safety software through the use of safety PLC’s&nbsp;</li> <li>HMI, SCADA, IoT (MQTT, OPC-UA), Ignition systems with focus on user friendly navigation and machine health monitoring and control&nbsp;</li> <li>Field Bus Networking protocols, preferably EtherCAT, Profinet, Profisafe, Ethernet/IP&nbsp;</li> <li>Robotics programming, preferably ABB</li> <li>Industrial software application to mechanical assemblies, electrical systems, sensors, pneumatics/hydraulics, including how to safely checkout these interdisciplinary systems prior to production implementation&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones&nbsp;</li> <li>Must be willing to travel up to 10%</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, title: Sr. Automation & Controls Engineer, Solar Cell Factory
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. AUTOMATION &amp; CONTROLS ENGINEER, SOLAR CELL FACTORY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Solar Cell team is revolutionizing power generation for space applications through advanced solar cell manufacturing. We're scaling production of high-efficiency solar cells to support sustainable energy solutions for Starlink constellations, launch vehicles, and beyond. As a Solar Cell Factory Sr. Automation and Controls Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize controls and automation systems for the production of solar cell manufacturing equipment and material movement mechanisms. This role requires a detail-oriented engineer passionate about safe electrical design, writing robust and elegant control code, and taking on total ownership of existing systems for optimization in addition to development of novel equipment, all while minimizing risks and maximizing efficiency in our cutting-edge solar cell factory.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: &nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and manage automation projects - including initial factory ideation, machine commissioning, proof of rate capability, and eventual hand-off to operational teams &nbsp;</li> <li>Architect, write, and debug PLC code with an emphasis on generating code that is organized, structured, documented, maintainable, and reusable for high-volume manufacturing applications &nbsp;</li> <li>Keep our factory safe and reliable by implementing ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA compliant systems for robots, gantries, conveyors, and other manufacturing equipment&nbsp;</li> <li>Generate aesthetically simple HMI screens to make complex machines easy to understand, operate, and troubleshoot&nbsp;</li> <li>Integrate individual equipment pieces into master SCADA and MES systems</li> <li>Design electrical systems compliant to NEC, NFPA, &amp; UL508A regulations&nbsp;</li> <li>Stay organized by creating schedules and budgets, and then motivate the team to achieve them &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: &nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, or chemical discipline &nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years of experience with high-speed manufacturing, controls and automation, and/or programming&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: &nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Excited by a quick and iterative design and manufacturing role&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven ability to solve complex problems with simple solutions in both design and implementation stages&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both written and verbal, with the ability to make plans and directional recommendations collaboratively and cross-functionally&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to engineer creative, new approaches to problems while adhering to ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA safety requirements to keep a factory safe &nbsp;</li> <li>Hazardous process expertise in an aerospace, oil and gas, or chemical industry where high pressure or hazardous systems for fluids or gasses were in use</li> <li>Experience with at least one of the specific disciplines listed below. The ideal candidate is interested in learning at least the fundamentals of the other areas they are not yet strong in</li> </ul> <p><em>Electrical/Industrial Controls: &nbsp;</em></p> <ul> <li>Electrical sizing of motors, valves, pneumatics, cables, circuit protection, VFDs, motor starters, various other motion systems &nbsp;</li> <li>Design of fail-safe electrical circuits using both safety logic controllers and safety-rated relays &nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial electrical systems using tools like multimeters, oscilloscopes, EMI probes&nbsp;</li> <li>Proficiency in understanding and creating electrical schematics and single line diagrams (EPLAN preferred)&nbsp;</li> <li>Field bus networks, serial communication, Profinet and Ethernet communications&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience designing and commissioning high quality electrical panels and electro-mechanical systems with appropriate safety considerations in mind&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of NEC, NFPA, UL508A codes with ability to ensure compliance with control system safety standards &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><em>Industrial Software: &nbsp;</em></p> <ul> <li>PLC programming, preferably Siemens TIA Portal or Beckhoff TwinCAT structured text + ladder&nbsp;</li> <li>HMI, SCADA, IoT (MQTT, OPC-UA), ignition systems with focus on user friendly navigation and machine health monitoring and control &nbsp;</li> <li>Field Bus Networking protocols, preferably EtherCAT, Profinet, Profisafe, Ethernet/IP &nbsp;</li> <li>Robotics programming, preferably ABB&nbsp;</li> <li>Industrial software application to mechanical assemblies, electrical systems, sensors, pneumatics/hydraulics, including how to safely checkout these interdisciplinary systems prior to production implementation &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: &nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones &nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Sr. Aviation Development Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. AVIATION DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>We are rapidly accelerating our transformation of the airline passenger experience and are seeking engineers with a track record of new product launch, service introduction and engineering solutions to complex technical challenges with partners and customers. Starlink designs, builds, tests and operates all of the technology utilized in our solutions for airlines. &nbsp;Our mission is to put Starlink on everything that flies and bring the Starlink experience to millions of passengers globally.&nbsp; To accomplish this, we are creating deep technical alignment with our airline partners across the areas of passenger experience, mechanical and electrical integration, network performance and measurement and application-level features and functionality.</p> <p>As an Aviation Development Engineer, you will be responsible for the service launch of Starlink with key airline partners. You will own the technical engagement defining the process, critical milestones, technology trades, resource prioritization, compliance with customer and manufacturing requirements and technical documentation needed to certify and introduce Starlink into our airline partner’s operations. You will team with the engineering, maintenance and passenger experience teams at our airline partners to ensure high alignment with business objectives, technical requirements and critical timelines. Your high integrity, command of engineering first principles, attention to detail, ability to set and keep commitments across a range of internal and external stakeholders while delivering results will be crucial factors in your success in this role.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for the technical engagement and successful Starlink service launch of Starlink with airline partners</li> <li>E<span data-teams="true">stablish and maintain comprehensive program governance, delivering accurate, timely reporting to both customer-facing teams and SpaceX leadership</span></li> <li><span data-teams="true">Lead strategic program reviews, coordination meetings, and workshops with internal stakeholders, customers, airframe manufacturers, and industry partners</span></li> <li><span data-teams="true">Engage with customers during pre-sales to deeply understand requirements and translate them into actionable technical and operational plans</span></li> <li>C<span data-teams="true">oordinate across company departments, vendors, airframe manufacturers, and partners to prepare technical, compliance, and commercial artifacts for licenses, type approvals, and regulatory audits</span></li> <li>Navigate complex schedules and project dependencies ensuring a maximally efficient use of SpaceX resources and customer success.</li> <li>W<span data-teams="true">ork closely with the FAA and other aerospace regulatory bodies to ensure full compliance throughout the customer engagement</span></li> <li>Manage multiple concurrent projects and provide regular updates on schedule and deliverables to senior management</li> <li>Act as the subject matter expert on the SpaceX Aviation Integration process and create alignment across all partners</li> <li>Work across all stakeholders to ensure feedback is incorporated into project schedules and statement of work</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline</li> <li>4+ years of experience in an engineering function (EG: software, network, mechanical, electrical) OR a technical program/product management role focused on bringing programs/products/services to market</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated ability to navigate complex technical programs with aerospace manufacturers from ideation, commercial negotiation, and implementation to roll-out</li> <li>Experience in one or more of the following functional areas:&nbsp; software architecture and protocols, electrical interfaces and standards, wireless data communications, mechanical structures or thermal analysis</li> <li>Experience conducting commercial and technical trades across partner and internal stakeholders</li> <li>Demonstrated high accountability to producing the correct requirements, eliminating complexity and communicating dependencies, critical path and key decision-points to a large group of stakeholders</li> <li>Experience with industry certification and regulatory compliance</li> <li>Experience with commissioning and testing, writing and executing integration plans</li> <li>Previous technical ownership of a complex project involving numerous stakeholders from conception to customer acceptance</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to produce documentation deliverables on a tight timeline</li> <li>Extremely strong proficiency with Microsoft Word as a tool to produce and manage large documents</li> <li>Experience generating schematics, diagrams, and data visualizations that clearly communicate design intent of systems, tests or analysis</li> <li>Hardware ownership for mechanical or electrical systems through entire lifecycle (design, qualification, manufacturing, and launch)</li> <li>Understanding of failure modes of complex mechanical and electrical systems</li> <li>Extremely strong verbal and written communication skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones</li> <li>Ability to travel if needed title: Sr. BAW Device Engineer (Starlink/Akoustis)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">SR. BAW DEVICE ENGINEER (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)</span>&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">XBAW technology utilizes MEMS-based thin film transfer process, enabling a broad range of piezoelectric material synthesis and compositions tailored for specific application needs with enhanced material properties and an optimized resonator performance including superior figure of merit from coupling and Q factor. Our Device Engineers plays a critical role in developing and improving XBAW resonators and supporting filter designs. This person will perform FEM simulations and experimental DOE to improve the figure of merit of BAW resonators, with an emphasis on developing efficient process integration and reduced cycle time for lean filter development.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-weight: bold;">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span>&nbsp;</span></p> <ul style="margin-top: 0in; margin-bottom: 0in;" type="disc"> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">Develop and improve FEA setups (COMSOL, HFSS) for BAW resonator simulations and optimization&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px; vertical-align: middle; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">Improve the performance of bulk acoustic wave resonators for RF filter applications&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="margin-top: 0px; title: Sr. BAW Filter Design Engineer (Starlink/Akoustis)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. BAW FILTER DESIGN ENGINEER (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)</strong></p> <p>Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX, providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary and connecting the world through Starlink.&nbsp;We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>XBAW technology utilizes MEMS-based thin film transfer process, enabling a broad range of piezoelectric material synthesis and compositions tailored for specific application needs with enhanced material properties and an optimized resonator performance, including a superior figure of merit from coupling and Q factor.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Responsible for designing and developing BAW filters from concept to production, including specification definition, simulation, characterization, front-end and back-end testing, architecture design, and performance optimization</li> <li>Perform advanced EM simulations using tools such as HFSS, ADS, or COMSOL to model BAW filter performance, optimize designs, and ensure manufacturability</li> <li>Design RF modules integrating BAW filters, including layout, packaging, and integration with other RF components such as amplifiers, switches, and antennas</li> <li>Optimize filter performance for key metrics such as insertion loss, return loss, bandwidth, and out-of-band rejection, while meeting size and cost constraints</li> <li>Work closely with process engineers, layout designers, and system architects to ensure seamless integration of BAW filters into larger RF systems</li> <li>Develop test plans, perform RF measurements, and validate filter performance using tools like network analyzers and spectrum analyzers</li> <li>Create detailed design reports, simulation results, and technical documentation to support design reviews and production handoff</li> <li>Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in BAW technology, contributing to the development of next-generation RF solutions</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or other engineering discipline</li> <li>5+ years of experience in RF filter design with a focus on BAW or SAW</li> <li>Experience in EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, CST, ADS, or COMSOL)</li> <li>Experience with radio test and measurement equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector signal analyzers, vector signal generators, and network analyzers</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree or PhD in electrical engineering with emphasis in RF/antenna engineering</li> <li>Experience with 5G, Wi-Fi, or IoT RF front-end module design</li> <li>Familiarity with MEMS fabrication processes for BAW filters</li> <li>Knowledge of mixed-signal design and co-simulation with analog/digital circuits</li> <li>Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, MATLAB) for automation of simulation and testing workflows</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and fast-paced, high-change environment.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Develop, implement, execute, and improve construction safety and contractor management programs at the title: Sr. Electrical Construction Project Engineer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>SR. ELECTRICAL CONSTRUCTION PROJECT ENGINEER</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">As a member of the SpaceX construction team at Starbase, you will design, build, and activate some of the world’s most technically advanced electrical infrastructure — from high-voltage substations through medium-voltage distribution to low-voltage production, launch, and facility power systems and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We execute complex electrical construction projects and infrastructure improvements from cradle to grave. You will operate with autonomy to solve diverse and complex power-system problems, excel at managing multiple projects at a time, and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will work with other construction engineers, electrical contractors, equipment vendors, utilities, architects, and internal customers to deliver reliable, high-capacity electrical systems that support Starship production, test, and launch operations. All SpaceX construction engineers serve additionally as project managers and supers — this is a construction management role per industry standards. The position is based at Starbase, TX.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">This role is focused on delivering the electrical backbone — from the high-voltage substation down to the low-voltage racks and BESS — that will power SpaceX’s Starbase operations.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><strong><span class="s2">RESPONSIBILITIES:</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">Oversee and own the full lifecycle of electrical construction projects (high-voltage substations, transformers, switchgear, BESS, production and launch-site power distribution, UPS, generators, and low-voltage systems) with on-time and under-budget delivery</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">Manage all aspects of multi-discipline electrical construction projects in the field and office; act as overall construction project manager and extreme owner</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; title: Sr. Electrical Hardware Engineer, AI Satellites (Starmind)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. ELECTRICAL HARDWARE ENGINEER, AI SATELLITES (STARMIND)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience deploying and operating the world’s largest satellite constellation to develop Starmind, a new constellation of satellites capturing solar energy in space to power low-cost, high-performance AI compute for Earth. Realizing this vision demands highly reliable, high performance electrical hardware ranging from power electronics, high speed digital systems, mixed signal designs, robust avionics, networking, and custom compute electronics. These systems must operate in the extreme environment of space while delivering the connectivity, control, power distribution, and processing needed for orbital AI inference.</p> <p>The Starmind team designs, builds, and operates the orbital compute fabric of the future. We develop nearly every key piece of technology in house – from the satellites’ flight computers and power systems to the fully custom compute electronics, memory, and networking that form the brain of our on-orbit data centers. As a Senior Electrical Design Engineer on the Starmind Payload Engineering team, you’ll have ownership over the entire life-cycle of the hardware that enables advanced on-orbit AI processing and data center workloads. Your work sits at the intersection of electrical, mechanical, thermal, and software engineering. The Payload team is responsible for the design of industry-leading compute electronics, memory, and networking in order to achieve required domain sizes and processing workloads.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Rapidly develop high-reliability electronics for satellites and spacecraft.</li> <li>Drive system trades, requirements capture, component selection, analysis, schematic capture, PCB layout, prototyping, hardware bring-up, debugging, documentation, manufacturing, test, and on-orbit performance of complex electrical designs</li> <li>Get hands-on and support hardware through production, satellite integration, and flight</li> <li>Determine layer stackup, perform component package selection, component placement, routing feasibility studies, and title: Sr. Facilities Engineer, Solar Cell Factory (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. FACILITIES ENGINEER, SOLAR CELL FACTORY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX, we are building the next generation of space infrastructure to enable large-scale AI data centers in orbit. These orbital AI platforms require massive amounts of reliable, high-efficiency solar power to support intensive computing workloads in space. To make this possible, we are standing up one of the largest solar cell manufacturing facilities in the world. We are seeking a Sr. Facilities Engineer to oversee the maintenance, performance, and continuous improvement of facility systems (power, ultrapure water, exhaust, bulk gases) that support high-volume solar cell manufacturing. This high-impact role offers the opportunity to build and shape the organization from the ground up while directly enabling SpaceX’s ambitious vision for AI data centers in space.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee the maintenance, performance, and continuous improvement of facility systems including power distribution, ultrapure water, exhaust systems (acidic, caustic, harmful gas, VOC, and general heat), bulk gases, chilled water, and process cooling systems that support high-volume solar cell manufacturing</li> <li>Collaborate with engineers, technicians, production teams, and leadership to maintain systems in peak operating condition and develop detailed work instructions for preventative maintenance to ensure zero unplanned interruptions</li> <li>Monitor and optimize utility systems supporting wet chemistry texturing, PECVD, PVD, metallization, and cleaning processes</li> <li>Perform failure assessments, root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions for facility systems</li> <li>Ensure work and materials comply with manufacturer specifications, industry standards, and all applicable safety, environmental, and building regulations</li> <li>Read and interpret P&amp;IDs, schematics, OEM manuals, and construction drawings for assembly, repair, and optimization</li> <li>Present equipment and system performance statuses to internal customers and leadership</li> <li>Track and resolve electronic work tickets, manage priorities with minimal guidance, and take on additional responsibilities as needed</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement initiatives for reliability, uptime, yield, and cost in a high-volume production environment</li> <li>Operate forklifts, scissor lifts, boom lifts, and other equipment as required</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, or related engineering discipline</li> <li>5+ years of professional experience in facilities engineering or sustaining engineering for a manufacturing environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience with cleanroom facility systems, ultrapure water, exhaust abatement, bulk gas delivery, and/or process utility systems supporting semiconductor or solar manufacturing</li> <li>Knowledge of high-pressure gases, flammable gases, hazardous chemicals, and associated safety systems</li> <li>Proficiency reading and interpreting P&amp;IDs, schematics, and technical drawings</li> <li>Experience with continuous improvement, root cause analysis, and implementing preventative maintenance programs</li> <li>Ability to troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and controls systems down to the component level</li> <li>Familiarity with commercial building codes, OSHA, EPA, and NFPA standards</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, high-stress environment balancing multiple projects</li> <li>Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and computerized maintenance management systems</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to travel internationally (20%)</li> <li>Ability to stand up to 6 hours, lift up to 25 pounds unassisted, and maneuver around equipment in a factory setting</li> <li>Ability to work in industrial environments with fumes/odors, noise, hazardous chemicals, and confined spaces</li> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, State. title: Sr. Failure Analysis Engineer, Microelectronics (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. FAILURE ANALYSIS ENGINEER, MICROELECTRONICS (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink is SpaceX’s ambitious goal to bring high-quality internet to the globe by building a constellation of thousands of satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO) using our Falcon 9 and Starship reusable rockets. We are developing millions of devices for end users to link our customers to our satellites.</p> <p>As a Sr. Failure Analysis Engineer on the Starlink team, you will perform detailed root cause failure analysis on microelectronic components and packaging to support high-volume manufacturing, qualification, and field returns. You will leverage advanced laboratory tools and physics-of-failure techniques to identify failure mechanisms and drive corrective actions that improve the reliability of our satellite constellation and user terminals.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own end-to-end root cause failure analysis investigations on microelectronics failing in manufacturing, test, and field, from initial failure characterization through final corrective action verification</li> <li>Conduct advanced electrical fault isolation and characterization using curve trace, TDR, RF characterization, Lock-in Thermography, OBIRCH, EBIRCH, EBAC, nanoprobing, and related techniques to precisely localize defects in complex devices</li> <li>Perform advanced physical failure analysis using SEM, FIB, EDS, SAM, cross-sectioning, and related techniques to identify failure mechanisms in silicon, packaging, and interconnects</li> <li>Apply physics-of-failure principles and deep knowledge of semiconductor failure modes (electromigration, thermal fatigue, delamination, EOS/ESD, solder joint fatigue, etc.) to determine root causes</li> <li>Drive corrective actions by working directly with silicon design, packaging, and manufacturing teams to implement and validate design or process changes based on FA findings</li> <li>Author detailed technical reports documenting failure modes, root cause conclusions, supporting data, and corrective action effectiveness</li> <li>Develop and improve failure analysis techniques and workflows to support new packaging technologies and advanced materials</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in materials science, electrical engineering, physics, chemical engineering, or other STEM discipline&nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years of hands-on experience in microelectronics failure analysis or materials characterization (internship experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s or PhD in materials science, electrical engineering, physics, chemical engineering, or other STEM discipline with a focus on microelectronics or failure analysis</li> <li>10+ years of hands-on experience in microelectronics failure analysis or materials characterization</li> <li>Direct experience with failure analysis tools and techniques (SEM, FIB, EDS, cross-sectioning, fault isolation, or equivalent)</li> <li>Strong understanding of semiconductor physics and common microelectronics failure mechanisms (electromigration, thermal fatigue, delamination, solder joint fatigue, electrical overstress/ESD, etc.)</li> <li>Proficiency with advanced FA tools including SEM, FIB, SAM, and EDS</li> <li>Hands-on experience in electrical characterization and fault isolation techniques such as IV curves, RF/VNA measurement, LIT, OBIRCH, EBIRCH, EBAC, nanoprobing, photon emission, or voltage contrast</li> <li>Experience applying JEDEC and AEC reliability test standards and physics-of-failure methodologies to root cause investigations</li> <li>Experience analyzing complex datasets with Python, JMP, or similar tools</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving, communication, and technical writing skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work overtime and weekends as needed</li> <li>Ability to work in a cleanroom or ESD-controlled environment when required</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer (Application Software)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. FULL STACK ENGINEER (APPLICATION SOFTWARE)</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.</p> <p>Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX</li> <li>Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates</li> <li>Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints</li> <li>Own all aspects of software engineering and product development</li> <li>Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions</li> <li>Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software development; OR 7+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree</li> <li>3+ years of professional experience in full stack development</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language</li> <li>1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications</li> <li>Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts</li> <li>Expertise in designing software systems</li> <li>Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment &amp; title: Sr. Hardware Development Engineer, Gateway Failure Analysis (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. HARDWARE DEVELOPMENT ENGINEER, GATEWAY FAILURE ANALYSIS (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is leveraging its experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation that provides fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, hundreds of gateway ground stations, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact. As we continue to upgrade and expand the constellation, we’re looking for best-in-class engineers to join the team.</p> <p>As a Sr. <span class="job-application-title">Hardware Development Engineer </span>on Starlink, you’ll contribute to the design, build, and test electronics for the world's largest network of ground stations, which function as an intermediary between the satellites and our end-users to ensure smooth data transfer and transmission. You will sit at the intersection of electrical, mechanical, thermal analysis, software, and antenna engineering - ultimately ensuring that our ground antenna hardware can withstand the harshest environmental conditions while maintaining reliable communication with millions of users on a global scale. This is an opportunity to work on cutting edge R&amp;D technology, and some of the most complex applications of electrical and mechanical engineering in the industry.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, develop, and execute novel environmental, RF, mechanical, and electrical test solutions for our ground antenna electronics and payload</li> <li>Perform detailed failure analysis of ground antenna hardware, identifying root causes of failures and implementing corrective actions</li> <li>Select commercial-off-the-shelf hardware and/or design custom PCBAs to measure signals, apply flight-like loads, and power units under test</li> <li>Hands-on support of hardware through design qualification, production ramp, and ground network rollout</li> <li>Work closely with engineers from adjacent disciplines (mechanical, thermal, software, test engineering, supply chain, silicon design) to deliver tightly integrated, high-performance hardware</li> <li>Perform electrical bench testing of failures to replicate and inform mitigation of anomalies</li> <li>Drive continual improvements to our designs by building physical and digital tools to analyze data collected both in the field and in the lab</li> <li>Challenge assumptions and work to find simple solutions to complex problems</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or other STEM discipline</li> <li>5+ years of experience in hardware development, failure analysis, or reliability engineering&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or other STEM discipline</li> <li>Experience with both electronics and mechanical design and analysis including knowledge of RF principles</li> <li>Experience analyzing circuits and PCBAs, and developing functional test plans</li> <li>Experience with test equipment and measurement techniques to verify and validate product requirements (oscilloscope, multimeter, electronic load, spectrum analyzer, network analyzer, vector signal generator, source measurement unit, etc.)</li> <li>Experience in environmental testing such as HALT/HASS, thermal, humidity, shock &amp; vibration</li> <li>Strong understanding of computers and programming languages (Python, C/C++)</li> <li>Thorough understanding of electronics reliability, manufacturing, and failure mechanisms</li> <li>Knowledge of quality tools such as Lean principles, Six Sigma, and root cause analysis methods</li> <li>Thorough understanding of metrology, sources of measurement error, and uncertainty analysis</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines</li> <li>Occasional travel to ground network sites to support root cause investigations</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a
