title: Sr. Trajectory Analysis Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>As a Trajectory Analysis Engineer, you will be responsible for finding creative analysis solutions to enable the world’s most advanced rockets, including our next-generation Starship vehicle, a fully reusable spacecraft capable of carrying humans to Mars and beyond. You will work with a talented team of accomplished engineers to iterate on mission objectives for upcoming and future flights to ensure flight safety objectives are met. You should thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments where you adapt quickly and love to solve hard problems.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze launch vehicle trajectories and vehicle performance in the presence of faults</li> <li>Find creative flight plan solutions to enable mission objectives, while maintaining safe vehicle operation</li> <li>Generate and submit flight safety deliverables</li> <li>Produce and present trajectory analysis products for internal and external partners</li> <li>Interface with internal operations teams, flight reliability teams, hardware teams, and external regulatory partners such as the FAA.</li> <li>Engage in multi-disciplinary vehicle systems investigations to motivate mission design, vehicle architecture, and analysis methodologies</li> <li>Develop and evaluate flight termination system mission rules</li> <li>Support launch and mission operations of vehicles that you enabled</li> <li>Conduct flight data review</li> <li>Automate mission-to-mission trajectory analysis product generation</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in physics or an engineering discipline AND 5+ years of professional experience&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with orbital mechanics, classical dynamics, modeling, and simulation</li> <li>Experience with the software languages Python or C++</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional experience in trajectory analysis and aerodynamics</li> <li>Demonstrated project or professional experience in launch vehicle and/or spacecraft systems</li> <li>Capable of solving complex problems with little to no supervision on schedule as an individual or as a member of an integrated team</li> <li>Experience with system trades and first-hand knowledge of how requirements tie hardware to larger systems</li> <li>Passion for advancing the commercial space industry and title: Sr. Water Treatment Engineer, Solar Cell Factory (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. WATER TREATMENT ENGINEER, SOLAR CELL FACTORY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we are building the next generation of space infrastructure to enable large-scale AI data centers in orbit. These orbital AI platforms require massive amounts of reliable, high-efficiency solar power to support intensive computing workloads in space. To make this possible, we are standing up one of the largest solar cell manufacturing facilities in the world. We are seeking a best-in-class Water Treatment Engineer to drive design, commissioning, build, and operations of ultrapure water and wastewater systems. This high-impact role will help shape process strategies from the ground up while enabling SpaceX’s ambitious vision for AI data centers in space. &nbsp;</p> <p>As a Sr. Water Treatment Engineer on the Starlink manufacturing program, you will take ownership for activating, qualifying, optimizing, and ensuring the consistency of operations for an ultrapure process water plant supporting our solar cell manufacturing lines. This position is responsible for the development, implementation, and operationalization of equipment, facilities, tooling, and manufacturing process technologies necessary for high-volume production. Your work will form the backbone for millions of next-generation of satellites used all over the world. For homes, schools, businesses, vehicles, planes, or boats, this team plays an instrumental role in ensuring high-speed connectivity is available to all who need it.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrate extreme ownership in the construction, activation, and operation of a new commercial ultrapure process water treatment facility</li> <li>Design, implement, and productionize mechanical and fluid systems that meet SpaceX and regulatory requirements</li> <li>Interpret lab analysis, data streams, and operator feedback to effectively maintain safe and effective plant operations</li> <li>Develop, implement, maintain, and improve operational procedures, methods, and process equipment</li> <li>Form strong partnerships with internal and external counterparts, including but not limited to manufacturing operations and engineering, environment health and safety (EHS), facilities construction and maintenance teams, representatives of regulatory bodies, OEM equipment manufactures, and supplier representatives</li> <li>Identify and champion continuous improvement projects</li> <li>Develop project plans, budgets, and cost/benefit analysis for implementation of new processes or machines</li> <li>Monitor and communicate area status and risks</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years hands-on project experience in wastewater treatment</li> <li>Experience with process parameters and engineering units for temperature, pressure, flow, and power</li> <li>Ability to read and understand process PFDs, P&amp;IDs, 2D and 3D CAD drawings, construction drawings, and BOMs</li> <li>Experience with mechanical equipment and systems requiring the isolation of the malfunction, disassembly of industrial machinery, and repair/replacement of bearings, gears, structural title: Sr. Wi-Fi Software Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. WI-FI SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, manufacture, and operate all parts of the system including thousands of satellites and millions of customer kits. Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. While users can get online within minutes almost anywhere in the world, we’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential.&nbsp;We are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for individuals, communities, and businesses.</p> <p>As a Sr. Wi-Fi Software Engineer, you will be a critical piece of the overall customer experience. We are looking for experts in the Wi-Fi space to help Starlink deliver an amazing end-to-end customer experience. You see the big picture, prioritize accordingly, and are comfortable with working at different levels of abstraction.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Driving the Wi-Fi software and product roadmap</li> <li>Debug and optimize kernel-level system performance</li> <li>Collaborate with our RF and EE engineers to improving our testing procedures for both software and hardware</li> <li>Mentor software engineers and building a great work culture</li> <li>Improve our Wi-Fi mesh performance</li> <li>Invent new tools that enable more frequent and reliable software deployment, test execution, and data analysis as part of a continuous integration and release system</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or STEM discipline and 5+ years of professional experience in software development; or 7+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of degree</li> <li>3+ years development experience in C or C++</li> <li>Experience with the IEEE 802.11 wireless standard and with networking protocols (UDP, TCP/IP, etc.)</li> <li>Experience working on embedded software for networking equipment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong fundamental knowledge of networks, embedded systems, math, and physics</li> <li>Solid communication and leadership skills</li> <li>Experience testing Wi-Fi for performance or stability</li> <li>Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment &amp; continuous monitoring</li> <li>Knowledge of DHCP, IPv4, IPv6, Linux bridge, network stack internals</li> <li>Experience with networking kernel modules and drivers</li> <li>Experience driving cross-team projects</li> <li>Experience with security issues associated with distributed systems and internet services</li> <li>Experience with Golang and Python</li> <li>Experience with hostAP</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Starlink Account Manager (State & Local Government)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARLINK ACCOUNT MANAGER (STATE &amp; LOCAL GOVERNMENT)</strong></p> <p>Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, is delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world. The Account Management team serves as the point of contact for customers from contract signature, through successful activation, ensuring all contract terms are fulfilled while and identifying new opportunities to generate business with enterprise customers. Prior to contract signature, the team will have a key role in ensuring that the commitments we make are ones we can successfully execute to.&nbsp;<br><br>In the past year, the Starlink team has signed contracts with customers who will deploy high speed internet at a pace and for use cases previously not possible. The team has designed the product to be self-service, and we need to similarly evolve our team and systems to enable large enterprises to manage Starlink themselves, minimizing humans-in-the-loop.&nbsp;Our ideal candidate is a self-starter that has a passion for making customers deliriously happy, supporting excellent teams, and managing complex cross-functional projects.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for a robust portfolio of assigned government customers and own the interface from contract signature onwards (onboarding, ongoing account management, and long-term retention/growth of the relationship and revenue) with emphasis on:</li> <ul> <li>Delivering impeccable customer service, including efficient acknowledgement and resolution of issues</li> <li>Building relationships to identify requirements and manage expectations</li> <li>Collecting, communicating, and championing customer feedback internally to influence and steer programmatic and technical development required to maintain and grow enterprise business</li> <li>Retaining and growing the value of accounts</li> </ul> <li>As an extreme owner of assigned accounts, identify and successfully communicate readiness levels, requirements, schedules, and risks to realize forecasted revenue on or ahead of schedule</li> <li>Serve as the team’s internal expert in the State &amp; Local / Local &amp; Regional government vertical in specific regions, shaping strategic direction and routinely leading high-impact commercial decision-making within the vertical and region in partnership with other teams</li> <li>Autonomously identify, design, and lead implementation of new processes and system improvements that will broadly accelerate growth for customers or enable the internal team to scale rapidly</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree; OR high school diploma/equivalency certificate and 5+ years of professional business development, operations, engineering, or account management experience</li> <li>3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or business operations</li> <li>1+ years of experience working with government customers</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience working with customers to support a technical product/service</li> <li>3+ years working with State &amp; Local / Local &amp; Regional government customers</li> <li>Significant knowledge or experience in one or more of the following industries: public sector, telecommunications, manufacturing, satellite communications and/or supply chain</li> <li>Experience managing multiple complex projects and delivering under tight deadlines and resource constraints</li> <li>Experience building long-term and successful customer relationships demonstrating empathy, active listening, and resiliency skills</li> <li>Significant technical knowledge of Starlink or telecommunications in at least one key area: satellites, ground network, user terminals, or related technology</li> <li>Ability to synthesize multiple unique requirements and suggest smart solutions, products, or features</li> <li>Track record of demonstrating sound business judgement, evaluating alternatives, and making recommendations that were adopted and ultimately successful</li> <li>Ability to negotiate successfully, especially after a contract is signed</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including ability to craft and present professional presentations at all levels</li> <li>Ability to manage execution of significant or complex contracts including initial intake, renegotiation of terms, and schedules</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be available to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to support critical milestones or operations shifts</li> <li>Must be willing to travel to other SpaceX offices and customer locations as needed</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR title: Starlink Customer Success Manager (Land Mobile)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARLINK CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER (LAND MOBILE)</strong></p> <p>Starlink is delivering high-speed, low-latency internet around the world. Customer Success is the post-sale owner of the customer relationship where they are the single name on a book of enterprise accounts from contract signature through onboarding, activation, payment, and long-term growth. This role owns Starlink Land Mobile accounts across agriculture, rail, trucking, OEM, heavy machinery, and other in-motion or remote vehicle networks. You take assigned accounts from contract signature through hardware, activation, payment, and expansion. Sales books the deal. You own everything after.&nbsp;This is an individual contributor role, and the ideal candidate is a self-starter who is comfortable operating without a defined playbook, holds a high bar of communication, and treats revenue, activation, and account health as their personal responsibility.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own assigned Land Mobile accounts from contract signature through onboarding, activation, day-to-day management, and long-term growth as the primary customer contact&nbsp;</li> <li>Hit and exceed revenue targets on time by tracking readiness, shipments, activations, certifications, and payments, and by raising risks early when dates or dollars may slip&nbsp;</li> <li>Keep internal systems current so account status, risk, and opportunity are visible in one place&nbsp;</li> <li>Monitor account health—including contract compliance, KPI performance, invoicing, logistics, in-motion or field performance, and the customer relationship—to prevent delayed cash or churn&nbsp;</li> <li>Set clear expectations with customers, resellers, and internal partners on what SpaceX can and cannot commit to on timing, hardware, and delivery&nbsp;</li> <li>Build account plans that define current state, a healthy account, and the next dollar of revenue&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify expansion across additional vehicles, machines, routes, sites, kits, and new ways customers can use Starlink in the field&nbsp;</li> <li>Facilitate leadership business reviews that connect Starlink performance to customer results&nbsp;</li> <li>Forecast retention and revenue for the book so leadership can plan against a real number&nbsp;</li> <li>Bring customer feedback into SpaceX and work with engineering, support, finance, and operations to reduce errors across accounts&nbsp;</li> <li>Coordinate high-touch onboarding, including hardware transitions, reseller partners, and certification or deployment requirements&nbsp;</li> <li>Document processes that support expansion and scaling of the Land Mobile book&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field, OR high school diploma / equivalency certificate and 6+ years of professional experience in account management, customer success, business development, operations, or a technical customer-facing role&nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years owning a defined book of business with accountability for customer health and revenue (retention, realization, expansion, or collections), not just project delivery&nbsp;</li> <li>5+ years supporting customers on a technical product or service&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting customers with in-motion, fleet, field, or similarly operationally complex deployments&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with agriculture, rail, trucking, OEM, heavy machinery, or other land-mobile / vehicle connectivity programs&nbsp;</li> <li>A track record of growing revenue inside existing accounts, such as expansion, additional vehicles or sites, or new ways the customer uses the product&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience running several complex workstreams at the same time and delivering them on tight timelines&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to work clearly with executives, operators, and finance&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with telecommunications, satellite, networking, or similar infrastructure sold to enterprise or government customers&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Willing to work early mornings, evenings, and weekends as needed for customer milestones and global time zones&nbsp;</li> <li>Willing to travel to customer sites, depots, yards, and field locations as needed&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Starlink Development Lead, Solar Ingot & Wafer
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARLINK DEVELOPMENT LEAD, SOLAR INGOT &amp; WAFER</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is developing a low-latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink will provide fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable.</p> <p>As the development lead, you will be responsible for factory acceptance tests, equipment readiness, process development, trials, and production launch for silicon ingot growth and wafering. Additionally, you will be the day-to-day link between OEMs, development, operations, quality, equipment, and suppliers, moving new recipes, tools, and process changes from trial to stable production with clear documentation, yield targets, and a schedule.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Plan, schedule, and run development trials on ingot pullers, crop and square, multi-wire saws, cleaning, and related metrology</li> <li>Turn engineering intent into trial plans: DOE, recipe versions, material lots, fixtures and consumables, and success criteria (yield, TTV, warp, resistivity, lifetime, breakage, kerf)</li> <li>Define process windows (pull rate, rotation, hot zone, slurry or diamond wire, tension, coolant, clean chemistry) and track KPIs such as kg/pull, wafer yield, kerf loss, downtime, scrap, and first-pass yield</li> <li>Coordinate tool time, material readiness, operator coverage, fixtures, hot-zone parts, wires, slurry and coolant, crucibles, and other consumables with production, maintenance, quality, EHS, and supply chain</li> <li>Track status, blockers, and results; escalate schedule, quality, or safety risks with options and owners; and give leadership concise updates</li> <li>Collect trial data and support root cause on trial and early-production issues (ingot defects, saw marks, TTV, warp, stains, lifetime)</li> <li>Own trial reports, work instructions, travelers, checklists, training notes, and revision control of recipes, fixtures, and consumable specs</li> <li>Initiate and track ECOs and process changes, including training and first-article or first-lot verification before release</li> <li>Partner with quality and metrology on incoming silicon, in-process checks, and outgoing wafer specs, and support vendor trials and incoming qualifications of new materials or tools</li> <li>Lead pilot-to-production transfer (standard work, operator training, control and reaction plans), support the ramp until rate and quality are stable, and capture lessons learned</li> <li>Enforce EHS requirements for high temperature, chemicals, slurry, wafer handling, lockout, PPE, and clean-area rules</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in materials science, chemistry, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, or a STEM field</li> <li>5+ years in manufacturing process development or production coordination (semiconductor, PV, crystal growth, precision machining, or injection molding/process engineering strongly preferred)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in Czochralski ingot growth, wafering (wire saw), or a photovoltaic or semiconductor wafer fabrication line</li> <li>Familiarity with silicon specifications, including resistivity, lifetime, oxygen, and geometry (TTV, bow and warp, and thickness)</li> <li>Working knowledge of MES and QMS, change control, and basic CAD or process mapping</li> <li>Experience working with equipment teams and suppliers</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Extended hours and weekend work may be required to support critical project and mission milestones</li> <li>Up to 10% travel is expected</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To title: Starlink Production Associate
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARLINK PRODUCTION ASSOCIATE</strong></p> <p>One of the most ambitious missions that SpaceX has undertaken to date, the Starlink satellite constellation is our solution to providing fast and reliable internet to the entire world. This facility in Bastrop, TX manufactures the high-volume consumer products that we ship directly to customers. Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas.</p> <p>This Production Associate position supports the Starlink product factory and manufacturing operation, which continues to grow as demand for Starlink increases globally. This is a hands-on position that operates light equipment and performs basic assembly tasks in an organized and efficient manner. We are looking for motivated and well-rounded workers to help ensure the productivity and reliability of our manufacturing facility, ultimately ensuring that we can produce thousands of Starlink kits every day.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the development of prototype manufacturing and test capabilities</li> <li>Mechanical/electrical assembly of user and other tasks</li> <li>Help develop and optimize production line stations and processes</li> <li>Keep a clean, organized, and thoroughly maintained workspace</li> <li>Ensure product quality and title: Starship Engineer, FOD Control
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARSHIP ENGINEER, FOD CONTROL</strong></p> <p>As a Starship Engineer specializing in FOD Control, you will own Foreign Object Debris (FOD) prevention and elimination across Starship Production while developing engineering and manufacturing processes that maximize quality at high rate. You will employ root cause investigations and data review to deploy robust fabrication methods, work instructions, tooling design, inspection and cleaning measures. Engineering design, process, facility and supply chain controls will all be areas of ownership.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own FOD control strategy and execution for Starship Production; ensure facilities and processes comply with AS9146 (Foreign Object Debris Prevention Program) and related aerospace/defense standards.</li> <li>Partner with design engineering to apply Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and design-for-cleanliness principles—sealing machined areas, eliminating hidden cavities where debris can lodge, and enabling clean assembly line layouts—while influencing flight design and vehicle architecture.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop and enforce manufacturing, integration, assembly, welding, NDE, cleanliness, and checkout processes across work centers, including Clean-As-You-Go methodologies, tool accountability tracking, and hardware kitting protocols.&nbsp;</li> <li>Design and implement precision tooling and poka-yoke systems for work access, build fixturing, lifting &amp; rigging, fluids, and mechanical/avionics/propulsion testing to eliminate assembly error, prevent FOD introduction, improve quality, and minimize cycle time.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop, qualify, and automate manufacturing processes and in-situ inspection techniques to enable high-rate, repeatable production with higher yield and lower takt time.&nbsp;</li> <li>Evaluate and integrate automated FOD detection systems, millimeter-wave radar, and specialized mechanical sweeping equipment into production and integration environments.&nbsp;</li> <li>Define inspection requirements, author planning/test plans/work instructions, and create training for production and inspection—including FOD awareness—ensuring stable quality as volume scales.&nbsp;</li> <li>Contain non-conforming hardware with quality, production, and design; conduct build quality and FOD audits to identify high-impact issues; drive corrective action and manage fleet risk.&nbsp;</li> <li>Challenge and simplify requirements where design intent, cleanliness, and production rate conflict; manage transition of parts and assemblies from development to high-rate production with FOD controls built in.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, materials engineering, manufacturing engineering, chemical engineering, electrical engineering, engineering physics, or other engineering discipline.</li> <li>1+ years in manufacturing, quality, process design, and/or design engineering (student project team or internship experience qualifies).</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master's degree in an engineering discipline.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience developing or leading FOD prevention, cleanliness, contamination control, or AS9146 (or equivalent) programs.&nbsp;</li> <li>Hands-on experience with high-rate or mixed value stream manufacturing, focused on yield, rate, and process control.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience building, assembling, or integrating aerospace hardware (structures, avionics, propulsion, fluids, valves, actuators, thermal protection, or similar).&nbsp;</li> <li>Mechanical tooling or component design with strong DFM; proficiency in assembly methods, testing, FMEA, and troubleshooting.&nbsp;</li> <li>Proficiency with 3D CAD (NX, SolidWorks, or CATIA).&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of welding (MIG, TIG, laser, stud, spot, or robot) and NDT (visual, penetrant, x-ray, EMAT, or other); experience improving weld processes and inspection, including automation.&nbsp;</li> <li>Knowledge of metallic manufacturing processes (machining, forming, casting, additive, fastening, drilling, bonding).&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience evaluating or deploying automated inspection, sensing, detection, or shop-floor cleanup technology.&nbsp;</li> <li>Proficiency with SQL, Power BI, or similar tools to prioritize work and measure performance.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collegiate or hobby design project experience (Formula SAE, rocketry, etc.); thrives hands-on on the shop floor.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate across diverse engineering disciplines.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours, weekends, and offsite as needed; schedule varies with site operational needs.&nbsp;</li> <li>Flexibility to travel to remote build sites, up to 10%.&nbsp;</li> <li>Flight hardware is built in tight quarters; physical dexterity required. Duties may include standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting, working in cramped openings, and climbing (including ladders/stairs up to 6 hours/day).&nbsp;</li> <li>Work may involve extreme outdoor environments (heat, cold, rain), temperatures over 80°F for 6+ hours/day, and exposure to fumes, odors, and noise.&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. In addition to the current use cases Starlink is serving in masse – such as residential, maritime, aviation, fixed site enterprise – there are many other uses cases and applications for Starlink that help social and economic development that require development or modification of existing capabilities and thinking. title: Structures Design Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STRUCTURES DESIGN ENGINEER (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>The structures design engineer is responsible for designing and building flight hardware such as propellant tanks, integration interfaces, primary structures, and structural subassemblies. You will be empowered to make real-time decisions, solve complex problems on the fly, and own end-to-end processes. The role will require the readiness to develop subject matter expertise in design for manufacturability, specifically those related to sheet metal and subassembly design and fabrication. If you are ready to be a hardware owner, eager to get out from behind a desk, and be hands-on working alongside a world-class production team, this may be the right role for you.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design metallic structures and propulsion fluid systems under accelerated timelines</li> <li>Review specifications and other engineering data to develop mechanical systems</li> <li>Update designs and drawings through engineering change orders to support SpaceX's rapid pace of design iteration</li> <li>Create detailed component and assembly drawings incorporating an understanding of GD&amp;T and tolerance stack-ups</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of mechanical design and drafting experience (including internships or personal projects)</li> <li>Experience with 3D CAD software (NX, Solidworks, etc)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solid understanding and application of GD&amp;T and tolerance stack-ups</li> <li>Hands-on experience working in school club or project teams designing hardware in a highly constrained system under defined timelines</li> <li>Familiarity with sheet metal design, welded structures, and fluid systems</li> <li>Ability to manage large assembly models and drawings</li> <li>Ability to work and communicate well in an integrated team including daily interactions with technicians, engineers, and leadership</li> <li>Creative problem solver that can bring jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SUPERVISOR, MACHINING &amp; FABRICATION (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink provides fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable.</p> <p>We are looking for an organized, creative, technically sharp, and driven Supervisor to lead the Machining &amp; Fabrication team. This is a group of highly skilled technicians and automation specialists. As the team Supervisor, you and your team will be at the center of fabricating all engineering R&amp;D and factory build-outs supporting exciting programs like high volume Starlink User Terminal assembly line technologies, PCB manufacturing, silicon packaging, and brand new products yet to be dreamed of.</p> <p>You will manage a diverse team of fabrication, assembly, electrical, and automation experts in close partnership to key engineering leaders across Starlink, with expectation to grow the capabilities, skills, and output of a fast-growing team and Bastrop site. Your ability to lead in a highly dynamic environment will have immense impact on the output of Starlink products being distributed to the entire world.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead a group of technicians and specialists that fabricate, build, integrate, and deploy Starlink factory equipment and tooling</li> <li>Collaborate with the broader development operations and automation teams to achieve factory infrastructure deployment targets and milestones</li> <li>Manage tooling/testing equipment and infrastructure required to support engineering, automation, and product development projects</li> <li>Manage the parts inventory used to build standard factory assets, set targets for the team, and drive continuous improvement</li> <li>Provide mentorship to technicians/specialists and assist with design decisions, project strategies, and technical problems</li> <li>Provide technical support and feedback to engineering groups on tooling, fabrication, testing, and maintenance</li> <li>Ensure technicians and specialists on the team have the training, tools, and materials needed to carry out their duties – including creating and giving safety trainings to all members of the team</li> <li>Identify and execute on projects that improve overall program success and progress</li> <li>Take input from partner teams to align team priorities with broader program priorities</li> <li>Improve factory safety and efficiency through regular auditing and continuous improvement</li> <li>Enforce area standards and rules (including bi-annual reviews, disciplinary action, and time management)</li> <li>Report on project status and critical path items to management and key stakeholders for alignment</li> <li>Provide surge support and leadership as needed by traveling to other SpaceX sites to deploy factory assets</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of professional experience in machining, maintenance, or production/manufacturing; OR 5+ years of professional experience in machining, maintenance, or production/manufacturing in lieu of a degree</li> <li>2+ years of professional experience managing a team or leading projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of conventional machining, CNC programming, machining operations, and quality inspection procedures</li> <li>Experienced in welding techniques, fabrication processes, and precision mechanical assembly operations</li> <li>Experience managing large scale electromechanical projects by coordinating resources appropriately and collaborating with cross functional teams to achieve program objectives</li> <li>Knowledge of electrical theory, power distribution (both low and high voltage) and pneumatics</li> <li>Experience working with electrical/pneumatic/hydraulic schematics</li> <li>Familiar with NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code), NFPA 70E (Standard for Electrical Safety), NFPA 79, and/or UL 508A standards</li> <li>Demonstrable hands-on skill in fault finding and technical problem resolution</li> <li>Ability to bring multiple departments with different priorities together and support them in achieving common goals</li> <li>Ability to coordinate multiple projects on a large scale with multiple stakeholders and deliver on schedule</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adjust team priorities as broader program priorities shift</li> <li>Strong communication skills both written and verbal</li> <li>Proficient in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Smartsheet (or equivalent)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, pulling, pushing, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position</li> <li>Ability to lift 30lbs. unassisted</li> <li>Willing to travel up to 20% of the time to support business needs</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR title: Supervisor, Hardware Reliability
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SUPERVISOR, HARDWARE RELIABILITY (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a Supervisor on the Starlink Hardware Reliability team, you will lead a group of technicians and specialists responsible for root causing production failures on Starlink hardware. You will own the day-to-day operations of the production root cause lab and drive improvements that directly enhance product reliability and manufacturing quality.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong>:</p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and develop a team of reliability technicians and specialists performing root cause analysis on electrical systems and PCBAs</li> <li>Drive root cause findings into actionable improvements with manufacturing and design teams to reduce failure rates and improve yield</li> <li>Own day-to-day operations of the production root cause lab, including technician scheduling, equipment maintenance, lab organization (5S), and resource planning</li> <li>Develop and implement new processes and tools that improve the team’s ability to efficiently and accurately root cause electrical failures</li> <li>Establish clear priorities across multiple shifts and ensure timely communication of findings and recommendations to production stakeholders</li> <li>Define and track team performance metrics and key indicators, holding the team accountable to measurable outcomes</li> <li>Identify development opportunities for team members that align with both individual growth and Starlink program goals</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>3+ years of quality or reliability experience in a manufacturing environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, aerospace engineering, or related technical field</li> <li>Demonstrated experience performing root cause analysis on electrical systems and PCBAs with expertise in diagnosing and resolving issues related to solder joint quality, component failures, and manufacturing/assembly defects</li> <li>Experience training, mentoring, and developing technicians or junior engineers</li> <li>Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, highly iterative environment with rapidly changing priorities</li> <li>Strong track record of influencing cross-functional teams through data-driven analysis and clear communication</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to organize, prioritize, and drive completion of work across a team</li> <li>Experience jumping into ambiguous problems and driving them to resolution</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>Experience in consumer electronics, aerospace, automotive, or other high-volume hardware manufacturing environments</li> <li>Familiarity with quality management systems (ISO 9001 or equivalent)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work extended hours, authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>HOSPITALITY SUPERVISOR</strong></p> <p>The SpaceX Hospitality team serves all employees, customers, government partners, potential clients and/or visitors with everything from snacks to daily meals to full-service events. The Hospitality Supervisor supports the direction and management of the organization’s food/beverage operations and is directly responsible for the quality of service throughout one or more of our food service outlets/catering locations. Duties include, but are not limited to, coordinating service operations; monitoring, positioning, and motivating staff; ensuring excellent customer service; engaging with customers; hiring, onboarding, and developing talent; maintaining team compliance with mandatory trainings; handling scheduling and payroll; and setting/upholding customer service principles. Additionally, maintaining food safety and sanitation standards is of utmost importance and necessity to protect the health of all served individuals, comply with regulations, and uphold the organization's commitment to excellence. The Hospitality Supervisor supports SpaceX’s mission by overseeing day-to-day hospitality functions and providing quality food/beverage options. This creates&nbsp;exemplary, professional and welcoming service&nbsp;environments that enhance productivity and morale.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Set and The Network Infrastructure team installs and supports the low voltage used for all types of telecommunications in support of the production and launch vehicles and spacecraft.&nbsp; This includes but not limited to installation and support of the layer 1 fiber and copper data network cabling infrastructure, support of mission video, ground-side vehicle and payload interface systems, ground stations, telemetry and optical tracking systems, marine communications, readiness testing, and other systems involved in real-time communications and operations for Falcon, Dragon, Starship and other missions.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Supervise technician teams to install and maintain mission critical communication systems</li> <li>Prioritize and schedule work to meet required timelines</li> <li>Provide feedback and progress updates to project stakeholders</li> <li>Evaluate, diagnose, troubleshoot cabling infrastructure systems and perform repairs as necessary</li> <li>Coordinate with other contractors and project teams as needed</li> <li>Collaborate with the communication engineers and telecommunication specialist in system designs, selection of materials, and creation of documentation</li> <li>Interface with external carriers (private and government) at cross-connect facilities, and transition points</li> <li>Provide superior customer service to SpaceX launch customers</li> <li>Provide QA and auditing before and after work</li> <li>Maintain the integrity of the documentation of all installations including assets, locations, connectivity, and the patch record databases&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Assist with the creation of local and companywide installation and workmanship standards</li> <li>Provide ongoing feedback, periodic review, and corrective action to direct reports</li> <li>Review timesheets, manage overtime and time off requests</li> <li>Verify compliance with OSHA regulations and SpaceX safety requirements</li> <li>Assist in the evaluation and selection of candidates for open positions in the team</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>5+ years of telecommunications systems experience</li> <li>2+ years prior leadership experience (leading teams, projects or people)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical expertise in the installation, termination, testing of low voltage cables and fiber optical cables to include twisted pair, coaxial, stranded and solid conductor low voltage cables, single mode and multi-mode fiber optical cables</li> <li>Strong knowledge of industry standards (BICSI, NEC, TIA/EIA); different types of fiber (MM, SM) for interior and exterior usage; Cat5E, Cat6 and Cat6A data cabling; and cable pathways such as conduit, fire penetrations and cable trays</li> <li>Knowledge of the telecom network best practices and concepts including network security, network architecture design, technical standards and deliverables, troubleshooting tools (e.g., line analyzers, breakout boxes, and network traces), software and hardware installation and configuration, network hardware, and protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, DLC, and ASYNC)</li> <li>Working knowledge of audio, video, and wireless systems and corresponding physical means of delivery (analog, digital, AoIP, tubing, cable harnessing, lacing, and proper strain relief concepts</li> <li>Experience with IP and HD-SDI video cameras and infrastructure</li> <li>Comprehension of modern networking architecture and what is necessary for physical layer inter-connectivity</li> <li>Experience operating articulating boom lifts, fork lifts, scissor lifts, and other work site machinery</li> <li>Proficient in the use of Visio or other CAD software to read and develop system documentation</li> <li>Experience in the installation and operation of RF communication systems</li> <li>IP and HD-SDI Video cameras and infrastructure</li> <li>Comprehension of modern networking architecture and what is necessary for physical layer inter-connectivity</li> <li>Working knowledge of electrical systems including UPS and standby power systems</li> <li>Sound knowledge of computer skills, MS Words, Excel, and Power Point</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be able to work 1st shift: title: Supervisor, Machining & Fabrication
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SUPERVISOR, MACHINING &amp; FABRICATION (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is developing a low latency, broadband internet system to meet the needs of consumers across the globe. Enabled by a constellation of low Earth orbit satellites, Starlink provides fast, reliable internet to populations with little or no connectivity, including those in rural communities and places where existing services are too expensive or unreliable.</p> <p>We are looking for an organized, creative, technically sharp, and driven Supervisor to lead the Machining &amp; Fabrication team. This is a group of highly skilled technicians and automation specialists. As the team Supervisor, you and your team will be at the center of fabricating all engineering R&amp;D and factory build-outs supporting exciting programs like high volume Starlink User Terminal assembly line technologies, PCB manufacturing, silicon packaging, and brand new products yet to be dreamed of.</p> <p>You will manage a diverse team of fabrication, assembly, electrical, and automation experts in close partnership to key engineering leaders across Starlink, with expectation to grow the capabilities, skills, and output of a fast-growing team and Bastrop site. Your ability to lead in a highly dynamic environment will have immense impact on the output of Starlink products being distributed to the entire world.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and lead a group of technicians and specialists that fabricate, build, integrate, and deploy Starlink factory equipment and tooling</li> <li>Collaborate with the broader development operations and automation teams to achieve factory infrastructure deployment targets and milestones</li> <li>Manage tooling/testing equipment and infrastructure required to support engineering, automation, and product development projects</li> <li>Manage the parts inventory used to build standard factory assets, set targets for the team, and drive continuous improvement</li> <li>Provide mentorship to technicians/specialists and assist with design decisions, project strategies, and technical problems</li> <li>Provide technical support and feedback to engineering groups on tooling, fabrication, testing, and maintenance</li> <li>Ensure technicians and specialists on the team have the training, tools, and materials needed to carry out their duties – including creating and giving safety trainings to all members of the team</li> <li>Identify and execute on projects that improve overall program success and progress</li> <li>Take input from partner teams to align team priorities with broader program priorities</li> <li>Improve factory safety and efficiency through regular auditing and continuous improvement</li> <li>Enforce area standards and rules (including bi-annual reviews, disciplinary action, and time management)</li> <li>Report on project status and critical path items to management and key stakeholders for alignment</li> <li>Provide surge support and leadership as needed by traveling to other SpaceX sites to deploy factory assets</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of professional experience in machining, maintenance, or production/manufacturing; OR 5+ years of professional experience in machining, maintenance, or production/manufacturing in lieu of a degree</li> <li>2+ years of professional experience managing a team or leading projects</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive knowledge of conventional machining, CNC programming, machining operations, and quality inspection procedures</li> <li>Experienced in welding techniques, fabrication processes, and precision mechanical assembly operations</li> <li>Experience managing large scale electromechanical projects by coordinating resources appropriately and collaborating with cross functional teams to achieve program objectives</li> <li>Knowledge of electrical theory, power distribution (both low and high voltage) and pneumatics</li> <li>Experience working with electrical/pneumatic/hydraulic schematics</li> <li>Familiar with NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code), NFPA 70E (Standard for Electrical Safety), NFPA 79, and/or UL 508A standards</li> <li>Demonstrable hands-on skill in fault finding and technical problem resolution</li> <li>Ability to bring multiple departments with different priorities together and support them in achieving common goals</li> <li>Ability to coordinate multiple projects on a large scale with multiple stakeholders and deliver on schedule</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adjust team priorities as broader program priorities shift</li> <li>Strong communication skills both written and verbal</li> <li>Proficient in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Smartsheet (or equivalent)</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed</li> <li>Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, pulling, pushing, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position</li> <li>Ability to lift 30lbs. unassisted</li> <li>Willing to travel up to 20% of the time to support business needs</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Supervisor, Materials Management (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SUPERVISOR, MATERIALS MANAGEMENT (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p><span class="ui-provider ec bwu bgd bwv bww bwx bwy bwz bxa bxb bxc bxd bxe bxf bxg bxh bxi bxj bxk bxl bxm bxn bxo bxp bxq bxr bxs bxt bxu bxv bxw bxx bxy bxz bya">At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the world.&nbsp;</span></p> <p>This role will involve the supervision of a team of hourly employees operating within SpaceX’s materials management organization. title: Supervisor, Porter
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SUPERVISOR, PORTER</strong></p> <p>Supervisor, Porter is a personnel management role responsible for the processes of ordering, receiving product, equipment, event support, managing inventory, tracking spends, and ensuring product and supplies are readily available in the necessary areas for the food services department. This role is also responsible for the scheduling and payroll management, as well as assignment of responsibilities and overall staff supervision of the porter team. The Porter Supervisor supports the mission by coordinating the logistics of the perishable and non-perishable resources utilized by our Culinary and Food &amp; Beverage team.&nbsp; They also that all food safety and quality assurance best practices are being followed.&nbsp; Additionally, they perform all of the heavy lifting for event setup, product, and equipment transport, to support with the necessary day to day operations.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Conduct on-hand inventories and place orders for all concept areas of Culinary food services</li> <li>Receive and inspect deliveries from vendors daily</li> <li>Set and enforce standards for ordering and receiving operations</li> <li>Maintain accurate inventory records for all departmental areas</li> <li>Create awareness among kitchen teams regarding inaccuracies in product deliveries</li> <li>Collaborate with the culinary team to ensure optimal product and vendor selection</li> <li>Monitor and track departmental spending by vendor</li> <li>Reconcile invoices and submit purchase orders for food and equipment vendors</li> <li>Fulfill interdepartmental requests through the internal request system</li> <li>Manage porters to provide site support, handle food deliveries, and maintain cleanliness of surrounding areas</li> <li>Support events and operations by moving equipment, setting up, and resetting event spaces</li> <li>Move equipment to and from the warehouse to meet site needs</li> <li>Maintain cleanliness of operational areas and report maintenance issues for repair</li> <li>Manage dishwashers to support kitchen operations and maintain cleanliness of the kitchen and surrounding areas</li> <li>Manage staff scheduling, payroll, and attendance for the team</li> <li>Conduct annual staff performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching and development</li> <li>Ensure all staff training and credentials remain up to date</li> <li>Supervise deliveries of water, ice, and backstock supplies across campus</li> <li>Support internal delivery of supplies for daily operations and events</li> <li>Maintain a safe and clean work environment for the team</li> <li>Monitor equipment and asset management, including preventative maintenance</li> <li>Support daily services and perform other tasks as directed by management</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>2+ years of inventory experience</li> <li>2+ years of restaurant or retail food service experience</li> <li>1+ years of leadership experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have or be able to obtain TX food handler card</li> <li>Have or be able to obtain manager level food safety certification</li> <li>Experience in a corporate environment</li> <li>Experience working in large team settings</li> <li>Customer service and or guest interaction experience</li> <li>Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook</li> <li>Data entry experience</li> <li>Experience with inventory management software</li> <li>Strong writing and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Detail oriented and organized</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to relocate to Starbase, TX and travel to remote Moon Corps sites on critical projects (up to 85% travel)</li> <li>Ability to provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies and critical operations</li> <li>Valid state issued driver's license</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Supervisor, Spaceport Operations
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SUPERVISOR, SPACEPORT OPERATIONS</strong></p> <p>The role of Spaceport Operations Supervisor will be to provide the management of the organization’s housing accommodations, transportation, site amenities, and customer service. You will help develop and implement effective customer service strategies and training programs. The duties of Spaceport Operations Supervisor will include but are not limited to: coordinating service operations, monitoring and motivating staff, ensuring excellent customer service, engaging with customers, creating and implementing processes to improve the growing operation, ensuring team is current with all mandatory company trainings, scheduling and payroll, interviewing, hiring and onboarding of new staff, setting and upholding customer service principles. The Spaceport Operations Supervisor will support the mission by providing a foundation of understanding for excellent customer service and quality of living and visiting accommodations that boost morale and productivity within SpaceX.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee Spaceport operations including strategy and execution leasing/traveler housing program, transportation and amenities</li> <li>Monitor quality and consistency of Spaceport operations by setting and enforcing standards, inspecting and routinely walking areas of responsibility</li> <li>Train staff on customer service, anticipating guest needs and problem resolution</li> <li>Enforce proper safety practices with staff and leads</li> <li>Coordinate and enhance time management for team</li> <li>Monitor financial activities for Spaceport operations strategically driving revenue and improving operating costs</li> <li>Create and maintain in-person and online training materials</li> <li>Manage performance for Spaceport Operations staff</li> <li>Work closely with Spaceport Development Team, Facilities, Culinary and Hospitality teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate&nbsp;</li> <li>3+ years of leadership experience within the hospitality or transportation industries</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in hospitality</li> <li>5+ years of leadership experience within the hospitality or transportation industries</li> <li>Experience opening new operations and/or creating operational procedures from the ground up</li> <li>Advanced knowledge of customer service and problem resolution</li> <li>Experienced with Microsoft Office and Outlook</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both written and verbal</li> <li>Excellent knowledge of room inventory, housekeeping processes and guest service</li> <li>Proficient knowledge of human resources management</li> <li>Strong time management skills</li> <li>Experience with high volume, complex multidisciplinary operations</li> <li>Experience leading groups in large team settings of 10 or more staff members</li> <li>Familiar with space planning procedures and operations</li> <li>Communication skills for relaying data (verbally and in-writing) between other employees, vendors, and customers</li> <li>Logical and strategic approach to solving problems</li> <li>Ability to read and understand basic floor plans</li> <li>Comfortable working in a high-stress environment balancing several projects at any given time, and the flexibility to adjust for abrupt changes in strategic directions</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to travel to remote Moon Corps sites on critical projects (up to 85% travel)</li> <li>Ability to provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies and critical operations</li> <li>Valid state issued driver's license</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>
