title: Welder (Starship) – Temporary
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>WELDER (STARSHIP) - TEMPORARY&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Welders in this temporary position will participate in an accelerated training program at the SpaceX South Texas build site, preparing to qualify for welding on the Starship and Super Heavy vehicles through intensive hands-on instruction and certification. Under the mentorship of seasoned experts, trainees will simulate and progressively master the fabrication of the primary airframe, including cylindrical tanks, bulkheads, and large associated structures, building the precision skills needed for flight-ready hardware. Upon successful qualification, participants will join an elite team to rapidly execute these fabrication tasks, advancing the production of groundbreaking multiplanetary vehicles.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform GTAW class A welds; cut, trim, fit and fabricate metal components to dimensions for building and assembling</li> <li>Collaborate with lead welder to ensure that the proper weld procedure, type of material and rod size are accurately assessed for each welding project</li> <li>Analyze engineering drawings and specifications to plan welding operations where procedural information is unavailable</li> <li>Make a continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly</li> <li>Perform other related duties, as assigned, for the purpose of ensuring an efficient and effective work environment</li> <li>Weld assembly and fabrication of various small to large scale structures and assemblies</li> <li>Effectively communicate with management/supervisors, engineering staff and planners to achieve build efficiency</li> <li>Modify repair, assemble, and install launch vehicles</li> <li>Check work after completion of each operation in job and/or completed job to ensure it is complete per drawing</li> <li>Handle and dispose of hazardous materials in approved manner</li> <li>Install and assemble custom and off-the-shelf tooling and machinery for building primary tank structure</li> <li>Setup safety equipment and work platforms at elevation</li> <li>Operate general shop equipment and vehicles (forklifts, boom lifts, scissor lifts, etc.)</li> </ul> <p><strong>POSITION DETAILS:</strong></p> <p>This is a <u>temporary</u> position with SpaceX for the duration stated, subject to change with minimal notice based on business needs. Temporary employees who successfully complete the assignment may be eligible for conversion to full-time roles.</p> <ul> <li>LENGTH OF POSITION: 1 month</li> <li>LOCATION: Brownsville, TX</li> <li>SHIFT: Must be available for all shifts (day shift, 6 AM - 6 PM or night shift, 6 PM - 6 AM), overtime and weekends as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>High school diploma or equivalency certificate</li> <li>1+ month of experience welding or certificate of completion for welding from an accredited program within the last 2 years</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience in TIG welding with one or more of the following materials: stainless steel, carbon steel, Inconel, aluminum and titanium</li> <li>Highly proficient in tube cutting, grinding and fabrication</li> <li>Highly experience in class A welds</li> <li>Certifications with AWS D17.1 and D1.2</li> <li>Knowledge in DC welding techniques, and engineering requirements</li> <li>Knowledge in standard tools, materials, motions, and practices of the welding trade</li> <li>Knowledge in occupational hazards and effective safety precautions of the trade</li> <li>Knowledge in arc air procedures and equipment</li> <li>Experience in overhead cranes and forklifts</li> <li>Use of precision measuring instruments</li> <li>Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Role requires passing a weld test per AWS D17.1</li> <li>Must be available for all shifts (day shift, 6 AM - 6 PM or night shift, 6 PM - 6 AM), overtime and weekends as the schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility is required</li> <li>Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings and climbing hand over hand</li> <li>Ability to work at elevated heights (up to 200 feet) and in confined spaces</li> <li>Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain</li> <li>Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise</li> <li>Stand: Up to 10 hours per day</li> <li>Sit: Up to 1 hour per day</li> <li>Push/Pull: Up to 75lbs. (unassisted) 30 minutes to 1 hour per day</li> <li>Overhead reach: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Walk: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Lift/Carry: Up to 50lbs. (unassisted) 15 minutes or less per day</li> <li>Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 3 hours per day</li> <li>Kneel/Crouch: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Upper body twist: Up to 6 hours per day</li> <li>Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees 30 minutes or less per day</li> <li>Candidate must be capable of safely using an air purifying respirator, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Welding Build Engineer (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>BUILD ENGINEER (STARSHIP)&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a build engineer on the Starship team, you will be responsible for developing and qualifying processes for high-rate, mixed-product manufacturing of propulsion, avionics, and welded structural assemblies. Focus will be on design for manufacturing, implementing poka-yoke systems, increasing product yield, and automation as required to minimize takt and cycle times.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and perform acceptance testing of manufacturing processes, techniques, and tools to enable efficient and high-rate manufacturing</li> <li>Design and implement precision tooling to eliminate assembly error, improve quality, and minimize cycle time</li> <li>Automate novel processes to ensure repeatability on high-rate manufacturing lines</li> <li>Work closely with design engineering teams to influence flight design and vehicle architecture with design for manufacturing improvements</li> <li>Develop and/or automate in-situ inspection techniques to increase yield and decrease cycle time</li> <li>Manage transition of parts and assemblies from development to high-rate production</li> <li>Challenge and simplify requirements to optimize processes and reduce overhead</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or advanced degree in aerospace engineering, manufacturing engineering, materials engineering, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline</li> <li>1+ years of manufacturing and process design experience (internship and academic experience is applicable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Master's degree in an engineering discipline</li> <li>Hands-on project experience with mixed value stream or high-rate manufacturing lines, focusing on maximizing yield and increasing rate</li> <li>Proficiency in mechanical assembly methods, testing, failure mode effects analysis, and troubleshooting</li> <li>Experience with integration and testing of propulsion, thermal, electrical, and/or structural systems</li> <li>Prior experience with developing, maintaining, and improving weld processes and weld inspection techniques, inclusive of automation</li> <li>Experience using SQL or other data management structures to inform priorities and measure performance</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flight title: Wi-Fi Software Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>WI-FI SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, manufacture, and operate all parts of the system including thousands of satellites and millions of customer kits. Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. While users can get online within minutes almost anywhere in the world, we’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential.&nbsp;We are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for individuals, communities, and businesses.</p> <p>As a Wi-Fi Software Engineer, you will be a critical piece of the overall customer experience. We are looking for experts in the Wi-Fi space to help Starlink deliver an amazing end-to-end customer experience. You see the big picture, prioritize accordingly, and are comfortable with working at different levels of abstraction.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Driving the Wi-Fi software and product roadmap</li> <li>Debug and optimize kernel-level system performance</li> <li>Collaborate with our RF and EE engineers to improving our testing procedures for both software and hardware</li> <li>Mentor software engineers and building a great work culture</li> <li>Improve our Wi-Fi mesh performance</li> <li>Invent new tools that enable more frequent and reliable software deployment, test execution, and data analysis as part of a continuous integration and release system</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, math, or STEM discipline and 1+ years of professional experience in software development; or 3+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of degree</li> <li>1+ years development experience in C or C++</li> <li>Experience with the IEEE 802.11 wireless standard and with networking protocols (UDP, TCP/IP, etc.)</li> <li>Experience working on embedded software for networking equipment</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong fundamental knowledge of networks, embedded systems, math, and physics</li> <li>Solid communication and leadership skills</li> <li>Experience testing Wi-Fi for performance or stability</li> <li>Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment &amp; continuous monitoring</li> <li>Knowledge of DHCP, IPv4, IPv6, Linux bridge, network stack internals</li> <li>Experience with networking kernel modules and drivers</li> <li>Experience driving cross-team projects</li> <li>Experience with security issues associated with distributed systems and internet services</li> <li>Experience with Golang and Python</li> <li>Experience with hostAP</li> <li>Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment with changing needs and requirements</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Wifi & RF Compliance Test Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>WIFI &amp; RF COMPLIANCE TEST ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>As a member of our fast-paced electromagnetic environmental effects (E3) team, you will be responsible for ensuring RF product compliance on wireless systems utilized for Starlink high speed satellite internet access with a focus on WiFi applications. The E3 team at SpaceX performs exhaustive analysis, design, and test at the board, unit, subsystem, and system levels with extensive opportunity to interact with a vast array of rocket, spacecraft, and ground support equipment hardware and electronics. As one of the few teams required to interface with the design, manufacturing, and production teams, the E3 team plays a critical role in the development of SpaceX systems as we advance our efforts towards broadband satellite internet and safe, reliable, inexpensive, and innovative access to space with the fundamental goal of expanding human space exploration capabilities.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li>Support pre-compliance testing and 3rd party certification testing for radio equipment in global markets per FCC, ISED, EN/IEC, ETSI, ITU and associated requirements</li> <li>Ensure ongoing compliance for compliant designs</li> <li>Develop automation and measurement tools to improve radio testing fidelity and efficiency</li> <li>Set requirements for design teams working on a variety of Starlink Product applications</li> <li>Ensure products meet these requirements through cross-collaboration with the involved design teams</li> <li>Generate and execute test plans and document results in test reports against the aforementioned standards as well as review and revise test reports generated by external test labs</li> <li>Troubleshoot RF issues from board to system level</li> <li>Operate and automate a variety of EMI, RF, and electronics test equipment</li> <li>Independently perform verifications and document results in a clear, precise, and complete manner</li> <li>Support engineering effectively and confidently with creative thinking and rigor – question the status quo while adhering to documentation and maintaining prescribed quality standards</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li>Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, physics, or other engineering discipline</li> <li>2+ years of experience in WiFi or radio compliance</li> <li>Programming/coding experience, preferably python and/or C++ as well as instrumentation automation protocols such as SCPI/VISA/NI &nbsp;</li> <li>Experience operating a spectrum analyzer, vector network analyzer, power meter, oscilloscope, and base station simulator</li> <li>Experience with 802.11 (APED), 802.3, IPv4, and IPv6</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li>5+ years of experience, including WiFi Radio/RF compliance, analysis, design, and testing</li> <li>Previous experience with CISPR/FCC radio and EMC standards and requirements</li> <li>EMC lab experience, including accreditation, maintenance and calibration</li> <li>Experience performing radio and/or EMC testing</li> <li>Proficiency with Python</li> <li>Proficiency with Linux systems</li> <li>Wi-Fi Alliance Certification experience</li> <li>Experience with other international EMC and radio requirements for global market access</li> <li>Knowledge of electrical safety and EMC commercial compliance standards, requirements and test methods for consumer electronics and commercial applications</li> <li>Demonstrated experience troubleshooting radio compliance issues from board to system level</li> <li>Previous work experience with reading, interpreting and following circuit schematics, PCB layouts, engineering drawings, BOMs, cable harnesses, wiring schematics, interface diagrams, layout drawings, mechanical drawings, and CAD software</li> <li>Experience with electrical circuit analysis using simulation tools such as Spice or equivalent</li> <li>Experience in a fast-paced work environment with production hardware</li> <li>Familiarity with phased array antenna operating principles and fundamentals</li> <li>Able to adapt to constantly changing work assignments</li> <li>Excellent concentration and attention to detail with outstanding work efficiency and accuracy</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul type="disc"> <li>Ability to work extended hours or weekends as needed for mission critical deadlines</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Application Software Engineer, Internal Systems
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>APPLICATION SOFTWARE ENGINEER, INTERNAL SYSTEMS</strong></p> <p>The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.</p> <p>Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX</li> <li>Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates</li> <li>Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints</li> <li>Own all aspects of software engineering and product development</li> <li>Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions</li> <li>Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree</li> <li>Experience in full stack development</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language</li> <li>1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications</li> <li>Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts</li> <li>Expertise in designing software systems</li> <li>Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment &amp; monitoring</li> <li>Expertise in profiling and improving application performance</li> <li>Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)</li> <li>Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them</li> <li>Experience working with in-stream data processing&nbsp;using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies</li> <li>Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes</li> <li>Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework</li> <li>Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> <li>This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER (PLATFORM TEAM)</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Platform Team builds the foundational tooling and security infrastructure that empowers every team at SpaceX to harness AI effectively. This team creates secure, scalable gateways and proxy systems that allow engineers and operators across the company to write code faster, perform advanced data analysis, connect AI to their daily tools and problems, and turn ideas into deployed solutions with confidence. By onboarding new frontier models, expanding compute capacity, optimizing proxy efficiency for logging and control, and building shared prompts, skills, and infrastructure, this team unlocks reliable, high-impact AI capabilities across the entire organization.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As a </span><span data-contrast="auto">Principal Software Engineer for SpaceX's AI platform</span><span data-contrast="auto">, you will set the technical vision and serve as a senior leader and entrepreneurial force for the leanest and most effective applied use of AI at SpaceX. You will architect platforms that convert engineering know-how into tested software, automation, and reliable data stores at massive scale while pioneering risk-mitigation tools such as intelligent code review and PR assistants. title: Principal Software Engineer, Continuous Integration (Starship)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, CONTINUOUS INTEGRATION (STARSHIP)</strong></p> <p>As a Principal Software Engineer on the Starship Continuous Integration team, you will own the tools that power Starship software development. You will design, maintain, and scale the systems which enable hundreds of engineers to integrate their changes and deliver reliable software to all Starship vehicles and launch pads on a continuous basis. This is a high-autonomy role and we are looking for people who want to work closely with peers, identify the biggest problems facing the team, and own solutions from start to finish!</p> <p>Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to be a force multiplier for building world class software that is critical to SpaceX’s mission to make life multiplanetary.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Invent tools and processes which enable fast and correct software development.</li> <li>Hands-on integration and troubleshooting across the entire Starship software stack.</li> <li>Collaborate with counterpart teams to design, maintain, and continuously improve a dedicated pool of on-premises compute.</li> <li>Identify areas for improvement and create innovative solutions that enable the software team to tackle all challenges facing the Starship program as we develop the world’s first fully reusable rocket and spacecraft.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of software engineering experience and a Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or STEM discipline; OR 9+ years of professional experience in software development in lieu of a degree</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Skill with Bazel or similar build systems</li> <li>Fluency in Python, C++, Rust, or Go</li> <li>Experience building tools and infrastructure that impacts hundreds of engineers daily</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development tools and interest in applying AI to improve code quality, testing, and development workflows</li> <li>Strong critical thinking and first-principles problem-solving skills</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Able to work effectively in a dynamic environment while assuming high levels of responsibility and demonstrating accountability for software outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Willing to work long hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR <a href="https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&amp;sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987">here</a>. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.</p> <p>Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:EEOCompliance@spacex.com">EEOCompliance@spacex.com</a><em>.&nbsp;</em></p></div>

title: Principal Electrical Design Engineer, Gateways & Customer Hardware (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRINCIPAL ELECTRICAL DESIGN ENGINEER, GATEWAYS &amp; CUSTOMER HARDWARE (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>Starlink believes in providing fast, reliable internet to serve populations with little or no connectivity. We design, build, launch, and operate the world's largest constellation of satellites, enabling us to operate a global internet network unbounded by traditional ground infrastructure limitations. Starlink also designs, builds, and delivers high-volume consumer hardware that allows users to connect to these satellites within minutes of unboxing, as well as our advanced gateways that we deploy regionally throughout the world. The root of SpaceX’s success so far lies in our mission to keep all engineering and production in-house, which enables a tight feedback loop, nimble decision-making, and speedy deliverables. With millions of daily users worldwide already online, Starlink is truly a game-changer and levels the playing field for those who were previously unconnected.</p> <p>As a Principal Electrical Design Engineer on the Starlink team, you will have complete ownership over the development of millions of customer-facing products and devices that we ship directly to end users (Starlink dishes/user terminals, Wi-Fi routers, etc.). Our customers currently include teachers in the most remote parts of the Amazon, researchers in Antarctica, digital nomads who travel via RV, emergency responders, commercial airlines, cruise lines, and residential users who live in more rural or developing areas. You will be responsible for the design, implementation, and verification of the entire electrical system for these products. title: Principal Security Software Engineer (Starlink)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>PRINCIPAL SECURITY SOFTWARE ENGINEER (STARLINK)</strong></p> <p>At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe.</p> <p>As a Security Software Engineer you will influence the security of software across our product lines. We are looking for people with a track record of shipping reliable software and who have a broad understanding of the security design of today’s Internet, including the cryptographic primitives involved. You see the big picture, prioritize accordingly, and are comfortable with working at different levels of abstraction. Ideally, you have notable skills in one or more of the following:</p> <ul> <li>Software engineering</li> <li>Applied cryptography</li> <li>Network security</li> <li>Operating system security</li> <li>Secure/Authenticated boot</li> <li>Incident response and adversary detection</li> <li>Vulnerability research</li> </ul> <p>Being flexible, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams are paramount to success. If you are passionate about building quality products, love the challenges of outsmarting adversaries, and want to make an impact on an inter-planetary scale, then you will fit right in.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build security infrastructure for Starlink, including cryptographic services and other security-critical services</li> <li>Develop security features for Starlink systems, including our router, dish, gateways, and satellites</li> <li>Design security into factory processes and provide network services in support of this</li> <li>Maintain existing production systems and improve security posture via both direct implementation and recommendations to other teams</li> <li>Build prototypes and help identify, design, and test security improvements</li> <li>Further our mission of providing secure and reliable Internet to underserved communities</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or another STEM discipline and 8+ years of professional experience in security software development; including the TCP/IP stack as well as UDP based protocols</li> <li>Experienced in navigating large, complex, interactive systems</li> <li>Flexibility, communicating clearly, and establishing and maintaining productive working relationships with other engineering teams</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal</li> <li>Ability to work both independently and in a team</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to deal with ambiguity and to learn new technologies quickly</li> <li>Advanced degree in a technical or engineering discipline</li> </ul> <p><strong>ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>ITAR REQUIREMENTS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Sr. Network Security Engineer (VPN)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>SR. NETWORK SECURITY ENGINEER (VPN)</strong></p> <p>SpaceX is looking for a Sr. Network Security Engineer with deep expertise in network security technologies and a strong emphasis on remote access VPN solutions (particularly Tailscale and WireGuard). This role requires a strong networking, infrastructure, systems, and software background and will focus heavily on designing, deploying, managing, securing, and troubleshooting enterprise remote VPN infrastructure. The employee will be a member of the Network Security Engineering team. The ideal candidate will be flexible, excel at multi-tasking, and flourish in a fast-paced and challenging environment. This person should be a self-starter, self-motivator, and possess the ingenuity to excel in this position.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide subject matter expertise on network security, firewalls, zero-trust architectures, and industry best practices, with primary focus on modern remote access VPN technologies.</li> <li>Architect, design, deploy, and secure enterprise remote access VPN solutions end-to-end (including supporting components such as routers, exit nodes, and connectors), with strong emphasis on Tailscale, WireGuard, IPsec, and SSL-based implementations.</li> <li>Own the full lifecycle of remote access infrastructure from initial design and ground-up implementation through ongoing management, policy definition, client distribution, and performance optimization.</li> <li>Configure, deploy, and support VPN clients across multiple platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android) while performing advanced troubleshooting of complex connectivity and performance issues.</li> <li>Manage Linux-based infrastructure and network security systems with end-to-end ownership of configuration, custom tooling, and operational reliability.</li> <li>Develop automation and CI/CD workflows (Python or similar) to streamline deployment, policy enforcement, monitoring, and maintenance of remote access and security systems.</li> <li>Implement and support zero-trust remote access architectures; manage firewall policies and network security appliances with tight integration of VPN solutions.</li> <li>Serve as an escalation point for complex network security and remote connectivity challenges; collaborate cross-functionally with engineering and operations teams to gather requirements, design secure solutions, and communicate best practices.</li> <li>Monitor VPN performance, logs, and overall security posture; proactively identify issues, drive resolutions, and formalize processes and change management for remote access infrastructure.</li> <li>Apply system patches, perform periodic maintenance, and continuously improve the reliability and security of the remote access environment.</li> </ul> <p><strong>BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field and 5+ years of network security experience; title: Starlink Product Growth Director (Pricing & Monetization Strategy)
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of&nbsp;enabling human life on Mars.</p></div><p><strong>STARLINK PRODUCT GROWTH DIRECTOR (PRICING &amp; MONETIZATION STRATEGY)</strong></p> <p>Starlink consumer growth depends on a clear monetization strategy: the right plans and prices, a sharp value proposition, and an honest read of whether we are on goal. This role owns three things: plan and pricing strategy, growth team reporting, and the growth metrics.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will own plan and pricing strategy: how we structure product pricing and service plan pricing, the in-market value proposition, and willingness to pay. You will work with global go-to-market teams on performance goal setting and tracking, and you will model impact with financial planning and accounting before decisions go to market and after they are live.</p> <p>You will own the growth metrics and the growth team’s reporting against them: how the overall growth team is doing toward goal, where the gaps are, and who needs to fix them, where, and by when. You will understand what each market needs, when it needs it, and what it will take to close the gap. You support the business operations of in-market GTM teams and serve as the central orchestrator between those teams and Growth Central, so in-market teams have what they need to be successful.</p> <p><strong>RESPONSIBILITIES:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recommend and validate product pricing and service plan pricing structures; build the pre-launch impact model and the post-launch readout with financial planning and accounting</li> <li>Partner with global go-to-market teams on value propositions, willingness to pay, and performance goal setting and tracking by market</li> <li>Own the growth metrics and the growth scoreboard: report how the overall growth team is tracking to goal, name the gaps, and specify who owns the fix, in which market, and by when</li> <li>Maintain a clear view of in-market needs (offer, price, capacity, program, tooling) and what it will take to close each gap; title: Lead Data Migration Consultant
location: Reno, NV; San Ramon, CA; New York, NY; Remote - USA
jd_text: <p>Are you a detail-oriented consulting professional with a passion for delivering impactful software implementations? Do you excel at leading data migration projects, ensuring accuracy and integrity in every step of the process? Are you eager to collaborate with diverse teams to transform how investment management firms manage their operations? If so, we invite you to be a part of our innovative team.</p> <p>As a Data Migration Consultant at Ridgeline, you will be responsible for end-to-end functional implementations of the Ridgeline enterprise cloud software for investment management customers. At the intersection of investment management and technology, you will directly interact with both internal and customer stakeholders to define and deliver an agreed upon scope of services with an emphasis on data migrations. A consultative approach, innovative mindset, and collaborative spirit will be key as you build a track record of successful go-lives and make a meaningful impact on an industry primed for change.</p> <p>At Ridgeline, how we work matters as much as what we build. Ridgeliners act like owners, choose growth over comfort, and communicate with transparency. We assume positive intent, bias toward action, and bring solutions—not just problems. We celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and thrive in a resilient, collaborative, high-performing culture. If this excites you, we’d love to meet you.<br><br>You must be work authorized in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.</p> <p><strong>The impact you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead data conversion projects from inception to completion, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and accessibility.</li> <li>Collaborate with the implementation team and customers to gather requirements, understand their client management, portfolio accounting and performance data needs.</li> <li>Perform data mapping, transformation, and cleansing activities to meet project specifications.</li> <li>Validate, troubleshoot, and resolve any variances between source data and Ridgeline system generated data during the data conversion process, providing technical support and guidance to customers.</li> <li>Coordinate closely with project managers and functional consultants to ensure dependencies are identified and accurately accounted for as part of the broader onboarding process.&nbsp;</li> <li>Partner with Data Science team to improve inefficient processes, enhance system automation, and improve accuracy.</li> <li>Understand and apply Ridgeline’s value proposition and leverages our established implementation methodology to provide holistic solutions.</li> <li>Deliver accurate and timely responses to customers and the implementation team (verbal and written) related to data migration tasks.</li> <li>Contribute to department broader Customer Success initiatives to improve the onboarding experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we look for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics.</li> <li>5+ years of experience within the investment management industry.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of financial instrument types, asset management industry, and data related workflows (reconciliation, data flows, and end user reporting).</li> <li>In-depth knowledge of portfolio accounting systems and performance measurement methodologies, including financial transaction types and asset classes (equities, fixed income, and FX).</li> <li>Strong communication and client-facing skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong experience in SQL, data integration ETL tools and MS Excel.</li> <li>Proven track record of managing complex data projects from planning through execution.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.</li> <li>Ability to work independently and in team settings, managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Project management skills and/or experience leading successful implementations of enterprise SaaS solutions.</li> <li>Understanding of Agile principles and software development lifecycles.</li> <li>Experience coaching customers around tech stack, tooling, and processes.</li> <li>Comfortable working with Slack, JIRA/Confluence, and professional services applications such as Kantata.</li> <li>Basic understanding of AWS, APIs, and serverless technology.</li> <li>Chartered Financial Analyst designation a plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Ridgeline</strong></p> <p>Ridgeline is the first front-to-back system of record for investment managers. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><h2>Join us in building the future of finance.</h2> <p>Our mission is to democratize finance for all. <a href="https://www.cerulli.com/press-releases/cerulli-anticipates-124-trillion-in-wealth-will-transfer-through-2048" target="_blank">An estimated $124 trillion of assets</a> will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.</p></div><h2><strong>About the team + role</strong></h2> <p>We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Financial Crimes Team at Robinhood works across multiple verticals to protect our customers and ensure strict compliance with all relevant Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Sanctions regulations. As our team of passionate professionals continues to evolve the program, we are intensely focused on leveraging innovative thinking, advanced analytics, and cutting-edge technology to build a best-in-class Financial Crimes Program.</p> <p>As the Senior Specialist, Model Validation &amp; Analytics, you will play a key role in this mission by executing the validation, testing, tuning, and optimization of various transaction monitoring and filtering programs across Financial Crimes. You will partner closely with the AML Surveillance Team, engineering partners, and cross-functional verticals to ensure our financial crimes models and systems are accurately implemented, rigorously evaluated, and effectively calibrated to meet the diverse regulatory requirements of our domestic and international lines of business.</p> <p><strong>This role is based in our Denver, CO, New York, NY, or Westlake, TX office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.</strong></p> <p>At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. <br><br></p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Model Validation &amp; Review Execution: Perform independent, rigorous quantitative and qualitative analyses of rule-based and machine learning financial crimes surveillance models, filtering systems, and detection logic targeting model design, algorithm soundness, data integrity, and change management</li> <li>Technical Review &amp; Remediation: Act as a technical bridge within a fast-paced fintech environment by leveraging a solid foundation in data engineering, data modeling, and infrastructure. Collaborate seamlessly with software engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to decipher complex logic, evaluate model implementations, test data pipelines, and support the remediation of model issues.</li> <li>Optimization &amp; Model Tuning: Execute effective tuning methodologies and statistical analyses to continuously calibrate and enhance surveillance models. Work on strategic initiatives focused on maximizing risk detection capabilities while systematically reducing false positive volumes to ensure an efficient and effective alert review process.</li> <li>Logic &amp; Data Integrity Assurance: Conduct comprehensive data validation and logic testing initiatives to establish a strong foundation of data quality. Ensure the completeness, accuracy, and end-to-end reliability of critical data pipelines and inputs feeding our compliance models, mitigating systemic risks and safeguarding the integrity of our transaction monitoring ecosystem.</li> <li>Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as a knowledgeable subject matter resource in AML and Model Risk, providing practical domain insights and supporting cross-functional partners in understanding model logic, performance, and risk trade-offs.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build strong working partnerships across engineering, product, and compliance teams to ensure technical solutions are conceptually sound, effective, and aligned with our risk tolerance.</li> <li>Change &amp; Issue Management: Uphold change and issue management policies for covered systems, models, and solutions, ensuring end-to-end traceability and maintaining defensible documentation for internal audit and external regulators.</li> <li>AI Strategy &amp; Tech-Forward Adoption: Bring hands-on capabilities and experience leveraging AI tools, Large Language Models (LLMs), and automation techniques to enhance daily productivity, elevate deliverable quality, and optimize team workflows.</li> <li>Documentation &amp; Reporting: Author thorough, concise, and defensible validation reports, change and issues management documentation, and executive summaries that clearly explain model theory, testing logic, performance findings, and actionable recommendations for key stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What you bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Education: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in a quantitative, technical, or financial field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, or Finance)</li> <li>Experience: 5+ years of experience across AML, Financial Crimes, or risk management within the financial services or fintech industry, with a focus on model validation, quantitative analysis, or surveillance system management.</li> <li>Domain Expertise: 3+ years of direct experience in the verification, validation, testing, or tuning of AML rule-based systems and/or machine learning models, along with a working knowledge of core Model Risk Management (MRM) principles and governance standards.</li> <li>Technical &amp; Analytical Skills: Proficiency in SQL and experience using quantitative tools or programming languages (e.g., Python, R) to query large datasets, perform statistical analyses, and evaluate model performance.</li> <li>Adaptability &amp; Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical and quantitative concepts to non-technical partners, coupled with an ability to manage multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.</li> <li>Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.</li> <li>Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.</li> <li>Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.</li> <li>Employer-paid life &amp; disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.</li> <li>Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!</li> <li>Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.</strong></p> <p>Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands.
